The candle is stored in a precious glass that creates an ethereal glow as it catches the light of the flame within. Sleek and understated, it’s easy to merge this home fragrance accessory with your existing room décor. Grapefruit creates a clean, citrus element, its coolness contrasting with Amber's molten depths, simmering below the surface. Vetiver’s earthy accent creates a sturdy rootedness, connecting the aroma to the natural world, adding a smokiness to the candle’s base. Burn Time: 400 hours approx.

Housed in a glass printed with a pink feminine symbol and 9-karat yellow gold, the candle makes for a delicate addition to home décor. Infused with a powdery floral scent, the fragrance has a gentle, flowering presence made up of the petals of Rose and Magnolia. It softly unfurls into a natural Musk, creating a light base that’s comforting and familiar. Approximate burn times by size: Max 10: 60 hours Max 16: 150 hours Max 24: 400 hours Max 35: 800 hours

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Wanted Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Experience the thrill of the Azzaro Wanted Eau de Parfum, an intensely woody aroma that offers a contrast of spice and fresh accords with an energising twist. A scent made for pleasure seekers, the fragrance delivers a daily shot of confidence to those who dare to wear it. Opening with juniper berries, the vibrant fruity aroma refreshes the senses with a zesty breeze. At its core, grounding sage adds an earthy twist, while vetiver completes the fragrance for a rich, masculine base.

listings.rawTitle: Baobab Collection Max 10 Feathers Touareg

listings.description: Notes: Jasmine, White Musk. Baobab’s Pearls collection of scented candles pays tribute to the iridescent beauty of the milky gemstone, which have long been symbols of love and purity, and coined the ‘tears of the gods’. To reflect the collection’s theme, the candles are presented in pearlescent glass jars, expertly hand-blown by the house’s skilled artisans to create an ornate piece. Fusing powdery floral hues of Jasmine with the heady perfume of White Musk, the White Pearls edition unleashes an intoxicating aroma, that fills the air with an intimate ambiance. Featuring a centred wick that ensures a slow and even burn, the scented candle offers a long-lasting olfactory experience. Approximate burn times by size: Max 10: 60 hours Max 16: 150 hours Max 24: 400 hours Max 35: 800 hours

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Forte Rosa Palissandro Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: The Aqua Allegoria fragrance collection celebrates the wonders of the world. Each creation pays tribute to nature’s beauty and sweeps us up in a discovery of exceptional raw ingredients and notes, beautifully enhanced by our perfumer-explorers. Discover Rosa Palissandro Forte, the spicy freshness of rosewood meets both the delicacy of rose and the intensity of patchouli. The flower and wood combine to give a fragrance blending strength and sophistication. “Rosa Palissandro Forte is a homage to the beauty of rosewood. A fresh wood with floral and spicy tones, paired with the intensity of patchouli and sandalwood, wrapped in an elegant vine of roses.” - Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfumer Aqua Allegoria Forte, the intense collection, is a warm and enveloping journey to the heart of the world’s wonders: Eaux de Parfum celebrating the intense beauty of nature, revealed by the golden rays of a setting sun. A powerful symbol of Guerlain's commitment to the planet, the Aqua Allegoria Forte fragrances contain more than 90% natural origin*. The French beetroot alcohol used in their formulas comes from a network committed to responsible farming. The 200 mL refill extends the life cycle of the Aqua Allegoria bottle without compromising on quality. The spray unscrews manually to top up the bottle with a user-friendly refill, fitted with an anti-spill system. It cannot be used alone and is only compatible with refillable 75 mL and 125 mL bottles. *In accordance with the ISO 16128, calculation including water.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Rosa Verde Eau de Toilette 125ml
listings.description: The Aqua Allegoria fragrance collection celebrates the wonders of the world. Each creation pays tribute to nature’s beauty and sweeps us up in a discovery of exceptional raw ingredients and notes, beautifully enhanced by our perfumer-explorers. Discover Rosa Verde, a vibrant rose bathed in freshness, that captures the feel-good effect of a dive on a summer’s day. The exhilarating aquatic freshness of cucumber evokes the invigorating frisson of skin plunging into water. The caress of rose soon unfolds, like the wave of pleasure that floods the body under the water’s surface. A vibrant green floral duo, accented with a crisp pear note and mellowed by a white musk accord. For the first time, Guerlain is exploring the emotions aroused by the fragrances in its iconic collection through the prism of the Science of the Emotions, which studies the close links between scents and emotions. At the heart of this approach, the Rosa Verde perfume offers an instant feeling of pleasure and relaxation. “Rosa Verde is the memory of an invigorating and relaxing dive. A rose bathed in freshness that unfurls on skin like a wave of well-being.” - Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfume Creation Director & Perfumer. A real symbol of Guerlain’s commitment to the planet, the Aqua Allegoria fragrances are composed of more than 90% naturally-derived ingredients. The French beetroot alcohol contained in their formulas is sourced from suppliers committed to sustainable agriculture. The Aqua Allegoria fragrances are housed in a screw-top, refillable and recyclable bottle made in France from at least 15% recycled glass. The 200ml refill extends the life cycle of the Aqua Allegoria bottle without compromising on quality. The spray unscrews manually to top up the bottle with a user-friendly refill, fitted with an anti-spill system. It cannot be used alone and is only compatible with refillable 75ml and 125ml bottles.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN La Petite Robe Noire Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Guerlain offers its iconic feminine fragrance a new intensity: La Petite Robe Noire Parfum. This highly concentrated variation casts a new light on La Petite Robe Noire’s signature rose. A Paris by night, electrified by the beam of neon lights, to introduce a new contemporary little black dress. The iconic flower of La Petite Robe Noire, Centifolia rose from Grasse exudes a more distinct character than ever in this new Parfum. At the heart of a generous bouquet of roses, the precious absolute is enhanced by a praline accord with an irresistible gourmand feel. Like a dark case setting off a jewel’s radiance, patchouli, vanilla notes and tonka bean blend to reveal rose’s natural beauty.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Les Légendaires Nahema Eau De Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Nahema is part of Guerlain's Patrimoine Collection. A collection made of emblematic fragrances, composed for more than a century by 5 generations of Perfumers. These mythical pioneer perfumes compose a unique olfactive library, that the Maison Guerlain endeavours to preserve. Nahema is an enigmatic elixir whose muse is a rose with spellbinding charm. Its main olfactory note gradually transforms into a haunting presence. It took its creator four years to develop this rich and sumptuous women's fragrance. Designed by Raymond Guerlain, its iconic “inverted heart” bottle is underscored with graceful scrolls typical of Art Nouveau. Its avant-garde stopper, in the form of a hollowed heart, evokes the delicate romanticism of this perfumery masterpiece and represented a real technical feat at the time.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Pamplelune Eau De Toilette 125ml
listings.description: The radiant and tangy liveliness of grapefruit elevated by the vibrant, fruity note of blackcurrant bud. The patchouli imbues the scent with its intense sensuality. Create your own signature by pairing Pamplelune with Bergamote Calabria or Orange Soleia. To create your own olfactory signature, select your favourite duo among recommended options and spray each Aqua Allegoria on your skin one by one in equivalent quantities. Pamplelune is also available in travel size, to slip into your bag and carry around with you.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Les Légendaires Chant D'Arômes Eau De Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Chant d'Arômes is part of Guerlain’s Legendary fragrance collection. A collection made of emblematic fragrances, composed for more than a century by 5 generations of Perfumers. These mythical pioneer perfumes compose a unique olfactive library, that the Maison Guerlain endeavours to preserve. Created in 1965 by Jean-Paul Guerlain for his young fiancée, Chant d'Arômes signifies the language of flowers, each of which carries its own meaning of love. Chant d'Arômes is a charming spring bouquet. Filled with innuendo, its trail hints at fire beneath the ice. Designed by Raymond Guerlain, its iconic “inverted heart” bottle is underscored with graceful scrolls typical of Art Nouveau. Its avant-garde stopper, in the form of a hollowed heart, evokes the delicate romanticism of this perfumery masterpiece and represented a real technical feat at the time.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Bergamote Calabria Eau De Toilette 75ml

Create your own signature by pairing Bergamote Calabria with: Nerolia Vetiver, Herba Fresca, Pamplelune, Orange Soleia, Granada Salvia, Flora Cherrysia, Mandarine Basilic, Pera Granita, Rosa Rossa, Flora Salvaggia or Nettare Di Sole. To create your own olfactory signature, select your favourite duo among recommended options and spray each Aqua Allegoria on your skin one by one in equivalent quantities. Bergamote Calabria is also available in travel size, to slip into your bag and carry around with you.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN L'Homme Idéal Parfum 100ml
listings.description: The ideal man is a myth. But with L'Homme Idéal Eau de Parfum, GUERLAIN has made his fragrance a reality. A woody ambery combining three ingredients and three accords to boost your powers of seduction and awaken the ideal lover within you.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Forte Oud Yuzu Eau de Parfum 75ml

Wood and citrus meet to give a fragrance that plays with light and shadow.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Mon GUERLAIN Sparkling Bouquet Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: The Mon Guerlain fragrances are a fragrant manifesto of today's femininity. A multi-faceted woman: strong, free and sensual. Discover Mon Guerlain Sparkling Bouquet, a smiling fruity fresh amber. The fragrance impression of a radiant personality. A fragrance faceted like a jewel, which revisits Mon Guerlain’s essential ingredients in a fruity and intensely luminous register. The essential lavender-vanilla duo is beautifully enhanced by a sparkling pear note and a luminous Sambac jasmine. A captivating fruity fresh amber sillage with a magnetic charm. "It’s a pear-lavender sorbet which melts onto burnt vanilla." - Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfumer The “quadrilobe” bottle, created in 1908, established itself as one of Guerlain’s iconic bottles. Simple and graphic, it echoes an alchemist’s bottle and owes its name “quadrilobe” to its stopper, which is formed from one piece to obtain a shape resembling four lobes. One century later, beautifully enhanced by a luxurious glass weight and a golden adornment, this bottle offers a contrast between strong taut lines and sensual curves, expressing contemporary femininity.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Absolus Allegoria Florabloom Eau de Parfum 125ml
listings.description: Absolus Allegoria, the absolute fragrance collection, is an enchanting and mysterious journey to the heart of the world’s wonders once night falls: fragrance trails celebrating deep and powerful nature, revealed by striking contrasts in the moonlight. Discover Florabloom Absolu, an enchanting floral bouquet by moonlight. Tuberose becomes more sensual and hypnotic, accompanied by an enigmatic Four O’Clock Flower accord. The warm depth of sandalwood and the woody refinement of patchouli beautifully enhance this powerful and addictive composition, inspired by the fascinating spectacle of desert superblooms at nightfall. ”Florabloom Asbolus is a spellbinding nocturnal bouquet, in which tuberose becomes more sensual and bewitching than ever.” - Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfume Creation Director & Perfumer. A powerful symbol of Guerlain’s commitment to the planet, the Absolus Allegoria fragrances contain more than 90% natural-origin* ingredients. The French beetroot alcohol used in their formulas comes from a network committed to responsible farming. Floabloom Absolu comes in the Allegoria collection’s emblematic bottle which is made in France and crafted from 15% recycled glass. Its unscrewable spray and transparent lacquer allow it to be recycled more easily.  *in accordance with ISO 16128, calculation includes water.

listings.rawTitle: NEST New York Indigo Eau De Parfum 50 ml/1.7 fl oz.
listings.description: Inspired by the founder's 1992 trip to Europe, NEST New York's Indigo Eau de Parfum is an exploration of the Mediterranean, bursting with fruits and spices. The fragrance blends Italian lemon, orange bergamot, Moroccan tea, cashmere woods, and wild figs from the South of France, offering a moment of bliss with every spritz.

listings.rawTitle: NEST New York Madagascar Vanilla Perfume Oil 30ml / 1 fl oz.
listings.description: Made with hand-harvested ingredients to exude the richest aroma, the NEST New York Madagascar Vanilla Perfume Oil melts into the skin with a warm gourmand finish. Blended with hydrating baobab oil to nourish and provide a base for your scent to project from, this fragrance oil leaves behind a long-lasting aroma. As the cosy essence of vanilla bean and Madagascan vanilla evoke the sweet sense of tranquillity, coconut and cashmere woods bring a sunny, skin-like comfort to close the trail. Simply massage a few drops into across the pulse points for a powerful sillage.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme La Vie Est Belle Rose Extra Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Forming a part of the quintessential La Vie Est Belle collection, the Rose Extraordinaire Eau de Parfum offers a sensuous take on Lancôme’s iconic fragrance. The perfume is infused with three rose extracts, fresh water, damascena absolue and space rose, laced with iris concrete for a powdery twist. The woody, musky base lends depth to the fragrance, creating a captivating sillage that uplifts the senses with every spritz. The simple yet sophisticated glass flacon is reminiscent of the elegant scent within. The bottle is engraved with a rose and topped with a sparkling bow, finished with silver accents for a touch of luxury.

listings.rawTitle: TRUDON Elae Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: TRUDON Elae Eau de Parfum cocoons you in a luminous floral fragrance with a fresh, radiant character.  Moroccan neroli and crisp apple create a bright opening before unfolding into a sumptuous heart of Egyptian jasmine and creamy ylang-ylang. As the fragrance settles, Laotian benzoin adds warm, resinous depth, grounded by smooth Australian sandalwood for a softly sensual finish. Encased in a refined bottle with crisp lines and understated detailing, the fragrance feels effortlessly elegant from first spritz to final impression.

listings.rawTitle: TRUDON Bruma Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: TRUDON Bruma Eau de Parfum is magnetic and deeply sensual, balancing aromatic freshness with rich, smoky depth. From the first spritz, a violet-like iris brings soft, powdery elegance, intertwined with the distinctive green character of galbanum for a fresh yet intriguing opening. As the scent develops, dark leather adds a smooth, animalic intensity before earthy vetiver grounds the composition with a subtly smoky finish. Lingering close to the skin, the fragrance leaves a sophisticated and captivating trail.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Wood Sage & Sea Salt & English Oak & Hazelnut Scent Layering Gift Set
listings.description: Harness the art of fragrance layering with the Jo Malone layering set. Blend Wood Sage & Sea Salt with English Oak & Hazelnut to create a scent that exudes effortless elegance, freedom, warmth, and understated confidence. Set Contents: Wood Sage & Sea Salt 30ml A grounded yet effortlessly fresh scent, where earthy sage intertwines with the crisp tang of sea salt, sweeping your senses into a windswept escape. Subtle, natural and endlessly calming, this essence carries the spirit of the ocean wherever you go. English Oak & Hazelnut 9ml Dry and slightly smoky, English oak leads the way, its strength softened by the solid, creamy warmth of hazelnut, creating a comforting, harmonious balance.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Eros Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Italian Lemon, Mandarin, Mint Oil, Candied Apple. Heart Notes: Geranium Flower, Clary Sage Essence, Ambermax®. Base Notes: Cedarwood Atlas And Virginia, Vetiver Orpur Essence, Patchouli Coeur Orpur Essence, Sandalwood, Vanilla. Inspired by the Greek god of love, the Versace Eros Eau de Parfum embodies the impassioned hero, seducing the senses with a medley of masculine aromas. The fragrance opens with the bite of citrus, infusing Italian lemon with the unique hint of candied apple. A verdant heart of geranium flower and clary sage essence softens into an earthy base. Cedarwood, vetiver and patchouli are complimented by the sweetness of vanilla, completing this spirited expression of fervour and bravery.

listings.rawTitle: Baobab Collection Lodge Refill - Stones Lazuli (Various Sizes)
listings.description: Notes: Cardamom, Sea Salt, Musk. Imbue your personal spaces with the sophisticated aromas of Baobab’s Stones Lazuli diffuser, a carefully-blended home fragrance. Replenishing the diffuser's original glass flacon designed with hypnotic marbling and gold accents, the perfume refill will transport you to the banks of Tanzania where the dreamy, cobalt-blue stones reign supreme. An ornate addition to your interior décor in any room, the refillable home accessory is available in a choice of sizes.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Le Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Encouraging you to flaunt all the rules, Jean Paul Gaultier’s Scandal Le Parfum forgets convention, turning heads with its ambery floral olfactive experience. The eau de parfum intense entices with rich florals and sweet accords, conjuring up a deliciously audacious scent trail. An explosion of jasmine creates a dazzling introduction, before revealing an unexpected, yet addictive, heart of salted caramel. Intoxicating black vanilla rounds off the infatuating fragrance. Adorned with Jean Paul Gaultier’s iconic pair of legs, the hot red bottle causes more than a stir, reflective of the scent within.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Le Parfum 80ml
listings.description: Encouraging you to flaunt all the rules, Jean Paul Gaultier’s Scandal Le Parfum forgets convention, turning heads with its ambery floral olfactive experience. The eau de parfum intense entices with rich florals and sweet accords, conjuring up a deliciously audacious scent trail. An explosion of jasmine creates a dazzling introduction, before revealing an unexpected, yet addictive, heart of salted caramel. Intoxicating black vanilla rounds off the infatuating fragrance. Adorned with Jean Paul Gaultier’s iconic pair of legs, the hot red bottle causes more than a stir, reflective of the scent within.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Pour Homme Le Parfum 150ml
listings.description: House of Gaultier delivers a knockout performance with Scandal Pour Homme Le Parfum. Oozing confidence and sex appeal, the theatrical scent showcases a myriad of talents to have the crowd cheering for an encore. Imparting opening notes of geranium with an uppercut of sensual tonka bean, the seductive fragrance follows with a hit of smooth sandalwood to deliver a bold and triumphant performance. The scandalous scent is housed inside a captivating, blacked-out bottle, topped with a flamboyant gold crown to amplify its ‘King of the Ring’ status.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme La Vie Est Belle Eau de Parfum 150ml
listings.description: Indulge your senses with the La Vie est Belle Eau de Parfum, Lancôme's bestselling fragrance for her created by three of France's leading perfumers. Represented by Julia Roberts, the luminous perfume is a universal declaration to the beauty of life. A reimagining of a signature scent, it plays with the addition of magnolia essence to create a sparkling olfactory experience. The EDP opens with a ripe burst of pear and blackberry before capturing the romance of orange flower and jasmine sambac at the heart. It settles on a rich base of patchouli essence that has been sustainably sourced to create an opulent olfactive experience. Revamped in an eco-conscious, refillable bottle, the fragrance takes a step toward a brighter tomorrow, celebrating the timeless iconicity of the scent again and again.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun Musc Invisible Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Comforting like your favourite pair of old jeans, Juliette Has a Gun’s Musc Invisible Eau de Parfum layers dreamy and nostalgic notes on a creamy base of musk. The soothing scent opens with clean, fresh tones of jasmine absolute and cotton flower, settling on a base of white musk for a warm, comforting finale. Evoking feelings of familiarity with its powdery musk facets, Musc Invisible is perfect as an everyday signature scent.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun Not a Perfume Superdose Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Juliette Has A Gun’s ground-breaking fragrance, now intensified. Not A Perfume Superdose is a more concentrated edition of its iconic predecessor, veiling the skin in a fresh and elegant scent that is one of a kind. Infused with just one note, Cetalox, the perfume’s composition adapts to your chemistry as it wears on the skin. What’s left behind is a clean, musky scent that is truly unique.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun Musc Invisible Eau de Parfum 7.5ml
listings.description: Comforting like your favourite pair of old jeans, Juliette Has a Gun’s Musc Invisible Eau de Parfum layers dreamy and nostalgic notes on a creamy base of musk. The soothing scent opens with clean, fresh tones of jasmine absolute and cotton flower, settling on a base of white musk for a warm, comforting finale. Evoking feelings of familiarity with its powdery musk facets, Musc Invisible is perfect as an everyday signature scent.

listings.rawTitle: Laboratory Perfumes Gorse Cream 200ml
listings.description: The Laboratory Perfumes Gorse Cream 200ml is an ultra-rich body moisturiser that glides on smoothly, leaving skin feeling silky and nourished. Enriched with a multi-vitamin complex including vitamins E, B3, B5, and B6, the formula helps soothe and visibly strengthen the skin’s natural barrier. Antioxidant-rich plant extracts, including bilberry, acai, pomegranate and mango, support hydration while promoting a radiant finish. Infused with vitamin C, the cream encourages a luminous, refreshed appearance.

listings.rawTitle: RITUALS Fleurs de l’Himalaya  - Wild Orchid & Himalayan Peony - Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Embodying the age-old grace and beauty of the Valley of Flowers, the Rituals Fleurs de l’Himalaya Eau de Parfum is an uplifting floral fragrance formed of 87.4% natural ingredients. Enchanting notes of wild orchid and Himalayan peony intertwine with a comforting cotton musk to form a scent reminiscent of a fresh breeze on a Spring day. The perfume captures the natural serenity and sanctity of the Himalayan Mountains in Tibet, inspiring wearers to seek out inner-tranquillity and peace.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Eau De Beauté Micellar Lotion 200ml
listings.description: The first essential skincare step, Eau de Beauté from Guerlain, concentrates all the effectiveness of a make-up remover, cleanser and toner for quick and effective cleansing in just one step. This unique, almost gel-like liquid is applied with a cotton pad to refresh the skin like beneficial dew. Its micelles – surfactant molecules – gently cleanse and trap the slightest impurity and every last trace of make-up on the face and eyes, while toning the skin. Gentle, pure and incredibly fresh, skin is hydrated and plumped up in a single step.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Flora Salvaggia Eau De Toilette 125ml
listings.description: A revitalising watermelon note refreshes a wildflower accord tinged with the powdery facets of iris and violet, and illuminated by a bouquet of white flowers. Create your own signature by pairing Flora Salvaggia with: Bergamote Calabria, Rosa Rossa, Granada Salvia or Flora Cherrysia. To create your own olfactory signature, select your favourite duo among recommended options and spray each Aqua Allegoria on your skin one by one in equivalent quantities.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Nettare Di Sole Eau De Toilette Refill 200ml
listings.description: Refill your precious Aqua Allegoria bottle in one simple step with the Nettare Di Sole refill format. As though bees had only pollinated perfumery’s most exquisite flowers: magnolia, rose and Sambac jasmine. A beautiful honey with an icy aquatic note evoking the heat of the sun caressing the skin. Create your own signature by pairing Nettare Di Sole with: Bergamote Calabria, Orange Soleia or Mandarine Basilic. To create your own olfactory signature, select your favourite duo among recommended options and spray each Aqua Allegoria on your skin one by one in equivalent quantities.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Les Légendaires Insolence Eau De Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Insolence is part of Guerlain’s Legendary fragrance collection. A collection made of emblematic fragrances, composed for more than a century by 5 generations of Perfumers. These mythical pioneer perfumes compose a unique olfactive library, that the Maison Guerlain endeavours to preserve. Insolence is a spark in the eyes, an intrepid smile. Insolence is a careless grace, an ironic elegance, an amused silence. Created in 2006, Insolence celebrates this surprising, free and daring femininity. An impertinent creation with powder hints which is built around a floral violet and iris duo with orange blossom. Designed by Raymond Guerlain, its iconic “inverted heart” bottle is underscored with graceful scrolls typical of Art Nouveau. Its avant-garde stopper, in the form of a hollowed heart, evokes the delicate romanticism of this perfumery masterpiece and represented a real technical feat at the time.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Les Légendaires Samsara Eau De Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Samsara is part of Guerlain’s Legendary fragrance collection. A collection made of emblematic fragrances, composed for more than a century by 5 generations of Perfumers. These mythical pioneer perfumes compose a unique olfactive library, that the Maison Guerlain endeavours to preserve. Samsara is an elixir of seduction for a woman who has found harmony and balance, which is notably conveyed through the composition's raw materials : the sandalwood and a jasmine used only for religious offerings until then. Designed by Raymond Guerlain, its iconic “inverted heart” bottle is underscored with graceful scrolls typical of Art Nouveau. Its avant-garde stopper, in the form of a hollowed heart, evokes the delicate romanticism of this perfumery masterpiece and represented a real technical feat at the time.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN L’Homme Idéal L'Intense Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: The Ideal Man is a myth. But thanks to Guerlain, his fragrance is a reality with L'Homme Idéal Intense. The ideal eau de parfum intense? Fiery spices, bewitching tonka bean and smoky notes for an utterly intriguing trail. A vigorous, elegant, woody-spicy-oriental fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN L’Homme Idéal L'Intense Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: The Ideal Man is a myth. But thanks to Guerlain, his fragrance is a reality with L'Homme Idéal Intense. The ideal eau de parfum intense? Fiery spices, bewitching tonka bean and smoky notes for an utterly intriguing trail. A vigorous, elegant, woody-spicy-oriental fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN L’Homme Idéal Extrême Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: The Ideal Man is a myth. But thanks to Guerlain, his fragrance is a reality with L'Homme Idéal Intense. L'eau de parfum extrême? A woody oriental fragrance that will allow you to remain a man who is talented to the extreme, for everything.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Mon GUERLAIN Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Mon Guerlain Eau de Parfum is a fragrance that enhances exceptional raw materials: french lavender, sambac jasmine, sandalwood and vanilla tahitensis. It expresses the quintessence of a history replete with experiences, nourished by success, expertise and generosity, all infused with the same passion since 1828.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Mon GUERLAIN Eau De Parfum Intense 100ml
listings.description: The Mon Guerlain fragrances are a fragrant manifesto of today's femininity. A multi-faceted woman: strong, free and sensual. Discover Mon Guerlain Eau de Parfum Intense, a sensual and unique woody amber. The vanilla tincture, artisan-produced by Guerlain, blends with vanilla Tahitensis and smoldering patchouli. They accompany lavender and sandalwood, forming a unique and sensual woody amber composition. "Mon Guerlain Intense is a confident sensual enveloping signature, that no ones forgets. It is this heavy dose of lush vanilla that creates an addictive quality, while offering up plenty of elegance and mystery" - Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfumer The “quadrilobe” bottle, created in 198, established itself as one of Guerlain’s iconic bottles. Simple and graphic, it echoes an alchemist’s bottle and owes its name “quadrilobe” to its stopper, which is formed from one piece to obtain a shape resembling four lobes. One century later, beautifully enhanced by a luxurious glass weight and a golden adornment, this bottle offers a contrast between strong taut lines and sensual curves, expressing contemporary femininity.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Shalimar Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: L'Eau de Parfum Shalimar is a mythic fragrance with bergamot, iris and vanilla notes ; an intense wake with a touch of impertinence, always glowing which embodies skin-caressing sensuality with a hint of the forbidden. Inspired by the passionate love story between an emperor and an Indian princess, Shalimar, which means "temple of love" in Sanskrit, symbolises the promise of eternal love forevermore. It is a fragrance of desire. In 1925, the Shalimar bottle designed by Raymond Guerlain won first prize at the Paris Decorative Arts Exhibition. Its curves were inspired by the basins of the famous Shalimar gardens. The fan stopper with its sapphire transparency recalls the garden's eternally gushing water.

listings.rawTitle: MCM Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Fusing the art of classic perfumery with the latest innovative technologies, the MCM Eau de Parfum is driven by the currents of wanderlust to deliver a remarkable olfactive journey that intrigues the senses. Deconstructed through expressive accords, the scent opens with hyper-real raspberry, offset by a bloom of hand-picked jasmine. Nuances of warm amber coincide with clean textured woods to create a tranquil realm. The universal scent is cleverly presented inside a miniature remake of the legendary Stark backpack, the perfect nod to the brand's travel DNA.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake Le Sel d’Issey Eau de Toilette Spring Giftset
listings.description: Bright and invigorating, the Issey Miyake Le Sel d’Issey Eau de Toilette Spring Gift Set pairs the woody marine fragrance with a matching shower gel. Set Contents: Le Sel d’Issey Eau de Toilette 50ml The woody marine fragrance combines notes of warming cedarwood with spicy ginger and crisp marine seawood for a salted twist. The scent trail feels both fresh and sophisticated. Le Sel d’Issey Shower Gel 50ml This shower gel lathers into a rich, airy foam that gently sweeps away daily impurities, leaving skin refreshed and delicately scented with the woody marine fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: NEOM Wellbeing Essential Oil Blend Scent Discovery Set
listings.description: Featuring a scent to suit your every mood, the NEOM Essential Oil Blend Scent Discovery Set includes six trial-sized vials of the brand’s best-selling well-being blends. Set Contents: Perfect Night’s Sleep Essential Oil Blend 3ml Infused with soothing lavender, chamomile and patchouli notes, perfect before bed. Bedtime Hero Essential Oil Blend 3ml Offering a lavender alternative, this chamomile, ylang ylang and cedarwood scent helps you to drift off. Real Luxury Essential Oil Blend 3ml The iconic original oil blend, made with jasmine, lavender and sandalwood to promote an air of relaxation. Complete Bliss Essential Oil Blend 3ml An energising aroma infused with uplifting lime, black pepper and blush rose. Happiness Essential Oil Blend 3ml Neroli, mimosa and lemon unite in this zesty scent, as it encourages a serene ambience. Feel Refreshed Essential Oil Blend 3ml Featuring Sicilian lemon and fresh basil, this blend invigorates the senses.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Exclusive Pen Spray Trio Set
listings.description: The Marc Jacobs Daisy Trio Penspray Gift Set presents a collection of three signature floral fragrances, each housed in a travel-sized penspray. This set showcases a spectrum of scents, from the optimistic and sophisticated original Daisy to the adventurous Daisy Wild and its captivatingly intense counterpart. The selection offers a fragrance for every mood and occasion, providing a unique olfactory experience that embodies a distinct feminine character. Set Contents: Daisy Eau de Toilette Penspray 10ml A radiant floral perfume opens with wild berries. The scent develops with a heart of white violets and jasmine, settling on a warm sandalwood base for a sophisticated finish. Daisy Wild Eau de Parfum Penspray 10ml A bold, feminine fragrance capturing the essence of nature. This scent combines notes of banana blossom accord with jasmine and macadamia, grounded by a base of sandalwood and vetiver des sables. Daisy Wild Intense Eau de Parfum 10ml An intense floral scent inspired by vibrant, unexpected findings in nature. This captivating fragrance features banana blossom and jasmine extract, enriched with a warm base of amber and sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa 68 Perfume Mist 90ml
listings.description: Embodying paradise on earth, the Cheirosa 68 Perfume Mist is a sparkling floral perfume from the iconic fragrance experts at Sol de Janeiro. Symbolic of a tropical paradise, thrilling top notes of pink dragonfruit and lychee transcend the senses to exotic shores and unknown delights. Carrying on a distant sea breeze, fresh notes of Brazillian jasmine, ocean air and hibiscus add an uplifting freedom to the scent, while creamy vanilla and rich sun musk add a sensual heat to the body mist. Fresh, floral and fun, the dreamy body spray embraces the senses to create the feel of an endless summer. Packaging may vary.

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Sol & Cheer Set (Worth £33)
listings.description: Rio days are never far away with the Sol de Janeiro Sol & Cheer Set, a trio of travel-sized sprays in iconic sunny scents. Featuring the creamy vanilla and pistachio Cheirosa 62, radiant floral Cheirosa 91 and the sugared violet Cheirosa 59, mist on your favourite or layer as desired for a more intense Sol de Janeiro trail. Set Contents: Cheirosa 62 30ml The brand's bestselling, inaugural scent blended with creamy pistachio, hazelnut and vanilla notes. Cheirosa 91 30ml A juicy, vibrant aroma with Rio pink rose and freshly picked passionfruit. Cheirosa 59 30ml A lively blend of vanilla orchid, sugared violet and sheer sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent MYSLF Eau de Parfum 100ml Gift Set
listings.description: The YSL MYSLF Eau de Parfum Gift Set includes a refined trio, perfect for the modern man. Centred around a bold woody scent, the set features the full-sized fragrance with a travel spray for fragrance on the go, complete with a sleek pouch for everyday use. Set Contents: YSL MYSLF Eau de Parfum 100ml Opening with fresh sparkling bergamot, the scent awakens the senses at first spritz. At its heart lies orange blossom absolute, bringing a vibrant floral nuance while a sensual base of patchouli and musky woods creates a powerful, long-lasting trail. YSL MYSLF Eau de Parfum Travel Size 10ml A travel-sized version of the signature scent, perfect for topping up throughout the day. YSL Bag Pouch A branded pouch designed to store your essentials in style.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradoxe Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: An invitation to express all dimensions of your identity, Prada’s Paradoxe Eau de Parfum is designed as a celebration of being never the same, always yourself. The refillable feminine fragrance encapsulates the essence of Prada, exploring multi-dimensional self-expression and liberation. The floral ambery fragrance opens with light, crisp notes of neroli, extracted as the flower blooms to capture its freshness. At the heart, amber accords add a vibrant warmth, leading into an intense and long-lasting depth of a new musk molecule. A reinvention of Prada’s iconic triangle logo, the Paradoxe bottle arrives with a tilted, yet powerfully grounded design. The triangular-shaped bottle is softened with rounded corners, while the coral pink fragrance within contrasts with Prada’s black coat of arms.

listings.rawTitle: NEOM Wellbeing Real Luxury Essential Oil Blend 10ml
listings.description: Take time out for yourself with the NEOM Wellbeing Real Luxury Essential Oil Blend, an expertly blended formula that combines 24 of the purest essential oils to help banish feelings of stress while drawing in a feeling of calm. Forming part of the Scent to De-Stress Range™, the mind-soothing oil blend is infused with the brand's Real Luxury™ fragrance, a natural scent that fuses essential oils of Lavender, Jasmine and Brazilian Rosewood to help leave the mind and body feeling calm and de-stressed. When added to your NEOM oil diffuser, a mist of natural fragrance is released into the air to create a calming and relaxing atmosphere. Can also be added to a warm bath or massage oil. Packaging may vary.

listings.rawTitle: The White Company Fireside Mini Home Scenting Set
listings.description: Cosy up next to the soft, smoky scent of a burning log fire with The White Company’s Fireside Mini Home Scenting Set. Woody and warm, let the inviting aroma comfort the senses and envelop your space in a soothing air. Featuring fresh birch, clove leaf and rich patchouli notes, all complemented by a creamy base of vanilla and amber, the fragrance set is perfect for enhancing your tranquil home ambience. Set Contents: Votive Candle 70g Perfect for those relaxing moments before bed, by the bathtub or when coming in from the brisk outdoors, let this long-lasting blend fill your space with its carefully curated scent at the strike of a match. Mini Diffuser 50ml Delivering long-lasting fragrance diffusion, this luxury reed diffuser freshens your interiors with the warming scent continuously. Mini Home Spray 15ml Refresh each room in a quick spritz with this aromatic home spray. Made with high-quality oils, the formula soothes the senses with its warm woody fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: OUAI Instant Ouai-Cation Kit 100ml
listings.description: Sunshine-inspired scents for your suitcase, the OUAI Instant Ouai-Cation Kit stars four mini fragrances from its bestselling hair and body mist collection. From all corners of the world, indulge in the beachy warmth of St. Barts to the vibrant citrus groves of Santorini, wearing each transportive blend alone or layering for a customisable trail. Set Contents: Hair & Body Mist – Ibiza 25ml A gourmand mist inspired by sun-soaked days and late nights in San Antonio, rich in cocoa, coffee and vanilla nuances. Hair & Body Mist – Santorini 25ml A fresh, effortless mist of orange, peach and honeysuckle, that whisks the senses away to the cobalt landscapes of Santorini. Hair & Body Mist – St. Barts 25ml An uplifting citrus floral fragrance that reminisces on sandy stretches with notes of ocean sea breeze, orange blossom and skin-like musk. Hair & Body Mist – Melrose Place 25ml A floral spray that captures the cool spirit of California with a bright, sparkling burst of champagne, lychee and velvety rose.

listings.rawTitle: The White Company Seychelles Large Home Scenting Set
listings.description: Create a welcoming atmosphere with The White Company’s Seychelles Large Home Scenting Set. The luxurious trio imbues your living space with a soothing aquatic aroma that exudes tranquility. Featuring a contrasting blend of fresh and warm accords, including amber, vanilla and coconut, the set transforms your home into an idyllic paradise. Set Contents: Seychelles Candle 140g Seychelles Home Spray 100ml Seychelles Diffuser 150ml

listings.rawTitle: NEOM Wellbeing Bedtime Hero Essential Oil Blend
listings.description: Inhale the calming serenity of natural wellbeing brand NEOM Organic London ’s Bedtime Hero Essential Oil Blend ; a complex aromatherapy blend of 100% natural essential oils to help you wind down and get you in the mood for a deep and restful slumber. Part of the label’s Scent to Sleep™ range, the blend boasts a sweet, fruity and fresh fragrance from 11 essential oils in its purest form, including Chamomile, Ylang Ylang and Cedarwood – the perfect sleep-enhancing alternative for those who are anti-Lavender. Use it in your NEOM Wellbeing Pod or add a few drops to a dreamy pre-bedtime bath. 85% would use the Bedtime Hero Programme as the natural solution to a better night’s sleep* Note: Up to 30 uses (5-10 drops per use)

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Noir Extreme All Over Body Spray 150ml
listings.description: Add dimension to your fragrance layering routine with the TOM FORD Noir Extreme All Over Body Spray. Inspired by the woody-amber cologne, wear alone or under the eau de parfum for an enhanced trail. Balancing two contrasting blends, the spray opens with spiced mandarin and cardamom to lend an invigorating edge, before Indian Kulfi accord mingles with the sweet sensuality of amber and sandalwood. Specially designed with 360° nozzle technology, ensure even, all-over scent coverage across the skin and clothes.

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Exclusive Iconic Cheirosa Duo
listings.description: Inspired by the beach culture of Brazil, Sol de Janeiro’s Exclusive Iconic Cheirosa Duo stars two sun-kissed sprays that imbue an irresistible summer scent. Arriving in vibrant, travel-friendly misting bottles that slot perfectly into your bag, take your favourite fragrance with you on the go to top up your addictive cheirosa aroma. Set Contents: Cheirosa 62 Perfume Mist 90ml The iconic first installment of Sol’s scent collection, Cheirosa 62 is a warm gourmand spray with notes of pistachio, salted caramel and vanilla. Cheirosa 48 Perfume Mist 90ml Brimming with juicy notes and fresh aquatic-citrus nuances, the 48 body mist enlivens the senses with its sparkling blend, before drying down with a pink musk and vanilla cloud medley.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani I Will Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: A bold expression of modern masculinity, Giorgio Armani's I Will Eau de Parfum leaves an intense and unmistakable trail. The fresh fragrance opens with notes of Calabrian bergamot, leading into a heart of soft lavender essence. At the base, dark woods and rich leather add a smoky sensuality to Madagascan vanilla. Encased in a striking black and gold architectural bottle, the perfume lasts up to 24 hours*, transitioning effortlessly from day to night. *Consumer test, 69 subjects.

listings.rawTitle: Armani My Way Eau de Parfum - 90ml
listings.description: Top Notes : Bergamia, Citrus Blossom, White Flowers. Heart Notes : Jasmine, Tuberose, White Flowers. Base Notes : Musk, Vanilla, Cedar Wood. Escape the boredom of everyday life with the Armani My Way Eau de Parfum. Taking you on an olfactive journey through a flourishing garden, the perfume is a blossoming bouquet of floral notes. A fluid fusion of rich hues, the fragrance invites its wearer to broaden her horizons, become unapologetically herself and live in her own way. Opening with a citrus accord, the hopeful top notes uplift the senses to inspire positivity. Making way for the potent heart, the fragrance dives into a floral collection. Jasmine, Tuberose and White Flowers are seamlessly blended, illuminating the perfume with delicate hues. Almost undetectably, the fragrance finds its final form, merging musky hues. Cedarwood and Vanilla intertwine to create a bittersweet base, lingering on the skin to ignite the senses.   Refillable bottle.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Black Orchid Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: A sultry fantasy, inspired by the rarest of flowers. Tom Ford’s Black Orchid Eau de Parfum Spray laces dark and tempting accords together in a spiced floral fusion, with hints of the extraordinary orchid seeping through. Toasted black truffle collides with sparkling bergamot in an unsuspecting opening, while black orchid and plum mingle in the heart of the fragrance, emboldening the sensual composition. Patchouli grounds the parfum spray with a sweet musky aroma that will only leave you craving more. Housed in a fluted, black glass bottle that is a streamlined, modern interpretation of 1920s and 1930s architecture. The dark paradisial eau de parfum is a timeless fragrance and a homage to daring glamour and iconic style.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent La Nuit De L'Homme Le Parfum Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Seduce your senses with the La Nuit De L'Homme Le Parfum Eau de Parfum from Yves Saint Laurent . Opening with a fresh burst of Bergamot and Anise, the masculine fragrance dives into a heart of spicy Black Pepper and aromatic Lavender,  before settling on a captivating Patchouli and Vetiver base. The EDP is housed in a curved bottle with a hexagonal cap. Top Notes: Bergamot, Anise. Heart Notes: Black Pepper, Lavender, Labdanum. Base Notes: Patchouli, Vanilla, Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Dylan Blue EDT 50ml Vapo
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Fougère Top Notes: Bergamot, Fig Leaves, Grapefruit. Heart Notes: Violet, Black Pepper, Ambrox, Papyrus. Base Notes: Saffron, Tonka Bean, Incense. Immerse yourself in the fresh, woody facets of Versace’s Dylan Blue Eau de Toilette. The EDT is a seductive force to admire, blended with precious natural ingredients. Characterised by high-quality musk, the fragrance is edged in carnal detail. Bergamot, fig leaves and grapefruit offer a vibrant opening, crashing into a wave of aquatic notes. Violet, black pepper and papyrus power the heart, before plunging to the pulsating depths of tonka bean, saffron and incense. The EDT sets in a warm, sensual dry down.

listings.rawTitle: NEOM Wellbeing Orange Blossom and Neroli Essential Oil Blend 10ml
listings.description: Encourage a lively, exciting atmosphere with the NEOM Orange Blossom and Neroli Essential Oil Blend. Bursting with fresh, fruity scents, the essential oil blend is ideal for promoting a warm, friendly ambience. Zesty and refreshing, the oil combines Orange Blossom, Neroli and Ylang-Ylang to evoke sun-kissed visions. Versatile and multi-use, the blend can be used with your NEOM Wellbeing Pod, in your bath water or for a massage.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Le Parfum 100ml
listings.description: I Want Choo pays homage to the glamorous and daring Jimmy Choo woman. Bursting with energy, the Eau de Parfum pairs sparkling florals with irresistible woody and amber notes to create a sensuous sillage. The scent’s radiance can be attributed to a joyful pear and golden gardenia elixir, warmed by sweet jasmine and ambrette in its heart. Creamy sandalwood marries with praline at the dry down, lending the fragrance irresistible richness, before finishing with an earthy moss accord.

listings.rawTitle: Armani Stronger With You Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Lose yourself in the aromas within Armani Stronger With You Eau de Toilette. Spicy and enticing, the fragrance opens with shocking notes of cardamom and pink pepper, instantly invigorating the senses. An elegant heart of sage offers an empowering element to the aftershave, leading hypnotically into a base of creamy crystallised chestnut. Sweet, playful vanilla rounds off the cocktail in a vulnerable, humble manner, making the fragrance destined to captivate and beguile.

listings.rawTitle: NEOM Wellbeing Feel Refreshed Essential Oil Blend 10ml
listings.description: Enliven the mind with the NEOM Wellbeing Feel Refreshed Essential Oil Blend, an expertly blended formula that combines 24 of the purest essential oils to help awaken a tired mind and encourage clear thinking. Forming part of the Scent to Boost Your Energy Range™, the invigorating oil blend is infused with the brand's Feel Refreshed™ fragrance, a natural scent that fuses essential oils of Sicilian Lemon and Fresh Basil to leave the mind and body feeling clear and energised. When added to your NEOM oil diffuser, a mist of natural fragrance is released into the air to create an uplifting atmosphere. Can also be added to a warm bath or massage oil.

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Exclusive Summer Scent Duo
listings.description: Featuring two iconic fragrances from Sol de Janeiro’s Cheirosa collection, a word in Brazil which means to ‘smell delicious,’ the Summer Scent Duo whisks the senses away to olfactive paradise. Set Contents: Cheirosa 59 Perfume Mist 90ml Inspired by the year 1959, when singer João Gilberto released the album Chega de Saudade, this best-selling perfume exudes joy. Nuances of vanilla orchid mingle with amber, plum and refreshing vetiver for a warm and uplifting finish. LF Exclusive Cheirosa 48 Perfume Mist 90ml A summer’s day spent lazing by the pool, perfectly encapsulated in a mist. Reminiscent of 1948, the year when the bikini was first spotted in Brazil, the sun-soaked fragrance pairs juicy coconut water and guava nectar with a zesty twist of lemon to create a tropical aroma.

listings.rawTitle: ESPA Restorative Aromatherapy Single Oil 10ml
listings.description: Take a moment for yourself with the ESPA Restorative Aromatherapy Oil. To be used in conjunction with the brand’s Diffuser Pod, this oil stars a harmonious fragrance blend. Notes of Rose Geranium, Orange, Lavender and Palmarosa infuse the surrounding air, designed to restore a sense of balance with a bright, positive aroma. Crafted to add luxury to any living space, this aromatherapy oil can also be dropped into your bath for an ultimate end-of-day treat.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Le Parfum 90ml
listings.description: YSL’s signature scent of freedom, now at its most intense, Libre Le Parfum inspires and empowers its wearer to live life authentically and unapologetically. Reinvented with a spicy saffron accord, the floral fragrance pays tribute to the fierce, bold and untamed YSL woman, embodied by ambassador and British singer-songwriter Dua Lipa. The fragrance makes an olfactive statement by opening with spicy notes of ginger and saffron accord, harvested from YSL’s Ourika Gardens in Morocco. A floral heart of orange blossom and lavender is set against a smooth, ambery base, fusing vanilla, honey and vetiver for added depth and intensity. Housed in the signature Libre bottle, the perfume arrives in a fiery shade to reflect the key saffron notes of the scent within.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Le Parfum 30ml
listings.description: YSL’s signature scent of freedom, now at its most intense, Libre Le Parfum inspires and empowers its wearer to live life authentically and unapologetically. Reinvented with a spicy saffron accord, the floral fragrance pays tribute to the fierce, bold and untamed YSL woman, embodied by ambassador and British singer-songwriter Dua Lipa. The fragrance makes an olfactive statement by opening with spicy notes of ginger and saffron accord, harvested from YSL’s Ourika Gardens in Morocco. A floral heart of orange blossom and lavender is set against a smooth, ambery base, fusing vanilla, honey and vetiver for added depth and intensity. Housed in the signature Libre bottle, the perfume arrives in a fiery shade to reflect the key saffron notes of the scent within.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Oud Minérale Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Embark on a new adventure with the Tom Ford Oud Minérale Eau de Parfum, a fragrance that summons the elements of the earth and sea into one hypnotic aroma. Water and wood combine to produce a sensational array of accords, powered by a rich oud aura. Fresh pink peppercorn mingles with oceanic accords to reveal a tantalising celebration of nature. Elements of salt and seaweed embark on a mystical journey out to sea, while fir, amber and agarwood remain grounded on earth. A smouldering oud blend ignites the scent with sensual, deep woods that dry down at the base, with rich musk that clings to the skin for a trail that lingers.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Dark Leather Eau de Parfum Spray 90ml
listings.description: Like the brushing of soft leather on the skin, Viktor & Rolf’s Spicebomb Dark Leather Eau de Parfum Spray ignites the senses with a magnetic scent that oozes refined sophistication. Enigmatic notes of spiced black pepper and warm nutmeg pierce through a smoked incense air, encapsulating the aroma of a cocktail bar late at night. To contrast, cinnamon lends its complex olfactive character to enhance the cologne with a sweet, subversive edge, before settling on a bed of dark leather and tobacco to capture a somewhat nostalgic allure. Housed in the iconic grenade-style flacon, the fragrance bottle features matte black coating to reiterate its sensual, luxurious charm.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy L'Interdit Eau de Toilette 80ml
listings.description: Givenchy presents L’Interdit Eau de Toilette, a distinctly sensual fragrance that dares you to experience the thrill of the forbidden. Embracing the skin with a radiant floral bouquet and nuances of musk, the scent offers an intoxicating olfactory experience. The EDT is introduced with a luminous elixir of orange, bergamot and mandarin. Tuberose and jasmine add depth to the fragrance, wrapped in a refreshing orange blossom accord. Defying conventions, a dry down of vetiver and patchouli juxtaposes against creamy, leathery notes of cistus flower, musk and sandalwood. Succumb to your desires with this daring fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Perfect Absolute Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: As moodier seasons and after-dark moments arrive, reach for Marc Jacobs Perfect Absolute Eau de Parfum – a sensual, refined gourmand-floral fragrance. Opening with a syrupy-sweet caramelised fig accord, this intense yet wearable blend leaves an addictive trail in your wake. Beneath the dessert-like fruity top lies jasmine absolu, a creamy and slightly exotic infusion, blooming at the heart with elegant depth. Once the scent matures, the dry-down is warm and enveloping thanks to rich amber, creating a resinous core. The result is a bold, feminine scent profile that lasts for hours and stays true to the label’s decadent DNA.

listings.rawTitle: Clarins Clarinsmen Super Moisture Balm 50ml
listings.description: Replenish skin with the Clarins ClarinsMen Super Moisture Balm, a rich yet comfortable moisturiser designed to hydrate and soothe, even in extreme climates. Powered by moisture-locking houseleek and leaf of life extracts, the restorative balm helps support skin hydration while revitalising tired-looking skin. Melting effortlessly into the complexion, it leaves skin feeling soft, comfortable and replenished.

listings.rawTitle: NEOM Perfect Night's Sleep Bundle (Worth £101)
listings.description: Take a moment to unwind with the NEOM Perfect Night's Sleep Bundle. Upgrading your pre-sleep ritual, the nurturing trio transform your evening into the ultimate pampering session. Set Contents: Luxury Magnesium Bath Milk 300ml A silky bath soak that revitalises your skin and senses with its nourishing, velvety texture. The formula is laced with magnesium and a trio of organic oils to soothe the feeling of muscles white releasing its natural scent of lavender, jasmine and sandalwood. Magnesium Body Butter 200g Charged with hydration, the quenching body cream envelops the skin with a veil of nurturing nourishment. The moisturiser is infused with the brand’s Tranquillity™ fragrance blend to soothe the senses after a long day. Sleep Mist 30ml Enjoy the relaxing aroma of lavender, sweet basil and jasmine to promote a luxurious night of rest. The weightless mist adorns your pillow with its comforting, grounding accords.

listings.rawTitle: The White Company Clementine & Juniper Mini Home Scenting Set
listings.description: Give your abode the sensory lift it deserves with The White Company's Clementine & Juniper Mini Home Scenting Set. Replicated across three much-loved products, the scent opens on a lively splash of orange peel, setting a vibrant, fruity tone. As it settles, elderflower and blackcurrant weave in a subtly sweet, almost gourmand layer, reclining into juniper wood for a warm and grounding flourish. Set Contents: Clementine & Juniper Votive Candle 70g Clementine & Juniper Mini Scent Diffuser 50ml Clementine & Juniper Mini Home Spray 15ml

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Aqva Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Energetic and mysterious, BVLGARI’s Aqva Eau De Toilette draws inspiration from the depths of the sea, exploring the freedom of what lies beneath the waves. The aquatic aromatic fragrance for men embodies the water’s magnetic character, colliding a refreshing burst of citrus with marine notes. The EDT combines clean, aquatic notes of posidonia with lively mandarin, amplified by a base of mineral amber to create an alluring, masculine scent trail. Housed in a spherical glass bottle, the turquoise hues of the perfume shine through, reflecting light like the sea.

listings.rawTitle: Molton Brown Delicious Rhubarb & Rose 7.5ml EDP
listings.description: Like a sunny spring afternoon, the Molton Brown Delicious Rhubarb and Rose Eau de Parfum emits a sparkling scent of tempting fruity accords. A trail of raspberry is enhanced by the floral facets, bringing out a powdery sweetness in the sophisticated fragrance. A delicious opening of lychee, rhubarb leaf and grapefruit lead into a delicate peony, rose and pink pepper heart. Rich cedarwood with vanilla and musk entwine to melt in a soft creamy base.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Mon GUERLAIN Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Mon Guerlain Eau de Parfum is a fragrance that enhances exceptional raw materials: french lavender, sambac jasmine, sandalwood and vanilla tahitensis. It expresses the quintessence of a history replete with experiences, nourished by success, expertise and generosity, all infused with the same passion since 1828.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentleman Society Eau de Parfum 60ml
listings.description: Redefine the meaning of modern masculinity with the Givenchy Gentleman Society Eau de Parfum, a multifaceted fragrance that contrasts floral notes with an enigmatic woody accord for a bold olfactory statement. Fresh top notes of sage combine with the florality of wild narcissus absolute, harvested in the heart of France. This is contrasted with the mysterious intensity of a vetiver quartet, harvested in Madagascar and Uruguay. Sandalwood, cedarwood and vanilla add warmth and create the addictive base of this men's aftershave, leaving a memorable trail behind. Inspired by the couture designs of the House, Gentleman Society revisits the iconic bottle of Givenchy men’s fragrances for an edgy yet distinguished look. Like a crest, a reinterpreted 4G monogram in gleaming silver metal emblazons the black lacquered finish. The bottle is made from 15% post-consumer recycled glass.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun Pear Inc. Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Showcasing a sparkling olfactive profile, the Pear Inc. Eau de Parfum by Juliette Has a Gun evokes the freshness of a crisp spring day, paired with the eternal sunshine of sweet musks for a well-rounded fruit fragrance. Succulent with a slight creaminess, the glazed green pear accord glistens amongst notes of ambroxan and cetalox, delivering a radiant, long-lasting dry down. Musk encourages a mellow softness, enhancing the clean composition while granting a multi-dimensional edge.

listings.rawTitle: TRUDON Parfum Midnight Omen 100ml
listings.description: Created by Émilie Bouge, Trudon's Midnight Omen Parfum is a richly layered woody amber fragrance that evokes the pull of the unknown. The fragrance keeps its wearer guessing with a powerful composition of bright mandarin, soft iris and powdery violet, settled on a base of suede-like leather and rare Nepalese sandalwood. Enigmatic and bold, the fragrance hints at omens, good or bad, with every spritz.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana The Only One Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Designed for the modern woman, Dolce&Gabbanna’s The Only One Eau de Parfum encapsulates the essence of feminine allure. The Only One captures the complexities of womanhood within a scent, enticing the senses with a contrasting blend of enchanting violet and zesty bergamot. Smooth iris blends with sensual notes of coffee, continuing a melange of opposites, as a warm base of vanilla and patchouli creates a comforting scent trail. The fragrance arrives encased within a sleek glass bottle with a squared, transparent base.

listings.rawTitle: TRUDON Parfum 45° 100ml
listings.description: An embodiment of passion and desire, Trudon's Parfum 45° offers an ultra-addictive amber vanilla olfactive experience. Centred around a trio of vanilla, the fragrance unfolds in playful ways, flirting with honey and bergamot for an unexpected twist.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste L.12.12 Noir Eau de Toilette Spray 100ml
listings.description: Reminiscent of exciting summer nights, the Lacoste L.12.12 Noir Eau de Toilette Spray captures the brand’s contemporary fougere character with warm woods and bold botanicals. Housed in a patent black bottle and stamped with the signature crocodile motif, the aromatic cologne makes a statement with its fresh yet powerful scent composition. Vibrant watermelon and basil invite the senses in with a charming cocktail, before lavender mellows the olfactive trail and leads us into the night with rich chocolate and cashmeran accords.

listings.rawTitle: Molton Brown Flora Luminare Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Floral Olfactive Signature: Ylang-Ylang. Top Notes: Bitter Almond, Mandarin Petit Grain, Olibanum. Heart Notes: Tiare, Neroli, Jasmine, Rose. Base Notes: Mate, Sandalwood, Cedarwood, Musk. Get lost in the aromas within the Molton Brown Flora Luminare Eau de Parfum. Sparkling and demure, the fragrance opens with notes of bitter almond and unignorable mandarin, illuminating the perfume with a crisp freshness that lingers in the air. A beating heart of neroli, jasmine and rose absolute offers a powdery floral element to the cocktail, evoking demure, elegant visions. A daring base of warm sandalwood and musk rounds off the fragrance in an opulent, luminous manner, making it perfect for balmy, sun-kissed nights.

listings.rawTitle: Miller Harris Rose Silence Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Floral Top Notes: Mandarin, Blackcurrant. Heart Notes: Turkish Rose Absolute. Base Notes: Patchouli, Cashmere Musk. Immerse your senses in a gentle floral fusion with the Miller Harris Rose Silence Eau de Parfum. Blushing with a heart of Turkish rose, this fragrance is artisanal, adaptable and modern. Juicy mandarin and tangy blackcurrant deliver a sweet impression, while depths of sandalwood and musk evoke the sense of warm skin. This fragrance is caught in serenity, creating a moment of quiet for a soft, powdery signature.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Peony & Blush Suede Cologne 100ml
listings.description: Inspired by modern British culture, Jo Malone London creates bespoke and luxurious fragrances synonymous with quintessential British style. Charming and exquisite, the Peony and Blush Suede Cologne opens with the crisp and juicy bite of red apple before succumbing to a floral heart of peony, a delicate accord that brings a subtle green freshness with hints of rose and honey. Luxurious and seductive, the Eau de Toilette settles on a bed of blush suede, which rounds off the fragrance with a soft and sensual opulence. Arrives in the brand's iconic cream box with ribbon accent.

listings.rawTitle: Balmain Carbone Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Enveloping the skin in a cloud of musky notes, the Balmain Beauty Carbone Eau de Parfum reveals an irresistible gourmand scent. Infused with white musk, the creamy aroma is matched with soft suede and sweet patchouli to entice the senses. A bouquet of roses mingles with earthy sandalwood and spiced cumin for a fragrance with balance.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana The One Men Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Encapsulated in a sleek glass flacon with a glossy black top, Dolce & Gabbana’s The One For Men Eau de Parfum is a fragrance of elegance and sensuality. Classic with modern touches, vibrant and engaging, The One unleashes fresh, herby notes which develop into a spicy aroma before settling on woody undertones. Charismatic, elegant, seductive and a match for the modern man that never passes by unnoticed. Top Notes: Grapefruit, Coriander, Basil. Heart Notes: Ginger, Cardamom, Sweet Orange Blossom. Base Notes: Tobacco, Amber, Cedarwood.

listings.rawTitle: NEST New York Balinese Coconut Perfume Oil 6ml / 0.2 fl oz.
listings.description: NEST New York Balinese Coconut Perfume Oil brings a warm, tropical feel to your fragrance routine in a concentrated, easy-to-apply oil format. Its smooth texture glides onto skin, making it ideal for wearing alone or layering with other fragrances. Creamy coconut creates a soft, milky opening, while tropical tiare blossom adds a delicate floral note. Salted musk captures a warm, skin-close finish, creating a smooth blend of tropical and musky notes.

listings.rawTitle: TRUDON Mortel Perfume 15ml
listings.description: Created by master perfumer Yann Vasnier, Trudon’s Mortel Eau de Parfum is described as a “revolutionary drive that combines virile force and natural harmonies”. The mystical, spicy scent is warm and opulent, blending cistus and incense with a heart of black pepper and myrrh. Presented in a hand-blown glass vessel with a pine green rippled cap, designed by Pauline Deltour to resemble the coveted Cire Trudon scented candles, the genderless perfume is housed within a luxury branded gift box.

listings.rawTitle: Perroy Mood Palette 8 x 2.5ml Discovery Set
listings.description: Your go‑to olfactory array, the Perroy Mood Palette 8 × 2.5ml Discovery Set brings together eight ultra-travel‑ready scents for effortless sampling, gifting or day‑to‑day spritzing. Set Contents: Perroy Azure Blush Eau de Parfum 15ml A candied bouquet that balances pink florals with a subtle warmth, evoking a tangy, fruity indulgence. Perroy Blonde Purple Eau de Parfum 15ml A fruity nectar that opens with juicy mango and softens with petals of ylang-ylang. Perroy Ivory Sky Eau de Parfum 15ml A subtly powdery fragrance laced with nuances of bright citrus and smooth woods. Perroy Mahogany Sun Eau de Parfum 15ml Warm and enveloping, the sun‑touched scent wraps rich woods in vanilla florals for a feel-good finish. Perroy Blue Forest Eau de Parfum 15ml Cool, green and quietly intense, the clean woody fragrance remixes cedar and black pepper with skin-like musks. Perroy Gold Fawn Eau de Parfum 15ml A trailblazing pyramid that features majestic amber, vanilla wood, spices and comforting sandalwood. Perroy Pink Fire Eau de Parfum 15ml Provocative to the core, the bouquet pairs raspberry with warm, woody amber and more. Perroy Tangerine Pearl Eau de Parfum 15ml A cocktail of grapefruit and ginger, with a smooth, grounding dry-down.

listings.rawTitle: Balmain Vent Vert Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Uplift your fragrance repertoire with Balmain Vent Vert, a green-aquatic floral wrapped in luminous fruit facets with a soft, musky base. The verdant profile explores every shade of vert – from the woody allure of blackcurrant bud to the resinous, almost sappy brightness of galbanum essence. These green notes boast a herbaceous sharpness, like leaves crushed between the fingers at first light. Then comes calypsone, an ozonic watery note with airy melon nuances, slicing through the greenery with a cool clarity. Dewy jasmine suffuses the scent, conjuring a coastline breeze that skims by a cliffside garden, lifted by white petals. Finally, musks settle at the base, smoothing the edges of the pyramid just enough to leave a soft trail in your wake. The scent is housed in a green ribbed bottle with gold-tone elements to reflect the luxury of the elixir within.

listings.rawTitle: Balmain Bleu Infini Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Taking cues from the serene beauty of the Mediterranean coast, Balmain’s Bleu Infini transports you on an olfactive journey filled with clear skies and the endless depth of rich blue oceans. Where the earth meets the sea, the fragrance reveals a harmonious blend of mineral freshness and earthy warmth. It opens with airy, aromatic facets that evoke coastal breezes, gradually deepening into a tapestry of textured woods and resinous notes. Cistus absolute, salted lichen and baie rose create a delicate tension between salty, sun-kissed minerals and soft herbal spice. Clary sage lifts the composition with an aromatic clarity, while akigalawood brings a mature peppery-woodiness. To finish, oakmoss anchors the scent with a depth that's reminiscent of rocky shorelines and shaded Mediterranean forests. "The aesthetic of the bottle respects the strength of Balmain - the cut, the craft, the texture. When you hold it, you feel such a sense of luxury." - Olivier Rousteing

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Man Rain Essence Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: An homage to the thrilling trail of a natural element, BVLGARI Man’s Rain Essence Eau de Parfum exudes power. The fragrance is an invitation to explore the force of water, merging fresh and woody notes for an intoxicating olfactory experience. An elixir of green tea and orange essence introduces the scent, invigorating the senses with a juxtaposition of earthy and citrus nuances. At the heart lies a white lotus accord, lending the fragrance a floral twist, before diffusing into a warm base of amber and guaiac wood.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica By The Fireplace Eau de Toilette - 30ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Woody Top Notes: Clove Oil, Pink Pepper, Orange Flower Petals. Heart Notes: Chestnut Accord, Gaiic Wood Oil. Base Notes: Vanilla Accord, Cashmeran. Enveloping the senses in a comforting warmth, By The Fireplace Eau de Toilette transports the senses to 1971 Chamonix, France, conjuring visions of frosty air and snow-topped mountains. Part of Maison Margiela’s Replica collection, the fragrance captures the memory of an evening spent by the fireplace after a day skiing in the French Alps. A playful contrast between hot and cold, the fragrance opens with exhilarating notes of pink pepper and clove, contrasting with the warmth of cashmeran and orange flower. Gourmand accents of creamy vanilla and rich chestnut give the unisex fragrance a unique, addictive quality. Made in France.

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa '71 Perfume Mist 90ml
listings.description: Wrap yourself in the comforting aura of the Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa ’71 Perfume Mist. Inviting you to be Cheirosa (meaning to smell delicious), the amber gourmand fragrance adds a delectable veil of sweet and sensual aromas to the skin and hair, transporting you to the sun-soaked beaches of Brazil. Rich notes of caramelised vanilla sprinkled with sea salt mingle with indulgent toasted macadamia nut and white chocolate. Decadent like cashmere, the scent trail is enhanced by tonka bean and coconut blossom. Inspired by Brazilian muse Leila Diniz, who celebrated her bikini body at eight months pregnant on the beaches of Rio, the fragrance captures the true Sol spirit of confidence and empowerment. Packaging may vary.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Born in Roma Donna Eau de Parfum for Her 30ml
listings.description: Inspired by Rome, a city where past and present coexist, Valentino's Born in Roma Donna Eau de Parfum celebrates living life freely and embracing heritage. The modern haute couture fragrance balances sensuality and vibrancy for a luxurious, feminine scent that invites its wearer to be unapologetically themselves. An opulent top note of jasmine sambac mingles with a woody heart of cashmeran, adding a lively twist with its unusually spicy note. A cool base of vanilla bourbon invites a rich leathery aspect for a distinctive, captivating scent reminiscent of Rome's street culture. Instantly iconic, the bottle is adorned with a recognisable stud pattern taking inspiration from Roman architecture.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Jazz Club Eau de Toilette - 30ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Warm & Spicy Top Notes: Pink Pepper, Neroli Oil. Heart Notes: Rum Absolute, Sage Oil. Base Notes: Tabaco Leaf Absolute, Vanilla Bean. Sweet and addictive, Maison Margiela’s Jazz Club Eau de Toilette transports the senses to an evening in an intimate, dimly-lit jazz club. Part of Maison Margeila’s Replica collection, the fragrance conjures memories of liquor-infused cocktails and tobacco filling the atmosphere. The fragrance opens with sharp notes of pink pepper and neroli oil, before transcending into a heart of rum absolute and earthy, leathery sage oil, adding a rich warmth. A melody of liquor and leather, creamy vanilla bean blends with smoky tobacco leaf absolute, balancing out this intoxicating and evocative scent trail. Made In France.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau de Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent’s Libre Eau de Parfum pays homage to the house’s most defining and enduring value: passionate and defiant freedom. Breaking from convention, the emblematic scent combines Aromatic French Lavender, found in classic Fougere perfumery, with luminous solar accords. This daring contradiction blurs masculine and feminine facets to create a distinctive, unisex appeal. Vibrant top notes of Tangerine, Neroli and aromatic Lavender exhilarate, revealing a sun-drenched heart of Jasmine and radiant Moroccan Orange Blossom. A creamy base of Madagascan Vanilla and White Musks wraps the composition in effortless sophistication. The sculpted bottle is entwined with a golden YSL Cassandra Logo, featuring a deep 'V' cut-out, with an, asymmetric black lacquer cap. Akin to the fashion house’s couture tailoring, the sensual fragrance offers a high-fashion amalgamation of menswear and womenswear, embodying signature YSL attitude. Unapologetically fierce, authentic and free.

listings.rawTitle: LOVENOTES by Ariana Grande Vanilla Suede Eau De Parfum 125ml
listings.description: Veiling the skin with a sensuous, delectable fragrance, Ariana Grande’s LOVENOTES Vanilla Suede Eau De Parfum devotes itself to spreading love through scent, conveying a message of appreciation and affection with every spritz. Each LOVENOTES blend is a love letter from Ariana to the world, with Vanilla Suede being her woody-musk curation dedicated exclusively to the UK. Opening with sparkling bergamot, the EDP draws in the olfactive attention with its lush allure, before notes of intimate sandalwood and rice milk melt with warm, woody passion. Emerging from the perfume’s irresistible heart, comforting vanilla bean accord enhances the creamy trail with its rich longevity, as liquid musk lends a cocooning second-skin finish.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy L'Interdit Eau de Parfum 35ml
listings.description: Unearth a hidden beauty with the iconic L’Interdit Eau de Parfum from Givenchy, a floral woody fragrance that seeks to capture your inner desires. Infused with a familiar top note of ginger, the fragrance invites you to bathe in the seemingly pure scent, while an alluring and captivating harmony of orange blossom, jasmine and tuberose ensnare you with a luxury aroma. Falling willingly into the depth of the EDP, the senses devour the dark, hypnotic accords of patchouli and vetiver that seek to empower the scent with their intricate nuances. The renowned fragrance from Givenchy leads the senses on a journey of self-discovery, teaching you to embrace the dark desires within. Arriving in a timeless bottle, the juxtaposing corners and soft curves embody the complexities of our identity.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier La Belle Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Jean Paul Gaultier invites us along on a luminous scent trail with La Belle Eau de Parfum . Settle down for a cosy evening with your lover as this alluring scent radiates feminine sensuality. The Eau de Parfum features a base of sweet roasted Vanilla pods caressed by nuances of white chocolate and salted caramel, irresistible and delectable like a desert. A heart of fresh Bergamot uplifts the warmth of the base, adding a sparkling freshness. An accord of juicy Green Pear invites an opening that is both mouth-wateringly sweet and crisp. The fragrance provides impressive longevity, settling on the skin with a vanilla dry-down, illuminated by sweet notes to bring you closer to that special someone. A true evocation of feminine beauty, La Belle veils you in a confident and empowering sensuality. The classic Gaultier flacon, updated with a ruby red tint and a necklace of fairy-tale roses in bloom.

listings.rawTitle: MUGLER Alien Goddess Eau de Parfum - 60ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Woody Floral Top Notes: Italian Bergamot Essence, Coconut Water Accord. Heart Notes: Grandiflorum Jasmine, Heliotrope Accord. Base Notes: Bourbon Vanilla, Cashmeran. Escape to another dimension with Alien Goddess Eau de Parfum, Muger’s embodiment of mystical femininity. Exuding an aura of incandescent solar radiance, the fragrance empowers the contemporary woman, who exists in perfect harmony with her body, soul and the world around her. The fragrance opens with radiant top notes of Italian bergamot and serene coconut water, revealing a luminous heart of sensual jasmine grandiflorum and heliotrope. Offering an endlessly captivating trail, the base features addictive bourbon vanilla and cashmeran. Willow Smith is the ambassador for alien goddess, epitomising the Mugler muse: powerful, talented, spiritual, and connected to the natural world. Radiating positive energy, the scent extends an invitation to all women to create the extraordinary.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Peony & Blush Suede Cologne 50ml
listings.description: Inspired by modern British culture, Jo Malone London creates bespoke and luxurious fragrances synonymous with quintessential British style.
