listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Special-Edition Myrrh & Tonka Cologne Intense 100ml
listings.description: Inspired by moments of calm, this scent begins with the serene freshness of lavender, gently soothing the senses as it settles into the heart of Omumbiri myrrh, a resinous, warm, and softly smoky. As the fragrance deepens, notes of tonka bean emerge, wrapping the skin in creamy sweetness touched with hints of vanilla and almond. Housed in an exclusive bottle, it mirrors the scent within, smooth, sophisticated and lingering beautifully throughout your day.

listings.rawTitle: Balmain Sel d'Ambre Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Introducing Balmain's Sel D'Ambre, a captivating scent that reveals warming nuances of spiced amber and cooling botanicals. Opening with amber essence upon first spritz, the aroma unfolds into a fresh melange of ambergris and olibanum. At its core, rukeri tea leaves soothe the senses with a comforting wind-down, while caramelised amber finalises the scent with a lasting impression of opulence.

listings.rawTitle: Balmain Ébène Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Transporting you to a deserted forest at the dead of night, the Balmain Ébène Eau de Parfum is an evolution of the archival Africa-inspired fragrance released back in '83. Featuring a rich medley of ebony wood, myrrh oil and tobacco leaves, the fragrance summons the raw scent of roots and oil, featuring a dignifying, vegetative essence. Grounded further in incense and cedarwood atlas oil, the rich olfactory elixir is inspired by Olivier Rousteing’s discovery of his origins, promoting virtues of self-expression and authenticity in every treasurable spritz. Housed in a rich brown bottle, the fragrance—nuanced with sweet traces of vanilla and cinnamon—possesses a woody amber scent profile.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Murakami Yellow Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: The Marc Jacobs Daisy Murakami Yellow Eau de Parfum 50ml brings the Daisy collection into the imaginative dreamscape of Takashi Murakami. The fruity-floral fragrance opens with an uplifting blend of mandarin, grapefruit and pink pepper, brightened by juicy kumquat. At its heart, notes of strawberry and raspberry mingle with delicate gardenia and rosebud, creating a blooming bouquet. A warm base of cedarwood and praline adds depth, lending a soft, lingering sweetness. Encased in a sunshine-yellow bottle adorned with Murakami’s signature flowers, this limited-edition Eau de Parfum captures a playful spirit, making it perfect for gifting.

listings.rawTitle: Kylie Cosmic & Intense Duo Pen Spray 10ml + 10ml Eau de Parfum
listings.description: Top up on your fragrance wherever you go with the Kylie Cosmic & Intense Duo Pen Spray. These travel minis slot perfectly into your clutch bag or carry-on so you can smell divine while on the go. Set Contents: Cosmic Kylie Jenner Eau de Parfum 10ml Magnetic and irresistible, the amber-floral fragrance features a delicate heart of sensual jasmine and zesty blood orange. A heart of amber and red peony takes over the senses with a floral embrace, before developing into a creamy, warm base of musk and vanilla. Cosmic Kylie Jenner Intense Eau de Parfum 10ml Opening with an energising zest of blood orange and sweetening jasmine, the fragrance unveils a decadent, glowing core of golden amber and warming benzoin. A rich base of tantalising musk and creamy vanilla completes the scent for a refined finish.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Euphoria Bold Elixir Parfum Intense 100ml
listings.description: Inspired by the mystical aura of the orchid flower, the Calvin Klein Euphoria Bold Elixir Parfum Intense explores the mystery and sensuality of womanhood. Opening with a juicy burst of pomegranate and persimmon, its succulent beginning energises the senses within the first spritz. An intoxicating bouquet of decadent orchid and radiant lotus blossoms for a radiant, floral heart. Its dry down leaves a lingering impression as unforgettable amber and rich mahogany woods are paired with gourmand cream and skin-like musk.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Euphoria Solar Elixir Parfum Intense 30ml
listings.description: Reminiscent of sun-kissed skin and florals in full bloom, the Calvin Klein Euphoria Solar Elixir Eau de Parfum reveals a bright aroma, perfect for summertime. Inspired by blooming vanilla in its rare green stage, the scent opens with a burst of juicy mango before revealing a heart of golden orchid that lends a soft, sensual twist. Creamy vanilla notes envelop the base in warmth, creating a sweet, indulgent finish. Crafted with a high concentration for added intensity, this feminine fragrance leaves a long-lasting olfactive trail.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss The Scent Intense For Her Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: The Scent Intense For Her Eau de Parfum by Hugo Boss is a gourmand fragrance that captures the depth of coffee in every layer. It opens with the scent of freshly brewed beans, unfolding into smooth, roasted coffee accords at the heart before melting into a creamy vanilla base. The result is a cocooning aroma that smells both rich and comforting. Housed in a statement-worthy bottle adorned with an oversized BOSS logo and a monogrammed warm-gold cap, the amber-toned fragrance glows through the glass, creating the picture of warmth.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Euphoria Bold Elixir Parfum Intense 30ml
listings.description: Inspired by the mystical aura of the orchid flower, the Calvin Klein Euphoria Bold Elixir Eau de Parfum explores the mystery and sensuality of womanhood. Opening with a juicy burst of pomegranate and persimmon, its succulent beginning energises the senses within the first spritz. An intoxicating bouquet of decadent orchid and radiant lotus blossoms for a radiant, floral heart. Its dry down leaves a lingering impression as unforgettable amber and rich mahogany woods are paired with gourmand cream and skin-like musk.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Murakami Green Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Through the playful artistry of Takashi Murakami, Marc Jacobs Daisy Murakami Green Eau de Parfum brings a fresh perspective to the iconic Daisy collection, with an unexpected fruity-floral blend. An infusion of Blue Java banana meets jasmine and creamy vanilla, creating a distinctive olfactive journey. Bright bursts of bergamot and pink peppercorn unfold into a floral heart, settling into a smooth trail of vetiver, sandalwood and musk. Presented in a bold green flacon detailed with Murakami’s signature motifs, the scent experiments with art, fragrance and imagination, perfect for gifting.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Murakami Pink Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Welcome back Marc Jacobs Daisy, now with an irresistible gourmand twist. In collaboration with artist Takashi Murakami, Murakami Pink Eau de Parfum maintains the classic DNA of Daisy with a pop-art essence. Bursting with radiant accords, sunlit coconut lends a tropical, creamy quality to the original scent. At its heart, white peony adds a feminine freshness to the aroma, while decadent praline infuses an irresistible gourmand charm to the classic floral fragrance. The vibrant flacon stands out against your dressing table, with neon hues of pink, the Murakami collection makes your beauty ritual a masterpiece.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Euphoria Solar Elixir Parfum Intense 100ml
listings.description: Reminiscent of sun-kissed skin and florals in full bloom, the Calvin Klein Euphoria Solar Elixir Eau de Parfum reveals a bright aroma, perfect for summertime. Inspired by blooming vanilla in its rare green stage, the scent opens with a burst of juicy mango before revealing a heart of golden orchid that lends a soft, sensual twist. Creamy vanilla notes envelop the base in warmth, creating a sweet, indulgent finish. Crafted with a high concentration for added intensity, this feminine fragrance leaves a long-lasting olfactive trail.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Dylan Blush Pink Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: On the hunt for a fruit-forward fragrance? Versace's Dylan Blush Pink Eau de Parfum is an elevated, gourmand scent take for you to cherish. While Versace’s Blue and Purple collections evoke faraway places, Pink turns inward – offering up a singular study in mood and emotion. The crowning element of the sweet fragrance is the central marshmallow note, injecting a fluffy, sugary elegance that's ultra-contemporary and unmissable. Overtones of Calabrian bergamot, strawberry and freesia lend bright accents to the profile, while Madagascan vanilla and musk root it in traditional perfumery. Orange blossom functions to amplify the mallow essence, making it all the more more-ish. Your olfactive pick-me-up, the scent is bottled inside an amphora-like bottle that's inspired by Greek mythology, playfully at odds with the modernity of the elixir within.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Man Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Unapologetically playful, Jimmy Choo's Man Parfum evokes the spirit of enticing sensuality and a sense of confidence. The fougère amber fragrance for men exudes charisma and intensity, enveloping its wearer in a blend of zesty and invigorating notes. The scent opens with sparkling bergamot and spicy black pepper, before revealing a sensual heart of lavender and orange blossom. At the base, bold woody benzoin and patchouli reinstate the Jimmy Choo perfume with a memorable trail.  The perfume's multifaceted personality is embodied by model Marlon Teixeira, evoking charisma and allure. Adorned with gold mirror-effect lacquering and a crocodile-embossed cap, the iconic flask-shaped bottle embodies the elegance of the scent within.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Elixir Parfum 80 ml
listings.description: Playful opulence plus sensory pleasure, Jean Paul Gaultier’s Scandal Elixir Parfum pushes the boundaries of rich, amber-fruity fragrances. Characterised by a sweet yet soft blackberry blend, this elixir captures the senses with its uplifting, vivacious and vibrant opening. Powdery, precious iris lies in the heart, steeped in mysterious and musky undertones to lead the way into a sensual sillage. To round out the trail, warm patchouli nuances add depth and dimension, leaving an unforgettable impression that lingers long after the first spritz.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Elixir Parfum For Him 100ml
listings.description: From the first spritz, Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Pour Homme Elixir transports you into an intoxicating world with an ambery embrace. As black cherry bursts forward, ripe, juicy and irresistibly playful, it sets the stage for a scent that commands attention. As the fragrance unfolds, the heart reveals a sensual core of patchouli and a smooth base of tonka bean. The bottle is draped in red velvet and encased in a bottle crowned with silver.

listings.description: Fall head over heels for Fame In Love Parfum Elixir, a delectable fruity fragrance with a non-conventional Rabanne edge. Starring a super juicy strawberry extract, the perfume enhances Fame’s signature woody-floral scent with playful, powerful freshness. Feminine yet fierce, a blend of iris and vanilla complement the vibrant fruit essence with a creamy, musky-milky finish for an addictive trail that’s inviting and impossible to resist.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Jasmine Absolute Eau de Parfum Absolute 80 ml
listings.description: Honouring a decade of the original, Carolina Herrera pays homage to the original fragrance’s core note with Good Girl Jasmine Absolute Eau de Parfum Absolute. At its heart, its signature jasmine accord unveils an irresistible luminosity, heightened by surrounding gourmand notes. Mandarin and blackcurrant uplift the senses, while creamy almond and indulgent toffee tempt you with a sweet but sensual final impression.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Phantom In Red Parfum Elixir 100ml
listings.description: Returning to take over the city of love, Rabanne's Phantom In Red Parfum Elixir makes a daring comeback, but this time he's in love. Breaking all the rules of romance, the Phantom robot embarks on a passionate love affair, disrupting the night with this masculine, woody-amber fusion. Let date night begin. Ready for an unforgettable night in Paris, the fragrance opens with aromatic benzoin, a comforting yet warming accord that evokes a sense of warmth and heat upon first meeting. A bouquet made of lavender dials up the romance, replicating the iconic scent's signature with mystery and elegance. Last orders are called with a drydown of refined woods, leaving behind a lasting impression of sophistication and confidence. Made for men born to stand out, Rabanne's robot is dressed to impress with its vibrant red lacquer. Phantom joins his partner in crime, Fame in Love Parfum Elixir, becoming the king and queen of Parisian nights.

listings.rawTitle: Olfactive O Woody Eau de Parfum Purse Spray 8ml
listings.description: Brimming with mystery and scented secrets, the Woody Eau de Parfum by Olfactive O takes vintage cafes, starry nightfall and rich espressos as muse. Intricately blended with contrasting yet complementary woods, discover the sensorial power of this dark fantasy. As the sun settles, spritz the elegant eau de parfum across the skin to allow notes of cedar, black pepper and smoked leathers to whisk you into the night. Vetiver and myrrh grant a spiced earthiness, before white ambergris, sandalwood and labdanum close the trail with a warm, amber-like dry-down. Housed in a black-topped bottle, wear this fragrance with your best suit to all your evening endeavours.

listings.rawTitle: Emporio Armani Power of You Eau de Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Joining the brand’s esteemed fragrance line-up, the Emporio Armani Power of You Eau de Parfum brings out your inner feminine beauty and encourages you never to shy away. Starting with a sweet-tart punch of maracuja passion fruit, the fragrance explores a near-edible olfactory profile, bursting with juicy vibrancy and temptation. As the fragrance evolves on skin, a dessert-rich frangipani centre presents itself, wrapping the composition in sugary, creamy florals. Finally, a time-tested core of vanilla absolute supports these bright notes in the base, melting seamlessly with the sweetness in every layer. The blush-pink elixir is encased in a rose gold-edged flacon topped with a matching cap for a feminine flourish.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Soleil Neige Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Soleil Neige is a ray of solar light – a breath of winter air that conjures sun on fresh alpine snow. Radiant and exhilarating, it captivates with bright citrus, white florals and musk. TOM FORD’s winter world conjures the thrill of a day on the slopes that melts into the celebratory warmth of après-ski. A cool burst of bright and green citrus gives way to a bouquet of winter white florals and rose absolute. The fluted flacon is glazed in a warm-white hue paired with the gleam of sliver-toned accents, evoking the luminosity of sun on snow.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana The One for Men Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Start your day with the vibrant freshness of Italian Tarocco orange in Dolce&Gabbana The One For Men Eau de Parfum. The first burst of citrus feels like a breath of fresh morning air, uplifting and instantly energising. At the heart, French clary sage adds a cool, herbal clarity, before smooth Australian sandalwood brings warmth and depth as the fragrance settles on the skin.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentleman Eau de Parfum Sport 60ml
listings.description: Inspired by the focus and drive of athletes, Givenchy Gentleman Eau de Parfum Sport 100ml delivers a fresh take on citrus and woody notes. The scent leads with a lively quartet of lemon, lifted by lavender and clary sage, before moving into a smooth heart of narcissus absolute and vetiver. As it settles, amber woods and musk create a clean, long-lasting trail. The signature bottle is reworked with a black gradient finish that reveals a cool blue hue, punctuated by a flash of red for a sharp, energetic sign-off.

listings.rawTitle: Ariana Grande REM Cherry Eclipse Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Enter into a dreamy world with the Ariana Grande REM Cherry Eclipse Eau De Parfum, a fruity-floral fragrance that serves as an olfactory pick-me-up. Black cherry jubilee meets sugared honeysuckle petals in the top layer, creating a saccharine opening with a soft hint of the stone fruit. Just beneath, natural jasmine and absolute sambac bring a gentle white-green floral dimension, tempered by a pillowy heart of marshmallow meringue. Supporting these notes in the base, glowing amber and white musks supply comfort in every spritz, lingering on your skin as the dessert-like scent wears on. The pink fragrance is housed in a crystal-like bottle for a precious finish.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Sakura Cherry Blossom Cologne 100ml
listings.description: Jo Malone’s London Sakura Cherry Blossom Cologne captures the very best of the season in a soft, luminous scent. Light yet luxurious, the delicate blend will shroud you in an olfactory veil of florals. It opens with a bright burst of bergamot, a citrusy layer of sparkle that signals your entrance as you enter a room. The fragrance then melts into its poetic heart: laden with cherry blossom, airy and romantic, evoking petals floating in a gentle breeze. Over time, you'll sense the smooth base of rosewood unfurl, leaving behind a balanced floral sillage. Finished in a limited-edition bottle, the fragrance is an ode to fleeting spring moments, preserving their beauty in fragrant form.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Sakura Cherry Blossom Cologne 30ml

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Man Wood Essence Parfum 150ml
listings.description: Bvlgari Man Wood Essence Parfum is crafted in a way only Bvlgari dares. Being the woodiest creation in the collection, its structure reveals every facet of this natural element: profound, textured, mysterious. Like a wood rooted in the ground, darker and veined with mystery. The intense wood blend accord – patchouli, cedarwood and guaiac wood, among the others - generates a refined ambery olfactive vibrancy that radiates in a masculine elegant aura. The elemental force is part of a deeper inspiration that unites the entire Bvlgari Man collection. At its heart lies the Circle of Nature: a visual and narrative journey through the geometry of nature, capturing the eternal essence of the elements. For Bvlgari Man, the Circle of Nature holds profound meaning. More than just a shape, it’s a timeless and ever-flowing force that governs all life; the eternal essence of nature. The timeless Bvlgari Man bottle translates the inspiration of a darker wood into a more layered visual expression – a dark cap crowns a deep brown glass base that gradually fades into a lighter hue. The removable cap reveals a circular aluminium plate engraved with the BVLGARI BVLGARI logo - reflecting the Circle of Nature concept.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Colonia Il Profumo Millesimato Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: A citrus-aromatic trailblazer, Acqua di Parma’s Colonia Il Profumo Millesimato Eau de Parfum serves as an olfactory portrait of Italy, capturing the interplay of sunlit freshness, spectacular vistas and verdant landscapes. Conjuring al fresco, garnished drinks at sunset, the fragrance opens with vibrant notes of bergamot, grapefruit and jammy-rich blood orange, sharp and tangy on the initial spritz. Just below, a bespoke 2024 ylang-ylang white fraction offers an ethereal interpretation of the white flower, gently softening the orange leaves and pine-like rosemary tucked within the aromatic heart. As the brightness settles into something more contemplative, grounding the punchy profile, a coupling of patchouli and vetiver comes through. This results in a dry, elegant trail that lingers long after you apply it to skin.

listings.rawTitle: Mugler Alien Pulp Fruity Floral Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: With every spritz, Mugler's Alien Pulp Fruity Floral Eau de Parfum ignites a powerful, lasting impression. A vibrant, feminine burst of raspberry lands on the skin, enhanced by a zesty touch of orange and green mandarin, before melting into the creamy embrace of jasmine. A lily of the valley accord enhances the white flower’s petals, while temptation ultimately lingers in a woody allure, infused with Alien’s signature cashmeran.

listings.rawTitle: Zadig & Voltaire ZADIG Eau de Parfum Intense 30ml
listings.description: The Zadig & Voltaire ZADIG Eau de Parfum Intense 30ml brings a richer, warmer twist to the original, with a glowing trail that lingers from day to night. A blend of black and golden sesame opens the scent with a soft spice, lifted by ginger and incense. Orange blossom and a creamy vinyl accord sit at the heart, before settling into vanilla, sandalwood and guaiac wood for a smooth, long-lasting finish. Housed in a gold-toned, refillable wing-shaped bottle, the scent is expressive and easy to wear.

listings.rawTitle: Floral Street Enchanted Masquerade Eau de Parfum for Bridgerton 10ml
listings.description: A love affair in a bottle, the Floral Street Enchanted Masquerade Eau de Parfum is a floral-gourmand fragrance designed exclusively for the new season of Bridgerton. Topped with a blushing combination of pink pepper, juicy pear and mandarin essential oil, the parfum is designed to unmask your true self and turn heads whenever you grace a room. Centred with a colourful core of jasmine and rose, the petal-rich pyramid is lightened by a gardenia nuance, evoking a leafy, blooming garden at dusk. The sweet, spellbinding bouquet lands softly with a woody, musky base, made to linger warmly on the skin into the after-hours. Dreamed up especially for the diamond of the season, the fragrance is elevated further by being housed within an ornamental floral bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Si Passione Red Bloom Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Blossom into spring with the Giorgio Armani Si Passione Red Bloom Eau de Parfum, a floral fragrance with facets of woods. The fragrances awakens the senses with a cocktail of bergamot, blackcurrant and raspberry, embarking on a new zest for scent. Blooming with iris pallida and two facets of rose, the bouquet of fresh florals romance and flirt with sensual vanilla bourbon. Finalised with cashmeran, the fruity-floral fragrance is elevated with an elegant, amber dry down.

listings.rawTitle: Goldfield & Banks Tales of Amber Extrait de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Crafted around the golden note of New Zealand ambergris, the Goldfield & Banks Tales of Amber Extrait de Parfum boasts a powerful scent composition with undertones of sunlit resin and mineral-warmed skin. Celebrating the honeyed strength of amber, this extrait de parfum combines soft orange blossom with subtle hints of cinnamon and oud for a refined, effortlessly balanced trail. Australian agarwood delivers a hit of depth and dimension in the fragrance’s base, providing exceptional longevity on the skin from the very first spritz.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Irresistible Eau de Parfum Nectar 80ml
listings.description: Treat yourself to a new bouquet with the Givenchy Irresistible Eau de Parfum Nectar, a floral-gourmand fragrance set to become your next signature. Amped up on the floral front, the scent opens up with a top layer of neroli essence, subtly honeyed and fresh in flavour. Just beneath, a trio of roses accord unfurls into a full-bodied yet soft core, whisking you away to red-rich botanical gardens set against cloudless skies during the peak of summer. For a contemporary twist, the base reveals a coupling of pistachio and vanilla wood, providing a warm gourmand aftermath for you to savour. Petal-rich and feminine to the core, the pink-hued scent is held within a faceted glass bottle.

listings.description: Featuring multiple complex layers, Billie Eilish Your Turn II Eau de Parfum lends itself to both daytime and evening wear, offering a woody, fresh scent with a subtly spiced edge. It opens with the vibrant contrast of pimento berry, mirabelle plum and cassis leaves, creating a bright yet gently warming introduction. As the fragrance develops, notes of fig nectar, black tea and vanilla orchid emerge, adding a mellow, softly gourmand depth. Grounding the scent, a base of natural vetiver, olibanum resin and Virginia cedarwood lingers on the skin, leaving behind an earthy, smoky trail with lasting warmth.

listings.rawTitle: Sabrina Carpenter Cherry Baby Bite Size Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Get date night ready with Sabrina Carpenter’s perfume, Cherry Baby. The Eau de Parfum starts the night with a fruity cocktail, met by a touch of romance and makes sure you stay until dessert. Making the third edition to her fragrance collection, Sabrina takes a seductive twist on the iconic scent, Sweet Tooth. Inspired by a Cosmopolitan cocktail, sparkling cherry is the star note in this scent, sweetened by glazed apple and plum nectar. A bouquet of red poppy and peony blossom flirts with vanilla orchid, romancing those who cross her path. Tempting yet addictive, an aroma of dark chocolate swirls with brown sugar provoking a warming, gourmand embrace. Patchouli and musk leave behind a seductive trail that leaves the senses unable to forget her.

listings.rawTitle: Sabrina Carpenter Lemon Pie Bite Size Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Satisfy your sweet tooth with the Sabrina Carpenter Lemon Pie Bite Size Eau de Parfum. Each spritz releases a nostalgic charm, evoking the warmth of a village bakery with its comforting, homely allure. Bright citrus notes blend with buttery graham pie crust, as lemon and sparkling neroli are lifted by a splash of limoncello. A soft bouquet of jasmine, orange blossom and violet gently tempers the zest, before a creamy gourmand base settles like whipped cream atop a slice of pie. Housed in a convenient travel size, the bottle slips effortlessly into your bag to keep your scent fresh on the go.

listings.rawTitle: Sabrina Carpenter Sweet Tooth Bite Size Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Satisfy your sweetest cravings with Sweet Tooth by Sabrina Carpenter. Dreamt up from Sabrina’s love for all things dessert, this delectable Eau de Parfum is a sugar-kissed treat for the senses. Top notes of bergamot and candied ginger melt into a swirl of chocolate marshmallow, creating a mouthwatering first impression. At its heart, a creamy blend of jasmine petals, coconut milk and Madagascan vanilla serves up confectionery heaven. Finally, warm cashmere wood and sugared musks leave a lingering finish for that final sugar rush. Sweet Tooth is the perfect guilty pleasure to add to your fragrance repertoire, housed inside a playful chocolate bar-shaped bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne 1 Million Night Elixir Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Rabanne’s iconic gold bar meets black, the 1 Million Night Parfum Elixir radiates the electric energy of an underground, invite-only celebration. Bringing together a glowing medley of notes, this addictive elixir opens with bitter orange and cardamom, before marching to the beat of its own drum with hints of magnetic maple syrup and cinnamon. In the dry down, warm spotlights of amber, patchouli and rum mingle to lend rich depth and dimension, fusing with an addictive, exciting intensity.

listings.description: A balance of earthy depth and sweet warmth, Carolina Herrera’s Bad Boy Cobalt Absolute is a compelling choice for evening wear. Defined by its bold woody-vanilla profile, the scent is favoured for its smoothness and intensity. It opens with fresh, aromatic notes of blue lavender and blue sage, creating a clean yet subtly earthy introduction. At the heart, geranium meets white truffle – an unexpected pairing that blends green, slightly minty facets with a rich, musky edge. As it dries down, golden vanilla and oakwood emerge, wrapping the skin in creamy, almost marshmallow-like warmth, grounded by a smoky, earthy finish.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Blush Polka Paradise Eau de Parfum 80ml
listings.description: Featuring a new look with the same iconic scent, Carolina Herrera's Good Girl Blush arrives dressed in signature black and white polka dot print. The classic stiletto silhouette embodies the house's elegance, joy and sophistication, arriving as a statement summer collector's edition. The fragrance is a fresh, floral explosion, blending sparkling bergamot and ylang-ylang with peony and sensual Madagascar vanilla. With each spritz, create a scent trail that feels empowering and irrisistible.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Invictus Elixir Parfum Elixir 100ml
listings.description: Experience the intensity of Rabanne Invictus Elixir, an exhilarating blend crafted for the undefeated hero. The most intense and long-lasting iteration in the Invictus family, the fragrance opens with an everlasting salted mineral accord. Its addictive salty twist is met by an aromatic cypress heart and opulent vanilla caviar base. Now draped in gold for amplified intensity, the classic V-shaped trophy bottle champions the epic fragrance within.

A crystalline aquatic accord opens with freshness, followed by a blooming heart of peony. At the base, vanilla unleashes its sensual notes for an embrace that lingers on the skin. Embodying a sublime Garden of Eden adorned with gold and crystals, the classic sculptural torso perfume bottle is illuminated by the orange-pink fragrance within, complemented by a golden floral jewel set within a garnet. Spritz the perfume as your final accessory to captivate everyone's gaze.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Olympéa Elixir Eau de Parfum Intense 50ml

The bottle's iconic design has been adorned with gold and a hanging charm that reflects the luminous intensity of the fragrance within.

listings.description: A warm, aromatic infusion, Rituals’ Suede Vanilla Home Perfume Spray from the Private Collection instantly envelops your space in comfort. Notes of sage, vanilla and creamy sandalwood unfold, creating a blend that feels both grounding and softly indulgent. Herbal freshness rises first, gently unfolding into the smooth, milky warmth of sandalwood, while vanilla lingers beneath with a subtle, velvety sweetness. Housed in a reusable glass vessel, its neutral tone complements any interior – simply spritz to delicately scent your surroundings.

listings.rawTitle: Balmain Destin de Balmain Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: The bold and feminine fragrance embodies Balmain’s savoir-faire and modern pulse. It opens with a flash of neon-saturated, ripe strawberry. The vibrant fruit sparks a joyful, optimistic energy, playfully contrasting the spicy pepper notes of baies rose. Rosy notes of peony reveal unexpected creamy lychee facets. The fragrance’s floralcy deepens with a lily accord. listings.rawTitle: Goldfield & Banks Tales of Amber Extrait de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Crafted around the golden note of New Zealand ambergris, the Goldfield & Banks Tales of Amber Extrait de Parfum boasts a powerful scent composition with undertones of sunlit resin and mineral-warmed skin. Celebrating the honeyed strength of amber, this extrait de parfum combines soft orange blossom with subtle hints of cinnamon and oud for a refined, effortlessly balanced trail. Australian agarwood delivers a hit of depth and dimension in the fragrance’s base, providing exceptional longevity on the skin from the very first spritz.

listings.rawTitle: Balmain Rouge Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Balmain ROUGE offers a modern, trailblazing take on florals, shaped by the visionary prowess of Pierre Balmain and Olivier Rousteing. Opening with a fruity-floral accord, the fragrance pairs the freshness of lily with the apricot-like essence of osmanthus, giving the bouquet—and your aura—a flirtatious lift. As the scent unfolds, Moraea ciliata slips in with nectar-sweet intensity, enveloping you in warmth that feels like stepping into a dimly lit bar on a summer night – cocktails chiming, red velvet banquettes lining the room. Magnolia adds sculptural complexity to the pyramid, while ylang-ylang cocoons it in a sensual, exotic creaminess. In the base, georgywood lingers with its fixative quality, grounding the luminous petals above. The powerful fragrance is encased in a red ribbed bottle, elevated with gold-tone details.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Electric Cherry Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: The TOM FORD Electric Cherry Eau de Parfum is far from sugary-sweet. Instead, it delivers a vibrant, energising scent that blends bold florals with sharp, juicy notes for a fragrance that instantly enlivens the senses. At its heart, rich morello cherry steps into the spotlight, lifted by the fiery kick of ginger extract. Jasmine sambac adds a lush, seductive floral layer, while ambrettolide brings a soft, musky warmth that lingers on the skin. Pink peppercorn introduces a spark of spice, balanced by the creamy smoothness of pistachio extract. The result is a daring, sensual fragrance with undeniable femme-fatale energy.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Legend Elixir Parfum 50ml
listings.description: A tribute to impactful masculinity, Montblanc's Legend Elixir Parfum is an opulent and modern fougere ambery fragrance. The most powerful concentration in the Legenc collection, the scent opens with an aromatic, sharp blend of lavender and bergamot, creating an energising introduction to the scent. The fragrance unfolds into a heart of punchy pink peppercorn, balanced by the florality of iris germanica and Pomarose™. As it settles, a smooth, buttery base of vanilla and the woody, amber notes of Ambrofix™ create a sensual, addictive trail, complemented by cistus and benzoin. It's presented in the iconic Montblanc Legend perfume bottle, featuring mirrored silver lacquering to reflect the elegance and intensity of the elixir inside.

listings.rawTitle: Coach Women Cherry Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Inspired by the vibrant energy of New York City, the Coach Women Cherry Parfum captures the uplifting fruity-floral core of glossy cherry. Irresistibly playful, this effervescent fragrance leads with a bright burst of the fruit, rich and heady yet fiercely fresh. Balanced on a petal-soft blend of sambac jasmine and warmed by gentle wood nuances of patchouli, it rounds out into a fully realised trail, that’s confident, charismatic and lingers on the skin with lasting intensity.

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa 39 Perfume Mist 90ml
listings.description: Transport your senses to the vibrant coast of Brazil with Sol de Janeiro’s Cheirosa '39 Hair and Body Fragrance Mist. Back (for good) with more coconut and vanilla than before, the scent is inspired by 1939, when Brazillian performa Carmen Miranda made tropical style iconic. The beachy mist blends smooth, decadent notes of coconut cream with toasted vanilla and tropical orchid, before melting into creamy sandalwood and warm praline for an indulgent paradise. Picture coconut-filled trees, a salty breeze and hammock daydreams with each spritz.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Bottled Striking Lavender Limited Edition Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: When worn, this limited-edition Hugo Boss Eau de Parfum leaves behind a fresh, bold trail, well-suited to summer days and warm evenings. The scent opens with white lavender essence, a softer, more delicate take on the traditional note, offering a subtly sweet, lightly honeyed aroma. At the heart, classic lavender brings a clean, herbaceous florality, while a moss accord grounds the base with an earthy, forest-like depth. The composition is housed in the iconic Boss flacon, reimagined with a deep blue gradient for a sleek, minimalist finish.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Bottled Striking Lavender Limited Edition Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: When worn, this limited-edition Hugo Boss Eau de Parfum leaves behind a fresh, bold trail, well-suited to summer days and warm evenings. listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Scarlet Beetroot Cologne 30ml
listings.description: Taking inspiration from the vibrant vegetable patch, Jo Malone London introduces its earthy, fruity and uniquely scented Scarlet Beetroot Cologne. Crafted around an authentic beetroot accord, the cologne invites you to find joy in the small things. Topped with a dash of fruity blackcurrant and a hint of woody patchouli, the playful blend celebrates the colourful charm of nature, lingering on the skin with luminous longevity.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Velvety Butternut Cologne 30ml
listings.description: Plucked from the vegetable patch, Jo Malone London invites us to enjoy the colourful charm of nature with its Velvety Butternut Cologne. Complemented by notes of ginger, patchouli and a dash of tonka bean, this smooth, gourmand and slightly nutty scent gently warms on the skin with wear. Made to be authentic, it evokes aromas of British harvest time with each spritz, celebrating the countryside and all its vibrant offerings.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Veggies Travel Cologne Trio
listings.description: The Jo Malone London Veggies Travel Cologne Trio features three in-season fragrances from the limited edition Veggies Collection. Inspired by just-picked produce from the vegetable patch, the colognes capture the scent of British harvest with every spritz. Wear them solo or layer for a unique scent experience. Set Contents: Jo Malone London Carrot Blossom Cologne 9ml A subtly sweet and earthy fragrance with notes of carrot, orange flower and musk. Jo Malone London Velvety Butternut Cologne 9ml A woody, gourmand scent with notes of smooth butternut, tonka bean and patchouli. Jo Malone London Scarlett Beetroot Cologne 9ml A vibrant, fruity fragrance with notes of beetroot, blackcurrant and patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Carrot Blossom Cologne 30ml
listings.description: Forming part of the limited-edition Veggies Collection, Jo Malone London's Carrot Blossom Cologne captures the scent of a just-picked vegetable patch. The fragrance blends subtly sweet carrot with orange flower and white musk to create an airy freshness with a slight earthiness. Housed in a vibrant carrot-orange bottle, the cologne captures the essence of the British harvest with each spritz.

listings.rawTitle: YSL MYSLF Eau de Toilette Intense 100ml
listings.description: Amp up your scent wardrobe with the YSL MYSLF Eau de Toilette, a long-lasting woody skin musk fragrance providing up to eight hours of intensity. Bold and masculine, vibrant notes of bergamot and orange blossom are intensified through woody depths and white musk for a minerally fresh second-skin sensation. Undressed for the first time, the see-through bottle unveils the intensely deep grey elixir, with a new atomiser that offers three times longer spray duration*. *compared to the existing MYSLF Eau de Parfum.

listings.rawTitle: Floral Street Enchanted Masquerade Perfume Mist 125ml
listings.description: A love affair in a bottle, the Floral Street Enchanted Masquerade Perfume Mist is a floral-gourmand fragrance designed exclusively for the new season of Bridgerton. Topped with a blushing combination of pink pepper, juicy pear and mandarin essential oil, the mist is designed to unmask your true self and turn heads whenever you grace a room. Centred with a colourful core of jasmine and rose, the petal-rich pyramid is lightened by a gardenia nuance, evoking a leafy, blooming garden at dusk. The sweet, spellbinding bouquet lands softly with a woody, musky base, made to linger warmly on the skin into the after-hours.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Elixir Eau de Parfum 125ml
listings.description: Enliven the senses with the Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Elixir Eau de Parfum. The scent exudes an evocative aroma inspired by woody amber accords. Sensual tonka bean opens the fragrance with an addictive aroma that imitates passion and warmth. The multifaceted scent follows with earthy lavender, adding a touch of nature to the fragrance for a hint of the outside. Enticing and igniting, smooth benzoin enhances the Eau de Parfum with richness and depth for an alluring scent that makes an impact.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Born in Roma Donna Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Inspired by Rome, a city where past and present coexist, Valentino's Born in Roma Donna Eau de Parfum celebrates living life freely and embracing heritage. The modern haute couture fragrance balances sensuality and vibrancy for a luxurious, feminine scent that invites its wearer to be unapologetically themselves. An opulent top note of jasmine sambac mingles with a woody heart of cashmeran, adding a lively twist with its unusually spicy note. A cool base of vanilla bourbon invites a rich leathery aspect for a distinctive, captivating scent reminiscent of Rome's street culture. Instantly iconic, the bottle is adorned with a recognisable stud pattern taking inspiration from Roman architecture.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradigme Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Prada Paradigme rewrites the rules of masculine fragrance with a refined, avant-garde signature. Built from the base up in a reversed olfactive structure, the ambery woody eau de parfum reveals its depth from the start as warm resins and Guaiac wood form a rich foundation. A floral twist of bourbon geranium and airy musks brings lift and light, while a calabrian bergamot heart adds freshness. The bottle mirrors Prada’s iconic triangle in a bold tilt, lacquered in a gradient of deep black to green for a scent shaped by new perspectives.

listings.rawTitle: NEOM Wellbeing Happiness Essential Oil Blend 10ml
listings.description: Elevate your mood with the NEOM Wellbeing Happiness Essential Oil Blend, an expertly blended formula that combines seven of the purest essential oils to help balance and uplift your emotions. Forming part of the Scent to Make You Happy Range™, the invigorating oil blend is infused with the brand's Happiness™ fragrance, a natural scent that fuses essential oils of Neroli, Mimosa and Lemon to leave the mind and body feeling happy and energised. When added to your NEOM oil diffuser, a mist of natural fragrance is released into the air to create a mood-enhancing atmosphere. Can also be added to a warm bath or massage oil.

listings.rawTitle: NEOM Wellbeing Perfect Night’s Sleep Essential Oil Blend 10ml
listings.description: Lack of sleep can have a detrimental effect on the body and mind. To help combat this, NEOM Wellbeing has created Perfect Night’s Sleep Essential Oil Blend, an aromatic cocktail which partners with your NEOM Wellbeing Pod Essential Oil Diffuser to help prepare the body and mind for a peaceful night's sleep. Forming part of the Scent to Sleep Range™, the relaxing oil blend is infused with the Neom Tranquillity™ fragrance, a natural scent comprising 19 of the purest essential oils, including English Lavender, Sweet Basil and Jasmine to help leave the mind and body feeling relaxed, calm and ready for a restful evening. When added to your NEOM oil diffuser, a mist of natural fragrance is released into the air to create a calming and relaxing atmosphere. Can also be added to a warm bath or massage oil. Packaging may vary.

listings.rawTitle: The White Company Seychelles Fragrance Oil 15ml
listings.description: The White Company Seychelles Fragrance Oil brings a sense of escapism to your space. Like a warm breeze drifting over sunlit shores, nuances of bergamot and bright orange intertwine with fresh coconut and a hint of green jasmine, while amber and buttery vanilla create a smooth, rich finish. Designed for use in an electronic diffuser or with potpourri, just a few drops release a long-lasting scent into your space.

listings.rawTitle: this works Deep Sleep Pillow Spray (75ml)
listings.description: Formed with over 99% naturally-derived ingredients, the this works Deep Sleep Pillow Spray is an award-winning formula that seeks to lend a touch of indulgence to your evening routine, guiding your senses toward sleep. A blend of lavender, chamomile and vetivert work in harmony to enrich your bedroom space with an uplifting sensorial experience that helps to promote an air of relaxation. Drift off to the scent of fresh botanicals and awaken each morning with a smile on your face. Vegan.

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Rio Radiance Perfume Mist 240ml
listings.description: Capturing the essence of a sun-soaked beach day in a bottle, the Sol de Janeiro Rio Radiance Perfume Mist veils the skin in a bright, tropical aroma. The refreshing scent combines creamy coconut milk with warm, earthy nuances of sand, uplifted by crisp white florals at the heart. A dry down of vanilla lends a sweet fragrance, wrapped in rich amber for a tantalising finish. Packaging may vary.

listings.rawTitle: NEOM Feel Good Mood Boost Duo
listings.description: Sprinkle a little joy into your day with the NEOM Feel Good Mood Boost Duo. Infused with 100% natural essential oils, this uplifting pair is formulated to uplift your space with sensorial notes and elevate your self-care rituals. Set Contents: Happiness Scented Candle 75g The travel-sized candle blends neroli, mimosa and lemon to create a sparkling aroma that fills your home with a positive aroma. Great Day Magnesium Body Butter 30ml A nourishing blend of shea butter, aloe vera and magnesium seeks to soften skin, while a mix of wild mint and mandarin uplifts your senses.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Million Gold For Her Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Making a grand floral entrance, Rabanne’s Million Gold for Her Eau de Parfum oozes glittering confidence and sensuality thanks to its symphony of white flowers. The multi-faceted fragrance is opened by vibrant rose nuances, before melting into the soft, alluring bouquet of suede-like white florals. At its dry-down, mineral musk contrasts the gentle medley with a sea-kissed coolness, lingering on the skin to showcase the perfume’s versatility. Housed in a prismatic crown jewel, the golden-tinted flacon reflects the rich honey-like elixir within.

listings.rawTitle: Sabrina Carpenter Sweet Tooth Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Satisfy your sweetest cravings with Sweet Tooth by Sabrina Carpenter. Dreamt up from Sabrina’s love for all things dessert, this delectable Eau de Parfum is a sugar-kissed treat for the senses. Top notes of bergamot and candied ginger melt into a swirl of chocolate marshmallow, creating a mouthwatering first impression. At its heart, a creamy blend of jasmine petals, coconut milk and Madagascan vanilla serves up confectionary heaven. Finally, warm cashmere wood and sugared musks leave a lingering finish for that final sugar rush. Sweet Tooth is the perfect guilty pleasure to add to your fragrance repertoire, housed inside a playful chocolate bar-shaped bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa 40 Jelly Perfume Balm 4g
listings.description: Encapsulating the intoxicating allure of Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa 40, this portable, mess-free fragrance balm redefines scent for life on the go. The jelly-like texture melts effortlessly into the skin, releasing warm notes of amber plum and blooming jasmine that linger in a sweet, fruity trail for up to 10 hours. For a truly signature scent, layer with the Cheirosa 40 Perfume Mist to amplify its lasting impression.

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa 39 Perfume Mist 240ml

This bold, ambery gourmand evolution of the original Cosmic is creamier, warmer and even more compelling. It features heightened vanilla notes and decadent benzoin that, when paired together, leave a lasting impression. Housed in the original sculptural bottle now dressed in a deep, fiery red, the outside is a reflection of the fragrance’s smouldering allure and intensity.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme La Vie est Belle Vanille Nude Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Blending the radiant essence of solar jasmine from France with the sweet warmth of glazed bourbon vanilla from Madagascar, La Vie Est Belle Vanilla unveils a fragrance that is intimate and inviting yet never overpowering. It opens as a floral escape sparkling with a burst of citrus brightness and luminous white petals touched by the elegance of solar jasmine. As the scent lingers, a clean, sensual caress of white musk envelops the skin, evoking a lasting feeling of joy and serenity with every note's intensity lasting up to 5 hours*.  *Self-assessment test, 69 women.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Eau de Toilette Pen Spray 10ml
listings.description: Radiant, youthful and irresistibly feminine, Marc Jacobs Daisy Eau de Toilette is instantly recognisable. Bursting with sweet, tangy wild berries, it opens with a playful freshness before unfolding into a bouquet of whimsical white flowers. A creamy base of sandalwood adds warmth and depth, balancing the lightness with earth sophistication.  Capturing the carefree spirit of a sunny afternoon, this travel-ready pen spray slips effortlessly into any bag.

listings.rawTitle: The White Company Seychelles Home Spray 100ml
listings.description: Like a warm breeze drifting over the seashore, The White Company Seychelles Home Spray brings an instant sense of tranquility to your space. The fragrance brings together bergamot, bright orange and fresh coconut with green jasmine, while warm amber and vanilla create a lingering scent trail. Designed to brighten every corner of your home with a quick spritz, this aromatic mist refreshes any room, adding warmth and character that welcomes you home.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé L’Eau de Parfum Intense for Women Penspray Exclusive 10ml
listings.description: Capturing the emotion and energy of the Chloé woman, Chloé L’Eau de Parfum Intense for Women Penspray 10ml exudes joy, optimism and freedom through its addictive floral fragrance – an expression of the power of women according to Chloé. The scent opens with vibrant, juicy notes of raspberry, complementing the sensuality of rose that lies beneath. As if captured at any moment of the day, the floral heart note embodies the fresh morning rose, the rich opening of midday rose and the sweet honeyed evening rose, taking its wearer on an olfactive journey. At the base, a bouquet of ambery woods unfolds, including musky ambrox, smooth cashmeran and warm cedar.

Top notes of juicy grapefruit and spicy cardamom envelop a heart of tuberose and ylang ylang, softened by a base of suede and vetiver. Inspired by the iconic Lacoste polo shirt, the perfume bottle features an embroidered crocodile logo.

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Limonada Gelada Mist 90ml
listings.description: Stock up on your summer fragrances with the Sol de Janeiro Limonada Gelada Mist. Scented with a milky citrus-gourmand profile, it takes cues from the sunset of Rio's Praia Vermelha beach, renowned for its golden-red sand and luscious mountain views. Effervescent and sweet, the top layer of the scent groups Brazilian lemonade with sharp bergamot zest and juicy pineapple, conjuring the first sip of something ice-cold in the heat. Solar florals work themselves into the bouquet, layered with creamy coconut and musk, whisking you away to turquoise coves with the sun hitting your bare shoulders. Finally, brown sugar and light amber allow the scent to soften into a warm, golden haze. Think of the fragrance as your olfactory postcard: the very essence of summer, perfect for day-to-day.

listings.rawTitle: Emporio Armani Stronger with You Powerfully Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: The Emporio Armani Stronger with You Powerfully Eau de Parfum 100ml is a deeper, more intense expression of the signature scent, shaped around warmth and texture. Perfect for evenings out, the scent features richer notes for a long-lasting presence. The fragrance centres on the brand’s signature chestnut accord, topped with nuances of cherry and mandarin and layered with lavender, amber wood and smooth vanilla. The result is warm and enveloping, leaving a lingering scent trail. Housed in the iconic Stronger With You bottle, the design is finished with a graduated amber lacquering that reflects the depth of the scent within.

listings.rawTitle: this works Deep Sleep Pillow Spray 250ml
listings.description: Experience a relaxing slumber with this works' Deep Sleep Pillow Spray ; an award-winning, aromatherapeutic formula dedicated to  calming and soothing the mind and body. Expertly blended with natural oils, including Lavender, Vetivert and Wild Chamomile, the sleep-inducing spray is the perfect solution for those who wish to wind down. Helps to relieve stress and tension, whilst allowing you to fall into a peaceful, undisturbed night's sleep to leave you feeling refreshed and restored come morning. Results: 99% slept better than normal* 89% fell asleep faster* 98% felt more refreshed in the morning* 100% would recommend to a friend with a sleep issue* *In a study of 100 subjects and 100 ex-prescription users compared to no product.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent LIBRE Berry Crush Eau De Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Complete your fragrance arsenal with the Yves Saint Laurent LIBRE Berry Crush Eau de Parfum – a daring, red‑berry twist on the iconic LIBRE signature. The scent opens with a vivid burst of raspberry and mandarin, a gourmand introduction that’s mouth‑watering and irresistibly indulgent. As the fragrance unfolds, the juicy brightness gives way to sensuous florals: orange blossom and lavender lend balance and elegance, preserving the unmistakable LIBRE DNA while adding a sweeter, more flirtatious nuance. Finally, the base settles into a warm, creamy trail of bourbon vanilla and musk, wrapping the berries in velvety depth. To complete the experience, the bottle is finished with a sophisticated gold‑tone monogram, a timeless sign‑off to this bold new chapter in the LIBRE story.

listings.rawTitle: Travalo Perfume Pod Atom Atomiser 5ml Black
listings.description: Revolutionising the way you travel with your favourite scents, Travalo’s Perfume Pod stores and carries up to 5ml of fragrance in a compact container. The Genie-S patented device takes the liquid directly from the original bottle and keeps it safe and secure while you’re on the go. Arriving in a sleek black colour, the easy-to-use pod allows you to enjoy your desired scent wherever you may be.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradoxe Intense Eau de Parfum Refill 100ml (Worth £172.22)
listings.description: Embodying fierce femininity, Prada’s Paradoxe Intense Eau de Parfum Refill explores the complexity yet comfort of floral amber fragrances, exuding an enveloping warmth through enigmatic expression. A harmonious blend of amber and jasmine reveals a paradoxical intensity, fusing delicacy with power to strike the perfect balance of boldness. An undertone of moss welcomes a familiar woodiness, nostalgic and instantly recognisable, granting the perfume a long-lasting, addictive scent trail. Arriving in a refill flacon, top up your existing bottle for continued use with minimised material and waste compared to re-purchasing.

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa 90ml Fragrance Duo
listings.description: Cheirosa, which means to always smell incredibly delicious, is Sol de Janeiro’s Brazilian beauty secret. The Fragrance Edit features two bestselling mists that embody the brand’s joyful essence, transporting the senses to paradise with every spritz. Vegan. Set Contents: Brazilian Crush Cheirosa 62 Perfume Mist 90ml Escape to the sunny beaches of Rio de Janeiro with this cult-favourite fragrance. The hair and body mist veils the skin in a delectable elixir of pistachio, almond and vanilla, wrapped in a salted caramel accord for an intoxicating finish. Cheirosa 68 Perfume Mist 90ml Inspired by the Tropicália Movement in 1968, Cheirosa 68 is a celebration of colourful energy. The vibrant fragrance evokes visions of a luscious oasis, featuring refreshing nuances of pink dragonfruit, lychee, hibiscus and sun musk. Packaging may vary.

listings.rawTitle: RITUALS The Ritual of Sakura Cherry Blossom & Rice Milk Car Air Freshener 2x3 g
listings.description: Transport your favourite Rituals fragrance wherever you venture with The Ritual of Sakura Floral Cherry Blossom & Rice Milk Car Perfume. listings.description: Cosmic 2.0 is a celestial scent offering from Kylie Jenner that draws inspiration from the ascent of the sun. The whimsical floral fragrance encapsulates the beauty of dawn with its embracing elixir of florals, fruits and woods. At its opening is a serene juxtaposition of spicy and sweet accords. Featuring juicy pear and pink pepper, the Eau de Parfum whisks the senses away to another realm, laced with a vanilla orchid and lavender bouquet for added sensuality. As the scent warms on the skin, nuances of amber begin to unfurl, lending the fragrance its bewitching aura.

listings.rawTitle: EXCLUSIVE Givenchy L'Interdit Eau de Parfum Rouge 50ml Gift Set
listings.description: Step into the incandescent world of L’Interdit with the Eau de Parfum Rouge 50ml Gift Set, pairing the scent’s signature heat with a couture mascara that intensifies every glance. Perfect for Mother's Day or as a two-piece gift for yourself. Set Contents: L'interdit Eau De Parfum Rouge 50ml Housed in an eye-catching, red‑glowing bottle, the fragrance evokes passion and forbidden thrill. Blood orange and red spices ignite the scent before melting into orange blossom, jasmine and a smouldering base of sandalwood and patchouli. L’interdit Mini Mascara Couture Volume 8g - #01 Black A jet‑black, 24‑hour mascara that marries length, volume and nourishment in a creamy, buildable formula. Its soft brush lets you customise the intensity without the consequence of clumps.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Explorer 60ml Eau de Parfum & 100ml Shower Gel (Worth £81)
listings.description: Discover the perfect gift for him with the Montblanc Explorer Eau de Parfum Gift Set. Featuring a 60ml fragrance and matching shower gel, the duo work together to extend the longevity of your scent. Set Contents: Explorer Eau de Parfum Spray 60ml Opening with invigorating bergamot, the enlivening scent kickstarts your day with spiced pink pepper and clary sage. At its core, leather and vetiver create a rich, earthy tone while patchouli and akigala wood finish the scent with a lingering trail of luxury and decadence. Explorer Shower Gel 100ml Infused with the same scent, the shower gel creates a fragranced lather that revitalises the skin and the senses.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Intense Eau de Parfum Refill 100ml (Worth £183.33)
listings.description: Intensify your fragrance with the Yves Saint Laurent Libre Intense perfume. Fuelled by fierce sensuality, the perfume is a celebration of tension, merging seemingly disparate notes to create a totally unique scent. Taken from the French word for free, the parfum is inspired by YSL’s dedication to independence and expression. Harnessing the power of a truly liberated woman, the fragrance is simultaneously strong and intense, but also graceful and delicate. Sourced from all around the world, the bottle houses fragrances from France alongside hues from Morocco, transcending boundaries to create a cross-cultural fusion. Opening with an unusual accord, the fragrance merges the invigorating note of Tangerine with the soft scent of Lavender. Next, the perfume dives into the floral heart, guiding the senses on an olfactive journey through blossoming gardens. Moving slowly to the base, the fragrance finds its final form. Seamlessly blending the woody hue of Vetiver with the warm note of Vanilla, the bittersweet base continues this theme of contrast, igniting the senses with a smoky perfume. Gold tinted, the glass bottle reflects YSL’s fiery sense of optimism, finished with flamboyant gold-tone branding. Topped with a black cap, the design finished with dainty embellishments.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Black Orchid Body Spray 150ml
listings.description: Worn alone or as part of your fragrance layering ritual, TOM FORD’s Black Orchid Body Spray freshens with a warm floral-chypre scent. Featuring a specially designed 360° spray applicator, the aerosol covers the body from any angle. As you spritz, indulge in spiced black truffle, bergamot and black orchid notes, balanced with plum and patchouli for a sophisticated, sensual trail.

listings.rawTitle: Emporio Armani Stronger with You Powerfully Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: The Emporio Armani Stronger with You Powerfully Eau de Parfum 100ml is a deeper, more intense expression of the signature scent, shaped around warmth and texture. Perfect for evenings out, the scent features richer notes for a long-lasting presence. The fragrance is centred around the brand’s signature chestnut accord, topped with nuances of cherry and mandarin and layered with lavender, amber wood and smooth vanilla. The result is warm and enveloping, leaving a lingering scent trail. Housed in the iconic Stronger With You bottle, the design is finished with a graduated amber lacquering that reflects the depth of the scent within.

listings.rawTitle: Cosmic 2.0 by Kylie Jenner Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Cosmic 2.0 is a celestial scent offering from Kylie Jenner that draws inspiration from the ascent of the sun. The whimsical floral fragrance encapsulates the beauty of dawn with its embracing elixir of florals, fruits and woods. At its opening is a serene juxtaposition of spicy and sweet accords. Featuring juicy pear and pink pepper, the Eau de Parfum whisks the senses away to another realm, laced with a vanilla orchid and lavender bouquet for added sensuality. As the scent warms on the skin, nuances of amber begin to unfurl, lending the fragrance its mythical aura.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Born In Roma Donna Extradose Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Paying homage to Rome at dusk, Valentino’s Born in Roma Extradose Donna Eau de Parfum celebrates the eternal city and its vibrant allure. The fragrance opens with a trio of luminous jasmine twinkling across the river Tiber, as warming benzoin nuances enhance the amber sweetness of the scent. An undercurrent of creamy vanilla ties the olfactive trail together, weaving hints of velvety depth throughout the perfume to encourage a long-lasting silage that exuberates from the skin. Housed in the brand’s prismatic studs, the fragrance nods to the Aristo punk evenings held in the city, highlighting its bold and brazen allure.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Escape into a joy-fuelled fantasy land with Gucci Flora. Evolving into a new delicious Eau de Parfum, floral yet delicately sweet, Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia relaunches in a new campaign filled with flowers and fluffy animals. A signature scent for all free-spirited women full of positive energy. The perfume is built around the Gardenia flower, admired since the dawn of time for its splendour and said to be used in elixirs and magical potions. Taking inspiration from this legend and the idea of its mystical power, the gorgeous White Gardenia note is blended with solar Jasmine Grandiflorum absolute. This delicious potion of joy is introduced by a cheerful Pear Blossom accord while a touch of Brown Sugar accord adds a delicate sweetness to its floral scent trail. Encased within a new, elongated perfume bottle, the lacquered pink glass and shiny gold cap make it an object of beauty. One notable addition is the House’s distinctive Flora pattern. A core part of the Gucci identity, the motif is a painting of colourful flowers by artist Vittorio Accornero, created for Gucci in 1966. Directed and shot by artist Petra Collins and fronted by artist, actor, trailblazer and philanthropist Miley Cyrus, The #FloraFantasy campaign is a journey through a candy pink world, inspired by Japanese anime and filled with pop references where more is more.

listings.rawTitle: NEOM Wellbeing Bundle
listings.description: Whatever your wellbeing needs, elevate your self-care rituals with NEOM’s Wellbeing Bundle, featuring a diffuser and four essential oil blends. Set Contents: Wellbeing Pod The NEOM Wellbeing Pod works at the touch of a button, helping you achieve better sleep, less stress, a mood boost or more energy through the 100% natural Essential Oil Blends. The signature white ceramic cover now complements an upcycled light wood base, touch-sensitive display, breathing mode and more. Happiness Essential Oil Blend 10ml Bringing nothing but good vibes, this joyful and uplifting blend welcomes essential oils like neroli, mimosa and lemon. Feel Refreshed Essential Oil Blend 10ml Get your mornings off to a good start or refresh any afternoon with this energising blend of lemon and basil. Real Luxury Essential Oil Blend 10ml De-stress and unwind thanks to this super soothing (and spa-like) blend of essential oils like lavender, jasmine and sandalwood. Perfect Night’s Sleep Essential Oil Blend 10ml Let us help you to bank a better night with this dreamy blend of essential oils including lavender, chamomile and patchouli. This serene botanical blend inspires an atmosphere of tranquillity.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme Idole Eau de Parfum 100ml Refill (Worth £129)
listings.description: Radiating feminine strength, Idôle is for those who dare to dream. The very first floral chypre scent from Lancôme, Idôle offers a sophisticated olfactory experience inspired by a new generation of innovators. Perfect for daytime wear, the eau de parfum is introduced by a refreshing bergamot accord. As the luminous fragrance wears on the skin, nuances of rose and jasmine begin to unfurl, lending freshness and depth to the scent. A dry down of patchouli, vanilla and cedar finishes the fragrance, lingering on the skin with a sense of empowerment. The jewel-like fragrance bottle is the slimmest in the world. Created by architect Chafik Gasmi, the 15mm flacon is a modern addition to your beauty space.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum for Women Refill 150ml
listings.description: The power within. Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum for Women tells a story of self-discovery. The new campaign follows Emma Mackey and the pride of lionesses. Radiating confidence, strength and kindness, Emma embodies the spirit of Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum. The Scent Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum is a unique gourmand aromatic fragrance led by a powerful trio of vanillas. On top, a vanilla infusion with woody tonalities, at the heart vanilla caviar with a rich sweetness, and at the base a vanilla absolute enriched with luminous lavender. An elegant design, Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum is the first refillable perfume by Burberry. Refill your existing elegant square-shaped bottle with this refill.

listings.rawTitle: Floral Street Mini Mist Trio (Worth £48)
listings.description: Experience Floral Street's best-selling scents with this Mini Mist Trio. Packed with skin-loving ingredients, each 50ml perfume mist contains innovative ActiScent™ ingredients to soothe and revitalise the skin, all while bringing a refreshing cloud of fine fragrance. The trio arrives housed in a convenient travel case. Set Contents: Wonderland Peony Eau De Parfum 50ml A dreamy blend of pink peonies, pink berries and violets, complemented by cedarwood for woody warmth and vetiver for a hint of hazelnut.  Wild Vanilla Orchid Eau De Parfum 50ml A sweet combination of creamy vanilla beans, blossom, cassis and citrus layered with freshly-picked jasmine, bamboo and sandalwood. Arizona Bloom Eau De Parfum 50ml Balinese coconut meets salted musks and a hint of Madagascan black pepper for a free-spirited scent.

listings.rawTitle: Floral Street 5 x 2ml Discovery Set
listings.description: Find your new signature scent with the Floral Street Discovery Set. Featuring five 2ml vials, the fragrance set allows to you to experience a taste of the collection and discover your new favourite. Set Contents: Sunflower Pop Eau de Parfum 2ml Inspired by Van Gogh’s ‘Sunflowers’, the scent refreshes your palette with a zesty burst of optimistic accords. An abstract blend of bergamot, bellini and honey creates a bright, enlivening aroma that stimulates creativity. Sweet Almond Blossom Eau de Parfum 2ml In collaboration with Van Gogh Museum®, the fragrance offers an ethereal experience, just like the artists’ enchanting ‘Almond Blossoms’ painting. Joyful notes of passionfruit, apple blossom and vanilla transport you to southern France to experience the majestic flowering trees. Wonderland Peony Eau de Parfum 2ml Celebrating the beauty of Spring, this fruity-floral fragrance is for those who enjoy sunny days spent amongst nature. Creamy vanilla swirls with sweet candy floss and peony petals to create an olfactive adaptation of the natural world. Arizona Bloom Eau de Parfum 2ml Drawing inspiration from the wildlife and nature of the desert, wild notes of black pepper and jasmine exude an air of spontaneity. A scent for those who are unpredictable, the spiced fragrance is interrupted with coconut, jasmine and salted musk to unleash a spirit of liberation and empowerment. Wild Vanilla Orchid Eau de Parfum 2ml Introducing vanilla as you have never known it, this amber floral scent takes a contemporary twist and the iconic fragrance accord. A heart of bamboo and jasmine warms the senses with an exotic blend, while a duo of vanilla creates a lingering sweetness with an everlasting trail.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Forever Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Exuding glamour and femininity, the Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Forever Eau De Parfum offers an energetic chypre ambery essence that epitomises the confident aura and playful spirit of the Jimmy Choo woman. Commencing with opening notes of rose and pink peppercorn, the intoxicating scent is topped with a fusion of black cherry liquor, vetiver and jasmine. Transcending onto a smooth base of earthy moss, tonka bean and smooth vanilla, the scent reveals an enchanting trial of captivating aroma. Housed within an opulent, gold-embossed façade, the bold Eau De Parfum is crowned with a golden cap and embellished with the iconic Jimmy Choo monogram.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica on a Date Eau de Toilette 30ml
listings.description: Inspired by a magical date on a late summer’s evening, where the golden glow of sunset warms your skin, Maison Margiela’s Replica On A Date Eau de Toilette exudes a joyful scent of ripe grapes and fresh roses. Part of the Replica collection inspired by familiar locations and memories, the perfume evokes nostalgia of seduction and falling in love. The sparkling fruitiness of grapes soaked in warm sunshine is captured with zesty bergamot and a sweet blackcurrant liquor accord. Luminous Isparta rose petal essence fills the air with floral and fruity inflections, recreating the thrill of a date. Sustainably sourced in Bali, sensual, woody notes of patchouli transport the senses to the vineyards of Provence at dusk.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Luna Rossa Ocean Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Explore new heights with the Prada Luna Rossa Ocean Eau de Parfum. The neo-fresh fragrance takes a modern twist on the esteemed fougere family. A medley of Italian bergamot and pink pepper opens the fragrance with a conflicting kick, as citruses and spices unite. Intertwining at the heart interrupts a bouquet of iris, lavender and saffron. Floral but sharp, the luminous accords deliver the unexpected. Earthy vetiver dries down at the base, alongside crisp musk with a hint of sweet patchouli. The complexities of this scent combine for a transcendent, addictive trail.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Myrrh & Tonka Cologne Intense 50ml
listings.description: Inspired by the setting sun melting into the golden sands of the Namib desert, Jo Malone London’s Myrrh and Tonka Cologne Intense transports you to a luscious, warm paradise. Opening with a fresh, floral facet, the cologne exudes soft lavender, honey, and camphor nuances, sinking into a vibrant omumbiri myrrh heart. The fragrance is emboldened by the richness of tonka bean, adding a subtle sensuality with almond and vanilla undertones. Spritz onto the pulse points for a long-lasting, addictive scent trail.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Le Parfum 40ml
listings.description: I Want Choo pays homage to the glamorous and daring Jimmy Choo woman. Bursting with energy, the Eau de Parfum pairs sparkling florals with irresistible woody and amber notes to create a sensuous sillage. The scent’s radiance can be attributed to a joyful pear and golden gardenia elixir, warmed by sweet jasmine and ambrette in its heart. Creamy sandalwood marries with praline at the dry down, lending the fragrance irresistible richness, before finishing with an earthy moss accord.

listings.rawTitle: Floral Street Wonderland Peony Perfume Mist 125ml
listings.description: Enveloping the senses in a cloud of floral fragrance, Floral Street’s Wonderland Peony Perfume Mist is laced with skin-softening actives and refreshing rose water. Bursting with zesty accords, a fruit cocktail of lemon, pink berries and pink guava revitalises the senses. At the heart, a bouquet of violet, peony and raspberry flowers release a sweet floral aroma with a light airiness. Cedarwood and hazelnut settle at the base with a dreamy gourmand finish.

listings.rawTitle: NEOM Wellbeing SOS Calming Pen 12ml
listings.description: NEOM’s SOS Calming Pen offers an on-the-go scent solution for a calming aroma. Offering a moment of tranquillity throughout busy days or tense moments, the roll-on fragrance is infused with NEOM’s Scent to De-Stress. A soothing blend of lavender, Roman chamomile and sweet orange essential oils creates a long-lasting, uplifting olfactory experience.

listings.rawTitle: Floral Street Enchanted Masquerade Eau de Parfum for Bridgerton 50ml
listings.description: A love affair in a bottle, the Floral Street Enchanted Masquerade Eau de Parfum is a floral-gourmand fragrance designed exclusively for the new season of Bridgerton. Topped with a blushing combination of pink pepper, juicy pear and mandarin essential oil, the parfum is designed to unmask your true self and turn heads whenever you grace a room. Centred with a colourful core of jasmine and rose, the petal-rich pyramid is lightened by a gardenia nuance, evoking a leafy, blooming garden at dusk. The sweet, spellbinding bouquet lands softly with a woody, musky base, made to linger warmly on the skin into the after-hours. Dreamed up especially for the diamond of the season, the fragrance is elevated further by being housed within an ornamental floral bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Cypress & Grapevine Cologne Intense 50ml
listings.description: Step into an enchanting garden, lined by statuesque trees and antique arches with the Cypress and Grapevine Cologne Intense by Jo Malone London. Uniting freshness with a sensuous, aromatic allure, the fragrance opens with resinous cypress to capture the olfactive attention, before nuances of vetiver, amber and grape grant an enlivening depth. Cushioned amongst the warm woods and luscious greenery, moss accord emerges in the base to add an earthy edge, encouraging a lasting scent trail and mesmeric first impression.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Oud Minérale Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Embark on a new adventure with the Tom Ford Oud Minérale Eau de Parfum, a fragrance that summons the elements of the earth and sea into one hypnotic aroma. Water and wood combine to produce a sensational array of accords, powered by a rich oud aura. Fresh pink peppercorn mingles with oceanic accords to reveal a tantalising celebration of nature. Elements of salt and seaweed embark on a mystical journey out to sea, while fir, amber and agarwood remain grounded on earth. A smouldering oud blend ignites the scent with sensual, deep woods that dry down at the base, with rich musk that clings to the skin for a trail that lingers.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Intense Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Discover another side of Flora and experience moments of unforgettable bliss with Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Intense. This floral woody gourmand fragrance combines the lush, sweet, and juicy characteristics of fruit with the delicate and fresh aspects of flowers. It enhances the floral sensuality of the gardenia flower with rich, woody tones. Its explosion of unfiltered joy and burst of pure pleasure quickens the pulse and makes the heart beat louder. This maximalist Eau de Parfum Intense offers a new experience of Flora's signature Gucci scent. Ignited by an untamed floral energy, its vegan, natural ingredients open with invigorating Italian Mandarin Essence to bring a sunny surge of penetrating pleasure. At the heart of this perfume for women, creamy Gardenia Accord entwines with Hedione for a burst of full-bodied floral opulence. Overflowing with blushing green glory, the air fills with sparkling brilliance, pushing the florality to another dimension. Enhancing the floral sensuality further still is the earthy Sandalwood Essence. With its rich, woody tones, a comforting trail of softness transforms joy into bliss, cocooning the senses in a vibrant aura of exhilaration. The result is sensual and elegant, perfect for expressing your joy on every occasion. For those who appreciate the depth and richness of a high-quality, floral fragrance. Dressed in sumptuous fuchsia, the House’s iconic Flora pattern adorns the bottle and outer packaging. The most intense perfume in the Flora collection glows with ‘Intense’ in bold gold lettering on both. As the sun shines upon the bottle, it transforms from mysterious to magnificent. Be enraptured by the energy. Bewitched by the bliss. Embrace the mesmerising joy of this astonishing aroma with Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Intense.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Euphoria Magnetic Elixir Parfum Intense 100ml
listings.description: Spritz your pulse points with the warm, comforting allure of Calvin Klein’s Euphoria Magnetic Elixir Parfum Intense, an irresistible Eau de Parfum infused with floral and earthy notes. Wrapped in softness and sweetness, it unveils creamy vanilla tones balanced by the clean warmth of musk, creating a cosy yet elevated scent that lingers close to the skin. Smooth and captivating, this fragrance transitions from day to evening, featuring a 28% ultra-concentrated formula for amplified intensity and long-lasting depth.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Jasmine Absolute Eau de Parfum Absolute 50 ml
listings.description: Honouring a decade of the original, Carolina Herrera pays homage to the original fragrance’s core note with Good Girl Jasmine Absolute Eau de Parfum Absolute. At its heart, its signature jasmine accord unveils an irresistible luminosity, heightened by surrounding gourmand notes. Mandarin and blackcurrant uplift the senses, while creamy almond and indulgent toffee tempt you with a sweet but sensual final impression.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro The Most Wanted Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Introducing The Most Wanted Parfum, a charismatic scent from Azzaro that invites you to flirt with danger. The addictive fragrance is inspired by a man who dares to play by his own rules, someone who lives life to the fullest and challenges destiny. Its powerful character can be attributed to a blend of caramel and spicy cardamom. Married with woody amber for added warmth and depth, the perfume tantalises the senses with every spritz.
