The design of the bottle pays homage to the magnetic scent within. Featuring a barrel-inspired silhouette and a jet-black colourway, the flacon commands attention.

listings.rawTitle: Travalo Perfume Pod Atom Atomiser 5ml White
listings.description: Revolutionising the way you travel with your favourite scents, Travalo’s Perfume Pod stores and carries up to 5ml of fragrance in a compact container. The Genie-S patented device takes the liquid directly from the original bottle and keeps it safe and secure while you’re on the go. Arriving in a sleek white colour, the easy-to-use pod allows you to enjoy your desired scent wherever you may be.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Man Wood Essence Eau de Parfum 60ml
listings.description: Embrace the verdant side of Italian fragrance with the BVLGARI Man Wood Essence Eau de Parfum. A beat away from the brand's city homestead of Rome, this scent leans into a greener, woodier sensibility. Although inspired by the elemental force of wood, the EDP opens with a punch of Italian zest accord and coriander essence, combining herb and citrus notes to reflect a love for incisive beginnings. A natural heart of cypress essence deepens the profile, lifted by a warm base layer of benzoin just beneath. The label's dolce vita lifestyle is reimagined in less of a cityscape lens and more naturally, making this the perfect daytime scent. Honouring multi-sensory storytelling, the flacon itself arrives in a rich jewel-like green with modern geometry and a logo-embossed cap.

listings.rawTitle: Moncler Pour Homme Sunrise Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Moncler’s Pour Homme Sunrise Eau de Parfum encapsulates the breathtaking moment where the sun and the mountains meet. The fragrance is bold and fresh, opening with a burst of pink peppercorn, before unfurling into a velvety suede accord. Lending earthiness to the scent, the EDP finishes with the refined nuances of Haitian vetiver. The iconic bottle embodies the audacious nature of the scent within. Pairing a gun metal colour with a ribbed exterior, the flacon exudes confidence.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Le Parfum for Women 50ml
listings.description: Inspired by French fragrance profiles, delight in the floral bouquet of the Chloé Le Parfum for Women. Starting with an escapist orange blossom accord, the perfume is layered with a powder-sweet essence of rose at the heart for a traditional feminine nuance. These warm top notes are caressed by an even warmer core of vanilla and tonka bean, creating an ambery sillage that's addictive without being sickly-sweet. Emphasising the scent's elegant DNA, the bottle is secured with a burgundy ribbon around its neck.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Scarlet Poppy Cologne Intense 10ml
listings.description: Infused with all things floral, the Jo Malone London Scarlett Poppy Cologne Intense is your next guilty-pleasure daytime fragrance. With a tonka bean base, the bouquet is warm, vanilla-centred, and dries down with this note lingering. It opens on an ambrette accord for a musky, sensual first impression, inviting envy on your trail. The heart component is scarlet poppy, a voluptuous, powdery botanical that adds a captivating depth to the overall scent profile. Think sun-drenched meadows and gardenia bliss, as the bold fragrance imparts a flowery appeal wherever you appear.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Parfum Eau de Parfum 200ml
listings.description: Lead the way with this enthralling eau de parfum by Jean Paul Gaultier. His Le Male Parfum is the emblem of magnificent masculinity, exuding an amber, woody scent that induces a charismatic appeal. Cardamom opens with a bold intensity, making its presence known as you do too. Melting into a lavender and iris heart, the cologne mingles with florals to balance out the potent woodiness, while a creamy vanilla base closes the olfactory trail with a smooth, softened finish. The daring eau de parfum arrives in a black officer’s outfit, shaped to represent the strength of the man, faceted with contrasting gold hardware.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun Banana Rush Discovery Set
listings.description: Spritz and sample, the Juliette Has a Gun Banana Rush Discovery Set showcases seven signature scents in a compact, curated collection, including the latest release, Banana Rush. Each fragrance offers a distinct expression, crafted in France with the label's signature attention to detail. Set Contents: Not A Perfume 5ml A minimalist fragrance built around a single molecule, creating a subtle, clean scent that adapts to the wearer. Miami Shake 2ml A bright and playful blend with fruity and floral notes. Ode to Dullness 2ml A soft composition with warm, understated notes. Lust for Sun 2ml A golden fragrance that captures the warmth and glow of sun-kissed skin. Pear Inc. 2ml A crisp and juicy scent layered with soft florals for an uplifting finish. Vanilla Vibes 2ml A sweet vanilla-based fragrance with subtle, creamy undertones. Banana Rush 2ml A playful perfume combining tropical banana notes with a luminous, aromatic finish.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Hero Eau de Parfum for Men 100ml
listings.description: Sincere, courageous and ever-evolving, Burberry Hero Eau de Parfum for men embodies the spirit of the modern man. Leading with fresh nuances of pine needles, the instinctive scent captures the essence of a forest by the English coastline. Offset by the rich warmth of benzoin and incense, it boasts a soulful olfactive trail that lingers long after its first impression. Descending into its signature base, a trio of warm cedarwood oils represents hero strength to add depth and power. Housed in an elegant oak-coloured bottle with gold accents, Burberry Hero invites you to surpass limits and embrace the extraordinary within.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Narcisse Eau de Parfum 125ml
listings.description: Attract attention with the Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Narcisse Eau de Parfum. The musky amber fragrance arouses desire in a single spritz, captivating with a scent that is as confident as the one who wears it.  A burst of freshness is introduced with bergamot, making way to a heart of musk that is amplified by tonka bean for intensified sensuality. The signature sculptural torso bottle is adorned with a gold scarf and a sapphire-blue stone, allowing the crystal-clear blue fragrance to radiate through. Be transported to a glistening, jewel-covered paradise with every spritz.

listings.rawTitle: Ghost Deep Night Eau de Toilette Spray 30ml
listings.description: Deep and mysterious like the darkness of night, the Ghost Deep Night Eau de Toilette Spray evokes confidence, bottled. The unapologetically bold fragrance blends moon flower with juicy peach and creamy sandalwood for a rich, sensual finish that endures. Whether feeling daring or dreamy, embrace your aura with Ghost's velvety amber olfactory.

listings.rawTitle: Zadig and Voltaire This Is Her! Eau De Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: Elegance and edge distilled, Zadig & Voltaire's This Is Her! Eau de Parfum brings a certain  je ne sais quoi  to your fragrance collection. The profile opens up with a familiar layer of jasmine, marking your entrance with a petal-rich brightness. Journeying into vanilla and roasted chestnut, the bouquet becomes increasingly complex as it settles on the skin, inviting notions of casual rebellion and luxury. A recurring theme in the brand's scent portfolio, sandalwood lingers at the very base, bestowing an effortlessly chic and milky Parisian flourish. "I like when it leaves a trail, asserts a personality," says founder and art collector Thierry Gillier – a sentiment that echoes through the fragrance’s refined pyramid.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Cypress & Grapevine Cologne Intense 10ml
listings.description: Step into an enchanting garden, lined by statuesque trees and antique arches with the Cypress and Grapevine Cologne Intense by Jo Malone London. Uniting freshness with a sensuous, aromatic allure, the fragrance opens with resinous cypress to capture the olfactive attention, before nuances of vetiver, amber and grape grant an enlivening depth. Cushioned amongst the warm woods and luscious greenery, moss accord emerges in the base to add an earthy edge, encouraging a lasting scent trail and mesmeric first impression.

listings.rawTitle: Coach Love Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Set free your inner romantic with the Coach Love Eau de Parfum, a floral fruity scent that exudes feelings of passion and tenderness. Inspired by the universal experience of love, the sweet fragrance accords mingle together to create a hypnotic love potion. Beginning with a passionate, fruity burst, wild strawberry opens this scent with a flirty feminine start. The ultimate symbol of romance, the red rose conquers the fragrance's heart with its rich, velvet petals. Warming cedarwood captures the ending of this love story, with a seductive and alluring finish. The fragrance was created in collaboration with director and photographer Juergen Teller to celebrate love in all its forms. Held captive in a vibrant red glass flacon, even the perfume’s bottle exudes passion and romance waiting to be unleashed. Adorned with an adorable gold heart charm, the bottle is embossed with the iconic carriage logo.

listings.rawTitle: NEOM Wellbeing Feel Good Vibes Essential Oil Blend 10ml
listings.description: Discover the uplifting power of aromatherapy with the Feel Good Vibes Essential Oil Blend from natural wellbeing brand NEOM . It boasts a soothing blend of 100% natural essential oils from May Chang, Mandarin and Ylang Ylang to promote an immediate sense of relaxation and serenity. Compatible with your NEOM Wellbeing Pod, the oil blend imbues your personal interior spaces with its energising scent, spreading positive vibes to get your day back on track. You can even add a few drops to a hot bath or use it for an oily massage to help you unwind and turn your frown upside down.  Made with 100% natural essential oils.

listings.rawTitle: Floral Street Arizona Bloom Perfume Mist 125ml
listings.description: Experience a cloud of fine fragrance and skin-loving benefits with Floral Street's Arizona Bloom Perfume Mist. Infused with rose floral water, each spritz envelops skin in a revitalising mist that can be worn alone or layered with the matching perfume for added intensity.  The dry floral amber fragrance unites Balinese coconut with salted musks and a sprinkle of Madagascan black pepper. Evoking endless skies and eternal sunshine, it's a scent for the sunny and free-spirited.

listings.rawTitle: Sabrina Carpenter Bite Size Set 4x10ml (Worth £64)
listings.description: Like dessert on skin, the Sabrina Carpenter Bite Size Set features four indulgent fragrances designed to sweeten up your scent arsenal. The bite-size deluxe coffret pairs perfectly portioned perfumes with chocolate bar-esque packaging, adding an instant feel-good factor before you’ve even spritzed. Each fragrance explores a different facet of sweetness—from creamy, whipped notes to syrupy, candy-like accords—creating a full spectrum to delight your senses. Think sugared confections, soft vanilla warmth and playful gourmand twists that melt into the skin like your favourite treat. From candy-coated cravings to rich, dessert-inspired delights, this set captures the ultimate sugar rush. Set Contents: Sabrina Carpenter Sweet Tooth Eau de Parfum 10ml Sabrina Carpenter Caramel Dream Eau de Parfum 10ml Sabrina Carpenter Cherry Baby Eau de Parfum 10ml Sabrina Carpenter Me Espresso Eau de Parfum 10ml

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Shalimar - Eau de Parfum Gift Set
listings.description: Discover Guerlain’s gift sets, exquisitely presented in a poetic design adorned with precious details. Set Contents: Shalimar de Guerlain Paris Eau de Parfum 50ml A voluptuous, sensual, spellbinding amber scent. A flight of flowers and bergamot whips up the top with a breeze of freshness, warmed by notes of iris, jasmine and rose at the heart. For the base, imprints of vanilla, the roundness of balsam and the gourmand warmth of tonka bean combine to create a sensual symphony. Shalimar de Guerlain Paris Eau de Parfum 5ml The same compelling fragrance in a travel-size flacon. Shalimar Sensational Body Lotion 75ml A fluid, velvety texture that leaves a shiver of delight on the skin, delicately perfumed.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Neroli Portofino All Over Body Spray - 150ml
listings.description: A cool breath of fresh air, Tom Ford’s Neroli Portofino conjures a relaxing oasis of sparkling waters and sun-warmed sands. Borrowing from the original fragrance, the body spray leaves skin sumptuously scented. Opening with fresh notes and a twist of citrus Mandarin and Lemon, the scent is brimming with the essence of the Italian Riviera. The gentle breeze blows through thriving vegetation, wafting notes of Lavender and Neroli into the heart of the perfume. It settles on a simmering base of warm Amber, adding richness while Rosemary creates a clean, clarifying edge to accentuate an unfaltering sense of freshness.

listings.rawTitle: Moschino Toy Boy Eau de Parfum 100ml Vapo
listings.description: Top Notes: Italian Bergamot, Pink Berries, Indonesian Nutmeg, Pear, Elemi. Heart Notes: Clove, Rose Absolute, Flax Flowers, Magnolia. Base Notes: Cashmeran, Haitian Vetiver, Ambermax, Sylkolide. Daring and playful, the ‘Toy Boy’ Eau de Parfum encapsulates the bold nature of Moschino. The label is known for experimental silhouettes and proportions, and this fragrance is housed in a sleek, black teddy bear-shaped bottle. Opening with a floral, fruity blend, the cologne entices excitement with its seductive accord. Seamlessly moving into the spicy heart, clove and magnolia bring a woody edge to the fragrance, complicating the aroma. Finally, the musky base notes of vetiver and amber darken the fragrance, grounding the perfume with earthy hues.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Le Parfum for Women 100ml
listings.description: Inspired by French fragrance profiles, delight in the floral bouquet of the Chloé Le Parfum for Women. Starting with an escapist orange blossom accord, the perfume is layered with a powder-sweet essence of rose at the heart for a traditional feminine nuance. These warm top notes are caressed by an even warmer core of vanilla and tonka bean, creating an ambery sillage that's addictive without being sickly-sweet. Emphasising the scent's elegant DNA, the bottle is secured with a burgundy ribbon around its neck.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Perfect Absolute Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: As moodier seasons and after-dark moments arrive, reach for Marc Jacobs Perfect Absolute Eau de Parfum – a sensual, refined gourmand-floral fragrance. Opening with a syrupy-sweet caramelised fig accord, this intense yet wearable blend leaves an addictive trail in your wake. Beneath the dessert-like fruity top lies jasmine absolu, a creamy and slightly exotic infusion, blooming at the heart with elegant depth. Once the scent matures, the dry-down is warm and enveloping thanks to rich amber, creating a resinous core. The result is a bold, feminine scent profile that lasts for hours and stays true to the label’s decadent DNA.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne 1 Million Elixir Parfum Intense 50ml
listings.description: Sensual and absolute, Rabanne 1M Elixir 22 Parfum Intense amplifies the opulence of the original best-selling Eau de Parfum. An opening of crisp apple and davana entices the senses, revealing a heart of hand-picked Turkish Damascena rose, its intoxicating, liquorous quality complementing nuances of elegant osmanthus and enduring cedar. Seduction meets unrivalled lasting power as the fragrance warms on the skin, lingering with a base of creamy vanilla absolute, wild-grown tonka bean and earthy patchouli. Capturing the thrill of excess, this truly hedonistic scent draws its power from the extreme quality of its raw materials, creating a masterpiece composition worthy of any millionaire.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste L.12.12 Rose Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: Inspired by the iconic Lacoste polo shirt, L.12.12 Rose Eau de Parfum offers an elegant and feminine fragrance. The floral fruity elixir exudes freshness with energising fruity notes, enveloped by musky accords. Effervescent green mandarin orange and fresh mint essence are sprinkled across a heart of sweet rose, balanced by musk and cedarwood. Mirroring Lacoste’s fashion pieces, the perfume bottle is adorned with the iconic embroidered crocodile logo.

listings.rawTitle: Ariana Grande Ari Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: From hit singles to fruity-floral fragrance blends, Ariana Grande’s Ari Eau de Parfum Spray is the artist’s introductory perfume, with an eponymous name to symbolise its intimate, multi-faceted allure. Playful and confident, the scent stars a light-hearted grapefruit and raspberry medley, mixed with juicy pear to add a sparkling sweetness. A feminine melange of rose, lily of the valley and vanilla orchid ignites passion, while spun musks and woods streamline the olfactive trail. Topped with marshmallow, the fragrance finishes on a rich, gourmand note, serving as a reminder to enjoy the fun and sensory delight of each day.

listings.rawTitle: Baobab Collection Max 10 Stones Marble
listings.description: Notes: Leather, Tuberose, Berries. Embodying the duality of marble stones, this intoxicating scent captures the contrasting interplay of feminine and masculine elements through a fusion of leather notes, softened with powdery hues of tuberose and the sweetness of berries. The scented candle is housed in an ornate, marbled glass jar, expertly hand-blown by the brand’s artisans. The flickering flames from the candle shine through transparent pockets of the marbled vessel, illuminating your interior spaces to create a cosy ambiance and inspire a tranquil atmosphere. Approximate burn times by size: Max 10: 60 hours Max 16: 150 hours Max 24: 400 hours Max 35: 800 hours

listings.rawTitle: Versace Dylan Blush Pink Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: On the hunt for a fruit-forward fragrance? Versace's Dylan Blush Pink Eau de Parfum is an elevated, gourmand scent take for you to cherish. While Versace’s Blue and Purple collections evoke faraway places, Pink turns inward – offering up a singular study in mood and emotion. The crowning element of the sweet fragrance is the central marshmallow note, injecting a fluffy, sugary elegance that's ultra-contemporary and unmissable. Overtones of Calabrian bergamot, strawberry and freesia lend bright accents to the profile, while Madagascan vanilla and musk root it in traditional perfumery. Orange blossom functions to amplify the mallow essence, making it all the more more-ish. Your olfactive pick-me-up, the scent is bottled inside an amphora-like bottle that's inspired by Greek mythology, playfully at odds with the modernity of the elixir within.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Divine Elixir Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Jean Paul Gaultier captures the warmth of golden skin and sunlit shores, encased in a reimagined corset glistening in molten gold. It’s a showstopper before you’ve even sprayed. Demanding attention from the first spritz, Divine Elixir Parfum blends salty floral notes with bold tuberose and sensual tonka bean, wrapped in an unapologetically feminine amber accord. Intensely radiant, irresistibly commanding—where creamy warmth and marine freshness collide.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Intense Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Discover another side of Flora and experience moments of unforgettable bliss with Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Intense. This floral woody gourmand fragrance combines the lush, sweet, and juicy characteristics of fruit with the delicate and fresh aspects of flowers. It enhances the floral sensuality of the gardenia flower with rich, woody tones. Its explosion of unfiltered joy and burst of pure pleasure quickens the pulse and makes the heart beat louder. This maximalist Eau de Parfum Intense offers a new experience of Flora's signature Gucci scent. Ignited by an untamed floral energy, its vegan, natural ingredients open with invigorating Italian Mandarin Essence to bring a sunny surge of penetrating pleasure. At the heart of this perfume for women, creamy Gardenia Accord entwines with Hedione for a burst of full-bodied floral opulence. Overflowing with blushing green glory, the air fills with sparkling brilliance, pushing the florality to another dimension. Enhancing the floral sensuality further still is the earthy Sandalwood Essence. With its rich, woody tones, a comforting trail of softness transforms joy into bliss, cocooning the senses in a vibrant aura of exhilaration. The result is sensual and elegant, perfect for expressing your joy on every occasion. For those who appreciate the depth and richness of a high-quality, floral fragrance. Dressed in sumptuous fuchsia, the House’s iconic Flora pattern adorns the bottle and outer packaging. The most intense perfume in the Flora collection glows with ‘Intense’ in bold gold lettering on both. As the sun shines upon the bottle, it transforms from mysterious to magnificent. Be enraptured by the energy. Bewitched by the bliss. Embrace the mesmerising joy of this astonishing aroma with Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Intense.

listings.rawTitle: Floral Street Sweet Almond Blossom Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: In collaboration with Van Gogh Museum®, Floral Street’s Sweet Almond Blossom Eau de Parfum offers a fragrance for the enchanting and ethereal. The fruity, floral, gourmand perfume showcases natural pomelo and juicy passionfruit floating over a cloud of warming, delicate apple blossom. Creamy vanilla, sandalwood and nutty tonka bean are balanced with bursts of crisp green matcha tea. Adorned with Van Gogh’s Almond Blossom of large blossom branches against a blue sky, the bottle unites the worlds of fine fragrance and fine art.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradoxe Radical Essence Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Reimagining gourmand as you know it, the Prada Paradoxe Radical Essence Parfum explores the boundaries between sweet and salty in this sophisticated display of floral amber nuances. Opening with a bouquet of neroli and orange flower, the scent transcends the floral realm with its zesty aura. At its heart, salted pistachio adds an unexpected twist with an addictive roasted note. Sophisticated sandalwood grounds the scent at the base to leave a modern, sensual trail.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Gaultier Divine Elixir Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Jean Paul Gaultier captures the warmth of golden skin and sunlit shores, encased in a reimagined corset glistening in molten gold. It’s a showstopper before you’ve even sprayed. Demanding attention from the first spritz, Divine Elixir Parfum blends salty floral notes with bold tuberose and sensual tonka bean, wrapped in an unapologetically feminine amber accord. Intensely radiant, irresistibly commanding—where creamy warmth and marine freshness collide.

listings.rawTitle: Sabrina Carpenter Me Espresso Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Rich, roasted and ready to wear, the Sabrina Carpenter Me Espresso Eau de Parfum is a gourmand fragrance ode to her iconic single. A lush blend of Cappuccino Smell-the-Taste™, cocoa powder and espresso bean notes open with freshly-ground intensity, deep and cosy to exude familiar coffee shop comfort. This heady essence is complemented by a sensual heart of night blooming jasmine and vanilla orchid, alongside biscotti to evoke a slightly nutty undertone. Served up with a side of caramel, sugared amber and whipped cream, the golden scent captures the edible essence of a sweet treat.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Bottled Beyond Intense Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: The Hugo Boss Bottled Beyond Intense Eau de Toilette is a bold fragrance where luminous freshness meets warm, textured depth. Fresh yet commanding, the long-lasting scent leaves a confident trail, making it an effortless choice for evenings and occasions that call for a bolder signature. Created by perfumers Daphne Bugey, Frank Voelkl and Bruno Jovanovic, the scent opens with orange blossom absolute, releasing a vibrant surge of floral brightness that feels powerful and energising before settling into rich leather for a smooth, sensual warmth that balances the radiant opening with deeper intensity.

listings.rawTitle: The White Company Seasonal Fragrance Oil Set (Worth £45)
listings.description: Transform your home atmosphere with The White Company Seasonal Fragrance Oil Set, featuring three signature scents: Winter, Fir Tree and Highland Escape. Designed to suit every mood and moment, each fragrance oil brings a unique, comforting aroma to your space, whether you're creating a cosy ambience or adding a refreshing, outdoors-inspired touch. Set Contents: Winter Fragrance Oil 15ml Winter brings the magic of the season into your home. A warming blend of spicy cinnamon and zesty orange, it’s a nostalgic scent that instantly evokes crackling flames, mulled wine and festive evenings. Fir Tree Fragrance Oil 15ml Fair Tree boasts crisp pine needles, eucalyptus and cedarwood to create a revitalising aroma that is both calming and invigorating. Perfect for moments of stillness and clarity. Highland Escape Fragrance Oil 15ml Highland Escape layers smoky wood with warming amber and soft moss, grounding, indulgent scent that brings the peace and drama of the wild landscape into your home.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Hero Elixir Parfum 60ml Eau de Parfum
listings.description: Welcome the night with the Burberry Hero Elixir Eau de Parfum, a modern masculine scent defined by its powerful yet unexpectedly soft dry‑down – the most intense expression in the Hero family to date. The fragrance opens with a warm, timeless dose of tonka, setting the tone with a sense of strength and quiet confidence from the very first spritz. Soon after, leathery vanilla steps in, inviting a striking interplay of contrasts – edge meets decadence, richness meets restraint, all balanced with expert precision. In the base, a vibrant trio of cedarwood levels the composition, hammering home its longevity and leaving an enduring trail that pushes you to meet the night on your own terms. Even the bottle reflects this duality: a blend of matte and glossy finishes, sculptural yet understated. Display it proudly on your dresser or take it with you for after‑dark moments – a final nod to the balance of power and refinement that defines Hero Elixir.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy L'Interdit Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Givenchy presents L’Interdit Eau de Toilette, a distinctly sensual fragrance that dares you to experience the thrill of the forbidden. Embracing the skin with a radiant floral bouquet and nuances of musk, the scent offers an intoxicating olfactory experience. The EDT is introduced with a luminous elixir of orange, bergamot and mandarin. Tuberose and jasmine add depth to the fragrance, wrapped in a refreshing orange blossom accord. Defying conventions, a dry down of vetiver and patchouli juxtaposes against creamy, leathery notes of cistus flower, musk and sandalwood. Succumb to your desires with this daring fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Ariana Grande MOD Blush Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Inspired by the singer’s ethereal aesthetic, the Ariana Grande MOD Blush fragrance showcases a duality of sweet and sumptuous notes with its sparkling fruity-amber blend. Celebrating free-spirited fierceness, the refined scent begins with a lush medley of passionfruit, bergamot and bright raspberry, energised by pink pepper to exhilarate the senses. A floral bouquet featuring dew-kissed magnolia and satin-soft rose petals imbues an air of blossoming freshness, before evolving into a warm, dreamy dry down of ambrox and musk. Housed in a sleek, contoured flacon, the fragrance stands out amongst your Ariana Grande perfume collection with a contemporary edge.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Absolus Allegoria Rose Amira Eau de Parfum 125ml
listings.description: The Allegoria fragrance collection celebrates the wonders of the world. Each creation pays tribute to nature’s beauty and sweeps us up in a discovery of exceptional raw ingredients and notes, beautifully enhanced by our perfumer-explorers.  Discover Rose Amira, a nocturnal tribute to the queen of flowers, an essential scent and perfumery icon. In this journey to the heart of a Persian garden, rose reveals its most sensual fragrance. Shot through with the sacred swirls of frankincense and the warmth of patchouli, the majestic flower unfolds with a blend of strength and softness in a halo of musks.   ""Rose Amira is my vision of rose, sumptuous and sensual within the secrecy of the night. A rose stood upright, turned towards the moon, within a poetic, nocturnal fragrance.” - Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfumer  Absolus Allegoria, the absolute fragrance collection, is an enchanting and mysterious journey to the heart of the world’s wonders once night falls: fragrance trails celebrating deep and powerful nature, revealed by striking contrasts by moonlight. A powerful symbol of Guerlain's commitment to the planet, Absolus Allegoria fragrances contain up to 90% natural-origin*. The French beetroot alcohol used in their formulas comes from a network committed to responsible farming. Rose Amira comes in the Allegoria collection’s emblematic bottle which is made in France using 15% recycled glass. Featuring a removable spray pump and transparent lacquer finish, its design can be easily recycled.  *90% to 94% of ingredients are of natural origin, in accordance with ISO 16128, calculation includes water.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Eros Najim Parfum 50ml
listings.description: A new star is born in the galaxy of scent with the Versace Eros Najim Parfum, a woody amber fragrance that reveals warming nuances inspired by the dunes of the Middle Eastern desert at sunset. Najim, derived from the Arabic word for star, offers an aroma of intrigue and mystique with a unique olfactory experience. A heated fusion of saffron and cardamom warms the senses, while caramel and oud add a decadent quality to the harmonious blend. At the base, patchouli and vetiver summon a seductive nature, as tonka bean and cedarwood create an elegant finish.

listings.rawTitle: Armani Stronger With You Eau de Toilette Spray 150ml
listings.description: Lose yourself in the aromas within Armani Stronger With You Eau de Toilette. Spicy and enticing, the fragrance opens with exhilarating notes of cardamom and pink pepper, instantly invigorating the senses. An elegant heart of sage offers an empowering element to the aftershave, leading hypnotically into a base of creamy crystallised chestnut. Sweet, playful vanilla rounds off the cocktail in a vulnerable, humble manner, making the fragrance destined to captivate and beguile.

listings.rawTitle: Le Sel d'Issey Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: A new, intense perfume for men, Issey Miyake’s Le Sel Eau de Parfum is amplified with a fusion of sea freshness and warm land vibrancy. Created by perfumer Quentin Bisch, the woody marine dry amber fragrance evokes the sea with a salt accord, marine seaweed and oakmoss. Evoking the land are notes of incense, amber and cedarwood. Designer Tokujin Yoshioka has intensified the sharp aesthetic of the Le Sel bottle with amplified masculinity – a smoky grey lacquer and gunmetal cap. With a refillable format, experience a long-lasting masculine elegance time after time.

listings.rawTitle: NEOM Wellbeing Happiness Pod Bundle
listings.description: Transform your home into a safe haven with the NEOM Happiness Pod Bundle. A luxury wellbeing diffuser pod plus a bottle of the essential oil blend to invigorate your home. Set Contents: Wellbeing Pod  A stylish diffuser pod that blends seamlessly into your home décor, designed to fill your home with an enticing aroma at the touch of a remote. Delivering an optimal diffusion of the fragrance for up to twelve hours, plus a compelling breathing mode light that brightens and dims to guide you through a meditative journey. Happiness Essential Oil Blend 10ml Enjoy the alluring aroma of the 100% essential oil blend, designed to scent double the space in minutes. Combining seven of the purest essential oils including, neroli, mimosa and lemon to brighten and enrich the room’s scent.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana The One For Men Parfum 50ml
listings.description: The first impression of Dolce & Gabbana The One For Men Parfum opens with a spark of black pepper, sharp and instantly energising, lifted by the sun-bright freshness of Tarocco orange. Together, they create a vivid awakening for the senses. As the notes settle, labdanum emerges with a slow, ambery warmth. In the final dry-down, tobacco introduces a smooth smokiness, lingering with warmth that feels effortlessly sophisticated.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Eros Najim Parfum 200ml
listings.description: A new star is born in the galaxy of scent with the Versace Eros Najim Parfum, a woody amber fragrance that reveals warming nuances inspired by the dunes of the Middle Eastern desert at sunset. Najim, derived from the Arabic word for star, offers an aroma of intrigue and mystique with a unique olfactory experience. A heated fusion of saffron and cardamom warms the senses, while caramel and oud add a decadent quality to the harmonious blend. At the base, patchouli and vetiver summon a seductive nature, as tonka bean and cedarwood create an elegant finish.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Fame Eau De Parfum Refill Bottle 200ml
listings.description: Crafted in France, Rabanne’s FAME Eau de Parfum Refill captures Parisian magnetism, sophisticated yet playful, intriguing and sensual. Exuding an amber fragrance laced with sparkling fruits and soft florals, the eau de parfum is the scent of the contemporary woman. Mango and bergamot begin the olfactory adventure with juicy nuances, tantalising the senses with a sumptuous, slightly citrusy, aroma. A jasmine and incense heart warms the fragrance, followed by a rich base of sandalwood and creamy vanilla that scents the skin with addictive notes, creating an unforgettable allure. The fragrance arrives in a one-of-a-kind bottle, a feminine figurine dressed in couture, making the eau de parfum the perfect centrepiece on any dresser. Please note - currently only the 80ml bottle is refillable. Vegan.

listings.rawTitle: Orebella Discovery Set 5 x 1.5ml
listings.description: Discover your elemental essence with the Orebella Discovery Set, a curated bundle of five perfumes rooted in nature and alchemy. Founded by Bella Hadid, Orebella is a celebration of self-expression through fragrance. This set invites you to explore a full rotation of moods and energies, from sheer florals to spicy gourmands. Each one is developed with bio-phase layers that amplify intensity and skin-nourishing essential oils. Set Contents: Window2Soul 1.5ml A floral olfactory journey with green and pink nuances: think geranium, damask rose and a warm flourish of tonka bean in the base. Blooming Fire 1.5ml A sheer botanical fragrance topped with spicy cardamom and bergamot, resting on an exotic middle note of Tahitian monoi. Eternal Roots 1.5ml An upliftingly sweet scent with pink pepper, raspberry blossom and pink sugar, offset with a mysterious layer of birch smoke. Salted Muse 1.5ml Woody and vibrant, this balanced profile rests on a warm base of amber and features sea salt in the top layer. Nightcap 1.5ml Seductively gourmand, this powerful bouquet is layered with moreish elements like ginger, patchouli and vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Ck One Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: A citrus sheer fragrance, Calvin Klein CK One Eau de Toilette creates an image of activeness and well-being. Top notes of citrusy Pineapple, Mandarin and Papaya are joined by heart notes of floral Rose, Jasmine and Violet, on a Sandalwood, Amber and Musk base. A refreshing, fruity scent suitable for casual use.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun Banana Rush Eau de Parfum 7.5ml
listings.description: From the very first spritz, the Juliette Has a Gun Banana Rush Eau de Parfum envelops the senses with an invigorating warmth. Ripe banana and irresistibly sweet maple syrup create a captivating opening, inspiring confidence before melting into sun-kissed notes of creamy coconut and exotic frangipani, reminiscent of basking at the ocean’s edge. Smooth and addictive, the fragrance settles into a lingering trail of soft vanilla and velvety sandalwood for an indulgent, escapist finish.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Y Iced Cologne Eau De Toilette Intense 100ml
listings.description: Light enough for every day, Yves Saint Laurent's Y Iced Cologne Eau De Toilette Intense delivers you the clean-cut edge you've been searching for. The crisp EDT opens with a blend of sage and lavender, herbal aromatics that work together to compose a delicate earthy layer. The fragrance is then emboldened by geranium, rosy, mint and spice all at once, lending its own tangy counterpoint with smoky green freshness. Like a chilly autumn afternoon, the enlivening scent profile has an incense twist to it, conjuring swirling smoke in a hallowed wood. Its coolness is offset by a mysterious layer of warm, allowing the fragrance to be worn into night if you desire. Encased in clear glass with a statement bottle, the design is signed off by a classic Y insignia detail.

listings.rawTitle: Jean PaulGaultier Divine Eau de Parfum Intense 100ml
listings.description: A fragrance fit for a goddess, Jean Paul Gaultier’s Divine Eau de Parfum Intense 100ml radiates cosmic sensuality with its heavenly amber floral elixir. The luminous scent draws inspiration from the fearless queens of Gaultier’s catwalks, encapsulating their dazzling aura with every spritz. The solar energy of the perfume can be attributed to an uplifting lily and frangipani blend. The warmth of benzoin contrasts with a whisper of saltiness to grant the scent an opulent aroma, wrapped in irresistible meringue for an angelic finish. Jean Paul Gaultier’s signature bottle takes on a new celestial form. The hourglass corset is reimagined with a conical bust and gleaming gold colour, paying homage to the almighty power of the scent within.

listings.rawTitle: Molton Brown Re-Charge Black Pepper Aroma Reeds Refill 150ml
listings.description: Escape into the warm trees and tranquil streams of Masoala with Molton Brown’s Re-Charge Black Pepper Aroma Reeds Refill. Releasing an earthy, exotic fragrance into the home, the aroma is reminiscent of hidden, tree-lined pathways in the Madagascan wilderness. Unveiling sharp top notes of black pepper, lemon and ginger, the fragrance opens into a botanical heart of coriander, basil and violet leaf. Settling into a rich base of vetiver, oakmoss and ambergris, the scented oil works to fill your home with a refreshing and alluring fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London English Oak & Hazelnut Cologne 50ml
listings.description: Capture the spirit of an enchanted woodland walk with every spritz of Jo Malone London English Oak & Hazelnut Cologne. The crisp green bite of hazelnut awakens the senses, lifted by the subtle spice of elemi and the earthy depth of vetiver. Anchored by roasted oak, the scent settles into a warm, woody embrace that enriches your natural aroma with understated sophistication and lasting, effortless charm.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Eau de Parfum 75ml Refill
listings.description: Step into a dewy summer’s day with the Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Eau de Parfum . This floral aquatic opens with notes of Lotus, Freesia and Rose, evoking the image of luscious blooms embellished with raindrops. A heart of Lily and Osmanthus adds a unique fresh twist to the fragrance, creating an outdoorsy wanderlust appeal. The sun-drenched florals emit a clean and enveloping scent. A base of Sandalwood Cedar and Ambrette creates a sensual warmth, like summers spent in a lakeside log cabin.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Perfect Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: A more uplifting and intimate interpretation of the classic Perfect scent, Perfect Eau de Toilette is a celebration of individuality, inviting you to embrace your true self with every spritz. The floral fragrance offering from Marc Jacobs exudes joy, exhilarating the senses with its cheerful notes. Spicy pink peppercorn and polygonum lend the long-lasting EDT its signature freshness, complemented by a rich daffodil accord in the heart. Underpinned by cedarwood’s warm, earthy facets, the fragrance provides an invigorating olfactory experience. The eclectic 50ml flacon draws inspiration from the scent within. The bottle combines Marc Jacobs’ signature round shape with an abundance of eye-catching charms, tinted with a pale blue colour for a touch of fun.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Bloom For Her Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Bloom into your true self with the irresistible Gucci Bloom Eau de Toilette. Inspiring a journey of self-discovery built on the empowering notion of connecting through difference, the floral fragrance stays true to the original Bloom signature. This addition to the Bloom floral bouquet is a lighter, more luminous interpretation of the Bloom signature scent that gently encourages women to Bloom into the truest version of themselves. Characterised by a mesmerising trio of Jasmine, Tuberose and Rangoon Creeper accord, it is now enlightened by a sweetened Neroli accord. Just like the perfume unfurls as its name suggests, Gucci Bloom women flourish in a natural, expressive and individual way, without conventional limitations. This tempting Gucci scent is presented in a frosted and luminous square-shaped pink glass bottle to bring freshness and vitality. Gucci Bloom Eau de Toilette for women celebrates the vitality and diversity of those who identify with the House’s modern philosophy.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Omnia Coral Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Inspired by the solar vitality of red coral, BVLGARI Omnia Coral brings to life the luminous energy of the vibrant gem in a striking fragrance. Radiant and colorful like coral, the floral-fruity Eau de Toilette, crafted by Master Perfumer Alberto Morillas, captures all the liveliness of nature through the bright aura of hibiscus notes. An emblem of passion, this lively flower is associated with the life-giving force of light, as it only grows if totally immersed in daylight. The new flacon design pays tribute to Omnia's iconic shape while staying true to its inimitable original scent, which remains untouched. Like a frame of light, an invitation to rediscover the iconic fascination of Omnia from a new, more precious perspective. Two rings smoothly flowing into each other through two detachable elements, unveiling the fragrance's atomizer and introducing a new concept for this iconic flacon. Like a shining secret at the heart, an elegant rose gold colored frame on the cap brings Bulgari's DNA as a jeweler to the core of one of its most iconic feminine fragrance collections. Faithful to its original design representing the symbol of infinity, the new flacon captures every single drop of light.

listings.rawTitle: Moncler Les Sommets Collection Haute Montagne Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Inspired by the materials found in Moncler boutiques, the Les Sommets Collection Haute Montagne Eau de Parfum unites the crispness of snow-covered mountains and warmth from blond woods in one enveloping unisex scent. Wrapped in a creamy Madagascan vanilla embrace, resinous woods, burning from a log cabin’s fireplace, spark feelings of comfort and calm. A cedarwood and tree moss breeze sweeps through the doors, bringing an air of fresh, earthy accords that mingle with a white musk base to close the olfactive trail. The fragrance arrives housed in a simplistic apothecary-style bottle, adorned with cursive text to showcase its rustic yet contemporary edge.

listings.rawTitle: Orebella Window2Soul Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Step into a luminous garden with the Orebella Window2Soul Eau De Parfum, a floral fragrance where a delicate bouquet of faceted rose and jasmine unfurls on the skin, kissed with fresh lemon for a natural, green brightness. Beneath the airy florals, warm tonka bean lingers softly, adding depth and a subtle sweetness. Light, elegant, and effortlessly radiant, this fragrance evokes sunlit mornings and gentle breezes.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana The One for Men Eau de Parfum 150ml
listings.description: Start your day with the vibrant freshness of Italian Tarocco orange in Dolce&Gabbana The One For Men Eau de Parfum. The first burst of citrus feels like a breath of fresh morning air, uplifting and instantly energising. At the heart, French clary sage adds a cool, herbal clarity, before smooth Australian sandalwood brings warmth and depth as the fragrance settles on the skin.

listings.rawTitle: The White Company Winter Large Home Scenting Set (Worth £80)
listings.description: Presented in a luxury gift box, The White Company’s Winter Large Home Scenting Set stars three fragrant additions to enliven your interiors. Crafted over 21 years ago by brand founder Chrissie, the warming winter blend melts rich cinnamon, aromatic clove and zested orange notes in a Christmas-inspired seasonal scent. Set Contents: Winter Candle 140g Flickering the festive aroma throughout your home, this chic candle imbues an uplifting air each time you strike a match. Winter Home Spray 100ml A fine-mist spray, ideal for instantly refreshing and scenting your space. Winter Diffuser 150ml Equipped with rattan reeds, this long-lasting diffuser releases the spiced fragrance for up to three months.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Black Orchid Travel Spray 10ml
listings.description: Tom Ford Black Orchid travel spray is a timeless fragrance. The brand's iconic olfactory creation blends rich, dark accords with tempting florals and a hint of spice to seduce the senses. Notes of Bergamot, Black Orchid and Black Plum combine with Black Truffle and Patchouli for a sensual, unforgettable aroma that lingers on skin.

listings.rawTitle: Olfactive O Scent Personality Discovery Set 8 x 2ml
listings.description: Discover your new signature scent with the Olfactive O Scent Personality Discovery Set. Featuring eight sample-size fragrances, each vial unlocks a unique aroma bursting with storytelling nuances, individual to its name. Elegantly housed within a gift box, the discovery collection makes the perfect elevated gift. Set Contents: Skin Extrait De Parfum 2ml Fruity Extrait De Parfum 2ml Woody Extrait De Parfum 2ml Amber Extrait De Parfum 2ml Floral Extrait De Parfum 2ml Floral Smoke Extrait De Parfum 2ml Gourmand Extrait De Parfum 2ml Citrus Extrait De Parfum 2ml

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana The One Eau de Parfum Intense 75ml
listings.description: A fragrance for the unmissable femme fatale, the Dolce & Gabbana The One Eau de Parfum Intense gives your scent rotation the upgrade it truly needs. If you’re drawn to gourmands, spice and florals, this signature olfactive wraps all three into a deliciously multi-faceted experience. It opens with a luminous burst of pink pepper, an immediate spark of warmth and vibrancy that turns heads without overpowering the senses. As the fragrance settles, it melts into a lush heart of jasmine, where creamy petals and warm floral tones ripple with unmistakable femininity. Finally, the scent dries down into a rich, addictive base of vanilla, giving the EDP its ambery, slightly gourmand signature that lingers long after the first spritz.

listings.rawTitle: Balmain Vent Vert Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Uplift your fragrance repertoire with Balmain Vent Vert, a green-aquatic floral wrapped in luminous fruit facets with a soft, musky base. The verdant profile explores every shade of vert – from the woody allure of blackcurrant bud to the resinous, almost sappy brightness of galbanum essence. These green notes boast a herbaceous sharpness, like leaves crushed between the fingers at first light. Then comes calypsone, an ozonic watery note with airy melon nuances, slicing through the greenery with a cool clarity. Dewy jasmine suffuses the scent, conjuring a coastline breeze that skims by a cliffside garden, lifted by white petals. Finally, musks settle at the base, smoothing the edges of the pyramid just enough to leave a soft trail in your wake. The scent is housed in a green ribbed bottle with gold-tone elements to reflect the luxury of the elixir within.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London English Pear & Freesia & Grapefruit Scent Layering Gift Set
listings.description: Elevate your fragrance game by mastering the art of scent layering. This bundle combines two Jo Malone colognes to curate a fragrance wardrobe tailored to every mood and moment. Set Contents:  English Pear & Freesia 30ml A versatile blend of fruit and florals into a light, wearable scent that creates a comforting yet sophisticated essence that is both familiar and distinctive. Grapefruit 9ml Awaken your senses with a sharp, uplifting burst of grapefruit. A refreshing note, it adds an invigorating layer to your scent profile that energises, refines, and leaves behind a trail of understated elegance.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London English Pear & Freesia & Peony & Blush Suede Scent Layering Gift Set
listings.description: Elevate your fragrance game by mastering the art of scent layering. This bundle combines two Jo Malone colognes to curate a fragrance wardrobe tailored to every mood and moment.  Set Contents:  English Pear & Freesia 30ml A versatile blend of fruit and florals into a light, wearable scent that creates a comforting yet sophisticated essence that is both familiar and distinctive.  Peony & Blush 9ml Romantic yet modern, this combination of florals is the essence of charm. Perfect for day or evening, it is effortlessly layerable with other Jo Malone favourites.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN La Petite Robe Noire Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: In La Petite Robe Noire’s perfume wardrobe, I am the Original Dress. A perfumed creation by Guerlain: An eau de parfum embroidered of the most beautiful "black" notes of perfumery. The legendary "heart-shaped" bottle has been boldly reinterpreted with a modern touch. Its crystalline transparency, fading from black to powdery pink, reveals an iconic little black dress. I am absolutely essential and utterly irresistible. I am the chic and very glamorous perfumed creation by Guerlain. I am La Petite Robe Noire.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Mon GUERLAIN Eau De Parfum Intense 50ml
listings.description: The Mon Guerlain fragrances are a fragrant manifesto of today's femininity. A multi-faceted woman: strong, free and sensual. Discover Mon Guerlain Eau de Parfum Intense, a sensual and unique woody amber. The vanilla tincture, artisan-produced by Guerlain, blends with vanilla Tahitensis and smoldering patchouli. They accompany lavender and sandalwood, forming a unique and sensual woody amber composition. "Mon Guerlain Intense is a confident sensual enveloping signature, that no ones forgets. It is this heavy dose of lush vanilla that creates an addictive quality, while offering up plenty of elegance and mystery" - Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfumer The “quadrilobe” bottle, created in 198, established itself as one of Guerlain’s iconic bottles. Simple and graphic, it echoes an alchemist’s bottle and owes its name “quadrilobe” to its stopper, which is formed from one piece to obtain a shape resembling four lobes. One century later, beautifully enhanced by a luxurious glass weight and a golden adornment, this bottle offers a contrast between strong taut lines and sensual curves, expressing contemporary femininity.

listings.rawTitle: Balmain Bronze Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Balmain Bronze is a woody fragrance shaped around warmth and depth, opening with a dash of black pepper that gives way to smooth, resinous woods. Tobacco leaf lends smoky nuances, while jasmine lends a floral thread that lifts the composition. As it settles, hay absolute adds an earthy tone, creating a grounded finish. The bottle reflects Balmain’s signature attention to form and texture for a luxurious feel.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden Blue Grass Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Fresh and light, yet infused with a rich floral bouquet of scents inspired by the beautiful flower fields and blue skies of Grasse in France, this Elizabeth Arden Blue Grass Eau de Parfum takes you on a trip to the fragrant countryside. The luxuriously feminine scent of the Elizabeth Arden Blue Grass Eau de Parfum possesses top notes of freshly cut flowers and citrus fruits, whilst the heart of the fragrance caries muguet, rose geranium, hyacinth and jasmine notes, which makes it a scent that fits all occasions. Finished off with top notes of precious wood, spices and herbaceous it is a scent that is perfect for romantic wear.

listings.rawTitle: Balmain Ébène Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Transporting you to a deserted forest at the dead of night, the Balmain Ébène Eau de Parfum is an evolution of the archival Africa-inspired fragrance released back in '83. Featuring a rich medley of ebony wood, myrrh oil and tobacco leaves, the fragrance summons the raw scent of roots and oil, featuring a dignifying, vegetative essence. Grounded further in incense and cedarwood atlas oil, the rich olfactory elixir is inspired by Olivier Rousteing’s discovery of his origins, promoting virtues of self-expression and authenticity in every treasurable spritz. Housed in a rich brown bottle, the fragrance—nuanced with sweet traces of vanilla and cinnamon—possesses a woody amber scent profile.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Elixir Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: Playful opulence plus sensory pleasure, Jean Paul Gaultier’s Scandal Elixir Parfum pushes the boundaries of rich, amber-fruity fragrances. Characterised by a sweet yet soft blackberry blend, this elixir captures the senses with its uplifting, vivacious and vibrant opening. Powdery, precious iris lies in the heart, steeped in mysterious and musky undertones to lead the way into a sensual sillage. To round out the trail, warm patchouli nuances add depth and dimension, leaving an unforgettable impression that lingers long after the first spritz.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Omnia Crystalline Eau de Toilette 100ml Gift Set
listings.description: The BVLGARI Omnia Crystalline Eau de Toilette captures the brilliance of light in scent form. Inspired by the purity of crystal, this luminous fragrance opens with crisp nashi pear and airy lotus, unfolding into soft white peony and fresh bamboo. A warm base of balsa wood and crystal musks leaves a sheer, radiant trail. The redesigned flacon reimagines Omnia’s iconic infinity loop with a modern twist – two interlocking rings revealing a rose gold accent at the heart. A sculptural tribute to BVLGARI’s jewellery heritage, it reflects light from every angle, standing out in your fragrance collection. Set Contents: BVLGARI Omnia Crystalline Eau de Toilette 100ml BVLGARI Omnia Crystalline Eau de Toilette 15ml BVLGARI Omnia Crystalline Hand Cream 40ml

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme Ôver The Top Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Channel the essence of a French springtime in the Lancôme Ôver The Top Eau de Toilette, a fruity fragrance that boasts a certain joie de vivre  in its bright appeal. Topped with tomato leaf, perfumer Carlos Benaïm describes this layer as a grapefruit-like burst of shimmer, sweet and slightly verdant. Caressed by jasmine just below, the fragrance is equal parts punchy and soft, feminine and fragrant, with petals providing an olfactory lift. A woody base grounds the contemporary blend, providing classic warmth to boost the scent's longevity.

listings.rawTitle: Juicy Couture Viva Noir EDP (100ml)
listings.description: An exotic, fruity-floral composition, Juicy Couture Viva Noir EDP (100ml) is a sensuous and seductive accord that will allow you to unleash your inner temptress. The fragrance opens with zesty top notes of berries and mandarin, before moving into a delicate heart of honeysuckle, gardenia and jasmine. Finishing with an aromatic dry-down of amber, caramel, vanilla and sandalwood, this enticing scent is perfect for the confident, daring woman. Presented in a beautiful pink flacon that's decorated with a stunning black bow, this fragrance will transport you to the ultimate state of sensuality. - L.M.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Colonia Pura Eau de Cologne 100ml
listings.description: The Acqua di Parma Colonia Pura Eau de Cologne reimagines the house’s classic citrus signature with a fresh perspective. Bright notes of Italian bergamot, orange and petitgrain open the scent, giving way to a heart of jasmine sambac, narcissus and coriander for added depth and warmth. A base of cedarwood, patchouli and musk lends a clean finish. Presented in the brand’s iconic Art Déco-inspired bottle with clear glass and a black cap, the perfume makes a luxurious addition to your collection.

listings.rawTitle: Balmain Bronze Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Balmain Bronze is a woody fragrance shaped around warmth and depth, opening with a dash of black pepper that gives way to smooth, resinous woods. Tobacco leaf lends smoky nuances, while jasmine lends a floral thread that lifts the composition. As it settles, hay absolute adds an earthy tone, creating a grounded finish. The bottle reflects Balmain’s signature attention to form and texture for a luxurious feel.

listings.rawTitle: Baobab Collection Max 16 Arabian Nights
listings.description: Encased in endlessly patterned glass screen printed with 24-karat gold, the Baobab Arabian Nights candle filters its light into a soft, golden glow. More than decoration, it transforms your space into a haven of poetry and comfort. Within unfolds a dance of contrasts as saffron’s radiant fire meets the dark gravity of oud, while incense drapes a smoky veil between them, grounding, uplifting, and deeply evocative. Approximate burn times by size: Max 10: 60 hours Max 16: 150 hours Max 24: 400 hours Max 35: 800 hours

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Wood Sage & Sea Salt & Peony & Blush Suede Scent Layering Gift Set
listings.description: Elevate your fragrance ritual by mastering the art of scent layering. Jo Malone’s Wood Sage & Sea Salt and Peony & Blush Suede come together in a fresh, grounding, and effortlessly elegant coastal floral blend that radiates uplifting energy. Set Contents: Wood Sage & Sea Salt 30ml A grounded yet effortlessly fresh scent, where earthy sage intertwines with the crisp tang of sea salt, sweeping your senses into a windswept escape. Subtle, natural and endlessly calming, this essence carries the spirit of the ocean into your space. Peony & Blush Suede 9ml Romantic yet modern, this combination of florals is the essence of charm. Perfect for day or evening, it is effortlessly layerable with other Jo Malone favourites.

listings.rawTitle: Balmain Blanc Galaxie Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Unveil a fragrance where fresh citrus notes, ranging from Buddha’s hand to cédrat, melt into a graceful magnolia heart with Balmain BLANC GALAXIE.  Luminous and quietly energising, the scent opens with a refreshing brightness that gradually softens into smooth floral warmth, wrapped in the delicate spice of cardamom. As it settles, the composition deepens into a long-lasting fusion of musky patchouli, creating a finish that feels both earthy and ethereal. The result is a grounded, serene glow that lingers beautifully on the skin.

listings.rawTitle: Baobab Collection Maxi Max Stones Marble
listings.description: Notes: Leather, Tuberose, Berries. Embodying the duality of marble stones, this intoxicating scent captures the contrasting interplay of feminine and masculine elements through a fusion of leather notes, softened with powdery hues of tuberose and the sweetness of berries. The scented candle is housed in an ornate, marbled glass jar, expertly hand-blown by the brand’s artisans. The flickering flames from the candle shine through transparent pockets of the marbled vessel, illuminating your interior spaces to create a cosy ambiance and inspire a tranquil atmosphere. Approximate burn times by size: Max 10: 60 hours Max 16: 150 hours Max 24: 400 hours Max 35: 800 hours

listings.rawTitle: Baobab Collection Max 10 Stones Agate
listings.description: Create a soft ambience with the Baobab Stones Agate scented candle, a luxurious addition to your home décor designed to elevate any interior. Encased in clear glass inspired by the enchanting Brazilian stones of Minas Gerais, each candle features hand-applied patterns in a random arrangement, making every piece one of a kind. The fragrance reveals a vibrant, fruity-floral composition, blending juicy acai berry with the distinct nuances of rhubarb and the delicateness of peony. Together, these notes create a joyful scent that feels both fresh and luxurious, echoing the beauty of agate stone.

listings.rawTitle: Olfactive O Amber Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: As romantic as a candlelit dinner. As daring as a secret trip to the tattoo parlor. The intoxicating and glamorous nature of Olfactive O Amber lingers long after the scent dissipates. The Eau de Parfum is unapologetically seductive, enthralling the senses with each fragrance chapter. Peppery rose and radiant bergamot marries with ambered frankincense, stealing the scene with its juxtaposing blend of aromas. Its captivating vanilla base lends passion to the scent, enhanced with patchouli for a musky finish. Dare to make every moment your own with Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Solar Violet Eau de Toilette Spray 50ml
listings.description: Solar Violet offers a modern twist on the quintessential L’Eau d’Issey fragrance. The luminous scent is a delicate amalgamation of warmth and freshness, drawing inspiration from the beauty of spring to create an uplifting olfactory experience. The Eau de Toilette centres around a blossoming violet accord. A symbol of sensuality and grace, the flower lends the scent an elegant powdery aroma, married with iris for its green undertones. Solar nuances of pear represent the warmth of the sun, providing the earth the vitality it needs for the rebirth of nature. The L’Eau d’Issey bottle takes on a new form with Solar Violet. Featuring the classic triangular silhouette, the flacon is reimagined with a lilac tint, topped with a contrasting wooden cap for a sophisticated finish. Vegan.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun Ex Vetiver 50ml
listings.description: Fusing citrus freshness with the richness of woods, Ex Vetiver by Juliette Has a Gun spotlights olfactive duality, showcasing its capability to achieve a delicate yet impactful finish. To open, hesperidic notes of bergamot and lemon lend gentle, versatile vibrancy, that uplifts the senses and complements the green nuances of a three-piece vetiver medley. Edging towards a slightly smoky base, the cologne evolves with wear to unearth second skin-like musks and ambery ambroxan to grant a long-lasting, compelling scent trail.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London English Pear & Sweet Pea Layering Collection
listings.description: Discover the art of fragrance layering with this Jo Malone London collection, curated to suit every season, mood and moment. At its heart lies the luminous English Pear & Sweet Pea, a cologne that evokes soft, sunlit orchards in bloom. Its juicy freshness is beautifully elevated when layered, choose bright Grapefruit for a zesty lift, English Oak & Hazelnut for earthy freshness, or Peony & Blush Suede for romantic warmth. The possibilities are endless to create a scent story that’s uniquely yours. Set Contents:  English Pear & Sweet Pea Cologne 30ml  Grapefruit Cologne 9ml English Oak & Hazelnut Cologne 9ml Peony & Blush Suede Cologne 9ml

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN L'Instant De GUERLAIN Pour Homme Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: L’Instant de Guerlain pour Homme highlights a unique moment: the one in which a man takes the initiative and after which everything will be different. This woody, sparkling, seductive fragrance was composed of contrasts. It is nothing less than surprising.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Habit Rouge Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Habit Rouge Eau de Parfum reveals the intense and sensual signature of woody and leather notes. Habit Rouge has an eternally elegant French appeal. Habit Rouge embraces a dandy man who dares everything, combining sophistication and refinement. He lives his life fervently and distinguishes himself with a trail of extreme sensuality.

listings.rawTitle: NEOM Energy Pen 12ml
listings.description: Designed for life on the go, the NEOM Energy Pen offers a fragrant boost when you need a subtle lift. The pocket-sized essential blends eucalyptus, rosemary and fir, aromas known to help refresh and elevate. With just a few swirls onto pulse points, the bright scent offers a moment of reset, whether you're between meetings or mid-commute. Light, uplifting and easy to carry, it's a simple ritual that fits seamlessly into your day.

listings.rawTitle: Balmain Blanc Galaxie Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Unveil a fragrance where fresh citrus notes, ranging from Buddha’s hand to cédrat, melt into a graceful magnolia heart with Balmain BLANC GALAXIE.  Luminous and quietly energising, the scent opens with a refreshing brightness that gradually softens into smooth floral warmth, wrapped in the delicate spice of cardamom. As it settles, the composition deepens into a long-lasting fusion of musky patchouli, creating a finish that feels both earthy and ethereal. The result is a grounded, serene glow that lingers beautifully on the skin.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent La Nuit De L'Homme Le Parfum Eau de Parfum 60ml
listings.description: Seduce your senses with the La Nuit De L'Homme Le Parfum Eau de Parfum from Yves Saint Laurent . Opening with a fresh burst of Bergamot and Anise, the masculine fragrance dives into a heart of spicy Black Pepper and aromatic Lavender,  before settling on a captivating Patchouli and Vetiver base. The EDP is housed in a curved bottle with a hexagonal cap. Top Notes: Bergamot, Anise. Heart Notes: Black Pepper, Lavender, Labdanum. Base Notes: Patchouli, Vanilla, Vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Aromatherapy Associates Revive Morning Mood Mist 100ml
listings.description: A burst of olfactive energy, wake up with Aromatherapy Associates Revive Morning Mood Mist. Blended with refreshing juniper berry, grapefruit and rosemary, this ultra-fine mist scents the space around you, uplifting the senses with its invigorating effect. Enhanced with adaptogenic ginseng, the formula harnesses the power of aromatherapy to surround you with a long-lasting fragrance that elevates all your morning moments.

listings.rawTitle: Baobab Collection My First Baobab Gift Box - Aurum
listings.description: Opening to reveal two home fragrances in Baobab’s signature Aurum scent, the My First Baobab Gift Box infuses the abode with a delicate floral aroma. The collection features a sensuous blend of jasmine and musk, wrapped in an earthy galbanum accord to create an enchanting scent trail. Arriving in a 70’s-inspired case, the set is the perfect luxury gift for yourself or a loved one. Set Contents: My First Baobab Candle in ‘Aurum’ My First Baobab Diffuser in ‘Aurum’

listings.rawTitle: TRUDON Parfum Mystique 100ml
listings.description: Channelling spiritual intensity and mystical allure, Trudon's Parfum Mystique draws its wearer in with a mysterious leathery-woody composition. The fragrance opens with top notes of leather, saffron and cedar before revealing a heart of agarwood, sandalwood and papyrus. Smoky and refined, it settles on a base of amber, patchouli and ebony wood.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent MYSLF L'ABSOLU 60ml
listings.description: An all-year-round masculine fragrance with a luxe warm profile, the Yves Saint Laurent MYSLF Eau de Parfum is set to become your next signature. Cosy accords ground this scent firmly in the woody family. From a bergamot top note to a patchouli base, the sincere blend is finessed with a harmony of bitter citrus, dark earthiness, and invigoratingly raw orange, layering shades of warmth into your aroma. Sophisticated yet inviting, add this robust scent to your pulse points for a collected surge of confidence. What's more, it has a long-lasting heart to see you through your evening agenda.

listings.rawTitle: EXCLUSIVE Ariana Grande LOVENOTES & Travel Bag Bundle
listings.description: Delight in the delectable notes of Ariana Grande's LOVENOTES & Travel Bag Bundle, featuring an Eau de Parfum duo alongside a travel bag and two sherpa scrunchies. Set Contents: Ariana Grande LOVENOTES Vanilla Suede EDP Spray 30ml The fragrance opens with sparkling notes warmed by creamy sandalwood and rice milk. Vanilla beans and liquid musk at the base cocoons skin in a sensual, delectable scent trail. Ariana Grande LOVENOTES Pink Woods EDP Spray 30ml An introduction of sparkling Italian bergamot makes way for a divine woodiness wrapped in vetiver and lotus flower. A blend of tonka bean, palo santo and cotton candy creates an unexpected yet addictive signature. Ariana Grande Cloud Pink Travel Bag with 2 Sherpa Scrunchies A sherpa pink travel bag and two hair scrunchies.

listings.rawTitle: Laboratory Perfumes Amber Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Woody Amber. Citrus: Bergamot, Lemon, Black Pepper, Birch Leaf, Juniper, Bourgeon de Cassis. Floral Woody: Lavender, Jasmine, Vetiver, White Flowers. Sensual Woody: White Amber, Leather, Oakmoss, Musks. Bursting open with a lively and energising introduction of fresh citrus, Laboratory Perfumes’ Amber Eau de Toilette has been expertly blended to follow the wearer through their day, mellowing as the hours pass. Bright, effervescent hues of spiced greenery that capture the spirited energy of morning slowly unfurl, making way for a dynamic burst of herbaceous florals, before maturing into a subdued backdrop of warm, earthy, balsamic notes as the evening draws in. The opening fuses fragrant citruses like Lemon and Bergamot, laced with the pungent bite of Black Pepper and subtle hints of multi-faceted aromatics like Juniper, which unleash piney nuances. At the heart, a bouquet of Lavender and Jasmine soften the zing of the fragrance’s zesty launch, bringing balance with a melancholic trail of heady, powdery flowers. As night falls, the EDT evolves slowly, cloaking the wearer in a balmy haze of Ambergris; a rich, woody warmth supported by Leather, Oakmoss and Musks. The luminous, golden-tinted perfume is presented in a contemporary glass bottle, crowned with a spray top for spritzing your pulse points. Socially-conscious, environmentally-friendly and cruelty-free ingredients. Made in the UK.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau de Parfum 150ml
listings.description: Oriental Fougere Top Notes: Tangerine, Neroli, Lavender. Heart Notes: Jasmine Sambac, Orange Blossom. Base Notes: White Musks, Vanilla Extract. Key Notes: Orange Blossom, Lavender. Yves Saint Laurent’s Libre Eau de Parfum pays homage to the house’s most defining and enduring value: passionate and defiant freedom. Breaking from convention, the emblematic scent combines Aromatic French Lavender, found in classic Fougere perfumery, with luminous solar accords. This harmonious contradiction blurs masculine and feminine facets to create a distinctive, unisex appeal. Vibrant top notes of Tangerine, Neroli and aromatic Lavender exhilarate, revealing a sun-drenched heart of Jasmine and radiant Moroccan Orange Blossom. A creamy base of Madagascan Vanilla and White Musks wraps the composition in effortless sophistication. The sculpted bottle is entwined with a golden YSL Cassandra Logo, featuring a deep 'V' cut-out, with an, asymmetric black lacquer cap. Akin to the fashion house’s couture tailoring, the sensual fragrance offers a high-fashion amalgamation of menswear and womenswear, embodying signature YSL attitude. Unapologetically fierce, authentic and free.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Perfect Eau de Parfum Pen Spray 10ml
listings.description: A floral scent with a comforting character, Perfect Eau de Parfum is an olfactive tribute to self-love. The Marc Jacobs fragrance celebrates what makes you unique, inviting you to embrace your individuality. Pairing perfectly with every occasion, the irresistible floral scent opens with a juxtaposition of tangy rhubarb and rich daffodil, softened by a creamy almond milk accord. As the perfume wears on the skin, nuances of cashmeran and cedarwood begin to unfurl, leaving behind a sophisticated aroma that lasts for hours. Housed in a travel-friendly pen spray, the pastel pink fragrance radiates your essence throughout the day.

listings.rawTitle: Khloé Kardashian XO Khloé Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: From the house of Kardashian, Khloé Kardashian brings to light her debut fragrance, XO Khloé EDP. Swirling with multi-facets of floral ambers and rich woods, the scent symbolises inner beauty. Opening with a bouquet of roses and lavender, your journey to self-love begins with a romantic gesture of blooming petals. At its amorous heart, a cocktail of orange blossom, creamy praline and juicy peach to immerse the senses with a delicious treat. Drying down with a base of tonka bean and soft woods, the fragrance is finalised with a sensual finish of skin-like musk.

listings.rawTitle: Floral Street 12 x 2ml Deluxe Discovery Wardrobe
listings.description: Featuring all 12 of Floral Street’s iconic fragrances, the Deluxe Discovery Wardrobe allows you to sample each scent and find your new signature perfume. With sensuous woods, delicious gourmands and refreshing florals to choose from, there’s a fragrance for every occasion and mood. Set Contents: London Poppy 2ml Wonderland Peony 2ml Sunflower Pop 2ml Electric Rhubarb 2ml Neon Rose 2ml Arizona Bloom 2ml Wild Vanilla Orchid 2ml Sweet Almond Blossom 2ml Iris Goddess 2ml Chypre Sublime 2ml Black Lotus 2ml Ylang Ylang Espresso 2ml

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy L'Interdit Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: With its forbidden blend of white flowers and a dark accord, L'Interdit Eau de Parfum is a resolutely underground flower. It unveils a sensual bouquet of orange blossom, jasmine, and tuberose. In contrast, earthy dark tones emanate from vetiver and patchouli to create a daringly addictive and sensual fragrance. In homage to the design of Hubert de Givenchy's first perfume, the bottle is truly timeless and terribly modern. With a round squareness and a soft strength, it dares you to break the rules with abandon. Defy conventions with L'Interdit Eau de Parfum in a new 100ml format. This fragrance is now part of an eco-responsible approach, with a refillable format. Experience the thrill of the forbidden with L'Interdit, a fragrance that invites you to defy convention and embrace your singularity.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Myrrh & Tonka All Over Body Spray 125ml
listings.description: Inspired by the warm glow of the Namib Desert at sunset, Jo Malone London’s Myrrh & Tonka All Over Body Spray wraps the skin in a soft, sensual mist. The lightweight spray delivers a warmly woody aroma. The tart, slightly balsamic edge of Omumbiri myrrh is offset by a fresh layer of lavender, making up the heart and head notes of the escapist fragrance. Once the scent settles, detect velvety, vanilla-laced tonka bean anchoring the scent profile with a core of comfort. Suitable for touch-ups, the smooth, enveloping scent offers luxury in every spritz.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Perfect Absolute Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: As moodier seasons and after-dark moments arrive, reach for Marc Jacobs Perfect Absolute Eau de Parfum – a refined gourmand-floral fragrance with a decadent edge. Opening with a syrupy-sweet caramelised fig accord, this intense yet wearable blend leaves an addictive trail in your wake. Beneath the dessert-like fruity top lies jasmine absolu, a creamy and slightly exotic infusion, blooming at the heart with elegant depth. Once the scent matures, the dry-down is warm and enveloping thanks to rich amber, creating a resinous core. The result is a bold, feminine scent profile that lasts for hours and stays true to the label’s decadent DNA.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Bottled Beyond Intense Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: The Hugo Boss Bottled Beyond Intense Eau de Toilette is a bold fragrance where luminous freshness meets warm, textured depth. Fresh yet commanding, the long-lasting scent leaves a confident trail, making it an effortless choice for evenings and occasions that call for a bolder signature. Created by perfumers Daphne Bugey, Frank Voelkl and Bruno Jovanovic, the scent opens with orange blossom absolute, releasing a vibrant surge of floral brightness that feels powerful and energising before settling into rich leather for a smooth, sensual warmth that balances the radiant opening with deeper intensity.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Nomade Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Floral Chypre Top Notes: Cherry Plum. Heart Notes: Freesia. Base Notes: Oak Moss. Give power to your femininity with the Chloé Nomade Eau de Parfum. This fragrance gifts the senses a floral, woody moment to inspire your adventurous side. Free and thriving, the EDP opens with a sweet, voluptuous note of Mirabelle Plum. It gives a dainty but memorable impression before succumbing to a radiant Freesia heart. Oak Moss defines the base with earthy complexity – a dry, green accord that tempts the soul. The Chloé woman is confident, elegant and truly timeless. Housed in a sleek, curved bottle with gold-toned accents, the EDP’s design reflects the exquisite fragrance within.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradoxe Virtual Flower Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Pushing the boundaries of sensory perception, Prada Paradoxe Virtual Flower Eau de Parfum showcases an Artificial Intelligence augmented floral signature as an ode to jasmine. Crafted with a luminous blend of vert de bergamot and neroli, the floral-musky fragrance opens with Paradoxe’s iconic zesty top notes. An AI-refined jasmine accord captures the flower’s airy, uplifting aroma as perceived in nature, allowing perfumers to explore its olfactive possibilities and rethink florality thanks to modern technology. To close the trail, notes of musk and ambrette melt together to create a warm, second skin-like sensation that supports the eau de parfum’s impressive longevity. The entire Prada Paradoxe range is refillable. A 50ml pack and a 100ml refill contains 38% less packaging in total compared to three 50ml packs of Prada Paradoxe.* *Reductions vary depending on original bottle size, between 20-31% for glass, 17-58% for plastic and 21-44% for cardboard.

listings.rawTitle: Coach Love Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Set free your inner romantic with the Coach Love Eau de Parfum, a floral fruity scent that exudes feelings of passion and tenderness. Inspired by the universal experience of love, the sweet fragrance accords mingle together to create a hypnotic love potion. Beginning with a passionate, fruity burst, wild strawberry opens this scent with a flirty feminine start.
