The ultimate symbol of romance, the red rose conquers the fragrance's heart with its rich, velvet petals. Warming cedarwood captures the ending of this love story, with a seductive and alluring finish. The fragrance was created in collaboration with director and photographer Juergen Teller to celebrate love in all its forms. Held captive in a vibrant red glass flacon, even the perfume’s bottle exudes passion and romance waiting to be unleashed. Adorned with an adorable gold heart charm, the bottle is embossed with the iconic carriage logo.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Bois Pacifique Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Bois Pacifique, an olfactive expedition to freedom. Tom Ford’s Eau de Parfum draws inspiration from nature, bringing to mind images of a blossoming woodland bathed in the sun’s warming rays. The fragrance expresses its majestic character through a sensuous blend of woods and spices, including turmeric, sandalwood and oakwood. A perfect balance of fresh and warm, every spritz invites its wearers on a journey to self-discovery. Like the scent itself, the flacon is bursting with vitality, featuring a luminous gold tint, metallic detailing and a ribbed silhouette.

listings.rawTitle: Floral Street Sunflower Pop Perfume Mist 125ml
listings.description: Inspired by Van Gogh’s iconic artwork, the Floral Street Sunflower Pop Perfume Mist brightens your scent trail with its citrus aroma. Made with rose water, this perfume mist nourishes the skin and hair as you spritz, offering light hydration. Meanwhile, notes of juicy mandarin, bergamot and bellini uplift the senses to leave you smelling sumptuous, capturing the essence of a vibrant, sunshine-filled morning. Power up your perfume layering routine with the brand’s Sunflower Pop Eau de Parfum for enhanced intensity.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Vanilla Sex All Over Body Spray 150ml
listings.description: Give your aroma a dessert-like overhaul with TOM FORD's Vanilla Sex All Over Body Spray. This sophisticated take on a vanilla fragrance features creamy sandalwood and other nuances to ground the sweetness. With brighter and deeper variations of the good-enough-to-eat note, the scent pyramid has plenty of dimension while boasting a moreish quality. Jasmine and orris accord offset the saccharine flavour with their flowery and powdery elements, while animalis injects a hearty dose of musk. Spritz it from top to toe and take it with you for sweet convenience.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradoxe Virtual Flower Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Pushing the boundaries of sensory perception, Prada Paradoxe Virtual Flower Eau de Parfum showcases an Artificial Intelligence augmented floral signature as an ode to jasmine. Crafted with a luminous blend of vert de bergamot and neroli, the floral-musky fragrance opens with Paradoxe’s iconic zesty top notes. An AI-refined jasmine accord captures the flower’s airy, uplifting aroma as perceived in nature, allowing perfumers to explore its olfactive possibilities and rethink florality thanks to modern technology. To close the trail, notes of musk and ambrette melt together to create a warm, second skin-like sensation that supports the eau de parfum’s impressive longevity. A 50ml pack and a 100ml refill contains 38% less packaging in total compared to three 50ml packs of Prada Paradoxe.* *Reductions vary depending on original bottle size, between 20-31% for glass, 17-58% for plastic and 21-44% for cardboard.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo With Love Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Invigorate your scent ritual with Jimmy Choo I Want Choo With Love Eau de Parfum, a fragrance that unfolds like a story on the skin. Opening with a bright zing of mandarin and orange flower petals, the perfume's bouquet begins on an invigorating sensory note. As the formula settles, florals bloom at its heart, with hibiscus flower complementing delicate freesia. Relish in the seductive dry-down as vanilla and moody musks feature at the perfume's creamy core.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani I Will Eau de Parfum 100ml Refill
listings.description: A bold expression of modern masculinity, Giorgio Armani's I Will Eau de Parfum Refill leaves an intense and unmistakable trail. The fresh fragrance opens with notes of Calabrian bergamot, leading into a heart of soft lavender essence. At the base, dark woods and rich leather add a smoky sensuality to Madagascan vanilla. Designed to refill your existing architectural bottle, the perfume lasts up to 24 hours*, transitioning effortlessly from day to night. *Consumer test, 69 subjects.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty For Him Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Extending a loving invitation to explore, create and connect with our truest selves, Gucci Guilty Pour Femme and Pour Homme fragrances relaunches with a campaign starring A$AP Rocky, Julia Garner and Elliot Page. An ode to self-acceptance, friendship and love in all its forms, Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Eau de Parfum for Men presents an aromatic Fougère, that inspires a fresh take on blending sensuality with living authentically. Suggestive and unexpected, Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Eau de Parfum for Men is a woody, aromatic and spicy aftershave fragrance created to provoke self-confidence and acceptance from within. Rose and Chili Pepper present an unexpected and invigorating retro vibe, while Patchouli and Cedarwood accentuate this Eau de Parfum for men’s richness and sensuality. Encapsulated in a fully metallised bottle, the seductive scent is dressed in dark anthracite, with a matching cap. The design is finished with the house’s emblematic Interlocking G logo.

listings.rawTitle: Le Monde Gourmand Banane Délice Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: The Le Monde Gourmand Banane Délice Eau de Parfum 30ml captures the feeling of sun-warmed skin and sweet, tropical air in a playful, creamy scent that lingers close. The Eau de Parfum opens with a bright twist of banana, pineapple and orange, softening into coconut and sugared florals. As it settles, whipped vanilla, tonka bean and soft musks leave a smooth, warming trail that wears like a summer memory.

listings.rawTitle: Molton Brown Mesmerising Oudh Accord & Gold 7.5ml EDP
listings.description: A richly layered scent that stirs the senses, Molton Brown’s Mesmerising Oudh Accord & Gold Eau de Parfum captures the enigmatic essence of the East. Nuances of smoky black tea, saffron and rose unfold against a rich heart, enveloped by the warmth of oud, honey and tobacco. Notes of bergamot and black pepper offer an initial brightness, while olibanum and styrax lend a smooth depth. Crafted with complexity, the travel-sized elixir offers an olfactive journey through shadow and light.

listings.rawTitle: Coach Men Pure Platinum Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Your gateway to compliments, the Coach Men Pure Platinum Parfum distils strength and expression into a magnetic elixir, boasting an ambery aromatic profile. An evolution of the 2018 opus created by perfumer Bruno Jovanovic, the fragrance weaves an olfactory web of intrigue and sophistication. In the top layer, vibrant lavender oil establishes a bold, herbaceous prelude that enters the room before you do. The fragrance evolves slowly into the boozy warmth of rum as it dries on the skin, offsetting the powdery element above with a molasses-like depth. Extending the trail from day into night, ambrox resides in the base, anchoring the composition with an addictive edge. The result is an unspoken assertion of confidence that's harnessed and reflected in the platinum-toned bottle housing it.

listings.rawTitle: Travalo Classic Atomiser 5ml Pink
listings.description: Producing an ultra-fine, luxurious mist, the Travalo Perfume Atomiser Classic HD is a refillable fragrance ampoule suitable for your hand luggage. Holding 5ml of formula, the spray features an innovative Genie-S 'pump to fill' system that stops any fragrance from spilling or being exposed to air. Its lightweight, aircraft-approved materials are perfect for travel, while the brand’s U-change system makes it easy to switch up your favourite scents as desired.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Her Elixir de Parfum for Women 100ml
listings.description: Capturing the essence of fearless and fierce femininity, Burberry’s Her Elixir de Parfum bottles a bold fruity fragrance with a sensual and adventurous olfactive story. A daring burst of dark berries opens the scent trail, immersing the senses in an addictive air from the very first spritz. A soft floral heart of jasmine pairs perfectly with the luscious fruit facets, emboldened by a golden creamy base of vanilla and amber. Housed in a pastel pink bottle with the brand name embossed, the parfum brings a confident charm to your fragrance collection.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Invictus Victory Elixir Parfum 50ml
listings.description: A potent nectar designed to push victory beyond limits, Rabanne’s Invictus Victory Elixir offers the pinnacle of intensity. The rich, powerful fragrance for men blends spicy woods with a sharp freshness to create a high-impact blend. Discover a rush of freshness with top notes of aromatic lavandin, green cardamom and black pepper, which settle to reveal a deep, mysterious heart of incense and woody Indonesian patchouli. A delectable tonka bean liqueur adds depth to the Madagascan vanilla bean. Showcasing the scent’s victorious DNA with a golden V and lacquered trophy design, the bottle reflects the richness of the elixir it holds.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Invictus Victory Elixir Parfum 100ml
listings.description: A potent nectar designed to push victory beyond limits, Rabanne’s Invictus Victory Elixir offers the pinnacle of intensity. The rich, powerful fragrance for men blends spicy woods with a sharp freshness to create a high-impact blend. Discover a rush of freshness with top notes of aromatic lavandin, green cardamom and black pepper, which settle to reveal a deep, mysterious heart of incense and woody Indonesian patchouli. Showcasing the scent’s victorious DNA with a golden V and lacquered trophy design, the bottle reflects the richness of the elixir it holds.

listings.description: A potent nectar designed to push victory beyond limits, Rabanne’s Invictus Victory Elixir offers the pinnacle of intensity. Discover a rush of freshness with top notes of aromatic lavandin, green cardamom and black pepper, which settle to reveal a deep, mysterious heart of incense and woody Indonesian patchouli. listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica on a Date Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Inspired by a magical date on a late summer’s evening, where the golden glow of sunset warms your skin, Maison Margiela’s Replica On A Date Eau de Toilette exudes a joyful scent of ripe grapes and fresh roses. Part of the Replica collection inspired by familiar locations and memories, the perfume evokes nostalgia of seduction and falling in love. The sparkling fruitiness of grapes soaked in warm sunshine is captured with zesty bergamot and a sweet blackcurrant liquor accord. Luminous Isparta rose petal essence fills the air with floral and fruity inflections, recreating the thrill of a date. Sustainably sourced in Bali, sensual, woody notes of patchouli transport the senses to the vineyards of Provence at dusk.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani My Way Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Giorgio Armani’s My Way Le Parfum is a feminine fragrance that invites you to explore new horizons. Refreshing and romantic, the scent is characterized by a powdery bouquet at its heart, perfect for springtime wear. A radiant bergamot accord introduces the perfume, intertwining with bright, floral nuances of tuberose. The fragrance dries down onto a bed of cedarwood, adding an earthy twist to the scent for an intoxicating finish. Adventure into the unknown with My Way Le Parfum.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani My Way Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Giorgio Armani’s My Way Le Parfum is a feminine fragrance that invites you to explore new horizons. Refreshing and romantic, the scent is characterized by a powdery bouquet at its heart, perfect for springtime wear. A radiant bergamot accord introduces the perfume, intertwining with bright, floral nuances of tuberose. The fragrance dries down onto a bed of cedarwood, adding an earthy twist to the scent for an intoxicating finish. Adventure into the unknown with My Way Le Parfum.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Un Jardin à Cythère Eau de Toilette Bottle Refill 200ml
listings.description: Created by Hermès' perfumer Christine Nagel, Un Jardin a Cythere eau de toilette is a surprising garden that is neither green nor floral, but... blond. It is the expression of an olfactory quest through Greece that leads to Kythira, a picturesque island that has inspired many artists. A citrus and woody fragrance, Un Jardin a Cythere eau de toilette combines enveloping notes of grasses with the strength of olive wood and the tenderness of fresh pistachio. The Un Jardin a Cythere eau de toilette refill can replenish the 100ml, 50ml and 30ml bottles. An environmentally responsible gesture, integral to an object designed to last.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Forte Nerolia Vetiver Eau de Parfum 125ml
listings.description: The Aqua Allegoria fragrance collection celebrates the wonders of the world. Each creation pays tribute to nature’s beauty and sweeps us up in a discovery of exceptional raw ingredients and notes, beautifully enhanced by our perfumer-explorers. Discover Nerolia Vetiver Forte, a neroli radiated with light, enveloped by the generosity of a creamy fig accord, the warmth of vetiver and the almond notes of the tonka bean. “I created a neroli gilded by the rays of a setting sun, and awakened by the power of vetiver." - Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfumer. Aqua Allegoria Forte, the intense collection, is a warm and enveloping journey to the heart of the world’s wonders: Eaux de Parfum celebrating the intense beauty of nature, revealed by the golden rays of a setting sun. A powerful symbol of Guerlain's commitment to the planet, the Aqua Allegoria Forte fragrances contain more than 90% natural origin*. The French beetroot alcohol used in their formulas comes from a network committed to responsible farming.  *In accordance with the ISO 16128, calculation including water.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Forte Nerolia Vetiver Eau de Parfum Refill 200ml
listings.description: The Aqua Allegoria fragrance collection celebrates the wonders of the world. It cannot be used alone and is only compatible with refillable 75ml and 125 ml bottles.  *In accordance with the ISO 16128, calculation including water.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentleman Society Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Redefine the meaning of modern masculinity with the Givenchy Gentleman Society Eau de Parfum, a multifaceted fragrance that contrasts floral notes with an enigmatic woody accord for a bold olfactory statement. Fresh top notes of sage combine with the florality of wild narcissus absolute, harvested in the heart of France. This is contrasted with the mysterious intensity of a vetiver quartet, harvested in Madagascar and Uruguay. Sandalwood, cedarwood and vanilla add warmth and create the addictive base of this men's aftershave, leaving a memorable trail behind. Inspired by the couture designs of the House, Gentleman Society revisits the iconic bottle of Givenchy men’s fragrances for an edgy yet distinguished look. Like a crest, a reinterpreted 4G monogram in gleaming silver metal emblazons the black lacquered finish. The bottle is made from 15% post-consumer recycled glass.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Ébène Fumé Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: A meditative scent that evokes mindfulness through aroma, meet TOM FORD’s iconic Ébène Fumé Eau de Parfum. Inspired by the purifying essence of Palo Santo smoke, this cologne invites you to take a moment to indulge in olfactive transformation. As you inhale, a blend of cistus absolute, black pepper and ebony wood evokes intrigue with its warm elegance, while a backdrop of leather entices the senses. Striking the perfect balance of soft, smoky tendrils with stimulating woods, spray this fragrance onto the pulse points for lasting intrigue and allure.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Ebène Fumé Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Conjuring a transcendent spiritual calm through its woody amber accords, Tom Ford’s Ebène Fumé captures a meditative feeling within a luxurious Eau de Parfum. The essence of palo santo is fused with ebony wood, creating a seductive and sensual unisex fragrance. Mystical and alluring, the smoky aromas are stoked by elegant notes of cistus absolute and rose. The bottle features a transparent glass design, showcasing the richness of the elixir it holds. A wood-embossed plaque and mahogany-toned cap encapsulate the perfume’s palo santo essence.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Q Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: A fragrance designed to make its wearer feel like a contemporary queen, Q by Dolce&Gabbana exudes radiant and refined feminine energy. The Eau de Parfum fuses vibrant citrus fruits with a delicate bouquet of florals. Sparkling notes of Sicilian lemon and red orange are elevated by delicate jasmine petals. A heart of sweet cherry and creamy heliotrope seduce the senses, before base notes of cedarwood and musk give the floral perfume an intense, addictive edge.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss HUGO Jeans for Men Eau de Toilette 125ml
listings.description: A bold and breezy cologne that’s always in fashion, the HUGO Jeans Eau de Toilette by Hugo Boss is a multi-seasonal fragrance with an invigorating composition. Laced with fresh facets of grapefruit, peppermint and juniper berries, the eau de toilette opens with a burst of irresistible energy, magnetising the senses from the first spritz. Emboldened by notes of sandalwood and vetiver, the scent melts into a warm woody base, giving it a long-lasting trail. The cologne arrives in a matte denim flask, featuring the iconic red and black logo like the one found on HUGO’s classic jeans.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme La Vie est Belle Eau De Parfum Refillable Bundle
listings.description: A universal declaration of the beauty of life, Lancôme’s La Vie est Belle Eau de Parfum is an iconic scent for her. Discover the luminous floral fragrance, alongside a refill to top up your scent. Set Contents: La Vie est Belle Eau de Parfum 100ml Created by three renowned French perfumers, the fragrance is the perfect balance of iris, patchouli and vanilla accord. A burst of pear and blackberry opens the scent trail, making way for a floral heart of iris, orange flower and jasmine sambac. Sourced from Bali, patchouli adds a rich depth to this scent of happiness. La Vie Est Belle Eau de Parfum Refillable Recharge 100ml Celebrate the iconic, timeless fragrance again and again with this refill, designed to top up your existing glass bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Miller Harris Myrica Muse Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Another sensorial story from Miller Harris, the Myrica Muse Eau de Parfum brings about an air of refined charm and serenity with its floral musk aura. Steal a moment alone for a brief taste of reflection, by enjoying a sunny evening walk or stopping to sit outside a café. Whatever your moment is, allow Myrica Muse to indulge in it with you.  A fruity fusion of bayberry, strawberry and tangerine exudes an aroma of freedom and liberation with its crisp freshness. At its heart, a bouquet of jasmine, lily and rose creates a sublime elegance captured in all its petals, while seductive rum and patchouli exert a sensual, woody dry down. Creamy vanilla fuses with resinous benzoin to finish off this scent in the most tempting way. With its fruity-floral nuances, this scent imitates the renewed sense of energy gained from taking a second for yourself. Vegan.

listings.rawTitle: Miller Harris Peau Santal Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Miller Harris’ Peau Santal Eau de Parfum celebrates the comforting warmth of New Caledonian sandalwood in a truly unisex composition. The rich scent conjures images of fireside evenings and library books, combining papyrus and olibanum to create an enveloping resinous quality. The opening of bergamot, pink pepper and saffron offers a kick of spice, enlivening the fragrance, while violet leaf lends a softness that holds close to the skin. A dry down of cashmere woods, moss and crisp amber creates a cosy, earthy feel, wrapped in creamy vanilla CO2 extract. Creating an addictive, lasting trail, the EDP evokes closeness by balancing sweetness and depth. Vegan.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Blush Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Discover a fragrance that exemplifies romance and allure with Carolina Herrera’s Good Girl Blush Eau de Parfum. Embody your light feminine side with notes of fresh rose and sensual vanilla. Italian bergamot and juicy mandarin open this scent with a delectable citrus kick, accompanied by luxurious almond oil. At its heart settles exotic ylang-ylang and elegant rose oil, providing a sophisticated and classic touch. Provoke allure and seduction with hints of rich vanilla and tonka bean, that adds a deepness to the base. The uniquely shaped bottle takes the form of a stiletto high heel. Providing glamour and class, the pink stiletto embodies the beauty of the Carolina Herrara fashion house.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Tantalising and Seductive Travel Cologne Duo
listings.description: Adorn yourself with enticing mandarin or seductive pomegranate with the Jo Malone London Travel Cologne Duo. Featuring miniature editions of Tantalising Lime Basil & Mandarin and Pomegranate Noir Cologne, the duo fit perfectly into any handbag or pocket for an on-the-go aroma. Set Contents: Lime Basil & Mandarin Cologne 9ml A tantalising fragrance featuring citrus and herbal hues for a refreshing aroma. One of Jo Malone London’s signature scents, the cologne conjures a Caribbean breeze with delectable notes of mandarin and basil, blending with an amberwood base. Pomegranate Noir Cologne 9ml A cologne that exemplifies seduction and boldness. Exotic pomegranate and rhubarb mingle with spiced pink pepper and guaiac wood for a sensual, seductive twist. Each note is contrasted by a conflicting counterpart. As subtle watermelon is contrasted by citrusy olibanum, Casablanca lily is seasoned with jasmine, and sweet patchouli is balanced with warm amber.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun Another Oud Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Juliette Has A Gun offers a modern interpretation of a classic fragrance note. The Another Oud Eau de Parfum exudes mystery, inviting the senses on an olfactive adventure with every spritz. The fragrance centres around the warm, rich nuances of oud. Paired with fruits and the ambery undertones of norlimbanol, the EDP creates an exciting scent trail that is modern and bold, laced with musk for a touch of sensuality.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Eau de Parfum For Her 50ml
listings.description: Extending a loving invitation to explore, create and connect with our truest selves, Gucci Guilty Pour Femme and Pour Homme fragrances relaunches with a campaign starring A$AP Rocky, Julia Garner and Elliot Page. An ode to self-acceptance, friendship and love in all its forms, Gucci Guilty Pour Femme Eau de Parfum for Women presents an ambery floral scent, that inspires a fresh take on blending sensuality with living authentically. Superior floral tones and enhanced fragrances flourish into a refined Eau de Parfum for women. This citrus perfume is strengthened, with a higher perfume concentrate than the classic Eau de Toilette, radiating with commanding Mandora, Pink Pepper, Lilac and Patchouli. Opening the mood of this perfume for women, citrus notes of Mandora are followed by nuances of Bergamot and Pink Pepper. The heart defines this Gucci scent’s complexity, where lilac contrasts rose and violet notes layered with Geranium oil. Defining the scent, Patchouli blends with ambery notes to add a layer of seduction. Echoing the same shape as the counterpart men’s fragrance, the Gucci Guilty Pour Femme bottle is partly wrapped in gold-toned metal, with a matching shimmering cap, reflecting the pale rose-tinted fragrance inside. The Interlocking G logo defines the front.

listings.rawTitle: Laura Mercier Ambre Vanille Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Adorn yourself with an aroma of decadence with Laura Mercier’s Ambre Vanille Eau de Parfum, a fragrance devised to charm and captivate with intoxicating amber accords. Beginning with a fruity burst, delectable tangerine creates a refreshing opening to the scent. Tiger orchid settles at the heart, blending with the star of the scent, spiced amber, for a warm blend of comfort. Adding to the iconic Ambre Vanille collection, the fragrance enhances the scent of your favourite Soufflé Body Crème with the same fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau D'Issey Pivione Eau de Toilette Intense 50ml
listings.description: A refreshing and radiant fragrance, the Issey Miyake L’Eau D’Issey Pivione Eau de Toilette Intense is an expression of an essential, ever-evolving element. The water-inspired fragrance is pure and calm, drawing on bright nuances of peony to illustrate the return of sunny days. Created exclusively for Issey Miyake, the floral accord lends the scent juicy green facets, intertwining with a delectable heart of raspberry. Lying at the base is a sensuous cedarwood essence, rounding out the uplifting EDT. The quintessential glass perfume bottle features an elegant pink tone, reminiscent of peony petals. Topped with a contrasting nude cap, the flacon exudes luxury and simplicity. Vegan.

listings.description: Elegant and refined, an invitation to live life to the fullest. The Serge Lutens Écrin de Fumée Eau de Parfum is an enchanting fragrance for those who find delight in opulent luxury. Sweet, sensual nuances of tobacco mingle with spicy rum for an addictive olfactory impression, finished with a delectable cocoa accord. The perfume is reminiscent of Serge Lutens signature minimalistic style, reflected in the simple, straight-lined flacon.

listings.rawTitle: MCM Onyx Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Allow MCM to take you on a transformative journey with the Onyx Eau de Parfum. Blurring the lines between real and virtual, the fragrance fuses vibrant aromatic notes with woody undertones to create a modern masculine scent. Hand-picked ginger and spices open with a burst of energy, before revealing a heart of lavender, basil and violet leaf. A dry down of sensual woody notes offers long-lasting minerality.

listings.rawTitle: MCM Ultra Intense Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Taking authority to challenge traditional ideals of femininity, MCM’s Ultra Intense Eau de Parfum pushes the boundaries of the olfactive universe to showcase a soft floral scent, spiked with contrasting woody notes. A fresh and aromatic air of pink pepper opens the fragrance trail, enticing the senses as they reach a flower-powered heart of dreamy tuberose. This rich, sweet facet is paired with its warmer, earthier counterpart of golden amber, and juxtaposed with balsamic cedarwood nuances to create an exhilarating, mesmeric cocktail of accords.

listings.rawTitle: MCM Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Fusing the art of classic perfumery with the latest innovative technologies, the MCM Eau de Parfum is driven by the currents of wanderlust to deliver a remarkable olfactive journey that intrigues the senses. Deconstructed through expressive accords, the scent opens with hyper-real raspberry, offset by a bloom of hand-picked jasmine. Nuances of warm amber coincide with clean textured woods to create a tranquil realm. The universal scent is cleverly presented inside a miniature remake of the legendary Stark backpack, the perfect nod to the brand's travel DNA.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Her Elixir de Parfum for Women 50ml
listings.description: Capturing the essence of fearless and fierce femininity, Burberry’s Her Elixir de Parfum bottles a bold fruity fragrance with a sensual and adventurous olfactive story. A daring burst of dark berries opens the scent trail, immersing the senses in an addictive air from the very first spritz. A soft floral heart of jasmine pairs perfectly with the luscious fruit facets, emboldened by a golden creamy base of vanilla and amber. Housed in a pastel pink bottle with the brand name embossed, the parfum brings a confident charm to your fragrance collection.

listings.rawTitle: Eilish by Billie Eilish Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: From the musings of singer Billie Eilish comes her debut Eau De Parfum, an amber gourmand scent that feels like home. The warm and cosy composition delicately blends fruity nuances with woods and spices for an inviting olfactory experience. Opening with sweet sugared petals, the EDP uplifts the senses with red berries and a mandarin accord, wrapped in a delectable blend of cocoa and vanilla. A creamy dry down of musk and woods adds a sensual twist, finished with tonka bean. Veiled in a luxurious amber-bronze hue, the statement bottle highlights Eilish’s favourite parts of the body, including the chest, neck and collarbone. Vegan.

listings.description: Embark on Billie Eilish’s dark floral fantasy with her latest fragrance addition, Eilish No. 2 Eau De Parfum. Housed in her signature sculpted silhouette with a chromatic black finishing, the mesmeric scent is sure to take centre stage on any vanity. The captivating aroma opens with an exhilarating air of Italian bergamot and apple blossom, lacing between sultry spices and flowered facets of black pepper and wild poppy to charm the senses. Papyrus welcomes warmth and earthiness, pairing perfectly with the woodiness of palo santo and ebony, wrapped in a seductive skin musk essence for longevity and intensity.

listings.rawTitle: Ghost The Fragrance Eau de Toilette 30ml
listings.description: Simple but mesmerising and a true modern classic, the Ghost fragrance captures the essence of femininity with delectable florals and aromatic vanilla. The fragrance opens with fresh notes of sweet ambrette and tropical hibiscus, mingling with rose petals for a floral kick. At the heart, sensual jasmine and rich sandalwood blend with earthy frankincense. An aromatic concoction of amber and apricot mix with delicate vanilla and crisp musk, creating the depth of the base which makes the fragrance iconic.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Explorer Platinum Eau de Parfum 60ml
listings.description: Dare to experience the thrill of the world’s highest mountains with the Montblanc Explorer Platinum Eau de Parfum. The fragrance offers an exhilarating olfactory experience that embodies the spirit of exploration, featuring vibrant green notes of grapefruit, violet leaves and clary sage. The addition of cedarwood adds depth and intensity to the scent, wrapped in an amber accord for an invigorating finish. Presented in a bold silver colourway, the bottle is inspired by the Montblanc 1958 Geosphere, a watch that paid tribute to the prestigious seven summit mountaineering challenge.

listings.rawTitle: Coach Green Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Inspired by an escape to nature, the Coach Green Eau de Toilette imitates the relaxing and aromatic notes of fresh greenery amidst the dynamic energy of the city. Opening with a fruity accord of green kiwi, the fragrance begins with a vibrant burst. Rosemary essence interrupts at the heart, capturing an evergreen freshness in the crisp cold air. Drying down to a woody base of crystal moss, the fragrance unlocks an earthy aroma that lingers.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Pour Homme Eau de Toilette Vapo 75ml
listings.description: Dedicated to the style and elegance of the Italian man, Dolce&Gabbana Pour Homme Eau de Toilette exudes irresistible appeal through its aromatic fougere olfactive experience. The fragrance for men opens with refreshing notes of neroli and citrus hints of mandarin and bergamot. A heart of sage, lavender and pepper evokes fresh laundry in a Mediterranean breeze. Adding a woody dry down, a touch of tobacco, cedar wood and tonka bean settle at the base.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana The One Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Revealing layers of golden sweetness with fruity-floral facets, Dolce&Gabbana’s The One Eau de Parfum Spray expresses your contemporary olfactive elegance. A solar opening of bergamot and mandarin entices the senses with a citrus radiance, paired with lychee and peach to embolden the juicy charm. Exotic fruits weave between classic petalled rose nuances, granting long-lasting freshness with a fierce edge. Warm amber and vanilla notes bring the eau de parfum’s trail to a close with an inviting familiarity, while encouraging scent longevity and wear on the skin.

listings.rawTitle: Houbigant Quelques Fleurs Original Eau de Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description: Premiering in 1912, the Houbigant Quelques Fleurs Original Eau de Parfum continues to excite wearers with its floral qualities and feminine exuberance. The scent begins with a green opening, with enlivening accords of bergamot and lemon accompanied by tarragon for an invigorating start. At the heart, a bouquet of ethereal flowers celebrates their ambrosial abilities with a compelling blend of carnation, rose and violet. Petals of jasmine, tuberose and lily of the valley combine to create a white floral composition that exudes sophistication.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Crystal Noir Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Cocoon yourself in a velvety blend of golden resin, smooth woods, and skin-like musk. This captivating fragrance opens with a burst of fiery spice, where cardamom’s soft sophistication meets the sharp heat of pepper and the radiant zest of ginger. As the intensity settles, luminous florals bloom, notes of gardenia, peony, and orange flower unfold in a delicate harmony that evokes confidence, elegance, and quiet romance. Finally, the scent melts into creamy ambered woods, wrapping the skin in a golden warmth that feels sensual, comforting, and effortlessly refined. From spark to serenity, it’s a fragrance that captures the essence of sophistication and timeless allure.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Tuscan Leather Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: Adorn your skin with the opulent scents within Tom Ford’s ‘Tuscan Leather’ Eau de Parfum. Prepare to give into your primal instincts as top notes of potent saffron, sweet, whimsical raspberries and herby thyme intoxicate your senses, encouraging you to express yourself honestly and authentically. Animalistic heart notes of olibanum and rich, luxurious jasmine evoke adventurous visions of journeys and pilgrimages, reminding you to surrender to your wanderlust and to never shy away from exploration. The fragrance finishes in a dramatic, dominant manner with earthy, smouldering aromas of suede, hypnotic amber and woods, rounding off the cocktail of scents to reveal possibility and excitement. Encased in a classic Tom Ford black bottle that is guaranteed to be an eye-catching addition to any room.

listings.rawTitle: Ariana Grande Sweet Like Candy Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Proving fruits and florals can be friends, the Ariana Grande Sweet Like Candy Eau de Parfum Spray is a gourmand scent with a delectable candied-amber dry down. Beaming with notes of sugar-frosted blackberry and sparkling bergamot, the fragrance opens with a juicy fruit blend, elevated by the elegance of pear extract. Nectarous honeysuckle mingles with fresh jasmine, while creamy cashmere woods are whipped amongst marshmallow and vanilla nuances, leaving a delicious, velvety finish on the skin. Encased in a jewelled baby pink flacon, attired with a fluffy pompom, the head-turning perfume is a chic, playful addition to your fragrance collection.

listings.rawTitle: Ariana Grande Ari Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: From hit singles to fruity-floral fragrance blends, Ariana Grande’s Ari Eau de Parfum Spray is the artist’s introductory perfume, with an eponymous name to symbolise its intimate, multi-faceted allure. Playful and confident, the scent stars a light-hearted grapefruit and raspberry medley, mixed with juicy pear to add a sparkling sweetness. A feminine melange of rose, lily of the valley and vanilla orchid ignites passion, while spun musks and woods streamline the olfactive trail. Topped with marshmallow, the fragrance finishes on a rich, gourmand note, serving as a reminder to enjoy the fun and sensory delight of each day.

listings.description: Radiating joy and positivity, the Cloud Eau de Parfum by ARIANA GRANDE promises an uplifting olfactory experience. The opening notes of bergamot and pear lend the scent its dreamy freshness, married with lavender blossom for a floral touch. As the fragrance unfurls, mouth-watering nuances of crème de coconut and praline begin to emerge, adding a sweet richness to the perfume that lingers on the skin, before finishing with an irresistible whipped cream and musk blend. The design of the bottle is as whimsical as the scent within. Nestled inside a cloud, the fragrance is an eye-catching addition to your scent collection.

listings.rawTitle: Ariana Grande Thank U, Next Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Celebrating freedom and individuality, Ariana Grande presents the Thank U, Next Eau de Parfum Spray to inspire self-expression and confidence. The gourmand scent blankets the senses with a reassuring aroma. Bursting with attitude, a fruity fusion of coconut, pear and raspberry brings the scent to life with a vibrant, enthusiastic opening. At the heart, a bouquet of pink roses treats you to a much-needed moment of self-love, paired with an indulgent serving of delectable macaroons. Creamy musk tops off the scent with a warming touch against the skin for a comforting finish.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake Fusion D'Issey Extreme Eau de Toilette Spray 50ml
listings.description: Fusion D’Issey Extreme, an olfactive exploration of nature’s most powerful wonders. Drawing inspiration from oceans and volcanoes, the fragrance plays on the juxtaposition of hot and icy to create a thrilling sillage. Issey Miyake’s Eau de Toilette offers a more intense experience than its predecessor. The freshness of the currents is represented by a spicy cardamom and bergamot elixir, balanced with a mineral solar accord. As formidable as the magma that spews from a volcano’s crest, the fragrance transforms into an incandescent force with an explosion of sandalwood and patchouli essences. These scent disparities are displayed in the flacon’s design. The blue polished glass sits beneath a jet-black, stone-like topper in a homage to the fragrance’s light and dark contrasts, while the orange lettering is reminiscent of its lava influences.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun MMMM... Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Putting a contemporary spin on Shakespeare’s heroine, Juliette Has a Gun presents feminine fragrances designed for the modern-day woman. Behind MMMM… Eau de Parfum lies a world of hidden pleasure that goes beyond the sound. The gourmand fragrance showcases an olfactive sweetness to provoke immediate bliss. Mouth-watering top notes of raspberry, geranium and neroli are sprinkled over a floral bouquet of orange blossom, jasmine and tuberose. Comforting like an indulgent treat, sandalwood and patchouli mingle with accents of vanilla and caramel to create a sweet, rich scent trail.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun Lady Vengeance Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Rich and confident, Juliette Has A Gun’s Lady Vengeance bottles the art of seduction. The feminine Eau de Parfum empowers its wearer with every spritz. The elegance of Bulgarian rose pairs with earthy patchouli to create a sophisticated sillage, finished with vanilla for its warm, creamy facets. The flacon represents the powerful energy of the scent within, pairing a jet-black colourway with eye-catching embellishments.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has A Gun Musc Invisible Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: Comforting like your favourite pair of old jeans, Juliette Has a Gun’s Musc Invisible Eau de Parfum layers dreamy and nostalgic notes on a creamy base of musk. The soothing scent opens with clean, fresh tones of jasmine absolute and cotton flower, settling on a base of white musk for a warm, comforting finale. Evoking feelings of familiarity with its powdery musk facets, Musc Invisible is perfect as an everyday signature scent.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun Pear Inc. Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Showcasing a sparkling olfactive profile, the Pear Inc. Eau de Parfum by Juliette Has a Gun evokes the freshness of a crisp spring day, paired with the eternal sunshine of sweet musks for a well-rounded fruit fragrance. Succulent with a slight creaminess, the glazed green pear accord glistens amongst notes of ambroxan and cetalox, delivering a radiant, long-lasting dry down. Musk encourages a mellow softness, enhancing the clean composition while granting a multi-dimensional edge.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun Vanilla Vibes Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: The essence of a summer escape, perfectly encapsulated in a fragrance. The Juliette Has A Gun Vanilla Vibes Eau de Parfum is a sensual and powerful scent, transporting the senses to paradise with its intoxicating aroma. The salty undertones of the perfume can be attributed to fleur de sel, a natural ingredient found in the coastal regions of France. Paired with vanilla, alongside warm sandalwood, tonka bean and musk, the fragrance’s juxtaposition of warmth and freshness creates a captivating scent trail that lingers on the skin.

listings.rawTitle: Ariana Grande God Is A Woman Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Bold. Breathtaking. Effortless. God is a Woman by Ariana Grande is a breath of fresh air for the senses, intricately composed to inspire the wearer. The amber floral fragrance opens with a burst of juicy pear and airy ambrette, delivering sweetness that puts you in the spotlight. A melody of Turkish rose and orris creates a sensual floral harmony. As the scent settles, rich Madagascar vanilla and creamy cedarwood provide a warm, grounding embrace, leaving a lingering note that resonates long after the final chord fades.  Housed inside a sculptural flacon, it features a geometric, stone-like outer shell surrounding soft lavender-hued glass, giving it an architectural feel with clean lines and a minimalistic aesthetic.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Eau de Citron Noir Eau de Cologne Spray 50ml
listings.description: THE CREATION Eau de citron noir was created in 2018 by Hermès perfumer Christine Nagel. It presents an elegant and surprising freshness that reveals the paradoxes of a citrus fruit known and loved by all: lemon. A sophisticated composition full of contrast. OLFACTORY NOTES A citrus woody fragrance, Eau de citron noir cologne combines sharp lemon and a woody black tea with smoky notes of guaiac wood. THE OBJECT The iconic lantern bottle is adorned with a deep blue hue and the orange box is sealed with a blue band. THE HERMÈS COLOGNES COLLECTION The Hermès Colognes collection offers an infinite playground created for exploring the sensory nature of materials. It brings immediate and abundant pleasure that unifies beyond. "Following a path through the olfactory universe of hesperidia led me into a vast world, dotted with surprises, with citrus fruits.  Finger lime, Buddha's hand fruit, Eureka lemon... So many unusual varieties of citrus appealed to me, but it was the smoky and distinguished black lime that finally stood out as the key note." Christine Nagel  Eau de citron noir offers a unique and paradoxical imprint, a surprisingly persistent freshness which rises to the challenge of tenacity: it is the midday-to-midnight Cologne!

listings.rawTitle: Miller Harris La Fumeé Alexandrie Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: Reminiscent of ancient Egyptian rituals and incense-filled temples, Miller Harris’ La Fumeé Alexandrie Eau de Parfum Spray marries rose and oud notes in a rich, regal infusion. Sacred and seductive, the majestic scent opens with a vibrant fruit melange of mandarin and lychee, mingling on a bed of rose petals aflame with incense absolute and spiced geranium. The dry heat of papyrus, oud and sandalwood add an earthy, grounding depth, drenched in honeyed amber for a mesmeric finish on the skin.

listings.rawTitle: Miller Harris Coeur de Jardin Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: Capturing a precious moment of sunlit warmth following a rainstorm, Miller Harris’ Coeur de Jardin offers a floral chypre composition. Opening with bright, summertime notes of lemon, pear and peach, the radiant scent reveals a heart of Turkish rose, jasmine and tuberose. Enveloped in creamy vanilla, the bouquet is grounded by soft orris and musk. Warm, earthy notes of amber, patchouli, musk and moss linger on the skin, creating an addictive scent trail.

listings.rawTitle: Miller Harris Vetiver Insolent Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: A modern take on a vetiver classic, the Miller Harris Vetiver Insolent Eau de Parfum creates an energic but sensual aroma with remnants of blazing fire. Enlivening bergamot instantly captures the senses with a citrusy fresh beginning to this enticing fragrance. Black pepper and cardamom harmonise with the zesty accords with a warming sensation. At the heart, a bouquet of iris and lavandin creates a refreshing floral fusion. The star of the scent, Haitian vetiver, exposes all of its facets as its earthiness is contrasted with the smokiness of elemi and amber in this contemporary take on the scent.

listings.rawTitle: Miller Harris Lumière Dorée Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: Out of the entire collection of London perfumery Miller Harris’ opulent fragrances, Lumière Dorée is by far the brightest scent. It blends crisp, powdery notes of fresh spring flowers with a soapy-clean, fougère undertone that lingers in the backdrop. Hints of musky and woody hues creep in as it dries down, leaving behind a complex but perfectly balanced aroma on your skin with an uplifting feel. Vegan

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Bloom For Her Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Gucci Bloom Eau de Parfum for women is a sophisticated perfume capturing the spirit of the contemporary, diverse and authentic women of Gucci. Tempting notes of Tuberose and Jasmine leave an unexpectedly rich white floral scent on the skin. Rangoon Creeper accord, a plant that changes colour when it blooms, infuses this Gucci scent with a powdery, floral edge.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty For Him Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Extending a loving invitation to explore, create and connect with our truest selves, Gucci Guilty Pour Femme and Pour Homme fragrances relaunches with a campaign starring A$AP Rocky, Julia Garner and Elliot Page. An ode to self-acceptance, friendship and love in all its forms, Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Eau de Toilette for Men presents an aromatic Fougère, that inspires a fresh take on blending sensuality with living authentically. Hedonistic and decadent, the aftershave fragrance opens with piquant Pink Pepper mixed with invigorating Italian Lemon. At the heart of this men's Eau de Toilette, the non-conformist ideals of Gucci Guilty coincide with non-conventional fragrance-making by incorporating Orange Blossom, a scent traditionally used as a symbol of romance and innocence in feminine fragrances. White floral with honey tones enrich this Gucci aftershave's notes of Neroli and French Lavender—the very flower the original playboy, Casanova, used to fragrance his love letters. Completing this modern expression of sensuality, mystery and intrigue are tempting aromas of Patchouli which develop with hints of leather, green, woodiness and incense-like qualities. The dry down finishes with the masculine richness of Cedar Wood. The Gucci aftershave is housed in a sleek black bottle with a transparent upper half which contrasts with the frosted metal bottom half, mirroring the aftershave fragrance within.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty For Him Eau de Toilette 90ml

listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradoxe Intense Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Embodying fierce femininity, Prada’s Paradoxe Intense Eau de Parfum explores the complexity yet comfort of floral amber fragrances, exuding an enveloping warmth through enigmatic expression. A harmonious blend of amber and jasmine reveals a paradoxical intensity, fusing delicacy with power to strike the perfect balance of boldness. An undertone of moss welcomes a familiar woodiness, nostalgic and instantly recognisable, granting the perfume a long-lasting, addictive scent trail. Arriving in a refillable flacon with a contrasting brand coat of arms, the fragrance conveys its iconicity through simplicity.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Omnia Crystalline Eau de Toilette 30ml
listings.description: Crispy. Luminous. Pure. Reveal your light through OMNIA. Evoking the purity and clarity of crystal, the iconic BVLGARI Omnia Crystalline is a luminous Eau de Toilette signed by Master Perfumer Alberto Morillas. A fragrance inspired by the aquatic transparency of the lotus flower, sublimated by the airy generosity of a white peony. Omnia Crystalline is a delicate scent evolving through watery crispy notes of nashi pear, the vegetal freshness of bamboo and ending on the warmth of balsa wood softened by an accord of crystal musks. The new flacon design pays tribute to Omnia's iconic shape while staying true to its inimitable original scent, which remains untouched. Like a frame of light, an invitation to rediscover the iconic fascination of Omnia from a new, more precious perspective. Two rings smoothly flowing into each other through two detachable elements, unveiling the fragrance's atomizer and introducing a new concept for this iconic flacon. Like a shining secret at the heart, an elegant rose gold colored frame on the cap brings Bulgari's DNA as a jeweler to the core of one of its most iconic feminine fragrance collections. Faithful to its original design representing the symbol of infinity, the new flacon captures every single drop of light. Top Notes: The fragrance opens with a duo bathed in light. The crispness of nashi pear accord is enhanced by the freshness of a bamboo accord. Heart Notes: A delicate alliance transports the heart of the fragrance towards floral and resolutely feminine tones. The aquatic transparency of lotus accord is tinged with the purity of a white peony note. Dry Down Notes: At dry-down, the warm balsa wood accord reveals a tender woody trail combined with the soft sensuality of a crystal musks accord.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Omnia Amethyste Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Evoking the soft shine and noble refinement of amethyst, the fragrance of BVLGARI Omnia Amethyste is an incredibly nuanced bouquet embodying the myriad scents of Iris gardens dappled with morning dew. A flower of great luxury and originality, the iris' velvety petals capture the multiple textures of light and reflect them with intense and enchantingly feminine shades. The new flacon design pays tribute to Omnia's iconic shape while staying true to its inimitable original scent, which remains untouched. Like a frame of light, an invitation to rediscover the iconic fascination of Omnia from a new, more precious perspective. Two rings smoothly flowing into each other through two detachable elements, unveiling the fragrance's atomizer and introducing a new concept for this iconic flacon. Like a shining secret at the heart, an elegant rose gold-coloured frame on the cap brings Bulgari's DNA as a jeweler to the core of one of its most iconic feminine fragrance collections. Faithful to its original design representing the symbol of infinity, the new flacon captures every single drop of light.

listings.rawTitle: Molton Brown Coastal Cypress & Sea Fennel Travel Case Refill Eau de Parfum 7.5ml
listings.description: The Molton Brown Coastal Cypress & Sea Fennel Eau de Parfum transports the senses to an uncharted peninsula with an aroma reminiscent of rolling waves and sea spray. The zest of bergamot and heat of ginger is infused with cardamom and the crisp marine notes at the heart of this invigorating fragrance. Sweet jasmine, aromatic frankincense and the bracing aroma of cypress embody the flourishing wilderness of sea cliffs. A tempting blend of leather, vetiver and musk offer harmonious, smoky undertones, completing this refreshingly thrilling fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Armani Si Eau de Parfum Intense Refill 100ml (Worth £130)
listings.description: A floral bouquet wrapped in an amber nest, Armani’s Si Eau de Parfum Intense Refill joins the freshness of vibrant fruits and freshly-picked flowers with the charisma of velvety vanilla accords. In true SÌ style, the signature scent of blackcurrant nectar strikes the senses with its bold embrace, capturing the olfactive attention with juicy charm and refreshing zest. Rich and compelling, Damascena rose and notes of davana impart an unforgettable sophisticated sensuality, leading into a warm bourbon vanilla and smoky black tea base to close the intense trail. Designed to top up your existing glass flacon, refill the SÌ bottle when empty for continued use with less waste.

listings.rawTitle: Armani Si Eau de Parfum Intense Refillable Spray 50ml
listings.description: A floral bouquet wrapped in an amber nest, Armani’s Si Eau de Parfum Intense Refillable Spray joins the freshness of vibrant fruits and freshly-picked flowers with the charisma of velvety vanilla accords. In true SÌ style, the signature scent of blackcurrant nectar strikes the senses with its bold embrace, capturing the olfactive attention with juicy charm and refreshing zest. Housed in a jewel-like bottle adorned by the SÌ logo, top up the flacon with the brand’s refill vial when empty.

listings.rawTitle: Armani Si Eau de Parfum Intense Refillable Spray 100ml
listings.description: A floral bouquet wrapped in an amber nest, Armani’s Si Eau de Parfum Intense Refillable Spray joins the freshness of vibrant fruits and freshly-picked flowers with the charisma of velvety vanilla accords. listings.rawTitle: Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum for Women 50ml
listings.description: The power within. Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum for Women tells a story of self-discovery. The new campaign follows Emma Mackey and the pride of lionesses. Radiating confidence, strength and kindness, Emma embodies the spirit of Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum. The Scent Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum is a unique gourmand aromatic fragrance led by a powerful trio of vanillas. On top, a vanilla infusion with woody tonalities, at the heart vanilla caviar with a rich sweetness, and at the base a vanilla absolute enriched with luminous lavender. The Bottle Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum for women is encased in an elegant square-shaped bottle designed to be refilled. An elegant design, Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum is the first refillable perfume by Burberry.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Cologne and Cologne Intense Discovery Collection
listings.description: Sample five of Jo Malone London’s most quintessential fragrances in the Cologne Discovery Collection. Worn alone or layered, each distinct scent offers an olfactive escape. Set Contents: English Pear & Freesia Cologne 1.5ml Fresh and radiant, this bestselling fragrance takes inspiration from a sunny orchid, marrying nuances of bright freesias with pear and patchouli. Peony & Blush Suede Cologne 1.5ml An alluring cologne that blends opulent florals with soft blush suede, creating a sensuous scent trail that embodies luxury. Wood Sage & Sea Salt Cologne 1.5ml Transport the senses to a breezy coast with this aromatic fragrance, featuring an uplifting sea salt and sage elixir. Myrrh & Tonka Cologne Intense 1.5ml The warm, vanilla nuances of tonka bean juxtapose against the resinous aroma of myrrh in this desert-inspired cologne. Oud & Bergamot Cologne Intense 1.5ml Alluring and mysterious, radiant yet rich. This fragrance envelops the skin in a precious blend of black musk, oud and bergamot.

listings.rawTitle: Molton Brown Wild Mint & Lavandin Perfume 100ml
listings.description: Escape to a luscious forest with the Molton Brown Wild Mint and Lavender Perfume. The uplifting fragrance is reminiscent of a calm amble through nature, marrying floral and herbal essences for a sophisticated finish. Notes of orris root, nutmeg and lavandin linger in the air as you trail through a shaded path, uplifted by a sharp mint accord. Tonka bean lends the scent a gentle warmth, creating a sillage that is both modern and elegant. Made in England. Vegan.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Terre d’Hermès Eau Givrée Eau de Parfum 175ml
listings.description: Terre d’Hermès Eau Givrée explores a new territory, where freshness and power interact. “An icy cloak fertilises the earth, exalting it with new and vibrant strength.” Christine Nagel, Hermès perfumer. Terre d’Hermès Eau Givrée Eau de Parfum combines the vigour of citron and the incisive freshness of juniper berry with the power of Timut pepper. The striking sensation of an icy breeze is juxtaposed with the generosity of the woody, mineral notes characteristic of Terre d’Hermès. As if cut from ice, the object is sleek and limpid. Frosted glass and brushed aluminium evoke the notion of frost covering the earth. The H on its base is a subtle reference to the ancestry of a now-cult object. Refillable and sustainable, the bottle combines glass with aluminium, two fully recyclable materials. A responsible gesture, integral to an object created to last. When held in the hand, the Terre d’Hermès Eau Givrée bottle unveils its many details: the house’s iconic saddle nail and its metal shoulders that reflect the light. Created by designer Philippe Mouquet, it is inspired by a bottle in a travel vanity case that is conserved at the Emile Hermès museum. Terre d’Hermès Eau Givrée explores a new territory where freshness and strength nourish each other. “An icy cloak fertilises the earth, exalting it with new and vibrant strength.” Christine Nagel, creative director of Hermès fragrances. Terre d’Hermès Eau Givrée encapsulates in a bottle two contradictions, two opposites: an icy tremor and generous power. The Eau de Parfum combines the vigour of citron, the incisive freshness of juniper berry and the power of Timut pepper. The Terre d’Hermès collection tells the story of man’s relationship with the earth, his humble and harmonious dialogue with nature and the elements.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Tutti Twilly d'Hermès Eau de Parfum 85ml
listings.description: Created by Christine Nagel for the Hermès girls, Tutti Twilly d'Hermès eau de parfum is a tribute to their free spirit – a blend of daring and lightheartedness – and their multifaceted nature. Individuality is reflected in this fragrance. A floral and fruity eau de parfum with a generous character crafted with gentle ginger blossom, mellow lychee, and enveloping musk notes. Designed by Florence Manlik, the lantern-shaped bottle has a square silhouette, adorned with an inverted lychee-red color graduation. With a final flourish, a hand-tied silk ribbon playfully embellishes the cap of each bottle designed by Carine Brancowitz. Each silk ribbon is unique. Its 30 ml format allows you to take the notes of Tutti Twilly with you while on the go to diffuse the sparkle of the Hermès girls anywhere and everywhere. The Twilly d'Hermès family of perfumes evokes the Hermès silk métier on two fronts: it calls to mind the house's silk twill scarf as well as the Twilly, a small, joyful, colourful silk ribbon that can be worn in countless ways.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Café Rose Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: The Tom Ford Café Rose Eau de Parfum captures the untamed sensuality of a refined rose spiked with an unexpected twist of dark coffee. Luxurious and sensual, the fragrance is enriched with the essence of Turkish and Bulgarian rose, while ylang-ylang adds an opulent floralcy. The enchanting fragrance is infused with rich, aromatic notes of cardamom, coriander and patchouli at the base, adding a touch of spice to incense resin and sandalwood accords. Embodying the opulence of the warm floral elixir, the Café Rose bottle features a semi-transparent rosy pink hue with a violet bronze-toned cap and plaque.

listings.rawTitle: Tocca Lucia Travel Spray Eau de Parfum 20ml
listings.description: Lucia is a luminous fresh floral fragrance that gives voice to your inner beauty. Inspired by the Italian art of slow living, Lucia weaves sunlit Italian lemon and woody vetiver with lush fig from the garden. This natural tapestry is the soul to Lucia’s heart.

listings.rawTitle: Tocca Lucia Eau de Parfum 50ml

listings.rawTitle: Hermès H24 Eau de Parfum Refillable Natural Spray 175ml
listings.description: Created by Hermès perfumer Christine Nagel, H24 Eau de Parfum reveals an intense strength as the signature of a new energy. A woody aromatic, H24 Eau de Parfum draws on the generous, botanical power of enveloping sage, dense high-tech moss, and warm and vibrant sclarene. With its pure lines, the bottle designed by Philippe Mouquet is adorned with moss-green lacquer to echo the fragrance’s olfactory notes. The intense grey box is decorated with a fine lime-green line that delimits and opens up the space. The aerodynamic, refillable bottle is crafted from recycled glass. Made entirely of untreated paper, the box is composed of recycled fibres. H24 is the key to a new space. H for Hermès, Homme and Hours. 24 to evoke a relationship with time and a link to the house’s flagship address of 24 rue du Faubourg Saint-Honoré.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description: Envelop yourself in a celebration of delectable aromas with the Dolce&Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum. The fragrance emulates feelings of temptation and cravings summoned by citrusy, vanilla baked goods amid the winter season. Inspired by the divine Italian dessert, panettone, the scent takes you on an olfactive journey through the sweet streets of Milan, wafting through irresistible accords of charming baked treats. Tantalising, gourmand notes of candied lemon open the fragrance for a bright and captivating beginning. At the heart, orange blossom adds luminosity and freshness to Eau de Parfum with an exquisite contrast of richer, sweeter accords. The superstar of the fragrance, Madagascar vanilla, interrupts the sensory journey, conjuring feelings of sensuality and irresistibility.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Gaultier Divine Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: A scent for the modern-day goddess, Jean Paul Gaultier’s Gaultier Divine Eau de Parfum radiates mystery and confidence through a dazzling marine floral olfactory. The fragrance embraces the world of Gaultier, celebrating the divinity of women, their power and uniqueness. The start of an eternal addiction, top notes of calypsone, pink berry and bergamot are caressed with a salty kiss. A floral bouquet of solar lily, jasmine and ylang-ylang is revealed before nestling into delicious airy meringue and musk. Striking with its voluptuous cones and curves, the bottle flaunts a corset gilded with gold. Allow the aura of Gaultier Divine to radiate forever thanks to the refillable bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Gaultier Divine Eau de Parfum 200ml Refill

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Fame Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Crafted in France, Rabanne’s Fame Eau de Parfum captures the magnetism of Parisian nights and the allure that surrounds the city. Sophisticated yet playful, the fragrance imparts an intense woody chypre scent with a soft jasmine heart, striking the perfect balance between fierce and feminine. The contemporary eau de pafum begins its olfactive adventure with juicy nuances of bergamot, tantalising the senses with a sumptuous, slightly citrusy, aroma. Precious jasmine melts into a hypnotic incense, musk and sandalwood base, closing the trail with hints of smoked amber richness. The golden elixir arrives in a one-of-a-kind bottle, a figurine dressed in black and gold chainmail couture, making the eau de parfum the perfect centrepiece on any dresser.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Forte Rosa Palissandro Eau de Parfum 125ml
listings.description: The Aqua Allegoria fragrance collection celebrates the wonders of the world. Each creation pays tribute to nature’s beauty and sweeps us up in a discovery of exceptional raw ingredients and notes, beautifully enhanced by our perfumer-explorers. Discover Rosa Palissandro Forte, the spicy freshness of rosewood meets both the delicacy of rose and the intensity of patchouli. The flower and wood combine to give a fragrance blending strength and sophistication.   “Rosa Palissandro Forte is a homage to the beauty of rosewood. A fresh wood with floral and spicy tones, paired with the intensity of patchouli and sandalwood, wrapped in an elegant vine of roses.” - Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfumer Aqua Allegoria Forte, the intense collection, is a warm and enveloping journey to the heart of the world’s wonders: Eaux de Parfum celebrating the intense beauty of nature, revealed by the golden rays of a setting sun. A powerful symbol of Guerlain's commitment to the planet, the Aqua Allegoria Forte fragrances contain more than 90% natural origin*. The French beetroot alcohol used in their formulas comes from a network committed to responsible farming. The 200 mL refill extends the life cycle of the Aqua Allegoria bottle without compromising on quality. The spray unscrews manually to top up the bottle with a user-friendly refill, fitted with an anti-spill system. It cannot be used alone and is only compatible with refillable 75 mL and 125 mL bottles. *In accordance with the ISO 16128, calculation including water.

listings.rawTitle: Miller Harris Hydra Figue Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Paying homage to the paradisial Greek island of Hydra, Miller Harris’ Hydra Figue Eau de Parfum unites tranquil marine accords with the fruit of fig and sun-warmed woods. Taking the senses on an enchanting olfactive voyage, the fragrance opens with crisp citrus notes of bergamot and cedrat before sinking into crystalline sea salt waters, where fig and florals float upon the Aegean current. Refreshing yet embracing, the eau de parfum is emboldened by nuances of ambroxan, sandalwood and velvet musk to add an earthy richness, imparting a comforting scent trail reminiscent of summer-spent Mediterranean memories.

listings.rawTitle: Miller Harris Black Datura Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Hypnotising with its rich, woody trail, the Miller Harris Black Datura Eau de Parfum showcases a plush bouquet of florals dancing in the dark. The duality of danger and seduction is introduced with a feminine, sensual floral fusion that reveals a captivating scent of intense woody notes. Dizzying tuberose is dusted in fresh notes of pink peppercorn and incense before an unveiling of seductive white flowers. Musk and amber notes shimmer at the base with a warm, lightly sweet scent, adding to the duality of the fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé L’Eau de Parfum Lumineuse 30ml
listings.description: Evoking the authentic femininity and free-spirited nature of the Chloé woman, Chloé L’Eau de Parfum Lumineuse presents at the heart of this creation the emblematic rose that radiates with unprecedented brilliance. Chloé L'Eau de Parfum Lumineuse seems to have been born from the encounter between a rose and a ray of sunshine. This eau de parfum is vegan and is formulated with natural origin fragrance, alcohol* and water, nothing else. Luminous rose is beautifully stitched with vanilla, illuminating the scent's floral heart with balsamic and amber undertones. Warmed by the vanilla, the rose unveils itself with heightened elegance, while velvety notes of jasmine sambac reveal its sublime richness, intensifying the fusion of sweet and floral tones. An ultra-feminine and solar fragrance for any occasion that lasts all day long. This Chloé perfume is encased in a timeless vintage-inspired glass bottle topped with a luminous silver cap. Echoing the radiant scent within, the outer pack is a luminescent beige adorned with silver accents, while around the bottle's neck is a hand-tied beige ribbon stitched with delicate pink thread. This unique stitching is an iconic Chloé fashion code making its debut appearance on a fragrance. The bottle is made using 25% recycled glass, and the ribbon is made of 100% recycled polyester. Please note: packaging may vary, but the iconic scent remains unchanged. * denatured alcohol

listings.rawTitle: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Sucre Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: The perfect scent for those with a sweet tooth, Juicy Couture’s Viva La Juicy Sucre delights the senses with a truly delectable fragrance. The perfume is a recipe of mouth-watering fruits and florals, evoking the unadulterated joy of a patisserie and the treats that await inside. The scent is bursting with flavour. Redcurrant tempts with its rich undertones, mixed with peach nectar and vanilla for a sugar rush. Topped with whipped cream and a dusting of nutty cocoa, the fragrance creates an unforgettable scent trail. The flacon is as joyful as the perfume within. The gold-tinted bottle sits inside a cupcake tray, dipped in white icing and tied with a bow for an eye-catching finish.

listings.rawTitle: Moncler Les Sommets Collection Les Roches Noires Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Warm and sensuous, the Moncler Les Roches Noires Eau de Parfum offers a bold olfactory experience. The fragrance forms a part of the Les Sommets Collection, a range that draws inspiration from nature. At the heart of the scent is a juxtaposition of earthy patchouli and amber nuances of labdanum. Sharp black pepper lends depth and spice to the fragrance, wrapped in an elixir of woods to create an elegant sillage. The opaque flacon and sleek packaging exudes luxury. The wood pattern is an homage to the fragrance’s forest influences.

listings.rawTitle: Moncler Les Sommets Collection La Cordee Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: An olfactive escape to a mountain’s peak. The Moncler Les Sommets Collection introduces La Cordee, a bold eau de parfum for the intrepid explorer. The fragrance centres around the fresh, aromatic nuances of cypress wood. Blended with warm black tea and a zesty bergamot accord, the EDP creates an invigorating scent trail reminiscent of a breathtaking forest view. The apothecary-style bottle is housed in a paper box embellished with a wood pattern, inspired by the scent within.

listings.rawTitle: Moncler Les Sommets Collection Haute Montagne Eau de Parfum 200ml
listings.description: Inspired by the materials found in Moncler boutiques, the Les Sommets Collection Haute Montagne Eau de Parfum unites the crispness of snow-covered mountains and warmth from blond woods in one enveloping unisex scent. Wrapped in a creamy Madagascan vanilla embrace, resinous woods, burning from a log cabin’s fireplace, spark feelings of comfort and calm. A cedarwood and tree moss breeze sweeps through the doors, bringing an air of fresh, earthy accords that mingle with a white musk base to close the olfactive trail. The fragrance arrives housed in a simplistic apothecary-style bottle, adorned with cursive text to showcase its rustic yet contemporary edge.

listings.rawTitle: Moncler Les Sommets Collection Le Solstice Eau de Parfum 200ml
listings.description: From Moncler’s Les Sommets Collection comes Le Solstice, an invigorating fragrance inspired by a mountain’s peak. The eau de parfum evokes images of a breathtaking summit’s view. A powdery iris accord marries with an elixir of warm woods, uplifted by the sweet, zesty nuances of mandarin. White musk lends freshness to the scent, creating an enlivening olfactory experience. The elegant glass flacon is encased in a box adorned with a wooden pattern, reminiscent of the nature-inspired scent.

listings.rawTitle: Fresh Hesperides Grapefruit Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Bask in the warm Italian sunshine with the Hesperides Grapefruit Eau de Parfum by Fresh, a citrus-scented spray with fresh fruit and crisp floral facets. Housed in an apothecary-style glass bottle, the vibrant fragrance centres a luscious pink grapefruit accord, wrapped in zesty lemon, mandarin and peach to excite the senses with a juicy medley. Jasmine and lotus add a gentle flowered femininity, before musk warms the aroma with a velvety base that strikes the perfect balance between clean and sweet.

listings.rawTitle: Fresh Rose Morning Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Awaken your inner romantic with the Fresh Rose Morning Eau de Parfum, a charming fragrance infused with freshly cut roses and musk notes to fill your day with passion and enchantment. Conjuring the aroma of a bright morning in summer, the scent unleashes a mist of aromatic florals to start your day. Laced with the most romantic flower of all, the rose, the alluring aroma is matched with a tempting blend of blackcurrant and violet leaf. At the heart lies a bouquet of Bulgarian rose, peach blossom, and freesia, unmasking a love potion that leaves a lingering floral trail on the skin. Hypnotic musk warms the scent with white tea and amber for the touch of sensuality within this tender union of accords.

listings.rawTitle: Fresh Sugar Lychee Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: The Sugar Lychee Eau de Parfum is a luscious scent offering from Fresh that offers a moment of serenity with each spritz. The warm fragrance is reminiscent of the soothing aroma left in the atmosphere after a spring shower, marrying fresh grapefruit, lychee and lime blossom with delicate florals. Balanced against rich nuances of amber and tonka bean, the lightweight scent exudes elegance. The packaging is simple yet sophisticated. Housed in an apothecary-style glass bottle, the flacon is a stylish addition to your fragrance collection.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Café Rose Eau de Parfum 50ml and Lip Bundle
listings.description: Discover an opulent duo from Tom Ford with the Café Rose Eau de Parfum and Lip Bundle, featuring a 50ml floral fragrance for her and a unique shade-shifting lip balm. Set Contents: Tom Ford Café Rose Eau de Parfum 50ml Café Rose Eau de Parfum captures the untamed sensuality of a refined rose spiked with an unexpected twist of dark coffee. Luxurious and sensual, the fragrance fuses the essence of Turkish rose and Bulgarian rose with opulent ylang-ylang, while rich aromatic notes of cardamom, patchouli and coriander infuse a spicy warmth to base notes of incense resin and sandalwood. Tom Ford Soleil Lip Balm in ‘Blush’ 3ml Inspired by the warmth of the sun’s golden glow, the Soleil Lip Balm swipes on to reveal a personalised pink hue that adapts to your skin’s unique pH. The lip balm is infused with gilded flecks that impart a sheer golden sheen as it coats lips in a veil of hydration.

listings.rawTitle: DKNY Golden Delicious Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: Experience the taste of luxury with the Golden Delicious Eau de Parfum Spray. The most regal of the apples in the DKNY collection, the fragrance is swirling with sensual florals and fruity nuances. Opening with a bouquet of orange flower and sparkling mirabelle, the scent begins with radiance before developing into an arrangement of fresh white rose and Casablanca lily petals. At its core, the Golden Delicious Apple reigns as the signature note for this scent, adding a refreshing zest. A blend of musk, sandalwood and teakwood bathes the skin in aromatic elegance for a refined finish.

listings.rawTitle: DKNY Be Extra Delicious Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: Contemporary and confident, just like the city it comes from, the DKNY Be Extra Delicious Eau de Parfum is a playful floral gourmand. Delicately decadent, the eau de parfum opens with crisp pear for a bite of fruity freshness, before gardenia and a swirl of creamy caramel add depth and dimension. Irresistible alone and even more tempting layered on top of the original Be Delicious fragrance, this versatile formula pairs perfectly with fellow floral-gourmand blends.

listings.rawTitle: DKNY Be Delicious Fresh Blossom Eau de Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description: Uplift your scent horde with the DKNY Be Delicious Fresh Blossom Eau de Parfum Spray, a pick-me-up fragrance composed of a tantalising bouquet of petals and fruits. Springtime in a bottle, the EDP opens with slices of sparkling grapefruit, sweet cassis and bright apricot, moving into a soft floral interlude of muguet and rose. A wisp of jasmine adds a powder-soft quality, while blonde woods and skin-like musks keep things anchored – think of it as a lesson in olfactory balance. To finish, the feminine fragrance is housed in a signature apple-shaped flacon, designed in a playful pink hue.

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa 59 Perfume Mist 90ml
listings.description: The latest addition to the Sol de Janeiro scent experience, Cheirosa 59 Perfume Mist exudes a joyful and uplifting fragrance. Notes of vanilla orchid, sugared violet and sheer sandalwood intertwine to create a rich, warm and sweet scent that transports its wearer to a Brazilian sunset. Inspired by the year 1959, when singer João Gilberto released the bossa nova album, Chega de Saudade (aka No More Blues), the mist embraces your skin and hair with the warmth of whipped amber, velvet plum and fresh vetiver. Packaging may vary.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Born In Roma UOMO Green Stravaganza Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Discover the spicy-woody sensation of Valentino’s Born In Roma UOMO Green Eau de Toilette, a fougere fragrance characterised by its vibrant composition. Taking the senses on an adventure to cool Italian gardens, the scent trail begins with sun-ripened Calabrian bergamot to capture the olfactive attention before a creamy coffee accord adds depth and dimension. This magnetic combination encourages an energising effect, melting into a vetiver base to bring a sense of earthiness and grounding to the fragrance. Spritz onto the pulse points for a long-lasting, mesmeric aroma.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Born In Roma Donna Green Stravaganza Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Immerse yourself in the culture of Italy’s capital city with the Born In Roma Donna Green by Valentino. Inspired by the extravagance and beauty of the eternal city, the fragrance unleashes luscious floral notes to transport your mind to the gardens of Rome. The scent opens with a smoky aroma of lapsang souchong tea accord, mingling with jasmine absolute to create heat and passion reminiscent of the Roman sun. A base of lavish vanilla takes over to add a luxurious but enchanting finish to the scent. Reinventing the iconic pyramidal structure, the bottle captures the spirit of Valentino with its distinctive studded design and leather accents as a symbol of fearlessness.
