The Eau de Parfum is undeniably hypnotic, enthralling the senses with a blend of florals, fruits and woods. Nuances of green mandarin and pear envelop the skin, lending the scent a sharp, tangy aroma. At the heart, jasmine sambac offers a rich twist, wrapped in warm cashmere to create an intoxicating sillage. The mysterious nature of the scent is displayed in the Alien Hypersense flacon. The bottle features iridescent splashes of purple, blue and pink, complete with a jewel-like topper for a captivating finish.

Opening with Darjeeling tea and water lily accords, the cologne invites the senses with a mellow blend to begin, before guaiac wood and cardamom essence embolden the aroma with a spiced edge. Musk and amber nuances close the olfactive trail with a warm earthiness that lingers on the skin with lightweight longevity, capturing the allure of the quietly confident BVLGARI man.

Characterised by a rose blossom duo and an elixir of fruits, the scent invites you on a journey of self-empowerment with every spritz. listings.rawTitle: Moncler Pour Femme Sunrise Eau de Parfum 60ml
listings.description: The Moncler Pour Femme Sunrise Eau de Parfum captivates with a delicate blend of woody and floral notes, effortlessly juxtaposing softness with underlying strength. Powdery tones of violet leaf lead the way, amplified by juicy pear and refreshing grapefruit. At the centre, a posy of peony, lily of the valley, Egyptian jasmine and freesia add an elegant touch. The scent transcends onto a rich sandalwood base and cedar, topped with warming ambergris accords. Reminiscent of the sun's golden hues rising over the mountains, the fragrance is encased inside a gold-toned bottle, delicately detailed with signature branding.

listings.rawTitle: Estée Lauder Bronze Goddess Nuit Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Embody the night with the Estée Lauder Bronze Goddess Nuit Eau de Parfum. The fragrance takes a nocturnally dark twist on the original summer scent. Swapping out sweetness for richness, the Nuit fragrance explores the depths of desire on a private island paradise. Pepper and ylang-ylang embark on a new, seductive take on bergamot, creating an aroma of mystery and intrigue as to what the night ahead holds. Conjuring images of landscapes at sunset and beaches illuminated by stars, salted coconut and jasmine sambac meet with night-blooming orchids to transition from day to night. The twilight settles with dark tonka and cashmere woods, ready to embrace the darkness.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Touch of Pink Eau de Toilette Spray 50ml
listings.description: Celebrating the feminine expression of authentic sensuality, Lacoste’s Touch of Pink Eau de Toilette Spray offers a fragrance for the independent and spontaneous woman. Vibrant top notes of orange, coriander leaves and cardamom seeds envelop a floral heart of jasmine and violet leaves. Creamy vanilla, sandalwood and musk add warmth at the base for a long-lasting scent trail. Embodying the Eau de Toilette’s effortless charm, the bottle is finished in a sleek pink and white hue.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Touch of Pink Eau de Toilette Spray 90ml
listings.description: Celebrating the feminine expression of authentic sensuality, Lacoste’s Touch of Pink Eau de Toilette Spray offers a fragrance for the independent and spontaneous woman. Vibrant top notes of orange, coriander leaves and cardamom seeds envelop a floral heart of jasmine and violet leaves. Creamy vanilla, sandalwood and musk add warmth at the base for a long-lasting scent trail. Embodying the Eau de Toilette’s effortless charm, the bottle is finished in a sleek pink and white hue.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Pour Femme Eau de Parfum Spray 90ml
listings.description: Embodying an invigorating floral breeze, the Lacoste Pour Femme Eau de Parfum Spray captures the free spirit of the modern-day woman. The vibrant floral fragrance awakens the senses with a burst of black pepper and freesia. At the heart of the scent, a feminine floral bouquet of jasmine, rose and hibiscus is unveiled, before the warmth of sandalwood, incense, cedar and musk emphasises the fragrance’s intensity.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste L.12.12 Blanc Eau de Toilette Spray 50ml
listings.description: Discover a fresh, crisp scent with the Lacoste L.12.12 Blanc Eau de Toilette Spray. The fragrance for men combines earthy, musky scents with refreshing nuances. Top notes of juicy grapefruit and spicy cardamom envelop a heart of tuberose and ylang ylang, softened by a base of suede and vetiver. Inspired by the iconic Lacoste polo shirt, the perfume bottle features an embroidered crocodile logo.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez for Her Musc Nude Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Introducing the Narciso Rodriguez for Her Musc Nude Eau de Parfum, a sensual fusion of provocative accords that celebrate the eternity of femininity. The gentle floral fragrance envelops the skin in a natural second skin-like breeze, bringing an olfactive symphony to your daily ritual. Opening with pink peppercorn and jasmine, the botanicals intertwine with each other to create an elegant and timeless scent. The signature Narciso Rodriguez musc interrupts at its heart to reveal richness and depth in the duality of this fragrance. Damask rose oil and orange flower complement the musk heart with a feminine floral burst. Drying down at the base, rich tonka bean mingles with cedarwood and patchouli, embracing the skin in an air of warmth and heat. With an all-over nude hue, the sophisticated bottle is finished with a divine frosted effect and a matte cap for an extra touch of luxury and elegance.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Under the Stars Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: A timeless bond between oud and leather, Maison Margiela’s Replica Under the Stars Eau de Toilette evokes the whimsical nostalgia of a warm, starry night. Between the blades of tallgrass, an air of black pepper and cardamom winds its way to comfort the senses, before a blend of earthy cypriol and cedarwood elicits the familiar scent of the outdoors. Labdanum and Oud marry in a smoky olfactive matrimony, twinkling amongst the black backdrop of well-worn leather.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Pour Homme Solar Lavender Eau de Toilette Spray 100ml
listings.description: Contrasting aquatic nuances with the warmth of the sun, Issey Miyake’s L'Eau d'Issey Pour Homme Solar Lavender Eau de Toilette Spray is a spiced-wood scent enhanced by the freshness of lavender. Opening with Sichuan pepper, the fragrance captures the olfactive attention with its vibrant character, before sprigs of lavender transport the senses to a sunshine-filled spring day. Emboldened with balsamic cedarwood, the cologne closes with a subtle citrus nod, granting a lasting clean trail. The eau de parfum is housed in a light purple-hued flacon that lets the sun shine through, topped with a wood cap as an ode to nature.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana The One for Men Gold Eau de Parfum Intense 50ml
listings.description: As magnetic as the individual who wears it, Dolce&Gabanna’s The One Gold Eau de Parfum Intense Pour Homme captivates the senses with its blend of spices and sensuous woods. Green, earthy nuances of clary sage introduce the fragrance, married with sparkling bergamot to create an invigorating freshness. At the base, a sweet yet rich patchouli accord begins to unfurl, lending depth to the scent for an intoxicating finish. The bottle pays homage to its namesake. Wrapped in a gold tint, the flacon is a striking addition to your fragrance collection.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Habit Rouge Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Habit Rouge Eau de Parfum reveals the intense and sensual signature of woody and leather notes. Habit Rouge has an eternally elegant French appeal. Habit Rouge embraces a dandy man who dares everything, combining sophistication and refinement. He lives his life fervently and distinguishes himself with a trail of extreme sensuality.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentleman Society Eau de Parfum Extreme 100ml
listings.description: Crafted with Givenchy savoir-faire, Gentleman Society Eau de Parfum Extrême is composed of exceptional raw materials, carefully chosen for their optimum olfactory qualities. Top notes of clary sage are heightened with ice-cold peppermint and fiery nutmeg creating an immediate aromatic and spicy twist. The mysterious heart reveals the original Gentleman Society accord, blending narcissus absolute and iris concrete, contrasted by the signature quartet of vetiver. A powerful and unexpected coffee extract absolute develops out of this accord. Paired with peppermint essence, the coffee note seems iced revealing a new and extremely textured facet. At the base, woody notes of cedar and sandal are deepened by patchouli essence and vanilla absolute, perfecting this deep trail. Inspired by couture, the iconic design of the Gentleman bottle is reinterpreted for a new high-impact look. The deep black lacquer finish is enhanced with the Givenchy signature: the 4G logo, emblazoned like a crest, in a striking new gunmetal finish. The Gentleman Society Eau de Parfum Extrême bottle is made from 15% post-consumer recycled glass.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun Ode To Dullness Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Celebrating the comfort of monotony, an Ode to Dullness Eau de Parfum by Juliette Has a Gun puts a light, inviting spin on an often pejorative narrative. Composed to convey a gentle, poetic scent story, the fragrance unites star anise and freesia in an unexpected blend, wrapping the wearer in a floral halo spiked with spicy facets. Creamy sandalwood, tonka bean and musks grant a calming, centering effect, reminding you to enjoy the small moments in life like soft cashmere on the skin or the warmth of a blanket on a rainy day. Housed in a minimalistic ombre flacon, wear an Ode to Dullness to indulge in olfactive serenity and reflection.

listings.rawTitle: Olfactive O Floral Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Feel the warmth of a glorious summer’s day with the O Floral Eau de Parfum from Olfactive. The enchanting fragrance exudes an air of romance and elegance with its delicate floral fusion. Like the feeling of a fresh breeze on a crisp day, the scent spritzes the skin with English chamomile and creamy magnolia for an effortlessly feminine aroma. Light and airy, the aroma transports you to a sunny day under a cherry tree with its bouquet of osmanthus, rose and tuberose. The fragrance touches the skin, like the feeling of a new silk scarf, with rich luxurious nuances of musk, jasmine and cedarwood to finish the sensory journey.

listings.rawTitle: Goldfield & Banks Ingenious Ginger Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: The initial fragrance house to explore Australian red back ginger as an olfactive note, Goldfield & Banks presents the first of its kind with the Ingenious Ginger Eau de Parfum. Uplifting but sensual, this scent transports you to a sun-kissed destination filled with tropical bliss. Radiant mandarin opens the scent with Italian bergamot and lemon to awaken the senses. A bouquet of white florals and elegant woods mingle together in a medley of magnolia, patchouli and sandalwood. At the core of this scent lies the ginger lily flower in an ode to the brand’s founder’s favourite flower. This complex native botanical embodies the spirit behind the luxurious Australian perfume collection.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun Juliette Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: In the ethereal landscape of perfumery, a tale unfolds with Juliette Has a Gun's Juliette Eau de Parfum. Since its rebellious debut in 2006, the label has redefined the archetype of a modern heroine through an olfactive symphony representing the brand itself. She is not simply a woman; Juliette is a force of nature, expressing untamed femininity, power and passion. With each spritz, she confidently commands the spotlight, captivating all with her magnetic allure. Overtones of dark cherry and pink berry harmonise with jasmine absolute, while the enigmatic cashmeran whispers tales of mystery, concluding this fascinating narrative.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy L'Interdit Eau de Parfum Refill 150ml
listings.description: With its forbidden blend of white flowers and a dark accord, L'Interdit Eau de Parfum is a resolutely underground flower. It unveils a sensual bouquet of orange blossom, jasmine, and tuberose. In contrast, earthy dark tones emanate from vetiver and patchouli to create a daringly addictive and sensual fragrance. In homage to the design of Hubert de Givenchy's first perfume, the bottle is truly timeless and terribly modern. With a round squareness and a soft strength, it dares you to break the rules with abandon. Defy conventions and discover the L'Interdit Eau de Parfum 150ml refill bottle. This fragrance is now part of an eco-responsible approach, with a new refillable format only compatible with the 100ml bottle. Experience the thrill of the forbidden with L'Interdit, a fragrance that invites you to defy convention and embrace your singularity.

listings.rawTitle: STORIES No.02 Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Allow the amber and musk nuances of STORIES No.02 Eau De Parfum to guide you through an immersive olfactive journey, painting memories with every spritz. A whispered symphony of ginger, green tea and cardamom beckons you into a secret garden, where clusters of Bulgarian roses sway in the breeze along the riverbanks. In the heart of this woodland, notes of tonka bean, cedarwood, and patchouli intertwine, weaving a tale of warmth, while the final embrace of amber, musk and honey tobacco crafts a fragrance so full-bodied, it becomes an ode to lost treasures.

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa 48 Perfume Mist 90ml
listings.description: Picture warm sunshine on your skin as you lounge by the pool with the Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa ’48 Perfume Mist. Conjuring summer energy with every spritz, the perfume spray is bursting with juicy notes of guava nectar, coconut water and pink musk, sprinkled with a zesty twist of lemon. Celebrating the liberating energy of 1948 when the bikini was first spotted in Brazil, the perfume mist cloaks your hair and skin in a delectable, tropical fragrance reminiscent of sun-soaked days during bikini season.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Mandarino di Sicilia Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Carry the ocean breeze into your aroma with the Acqua Di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Mandarino di Sicilia Eau de Toilette, an Italian-born fragrance that radiates vitality. The EDT opens with an uplifting top layer, featuring an immediate blend of green mandarin, citrus and blood orange. Attention-grabbing and slightly tart, this first colourful impression melts into a herb-laced heart reminiscent of Mediterranean groves at high noon. Petitgrain from the bitter orange tree mingles with sharp, invigorating spearmint, creating an alluring tension between citrus and freshness. At the base of the la dolce vita- inspired pyramid, note the woody base of patchouli, cedarwood and musk – a grounding counterpoint to the effervescence above.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild Eau de Parfum 150ml Refill
listings.description: Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild is an invitation to reconnect with nature. The floral scent offering is bold and feminine, taking the senses on an outdoor adventure with its whimsical blend. The Eau de Parfum encapsulates the freshness of a wildflower bouquet. Pairing fruity banana blossom with sensuous jasmine and nutty macadamia, the fragrance veils the skin in a scent that captivates with every spritz, underpinned by warm sandalwood and vetiver des sables for a multi-faceted finish. This refill is designed to replenish your existing 30ml, 50ml or 100ml Daisy Wild fragrance, allowing you to continuously enjoy the fragrance without swapping your existing bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild Eau de Parfum Pen Spray Exclusive 10ml
listings.description: Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild is an invitation to reconnect with nature. The floral scent offering is bold and feminine, taking the senses on an outdoor adventure with its whimsical blend. The Eau de Parfum encapsulates the freshness of a wildflower bouquet. Pairing fruity banana blossom with sensuous jasmine and nutty macadamia, the fragrance veils the skin in a scent that captivates with every spritz, underpinned by warm sandalwood and vetiver des sables for a multi-faceted finish.  The 10ml pen spray is perfect for on-the-go use. Simply pop into your handbag or pocket to enjoy the fragrance wherever you may be.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Flowers and Flames Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Building on the success and glamour of Yves Saint Laurent Libre, the Flowers and Flames Eau de Parfum Spray offers a vibrant, fiery twist on the beloved original. The blazing fusion settles with an intensified warmth, emboldening she who wears it. Bold in both scent and elegance, bergamot essence opens the fragrance with a zesty start to awaken the senses. At the heart, Libre’s signature orange blossom inspires sensuality and seduction, set ablaze by spiced desert lily in a flaming twist. Creamy vanilla interrupts for a sweet taste of gourmand accords, met with hints of coconut and ylang-ylang to lure those who cross her path. Tailored with YSL’s craftmanship, the perfume’s flacon is set alight with a golden glow, reflecting the sun-kissed warmth hidden inside.

listings.rawTitle: Cosmic by Kylie Jenner Eau de Parfum Pen Spray 10ml
listings.description: Trending for its transcendent aroma, Cosmic by Kylie Jenner Eau de Parfum Pen Spray launches an out-of-this-world collision of celestial florals and galactic amber accords. Arriving in a handbag edition, the travel-sized scent is perfect for on-the-go top-ups or holiday travels. Embarking on its descent to Earth with star jasmine and blood orange notes, the scent takes you on an olfactive journey to the stars. At its core, golden amber and red peony create a divine fusion that transports your senses to otherworldly galaxies. Creamy vanilla and crisp musk complete the fragrance alongside magnetic cedarwood that grounds the scent for a rich, warming finish. The perfume’s unique flacon is specially crafted to imitate a piece of art from another universe. Designed to fit perfectly into the palm of your hand, the curved shape adds a modern twist to any dressing table.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy L'Interdit Eau de Parfum Absolu 35ml
listings.description: Reinventing the iconic scent, Givenchy’s L'Interdit Eau de Parfum Absolu redefines convention by breaking the boundaries of fragrance with a newly found intensity. Deeper and richer than before, the scent takes a smoky twist on the revered floral fragrance. For those who dare to be different, the fragrance opens with warming neroli and spiced cardamon to liberate the senses with a zesty fusion. Signature to the original L'Interdit, a floral heart proudly displays a bouquet of white florals, including orange blossom, tuberose and jasmine for a moment of refined femininity. Inviting you to free yourself from convention, contrasting accords of tobacco and vetiver bring a smoky quality to the scent with a warming, woody dry down of patchouli. Individuality and self-expression leave a lasting impression with this unforgettable, lingering trail. The bottle is redesigned with a darkened lacquer to represent the contrast between light and dark within the scent.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy L'Interdit Eau de Parfum Absolu 80ml
listings.description: Reinventing the iconic scent, Givenchy’s L'Interdit Eau de Parfum Absolu redefines convention by breaking the boundaries of fragrance with a newly found intensity. Signature to the original L'Interdit, a floral heart proudly displays a bouquet of white florals, including orange blossom, tuberose and jasmine for a moment of refined femininity. Inviting you to free yourself from convention, contrasting accords of tobacco and vetiver bring a smoky quality to the scent with a warming, woody dry down of patchouli. Individuality and self-expression leave a lasting impression with this unforgettable, lingering trail. Housed in Givenchy’s timeless flacon, the bottle is redesigned with a darkened lacquer to represent the contrast between light and dark within the scent.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Cypress & Grapevine Cologne Intense 9ml
listings.description: Introducing the Jo Malone London Cypress and Grapevine Cologne 9ml, an aromatic and sensuous fragrance that transports the senses to a verdant hanging garden enhanced with expansive terraces and noble arches. Statuesque cypress trees infuse the air with freshness, powered by intertwining grapevines, grounded with depths of amber. Resinous cypress tree accord introduces the cologne. Grapevine lends the scent a fresh twist, featuring nuances of warm amber, juicy grape and wood. Reminiscent of undergrowth sprinkled with fresh rain, the fragrance settles on a bed of moss.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé L’Eau de Parfum Intense for Women 30ml
listings.description: Capturing the emotion and energy of the Chloé woman, Chloé L’Eau de Parfum Intense for Women 30ml exudes joy, optimism and freedom through its addictive floral fragrance – an expression of the power of women according to Chloé. The scent opens with vibrant, juicy notes of raspberry, complementing the sensuality of rose that lies beneath. As if captured at any moment of the day, the floral heart note embodies the fresh morning rose, the rich opening of midday rose and the sweet honeyed evening rose, taking its wearer on an olfactive journey. At the base, a bouquet of ambery woods unfolds, including musky ambrox, smooth cashmeran and warm cedar. Reinvented for L’Eau de Parfum Intense, the famous pleated Chloé bottle is stamped with a sleek black and ecru label for a modern look, alongside a deep garnet ribbon to reflect the fragrance’s floral composition. Refill your fragrance when it runs out to enjoy the long-lasting scent trail, perfect for any occasion.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé L’Eau de Parfum Intense for Women 50ml
listings.description: Capturing the emotion and energy of the Chloé woman, Chloé L’Eau de Parfum Intense for Women 50ml exudes joy, optimism and freedom through its addictive floral fragrance – an expression of the power of women according to Chloé. The scent opens with vibrant, juicy notes of raspberry, complementing the sensuality of rose that lies beneath. As if captured at any moment of the day, the floral heart note embodies the fresh morning rose, the rich opening of midday rose and the sweet honeyed evening rose, taking its wearer on an olfactive journey. Refill your fragrance when it runs out to enjoy the long-lasting scent trail, perfect for any occasion.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Hinoki & Cedarwood Cologne Intense 9ml
listings.description: The Hinoki and Cedarwood Cologne Intense takes the Japanese wilderness as its muse. Earthy and distinctively fresh, the fragrance transports the senses to a tranquil forest, evoking images of endless trees and greenery. The immersive scent marries a clean aromatic accord with warm, rich nuances of hinoki, soothing the senses as the cologne wears on the skin. Grounded in cedarwood, the miniature fragrance offers a serene olfactive escape.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Perfect Elixir Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Warm and inviting, Marc Jacobs’ Perfect Elixir empowers you to embrace your individuality and love every facet of your personality. The Eau de Parfum exudes positivity. Featuring rich plum, honey nectar and rhubarb, the opening notes feel like a cosy hug, wrapping you in a blanket of comforting fruits and gourmand accords. Golden amber woods lie at the heart of the fragrance, adding intensity and depth to the fragrance, before giving way to sensuous vanilla bean. The 50ml perfume bottle features an opulent lilac hue and is topped with a bouquet of eclectic charms, representing the confident character of the scent within.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: An invitation to free your fantasies with confidence, Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia Eau de Parfum for women is the third Gucci fragrance to join the #FloraFantasy collection. Transporting you to a world of radiant floral power, the soft and sensual scents of Magnolia Essence, Dewberries Accord, and Patchouli Essence combine to create an empowered women's Eau de Parfum. The bottle, adorned with a mesmerising flora pattern and a captivating shade of purple, symbolises the limitless potential that lies within you. An unwavering ally to the Flora woman who seeks to explore all possibilities, this delightful fragrance is a unique bouquet full of joyful floral strength, that reminds you to trust yourself and free your fantasies. Miley Cyrus is the #FloraFantasy protagonist, guiding us on a journey through an enchanted world of heightened reality and anime adventure. With her free, rebellious spirit, she draws us towards the boundless potential of the world around us, like an intuitive reminder that with Gucci Flora Eau de Parfum Collection by your side, you can confidently conquer any challenge that lies before you.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss BOSS The Scent Eau de Parfum for Her 30ml
listings.description: Experience the power of seduction with the BOSS The Scent Eau de Parfum for Her. Hugo Boss captures the dichotomy of femininity with a floral-amber blend of fiery, yet anchoring notes that reveal an intoxicating trail. Sweet but energising, nuances of juicy peach open the scent, honeyed by a bouquet of osmanthus at the heart. White musk lingers at the base with a hint of sensuality and wanting that compels the sense to desire more. Housed in a refillable bottle, the flacon features the BOSS logo on translucent, golden glass and a BOSS Double-B monogram icy-gold cap.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Her Eau de Parfum Intense 100ml
listings.description: Unleash your inner muse with the lushly-layered Burberry Her Eau de Parfum Intense, a magnetic fragrance that elevates your signature scent to new heights. Crafted for a multi-faceted allure, this perfume boldly embraces its character, leading with vibrant wild strawberry and radiant notes of orange blossom. Beyond this delectable gourmand blend lies a warmly-woody amber core, grounding a seductive aroma that envelops you as you enter bustling bars or sunset soirées. Encased in a modern lacquered matte-pink bottle, this expression of refined femininity from the British brand is as striking as it is elegant. The scent retains the addictive charm of the original while leaving a stronger impression, paving the way for cherished memories. Keep this exquisite fragrance for yourself or gift its richness to a loved one.

listings.rawTitle: Armani Stronger With You Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Stronger With You is a head-turning fragrance from Armani that commands attention. Centred around a warm chestnut accord, the scent creates an unforgettable impression with its daring blend of notes. Leathered nuances of vanilla lend the perfume warmth and depth, intensified with the sharpness of pink pepper. Lavender lends an unexpected floralcy, complementing the fragrance’s spicy facets for a smooth, thrilling finish. The intensity of Armani’s Stronger With You Parfum is represented in the bold aesthetic of its flacon. Featuring a rich, amber colour, the bottle exudes power.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Café Rose Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: The Tom Ford Café Rose Eau de Parfum captures the untamed sensuality of a refined rose, spiked with an unexpected twist of dark coffee. Luxurious and sensual, the fragrance is enriched with the essence of Turkish and Bulgarian rose, while ylang ylang adds an opulent floralcy. The enchanting fragrance is infused with rich, aromatic notes of cardamom, coriander and patchouli at the base, adding a touch of spice to incense resin and sandalwood accords. Embodying the opulence of the warm floral elixir, the Café Rose bottle features a semi-transparent rosy pink hue with a bronze-toned cap and plaque.

listings.rawTitle: Moncler Les Sommets Collection Bois Rouge Eau de Parfum 200ml
listings.description: Explore the olfactive intensity of amber woods with Moncler’s Les Sommets Collection Bois Rouge Eau de Parfum. Translating to ‘red wood’, the fragrance evokes the warmth felt from a crackling fireplace, aglow and flitting fragrant embers, contrasting against the crisp outdoor air. Cushioned amongst the crystal moss, cashmeran lends a mineral inflection, while saffron weaves between accords with its lively spiced signature. Closing the trail, rich patchouli connects the senses with the earth thanks to its grounding profile, tying the warm, woody and multi-dimensional nuances together in one seamless fragrance blend.

listings.rawTitle: Billie Eilish Your Turn Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Entering a new chapter, the Eilish by Billie Eilish Your Turn EDP makes a statement by intertwining playfulness with intrigue. Inspired by Billie's admiration for modern art, the unique flacon mimics a stacked dice, sheathed with a silver chrome finish. The scent opens with a vibrant display of bergamot and cardamom, before enlivening ginger warms for an invigorating twist. A blooming bouquet of jasmine mingles with velvety peach skin and an air of coconut water to reveal a soft, sensual heart. Creating an unforgettable finish, an alluring fusion of sandalwood, musk and amber lingers against the skin with an all-consuming trail.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Eau de Parfum Intense 100ml
listings.description: Dreamt up in collaboration with renowned perfumer Sonia Constant, For Her Eau de Parfum Intense offers a new twist on Narciso Rodriguez’s quintessential heart of musc accord, layering fresh fruits and florals with addictive vanilla for a sensuous olfactory experience. The vegan fragrance starts with a juicy trail, invigorating the senses with a blend of peach and bergamot. Solar white flowers amplify the scent’s musk signature, before giving way to woody, earthy nuances of vetiver. The iconic For Her perfume bottle is reimagined to reflect the intensity of the perfume within. Wrapped in a deep shade of pink, the flacon encapsulates the fragrance’s bold character.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Hero Parfum Intense For Men Refill 200ml
listings.description: A new addition to the Hero family, Burberry’s Hero Parfum Intense 200ml Refill introduces a stronger, intensified fragrance with the addition of a rich leather accord. A signature trio of cedarwood oils leads the scent, layered with notes of invigorating black pepper. Amplified by a new deep leather note, the fragrance captures the power and daring spirit of the Burberry man. Replenish your existing 100ml bottle with this Hero refill.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Million Gold For Her Eau de Parfum Refillable 50ml
listings.description: Making a grand floral entrance, Rabanne’s Million Gold for Her Eau de Parfum oozes glittering confidence and sensuality thanks to its symphony of white flowers. The multi-faceted fragrance is opened by vibrant rose nuances, before melting into the soft, alluring bouquet of suede-like white florals. At its dry-down, mineral musk contrasts the gentle medley with a sea-kissed coolness, lingering on the skin to showcase the perfume’s versatility. Housed in a refillable crown jewel, the golden-tinted flacon reflects the rich honey-like elixir within.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc The Collection Star Oud Eau de Parfum 125ml
listings.description: From pens to parfum, Montblanc's The Collection Star Oud Eau de Parfum marks the German house's evolution, centring on an oud note that links tradition with modernity. Woody, ambery and heritage-focused, the scent will summon a glimmer of strength and confidence in every spritz. A flash of cardamom opens up the fragrance, luxurious and slightly citrusy. Beneath, a layer of gaiac wood adds smoky-soft texture to the profile, acting as a noble interlude between the spicy top and heavy base. The hero note oud provides a faintly animalic, leathery foundation, lingering deeply in your wake.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun Miami Shake Eau de Parfum 7.5ml
listings.description: Dare to resist temptation with Juliette Has a Gun’s Miami Shake Eau de Parfum. Whimsical yet ostentatious, the gourmand scent captures the sun-soaked paradise of Florida. Opening with the essence of wild strawberries, the sweetened aroma lures the senses with a cocktail of voluptuous, creamy notes. Decadent vanilla mingles with whipped cream and ice cream to leave behind a lingering, addictive trail.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Orange Marmalade Cologne 30ml
listings.description: Inspired by the British tradition of marmalade making, the Jo Malone London Orange Marmalade Cologne melts together zested orange and cashmere woods in a sweet citrus scent. Characterised by a vibrant, tangy profile, the fragrance reminisces orange peel being warmed on the stove, simmering into a golden nectar that uplifts the senses. Its grounding woody base adds depth and dimension, delivering long-lasting, tantalising intensity with each spritz onto the skin.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Peony & Blush Suede Cologne 10ml
listings.description: Inspired by modern British culture, Jo Malone London creates bespoke and luxurious fragrances synonymous with quintessential British style. Charming and exquisite, the Peony and Blush Suede Cologne opens with the crisp and juicy bite of red apple before succumbing to a floral heart of peony, a delicate accord that brings a subtle green freshness with hints of rose and honey. Luxurious and seductive, the blend settles on a bed of blush suede, which rounds off the fragrance with a soft and sensual opulence.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Nectarine Blossom & Honey Cologne 10ml
listings.description: Lift your spirits olfactory-style with the Jo Malone London Nectarine Blossom & Honey Cologne, taking cues from fruitful morning markets and lush summer gardens. Transporting you from your everyday, this fragrance features a cocktail of sugary accords, from a blackcurrant top layer to a warm, fuzzy peach centre. Acacia honey is the hero note in this blend, a less overpowering alternative to honey with appealing hints of beeswax and blossoms. This adds a natural touch to the overall juicy, sweetened profile, perfect for the months leading up to the height of Summer.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: An invitation to free your fantasies with confidence, Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia Eau de Parfum for women is the third Gucci fragrance to join the #FloraFantasy collection. Transporting you to a world of radiant floral power, the soft and sensual scents of Magnolia Essence, Dewberries Accord, and Patchouli Essence combine to create an empowered women's Eau de Parfum. The bottle, adorned with a mesmerising flora pattern and a captivating shade of purple, symbolises the limitless potential that lies within you. An unwavering ally to the Flora woman who seeks to explore all possibilities, this delightful fragrance is a unique bouquet full of joyful floral strength, that reminds you to trust yourself and free your fantasies. Miley Cyrus is the #FloraFantasy protagonist, guiding us on a journey through an enchanted world of heightened reality and anime adventure. With her free, rebellious spirit, she draws us towards the boundless potential of the world around us, like an intuitive reminder that with Gucci Flora Eau de Parfum Collection by your side, you can confidently conquer any challenge that lies before you.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Eau de Parfum For Her 150ml
listings.description: Extending a loving invitation to explore, create and connect with our truest selves, Gucci Guilty Pour Femme and Pour Homme fragrances relaunches with a campaign starring A$AP Rocky, Julia Garner and Elliot Page. An ode to self-acceptance, friendship and love in all its forms, Gucci Guilty Pour Femme Eau de Parfum for Women presents an ambery floral scent, that inspires a fresh take on blending sensuality with living authentically. Superior floral tones and enhanced fragrances flourish into a refined Eau de Parfum for women. This citrus perfume is strengthened, with a higher perfume concentrate than the classic Eau de Toilette, radiating with commanding Mandora, Pink Pepper, Lilac and Patchouli. Opening the mood of this perfume for women, citrus notes of Mandora are followed by nuances of Bergamot and Pink Pepper. The heart defines this Gucci scent’s complexity, where lilac contrasts rose and violet notes layered with Geranium oil. Defining the scent, Patchouli blends with ambery notes to add a layer of seduction. Echoing the same shape as the counterpart men’s fragrance, the Gucci Guilty Pour Femme bottle is partly wrapped in gold-toned metal, with a matching shimmering cap, reflecting the pale rose-tinted fragrance inside. The Interlocking G logo defines the front.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Bloom For Her Eau de Parfum Intense 50ml
listings.description: Blended by Master Perfumer Alberto Morillas, the addictive deep floral perfume smells divine, weaving the charming signature of Jasmine and Tuberose into an embodied essence. The Eau de Parfum Intense naturally expands into its full vital and mesmerising expression, blooming like the individual who wears it. Its inspired fragrance intensifies the Gucci Bloom white floral blend with added sensuality, a go-to perfume for any occasion. A radiant top note of Orange Blossom Absolute opens the incantation while its floral heart of Jasmine and Tuberose unfurls with Lady of the Night – a night-blooming flower that heightens the heady bouquet. Grounded in a base of Patchouli Essence and Crystal Moss Accord, the essence of this Gucci scent invokes deep perception and echoes with a sensuous fragrance. The distinctive square bottle that holds this tempting Eau de Parfum for women is embellished with a red Toile de Jouy Herbarium Gucci print, radiating creative power and bold luminosity.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Bloom For Her Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Gucci Bloom Parfum blossoms into the floating garden of dreams, bringing an addictively solar amber bouquet to the Bloom collection. The new Parfum from Gucci Beauty reimagines the iconic white Bloom Accord, transforming it into a golden Bloom Accord. It brings an intense gourmand edge with Coral Jasmine accord, a warm and luminous night-flowering jasmine that bathes the scent in a timelessly elegant golden veil. A modernizing co-extraction of Tuberose accord brings intensely fragrant sophisticated richness and powdery sensuality with hints of orange blossom accord. With subtle yet unique differences created through a singular note, the new Bloom scent’s rich and ambery accent is driven by the Peru Balsam extract. This is passionately blended with a duo of vanilla notes: a contrasted blend of creamy sweet and spicy woody accords. With these additional notes, the fragrance is wrapped in golden layers of delectable Vanilla, sweet Balsam, and rich Amber accords that drive its addictive solar intensity. The bottle is presented in a striking midnight black that echoes the concentrated depth and power of the juice within. The House’s iconic print of leaves, cherry branches, flowers, and butterflies is finished in gold to evoke its warm, elegant lightness. A modern portrayal of blooming femininity, Gucci Bloom is a place of self-discovery, where beauty blossoms and women celebrate each other as they evolve.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Eros Najim Parfum 100ml
listings.description: A new star is born in the galaxy of scent with the Versace Eros Najim Parfum, a woody amber fragrance that reveals warming nuances inspired by the dunes of the Middle Eastern desert at sunset. Najim, derived from the Arabic word for star, offers an aroma of intrigue and mystique with a unique olfactory experience. A heated fusion of saffron and cardamom warms the senses, while caramel and oud add a decadent quality to the harmonious blend. At the base, patchouli and vetiver summon a seductive nature, as tonka bean and cedarwood create an elegant finish.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Bottled Beyond Eau de Parfum 50ml Gift Set
listings.description: Celebrate the party season with the BOSS Bottled Beyond Eau de Parfum Gift Set. This two-piece collection showcases a sophisticated fragrance for the modern man, housed in a sleek, monogrammed gift box. The scent is defined by a powerful duality, contrasting the stimulating freshness of ginger with the warm sensuality of leather. This expertly balanced composition creates a distinctive and long-lasting olfactory experience, embodying a spirit of bold ambition. Set Contents: BOSS Bottled Beyond Eau de Parfum 50ml A premium fragrance where vibrant ginger and rich leather accords collide. The Eau de Parfum offers a long-lasting, intense scent that captures a refined, masculine energy. BOSS Bottled Beyond Shower Gel 100ml A luxurious body wash that gently cleanses the skin. The formula is scented with the signature notes of BOSS Bottled Beyond, leaving the body feeling refreshed and lightly perfumed.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre L'Eau Nue Parfum de Peau 50ml
listings.description: The first alcohol-free Parfum de Peau by Yves Saint Laurent, Libre L'Eau Nue Parfum de Peau is a cocktail of fruity-floral accords for you to delight in. Layered with mandarin, lavender, and orange blossom, this oil-based fragrance offers a luxe take on zingy, citrusy themes. The sun-kissed scent recalls sultry evenings spent on Mediterranean sands, gracing the skin with a compellingly juicy aroma and a radiant glow. A slight herbaceous touch keeps it sophisticated without toning down the inherent vibrance. Allow the scent to diffuse into a romantic, dimensional bouquet as you go about your day, spraying it in your hair too for a complete sensorial experience.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradoxe Radical Essence Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Reimagining gourmand as you know it, the Prada Paradoxe Radical Essence Parfum explores the boundaries between sweet and salty in this sophisticated display of floral amber nuances. Opening with a bouquet of neroli and orange flower, the scent transcends the floral realm with its zesty aura. At its heart, salted pistachio adds an unexpected twist with an addictive roasted note. Sophisticated sandalwood grounds the scent at the base to leave a modern, sensual trail.

listings.rawTitle: Armani Acqua Di Gio Profondo Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Make waves with the Armani Acqua Di Gio Profundo Eau de Toilette, a fresh fragrance designed to uplift and invigorate. Leading with lemon essence and fresh spices, the ocean-inspired scent opens on a light, inviting note. Marine accords layer with cypress essence and herbaceous lavender to provide heart to the nuanced aroma, while patchouli offers a woody, deepening base. The power of the elements is captured with hints of juxtaposing layers, for a unique complexity that subtly lingers. Spritz it liberally in the daytime.

listings.rawTitle: Armani Acqua Di Gio Profondo Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Make waves with the Armani Acqua Di Gio Profondo Eau de Toilette, a fresh fragrance designed to uplift and invigorate. Leading with lemon essence and fresh spices, the ocean-inspired scent opens on a light, inviting note. Marine accord layers with cypress essence and herbaceous lavender to provide heart to the nuanced aroma, while patchouli offers a woody, deepening base. The power of the elements is captured with hints of juxtaposing accords, for a unique complexity that subtly lingers. Spritz it in the daytime.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent MYSLF Eau de Parfum 150ml
listings.description: An all-year-round masculine fragrance with a luxe warm profile, the Yves Saint Laurent MYSLF Eau de Parfum is set to become your next signature. Cosy accords ground this scent firmly in the woody family. From a bergamot top note to a patchouli base, the sincere blend is finessed with a harmony of bitter citrus, dark earthiness, and invigoratingly raw orange, layering shades of warmth into your aroma. Sophisticated yet inviting, add this robust scent to your pulse points for a collected surge of confidence. What's more, it has a long-lasting heart to see you through your evening agenda.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Absolu de Parfum Pour Homme 60ml
listings.description: Dress sharp with a fragrance to match. Gucci Guilty's Absolu de Parfum Pour Homme offers an amber woody scent profile with a twist, creating a refined yet nuanced impression. Starting with a rich rum accord, the parfum opens with bitter almond and orange flower notes, creating a deep, orange-soaked layer. Cutting through just below is a red chilli pepper accord, layered with balsamic-woody resinoid and tonka bean absolute, injecting warmth and texture. Anchoring the pyramid is a base-level leathery accord and vanilla, completing the multi-faceted arrangement. The fragrance is outfitted in an ombre green and black bottle, embossed with the interlocking G moniker and topped with a polished black cap.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN La Petite Robe Noire - Eau de Parfum Gift Set
listings.description: Discover Guerlain’s Christmas gift sets, exquisitely presented in a poetic design adorned with precious details. A new creation that captures the irresistible free spirit of the most Parisian fragrances of the House. Guerlain’s gift sets are dressed in an exclusive new deep red design adorned with delicate glittering details. Paper artist Mélissandre Vidal has dreamt up a festive creation inspired by Art Nouveau that pays homage to nature. Give the gift of the House’s iconic creations, brought to life by a wonderful, poetic décor. A delicious floral and fruity sillage. Inspired by the inimitable Parisian style, La Petite Robe Noire is an ode to love and freedom, the embodiment of elegance and style, an invitation to joie de vivre and irreverence. An elegant and timeless creation embroidered with the finest black notes in perfumery: rose, black cherry, black tea and patchouli. Set Contents: La Petite Robe Noire Eau de Parfum 75ml La Petite Robe Noire Eau de Parfum 20ml

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Capturing the invigorating sun-kissed shores of the Mediterranean, Dolce&Gabbana’s Light Blue Eau de Toilette scents the skin with the bright, airy breeze of fresh fruits and woods. Characterised by a Sicilian lemon opening and crisp apple heart, the fragrance uplifts the senses with its vibrant zesty blend. Cedarwood anchors the cologne by adding woody depth and dimension, supporting the scent’s longevity on the skin. Housed in a frosted bottle with refined silver finishes and an enamelled blue cap, the eau de toilette pays homage to the traditional ceramics of the Amalfi Coast.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Claiming inspiration from the evanescent seascapes of southern Italy, the Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue Eau de Toilette captures the essence of the Mediterranean lifestyle. Evoking memories of a sunny Sicilian summer, the clean, fruity scent opens with notes of cedar, combined with crisp green apples, zesty lemons and sprightly bluebells. At the heart, a floral bouquet made up of white rose and fragrant jasmine lies, underpinned by the freshness of bamboo. The scent settles on a rich base of amber and musk, delivering a powerful scent created for the modern woman.

listings.rawTitle: Aramis Intuition Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Elevate your scent profile with Estée Lauder's Aramis Intuition Eau de Parfum, a sophisticated cologne with a warm, seductive bouquet. First conceived back in 1964 by Bernard Chant, the fragrance was inspired by the classic chypre structure: a combination of fresh, citrusy top notes with a rich, woody base. This breakthrough olfactory mix has cemented itself as a staple in grooming routines, and is updated here with a modern, lavender-topped flourish. Retaining the exclusive Leathery Cuirissima LXR essence, it's cut through with notes of grapefruit, Orris and patchouli – adding a punchy drive to the grounded aroma. Conjuring images of New York City, the scent is associated with the dynamic, forthright energy of the metropolis.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy L'Interdit Parfum 35ml
listings.description: Givenchy overhauls your aroma with L'Interdit Parfum, a rich and multifaceted olfactory treat for the senses. Layered with an inimitable blend of notes, the perfume opens intriguingly with sharp-sweet almond essence. Just beneath, several traces marry at the heart: think floral, fresh orange blossom, intoxicating tuberose, and heady jasmine. The core is a deep, warm blend with impressive longevity, suffused with vetiver, patchouli, vanilla-like benzoin, and more. Multi-dimensional and sophisticated, Givenchy's signature scent takes cues from French fragrance profiles.

listings.rawTitle: Armani Si Parfum 100ml
listings.description: The most intense and sensual interpretation of Si, Armani Si Parfum invites you to embrace the power of self-confidence. The iconic chypre scent takes on a new leathery intensity to entice. The scent opens with a gourmand blackcurrant nectar interlocked with a precious saffron accord and rich damascene rose absolute. At the core of the fragrance lies an addictive vanilla note, elevated by a leathery accord and earthy patchouli. Adorned with the gold-toned Si logo, the jewel-like bottle features a smoky gradient effect that amplifies the amber-toned elixir within.

listings.rawTitle: Armani Si Parfum 50ml
listings.description: The most intense and sensual interpretation of Si, Armani Si Parfum invites you to embrace the power of self-confidence. The iconic chypre scent takes on a new leathery intensity to entice. The scent opens with a gourmand blackcurrant nectar interlocked with a precious saffron accord and rich damascene rose absolute. At the core of the fragrance lies an addictive vanilla note, elevated by a leathery accord and earthy patchouli. Adorned with the gold-toned Si logo, the jewel-like bottle features a smoky gradient effect that amplifies the amber-toned elixir within.

listings.rawTitle: Armani Stronger With You Amber Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Reach for the Armani Stronger With You Amber Eau de Parfum, a fougère fragrance that introduces a moreish mossy freshness to your scent collection. The warm, fern-line EDP features a blend of lavender, amber, and vanilla, enveloping the senses in a nuanced green depth. The herby floral note is deepened by the sweet, gourmand core, with amber layering in a subtle warmth. Sophisticated and revitalising, the overall effect is that of a forest at golden hour. To reflect the nuance within, the scent is encased in an amber bottle with gold-tone branding and a luxe accented cap.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradigme Eau de Parfum 150ml Refill (Worth £180)
listings.description: Prada Paradigme rewrites the rules of masculine fragrance with a refined, avant-garde signature. Built from the base up in a reversed olfactive structure, the ambery woody eau de parfum reveals its depth from the start as warm resins and Guaiac wood form a rich foundation. A floral twist of bourbon geranium and airy musks brings lift and light, while a calabrian bergamot heart adds freshness. The bottle mirrors Prada’s iconic triangle in a bold tilt, lacquered in a gradient of deep black to green for a scent shaped by new perspectives.

listings.rawTitle: Miu Miu Fleur De Lait Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Emulate the Miu Miu girl with the French label's Fleur De Lait Eau de Parfum. Whipped up with a considered contrast of accords, the fragrance will lend your aroma the sweetness and depth it was missing. Topped with a burst of mango, the blend doesn't shy away from leaving a fruity first impression. Conjuring a beachside cocktail or a tropical sorbet, this first layer leads naturally into osmanthus, an exotic flower laced with delicate apricot facets. Think visceral orange and yellow hues distilled into a feminine sillage. As the dry-down unfolds, a creamy whisper of coconut emerges, softening the edges with its calming, skin-like warmth. The luxe design comes packaged in a pink-tinged matelassé glass bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Miu Miu Fleur De Lait Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Emulate the Miu Miu girl with the French label's Fleur De Lait Eau de Parfum. listings.rawTitle: Miu Miu Eau Rosee Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Find a chic companion in the Miu Miu L’Eau Rosée Eau de Toilette, a chypre fragrance that captures the multifacetedness of femininity. Dewy and luminous, it opens with the delicate freshness of lily of the valley, sharpened by a punchy lychee top note. This floral-fruity pairing shares a deep rosiness, conjuring shades of pink in the fruity-floral bouquet. Grounded in musk and wrapped in woody notes of musk, the scent settles into a mysterious, textured base – a nod to the signature trails of Miu Miu fragrances. Presented in a pink-hued matelassé glass flacon that catches the light with every turn, the bottle is topped off with a contrasting navy collar and crisp white disc.

listings.rawTitle: Mugler Angel Stellar Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: A celestial twist on a classic gourmand, Angel Stellar Eau de Parfum infuses Mugler’s iconic DNA through a prism of unexpected luminosity. Vivid bergamot opens the fragrance with a bright, tangy lift before melting into a creamy pistachio accord, leaving a sweet, salty and smooth olfactive trail. Anchored by soft vanilla and a veil of rich woods, the fragrance boasts powdery nuances for warmth and depth. Encased in an electric cobalt star, it’s like a fantasy reimagined in scent.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme La Vie est Belle Vanille Nude Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Blending the radiant essence of solar jasmine from France with the sweet warmth of glazed bourbon vanilla from Madagascar, La Vie Est Belle Vanilla unveils a fragrance that is intimate and inviting yet never overpowering. It opens as a floral escape sparkling with a burst of citrus brightness and luminous white petals touched by the elegance of solar jasmine. As the scent lingers, a clean, sensual caress of white musk envelops the skin, evoking a lasting feeling of joy and serenity with every note's intensity lasting up to 5 hours*.  *Self-assessment test, 69 women.

listings.rawTitle: Miu Miu Miutine Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: For a hit of sweet contradiction, reach for the refreshing appeal of Miu Miu's Miutine Eau de Parfum. The fragrance opens with a fresh layer of wild strawberry, drawn from the French-bred 'Mara des bois' variety. Inspired by the season's turn away from overly dessert-like notes into more nuanced, ripe-smelling fruits, this creates a lightly effervescent first impression. As the scent settles, a gardenia accord unfurls at the heart – think creamy petals edged in mossy green, with a subtle fruitiness that builds on the top note. Finally comes the dry-down: a glorious coupling of vanilla brown sugar and patchouli oil, creating a deep and warm centre that cuts through the entire scent profile. Memorable and filled with contrasts, this eau de parfum is housed in a luxe gold-capped, matelassé glass bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Gorgeous Gardenia Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Escape into a joy-fuelled fantasy land with Gucci Flora. Evolving into a new delicious Eau de Parfum, floral yet delicately sweet, Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia relaunches in a new campaign filled with flowers and fluffy animals. A signature scent for all free-spirited women full of positive energy. The perfume is built around the Gardenia flower, admired since the dawn of time for its splendour and said to be used in elixirs and magical potions. Taking inspiration from this legend and the idea of its mystical power, the gorgeous White Gardenia note is blended with solar Jasmine Grandiflorum absolute. This delicious potion of joy is introduced by a cheerful Pear Blossom accord while a touch of Brown Sugar accord adds a delicate sweetness to its floral scent trail. Encased within a new, elongated perfume bottle, the lacquered pink glass and shiny gold cap make it an object of beauty. One notable addition is the House’s distinctive Flora pattern. A core part of the Gucci identity, the motif is a painting of colourful flowers by artist Vittorio Accornero, created for Gucci in 1966. Directed and shot by artist Petra Collins and fronted by artist, actor, trailblazer and philanthropist Miley Cyrus, The #FloraFantasy campaign is a journey through a candy pink world, inspired by Japanese anime and filled with pop references where more is more.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Man Rain Essence Eau de Parfum 150ml
listings.description: An homage to the thrilling trail of a natural element, BVLGARI Man’s Rain Essence Eau de Parfum exudes power. The fragrance is an invitation to explore the force of water, merging fresh and woody notes for an intoxicating olfactory experience. An elixir of green tea and orange essence introduces the scent, invigorating the senses with a juxtaposition of earthy and citrus nuances. At the heart lies a white lotus accord, lending the fragrance a floral twist, before diffusing into a warm base of amber and guaiac wood.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Man Rain Essence Eau de Parfum 200ml Refill
listings.description: An homage to the thrilling trail of a natural element, BVLGARI Man’s Rain Essence Eau de Parfum exudes power. The fragrance is an invitation to explore the force of water, merging fresh and woody notes for an intoxicating olfactory experience. At the heart lies a white lotus accord, lending the fragrance a floral twist, before diffusing into a warm base of amber and guaiac wood.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Man In Black Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Elementally inspired by fire, BVLGARI Man In Black Parfum ignites your scent arsenal with bold intensity. True to BVLGARI’s signature of unexpected contrasts, the fragrance opens with a striking spice accord, fused with elemi essence for a smoky, resinous lift – an aromatic intro that evokes the orange-red glow of flames. A powdery, creamy heart follows, softening the heat with a skin-like sensuality. Anchoring the composition is a base of dark woods and benzoin, their musky, enveloping richness strengthening one another. Sense as they linger in your wake, like drifting embers. The flacon itself is rendered in classic black, finished with gold-tone branding for a strong, decisive flourish.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Omnia Coral Eau de Toilette 200ml Refill
listings.description: Inspired by the solar vitality of red coral, BVLGARI's Omnia Coral Refill brings to life the luminous energy of the vibrant gem in a striking fragrance. Radiant and colorful like coral, the floral-fruity Eau de Toilette, crafted by Master Perfumer Alberto Morillas, captures all the liveliness of nature through the bright aura of hibiscus notes. An emblem of passion, this lively flower is associated with the life-giving force of light, as it only grows if totally immersed in daylight.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Man In Black Eau de Parfum 200ml Refill
listings.description: Personifying the impetuous character of fire, BVLGARI’s Man In Black Eau de Parfum Refill is a daring and magnetic fragrance that creates a new statement of masculinity. Exuding energy, the charismatic scent opens with a bold infusion of vibrant spices and rum. Leather accord electrifies the fragrance with its intoxicating aroma, mingling with elements of rich tuberose flower before diffusing into a warm, creamy base of benzoin and tonka bean.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Man Wood Essence Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Embrace the verdant side of Italian fragrance with the BVLGARI Man Wood Essence Eau de Parfum. A beat away from the brand's city homestead of Rome, this scent leans into a greener, woodier sensibility. Although inspired by the elemental force of wood, the EDP opens with a punch of Italian zest accord and coriander essence, combining herb and citrus notes to reflect a love for incisive beginnings. A natural heart of cypress essence deepens the profile, lifted by a warm base layer of benzoin just beneath. The label's dolce vita lifestyle is reimagined in less of a cityscape lens and more naturally, making this the perfect daytime scent. Honouring multi-sensory storytelling, the flacon itself arrives in a rich jewel-like green with modern geometry and a logo-embossed cap.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Man In Black Eau de Parfum 60ml
listings.description: Personifying the impetuous character of fire, BVLGARI’s Man In Black Eau de Parfum is a daring and magnetic fragrance that creates a new statement of masculinity. Exuding energy, the charismatic scent opens with a bold infusion of vibrant spices and rum. Leather accord electrifies the fragrance with its intoxicating aroma, mingling with elements of rich tuberose flower before diffusing into a warm, creamy base of benzoin and tonka bean. Encased in a sleek, black bottle embossed with the BVLGARI logo.
