A natural heart of cypress essence deepens the profile, lifted by a warm base layer of benzoin just beneath. The label's dolce vita lifestyle is reimagined in less of a cityscape lens and more naturally, making this the perfect daytime scent. Honouring multi-sensory storytelling, the flacon itself arrives in a rich jewel-like green with modern geometry and a logo-embossed cap.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Man In Black Eau de Parfum 150ml
listings.description: Personifying the impetuous character of fire, BVLGARI’s Man In Black Eau de Parfum is a daring and magnetic fragrance that creates a new statement of masculinity. Exuding energy, the charismatic scent opens with a bold infusion of vibrant spices and rum. Leather accord electrifies the fragrance with its intoxicating aroma, mingling with elements of rich tuberose flower before diffusing into a warm, creamy base of benzoin and tonka bean. Encased in a sleek, black bottle embossed with the BVLGARI logo.

listings.rawTitle: AERIN Amber Musk Guimauve Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Overhaul your fragrance horde with the AERIN Amber Musk Guimauve Eau de Parfum, a sweet, floral olfactive gateway to compliments. Layered with pink pepper and orange flower, the fragrance is a spicy-floral update on the brand’s signature Amber Musk scent. While it retains the lingering warmth of the titular notes, these are here caressed with sweet, floral nuances that you will smell immediately on contact with the skin. The overall ambience is cheerful and refined, lending itself to all-day wear.

listings.rawTitle: L'Occitane Fleurs de Cerisier Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Whisk yourself away to the cherry orchards of southern France with Fleurs de Cerisier Eau de Toilette, a delicate and uplifting olfactive treat inspired by Provence's blossom trees. This cult-favourite fragrance opens with rich, fruity overtones of cherry, freesia, and blackcurrant. At its heart, cherry blossom and lily of the valley bring a soft floral note, while a base of rosewood, amber, and musk establishes a warm, enveloping dry-down. The result is a delicately balanced botanical aroma, ideal for earlier seasons and before dark. The formula is now rehoused in a contemporary, minimalist bottle with signature branding.

listings.rawTitle: L'Occitane Néroli Orchidée Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Immerse yourself in the harmonious blend of orchid and florals with L’Occitane’s Néroli & Orchidée Eau de Toilette.  The bottle, designed with minimalism in mind, reflects the cultural heritage of Provence. Inside, bright bursts of mandarin introduce the fragrance with a citrusy freshness. Neroli then blooms at the heart, capturing the delicate essence of orange blossom, long celebrated in Grasse, the capital of perfumery. As the scent lingers, warm vanilla rises through the blend, taking the aroma from day to night.

listings.rawTitle: L'Occitane Lavande Poivre Noir Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Evolving hour by hour, L'Occitane's Lavande Poivre Noir Eau de Toilette takes you on an olfactive journey, delivering a bold, aromatic and fresh appeal. Opening with a crisp burst of aromatic lavender, the scent begins on a herbaceous, revitalising note. One layer down, an incisive nuance of black pepper is grounded by a core facet of cedarwood, creating a spicy, warm contrast that invites compliments. The dry-down sees the EDT go from crisp and clean to addictively sensual, making it a choice pick for dusk 'til dawn. The fragrance is encased in a clean and simple bottle, with signature black branding and a designer moniker cap.

listings.rawTitle: L'Occitane Cédre Encens (Formerly Eau des Baux) After-Shave Balm 75ml
listings.description: Indulge in post-shave restorations with L'Occitane Cédre Encens after-shave balm. Infused with the warm, mysterious notes of cedarwood and frankincense, this soothing formula envelops skin in a subtle, sensual aroma.  Enriched with shea butter and plant-based glycerin, it delivers lasting hydration while easing irritation. A touch of birch tree extract helps calm and refresh, while the lightweight texture absorbs effortlessly, leaving skin velvety-soft with no oily residue.

listings.rawTitle: L'Occitane Cédre Encens Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Opening with a burst of bright bergamot, L’Occitane’s Cédre Encens Eau de Toilette unfolds into a warm, resinous and creamy olfactive journey. Inspired by the legendary knights of Les Baux de Provence, its heart is anchored by deep frankincense, lending a time-tested, distinguished character. As the fragrance settles, smooth vanilla and noble cedarwood linger, adding structure and warm masculinity to the aroma. A dash of juniper essential oil adds a purifying element to the majestic mix, encouraging a sense of calm as it emanates from the skin. The EDT's mysterious quality is destined for cooler seasons or evening wear.

listings.rawTitle: Sabrina Carpenter Me Espresso Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Rich, roasted and ready to wear, the Sabrina Carpenter Me Espresso Eau de Parfum is a gourmand fragrance ode to her iconic single. A lush blend of Cappuccino Smell-the-Taste™, cocoa powder and espresso bean notes open with freshly-ground intensity, deep and cosy to exude familiar coffee shop comfort. This heady essence is complemented by a sensual heart of night blooming jasmine and vanilla orchid, alongside biscotti to evoke a slightly nutty undertone. Served up with a side of caramel, sugared amber and whipped cream, the golden scent captures the edible essence of a sweet treat.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera La Bomba Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Immerse yourself in Carolina Herrera’s La Bomba Eau de Parfum, a larger-than-life scent housed in a sculptural butterfly bottle. Ultra-feminine, the floral-fruity fragrance boasts a vivacious blend of accords. It opens with pitaya, a mildly sweet fruit indigenous to Central and South America with an earthy undertone. Blooming beneath, peony comes through in all its pink floral glory, adding botanical nuance. Grounding the sweet sillage is a strong, warm base of solar vanilla, making your trail delightfully moreish. Select the Venezuelan signature when you want to make a strong sensual impression.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera La Bomba Eau de Parfum 200ml
listings.description: Carolina Herrera's La Bomba Eau de Parfum injects your aroma with a moreish burst of pink petals and juicy fruits. Opening with exotic pitaya, the fragrance pays homage to the Venezuelan designer’s roots, bringing tropical vibrancy to the fore. This zingy top note melts into a heart of cherry peony and red frangipani – pink gourmand elements with a dessert-like appeal. Anchoring the composition is a radiant solar vanilla, wrapping the scent in warmth and sensuality. Now available in a sleek, refillable format, the fuchsia-tinged bottle is as bold and coveted as the blend within.

listings.rawTitle: Kérastase Gloss Absolu Le Parfum - Hair Perfume 30ml
listings.description: Infuse your hair with a rich floral bouquet courtesy of Kérastase’s Gloss Absolu Le Parfum, a luxe finishing mist, perfectly sized for on the go. Made with a flirty fragrance pyramid, the hair perfume opens with a sparkling burst of citrus, where zesty lemon lends a crisp, clean brightness. As the scent settles, a heart of rosy jasmine unfurls, delicate yet opulent, adding a soft, feminine dimension. Over time, the base reveals a warm, gourmand coupling of creamy vanilla and smooth sandalwood. Fresh and uplifting at first spritz, then subtly sweet and woody on closer contact, spray this for a sensory hair lift. Adding to the effect, natural oils lend their own conditioning benefits, leaving strands touchably silkier and softly scented.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Goddess Parfum for Women 30ml
listings.description: A new chapter of self-discovery, Burberry Goddess Parfum for Women radiates an intense magnetism that captivates those nearby. The ambery fragrance opens with a vibrant raspberry accord complemented by lavender essence from the original Eau de Parfum. The signature trio of vanilla extracts is unveiled at the heart, before a suede leather accord at the base conjures warmth and sensuality. Reminiscent of the shades of a radiant sunset, the refillable bronzed square bottle is housed in elegant light brown packaging adorned with a gold label inspired by Burberry’s signature gabardine fabric.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Goddess Parfum for Women Refill 150ml
listings.description: A new chapter of self-discovery, the Burberry Goddess Parfum for Women Refill radiates an intense magnetism that captivates those nearby. The ambery fragrance opens with a vibrant raspberry accord complemented by lavender essence from the original Eau de Parfum. The signature trio of vanilla extracts is unveiled at the heart, before a suede leather accord at the base conjures warmth and sensuality. Reminiscent of the shades of a radiant sunset, the refill is housed in elegant light brown packaging adorned with a gold label inspired by Burberry’s signature gabardine fabric.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Goddess Parfum for Women Travel Spray 10ml
listings.description: A new chapter of self-discovery, Burberry Goddess Parfum for Women radiates an intense magnetism that captivates those nearby. The ambery fragrance opens with a vibrant raspberry accord complemented by lavender essence from the original Eau de Parfum. The signature trio of vanilla extracts is unveiled at the heart, before a suede leather accord at the base conjures warmth and sensuality. Reminiscent of the shades of a radiant sunset, the travel spray is housed in a bronzed bottle filled with a deep ambery fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Black Orchid Reserve Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Powerfully signature, TOM FORD's Black Orchid Reserve Eau de Parfum delivers your floral fix with a rich, autumn-winter edge. Topped with black truffle and sparkling ylang ylang, the fragrance begins on a flirty, seductive note.  A citrus burst of bergamot and orange collides with rum-soaked black plum, creating a damson-rich heart that deepens the trail with syrupy allure. As the scent settles, earthy patchouli and creamy vanilla wrap around a final whisper of orchid, grounding the composition in mystery. Let this complex, cult-favourite fragrance imprint your presence with its chypre profile.

listings.rawTitle: Aramis Intuition Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Elevate your scent profile with Estée Lauder's Aramis Intuition Eau de Parfum, a sophisticated cologne with a warm, seductive bouquet. First conceived back in 1964 by Bernard Chant, the fragrance was inspired by the classic chypre structure: a combination of fresh, citrusy top notes with a rich, woody base. This breakthrough olfactory mix has cemented itself as a staple in grooming routines, and is updated here with a modern, lavender-topped flourish. Retaining the exclusive Leathery Cuirissima LXR essence, it's cut through with notes of grapefruit, Orris and patchouli – adding a punchy drive to the grounded aroma. Conjuring images of New York City, the scent is associated with the dynamic, forthright energy of the metropolis.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Black Orchid Reserve Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Powerfully signature, TOM FORD's Black Orchid Reserve Eau de Parfum delivers your floral fix with a rich, autumn-winter edge. Topped with black truffle and sparkling ylang ylang, the fragrance begins on a flirty, seductive note. A citrus burst of bergamot and orange collides with rum-soaked black plum – creating a damson-rich heart that deepens the trail with syrupy allure. As the scent settles, earthy patchouli and creamy vanilla wrap around a final whisper of orchid, grounding the composition in mystery. Let this complex, cult-favourite fragrance imprint your presence with its chypre profile.

listings.rawTitle: Rituals The Ritual of Ayurveda Indian Rose & Sweet Almond Oil Home Perfume 400ml
listings.description: Fill your home with the captivating warmth of Indian rose and sweet almond oil with The Ritual of Ayurveda Home Perfume from Rituals. The soft, romantic floral notes of rose mingle with the creamy, comforting essence of almond, creating a fragrance that feels both indulgent and nurturing. Every spray transforms your space into a serene haven of effortless elegance and cosy sophistication.

listings.rawTitle: Rituals The Ritual of Karma Lotus Flower & White Tea Home Perfume 400ml
listings.description: Make your home guest-ready—or lift its aroma solely for your sake—with Rituals' The Ritual of Karma Lotus Flower & White Tea Home Perfume. Experience the alchemy's fresh and inviting aroma in just one or two spritzes. Fresh white tea brightens the home spray, lifting the soft, powdery sweetness of the complementary lotus note. Botanical and herby in equal measure, the perfume evokes a clean, spa-like atmosphere for a revitalising feel when you enter the room(s). The design is packaged in a minimalist bottle, finessed with signature branding.

listings.rawTitle: Balmain Carbone Eau de Toilette 125ml
listings.description: Enveloping the skin in a cloud of musky notes, the Balmain Beauty Carbone Eau de Toilette reveals an irresistible gourmand scent. Infused with white musk, the creamy aroma is matched with soft suede and sweet patchouli to entice the senses. A bouquet of roses mingles with earthy sandalwood and spiced cumin for a fragrance with balance.

listings.rawTitle: Balmain Rouge Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Blooming with a delicate bouquet of florals, the Balmain Beauty Rouge Eau de Toilette entangles the senses in a romantic arrangement of fresh petals. Fresh lily and osamanthus dance with magnolia and ylang ylang to reveal a white floral array of sensual but refreshing accords. A blend of georgywood and morea ciliata creates an earthy, woody finish to ground the scent in a celebration of nature.

listings.rawTitle: Balmain Rouge Eau de Toilette 125ml
listings.description: Blooming with a delicate bouquet of florals, the Balmain Beauty Rouge Eau de Toilette entangles the senses in a romantic arrangement of fresh petals. Fresh lily and osamanthus dance with magnolia and ylang ylang to reveal a white floral array of sensual but refreshing accords. A blend of georgywood and morea ciliata creates an earthy, woody finish to ground the scent in a celebration of nature.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Le Parfum for Women 30ml
listings.description: Inspired by French fragrance profiles, delight in the floral bouquet of the Chloé Le Parfum for Women. Starting with an escapist orange blossom accord, the perfume is layered with a powder-sweet essence of rose at the heart for a traditional feminine nuance. These warm top notes are caressed by an even warmer core of vanilla and tonka bean, creating an ambery sillage that's addictive without being sickly-sweet. Emphasising the scent's elegant DNA, the bottle is secured with a burgundy ribbon around its neck.

listings.rawTitle: BOSS Bottled Beyond Eau de Parfum for Him 100ml
listings.description: Memorably bold and long-lasting, amplify your presence with BOSS' Beyond Eau de Parfum for Him. Fronted by global ambassador Bradley Cooper, this standout scent makes a confident entrance into your aftershave collection. The composition opens with a vibrant burst of ginger, delivering a zesty, peppery freshness that awakens the senses. As it settles, smooth leather emerges, adding a smoky, resinous depth that’s equal parts refined and magnetic. Lending itself to evenings that demand impact, the Beyond EDP is for leaving your mark in olfactory form.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has A Gun Powder Love Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Wrap yourself in the soft embrace of Juliette Has A Gun Powder Love. Airy trails of fragrance swirl like cotton candy across a pastel sky, unfolding into delicate orange blossom petals atop a bed of pillowy marshmallow. On skin, sugared almond melts into a whisper of powdery musk, leaving a sweet, lingering memory. Light, playful, and utterly addictive, it’s a scent that turns every moment into pure, wearable bliss.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has A Gun Powder Love Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Wrap yourself in the soft embrace of Powder Love. Airy trails of fragrance swirl like cotton candy across a pastel sky, unfolding into delicate orange blossom petals atop a bed of pillowy marshmallow. On skin, sugared almond melts into a whisper of powdery musk, leaving a sweet, lingering memory. Light, playful, and utterly addictive, it’s a scent that turns every moment into pure, wearable bliss.

listings.rawTitle: Le Sel d'Issey Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: A new, intense perfume for men, Issey Miyake’s Le Sel Eau de Parfum is amplified with a fusion of sea freshness and warm land vibrancy. Created by perfumer Quentin Bisch, the woody marine dry amber fragrance evokes the sea with a salt accord, marine seaweed and oakmoss. Evoking the land are notes of incense, amber and cedarwood. Designer Tokujin Yoshioka has intensified the sharp aesthetic of the Le Sel bottle with amplified masculinity – a smoky grey lacquer and gunmetal cap. With a refillable format, experience a long-lasting masculine elegance time after time.

listings.rawTitle: AERIN Rose Cocoa Parfum 50ml
listings.description: The AERIN Rose Cocoa Parfum arrives as a part of the brand's Premier Collection. Dreamed up with floral and gourmand essences, the evocative fragrance is set to overhaul your collection. Two timeless symbols of indulgence—rich chocolate and powdery roses—unite in this addictive fragrance. Beloved by the founder herself, these nuances evoke instant pleasure, blending the warmth of confectionery with the timeless pull of florals. At its core, oud dries down into a luxurious, slightly animalic trail. Detect this base note as it lingers on the skin long after midnight. Reserve this scent for special occasions, for a burst of romance in olfactive form.

listings.rawTitle: The Merchant of Venice Nobil Homo Ottoman Amber Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: The majestic, audacious top notes of sparkling bergamot are beautifully softened by delicate hints of geranium and luscious plum, creating a scent that’s at once vibrant and inviting. The rich brown hues adorning the glass bottle echo the warm, woody essence of sandalwood, setting the stage for the perfume’s deeper story. At its heart, sensual patchouli adds depth and intensity, perfectly complemented by the indulgent blend of vanilla and labdanum. Together, they unveil the opulent richness of ottoman amber, a fragrance that transports you to a distant, dream-like world filled with mystery and allure.

listings.rawTitle: The Merchant of Venice Moscado Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Soft blue-violet blooms capture the elegance and understated charm of Asiatic lands. This enchanting fragrance unfolds around a poetic accord of blue tea, paired with a delicate floral bouquet of rose, magnolia, and neroli. On contact, the heart blooms with fresh, suave, and subtly fruity facets. Gentle musks and textured vetiver anchor the green, invigorating scent, adding depth and warmth to a fragrance that is at once rejuvenating and unforgettable.

listings.rawTitle: The Merchant of Venice Nobil Homo Venetian Blue Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: The Merchant of Venice Nobil Homo Venetian Blue Eau de Parfum is a bold, charismatic marine fragrance with a modern fougère twist. Fresh citrus notes of lemon and bergamot meet the vibrant sweetness of juicy apple and pineapple, creating an energetic, lively opening. At its heart, warming spices mingle with smoky undertones, while a rich base of patchouli and birch adds depth and sophistication. The result is a fragrance that is dynamic, daring, and unforgettable.

listings.rawTitle: The Merchant of Venice Cyprus Shell Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Born from a refined reinterpretation of Cyprus powder, The Merchant of Venice Cyprus Shell Eau de Parfum draws inspiration from the Secreti Nobilissimi of the Art of Perfumery. Opening with a delicate breath of iris, the regal heart of the composition is softly laced with airy saline nuances and the crisp freshness of pear. At its core, velvety roses and precious resins wrap the senses in opulence, before settling into a deep, lingering base of warm woods and earthy richness, infused with an irresistible sensuality. The bottle mirrors the sea itself, its blue waves recalling the Mediterranean shore where Aphrodite rose from the shell, a vision of timeless beauty revealed to the world.

listings.rawTitle: The Merchant of Venice La Fenice Maria Callas Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: The Merchant of Venice La Fenice Maria Callas Eau de Parfum captures the timeless femininity of the legendary Divina. Delicate floral notes unfold gracefully, leading to a rich, amber base that is both multifaceted and enduring, leaving a captivating trail. Created to celebrate the 100th anniversary of Maria Callas’ birth, this is the first official fragrance inspired by her unparalleled artistry and charisma. An iconic scent, it embodies her elegance, poise, and the magnetic essence that made her unforgettable.

listings.rawTitle: The Merchant of Venice Queen of the Night Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Step into the splendour of ancient Egypt with this intoxicating Merchant of Venice Queen of the Night Eau de Parfum, a tribute to the opulence of the Pharaohs. A luminous opening of blue lotus unfurls, kissed with the fiery richness of saffron and the warm embrace of cinnamon bark. Sweet, spicy and sophisticated, it deepens into a voluptuous heart of amber, incense and the sacred kyphi accord. Finally, the fragrance settles into a velvety, sensual base of creamy sandalwood, gourmand tonka bean and the mythical depth of myrrh, a trail that lingers with radiant mystery. Encased in an equally captivating bottle, this fragrance is a celebration of timeless elegance, designed to enchant and enthral.

listings.rawTitle: The Merchant of Venice Murano Red Potion Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: The Merchant of Venice Murano Red Potion Eau de Parfum captures the elegance and nobility of the Serenissima, opening like sunlit corridors in a Venetian palace. Its deep red bottle, topped with a transparent cap, conceals the passion and mystery within. From the very first breath, vibrant orange blossom and aromatic rosemary conjure the warmth of North African coasts and the salty Mediterranean breeze. As the heart unfolds, Venice reveals itself through golden sandalwood and the honeyed glow of precious immortelle, weaving a tapestry of scents that is opulent, refined, and utterly unforgettable.

listings.rawTitle: Zadig & Voltaire This Is Him! Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Built up with a Parisian-inspired olfactory pyramid, this Zadig & Voltaire This Is Him! Eau de Toilette is confidence and creativity combined. Before revealing its woody-spicy character, the profile opens up with a vibrational layer of grapefruit. Progressing into vanilla, the fragrance becomes increasingly complex as it unfurls on the skin, blending rebellion and luxury. A base layer of sandalwood creates a signature trail. "I like when it leaves a trail, asserts a personality," says founder and art collector Thierry Gillier – a sentiment that carries through in the confident scent journey.

listings.rawTitle: Orebella Blooming Fire Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Ignite your senses with Orebella Blooming Fire Eau De Parfum, a warm floral fragrance that captures the heat of sun-drenched skin. Sparkling bergamot and spiced cardamom open into a luminous heart of Tahitian monoi and jasmine, before settling into the sensual depth of patchouli and cedarwood. The result is a radiant, tropical warmth that feels both fiery and serene.

listings.rawTitle: Zadig & Voltaire This Is Her! Undressed Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Indulge in the delicate yet sensual aroma of Zadig & Voltaire's This is Her! Undressed, an Eau de Parfum designed for the modern, confident woman. Sparkling top notes of organic ginger and orange blossom bring a fresh luminosity, while the heart of ylang-ylang and intimate ‘skin accord’ adds a soft, glowing warmth. Grounded by base notes of benzoin resinoid, Nepalese sandalwood and creamy musk, the fragrance leaves an addictive, lingering trail that evokes intimacy and elegance.

listings.rawTitle: Orebella Salted Muse Eau De Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Where the sea meets the skin, Orebella’s Salted Muse Eau De Parfum is a clean yet sensual fragrance that channels the raw energy of ocean tides and forest air. It’s a scent that awakens the senses, bestowing freshness in full force while grounding you in earthy fashion. This EDP is layered with a dynamic interplay of marine and woodland notes, creating a vivacious, elemental character. At the top, sea salt and pink pepper collide – mineral-rich and spicy, like a piquant coastal breeze. The heart reveals an olive tree accord, adding a Mediterranean depth that feels irresistibly sun-kissed. Anchoring the fragrance is a cedar and sandalwood core, softened by a veil of amber that lends warmth and modernity. The result is a pyramid that feels both wild and refined, with essential oils adding a nourishing skin touch.

listings.rawTitle: Zadig & Voltaire ZADIG Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Dreamed up by perfumers Amandine Clerc-Marie and Florian Gallo, Zadig & Voltaire's ZADIG Eau de Parfum lends you a dose of freedom in sensory form. Topped with a duo of black and white sesame, the scent opens with a nutty, slightly spicy top layer – think of it as an olfactory palette cleanser. Next, luminous néroli essence and orange blossom absolute combine for a golden, citrus-floral heart, layering in zesty warmth that cuts through the pyramid. As it evolves, the dessert-like combination of roasted vanilla and chantilly accord comes into play, followed by creamy sandalwood. This final note is shared in many of the label's creations, establishing a strong yet elegant sillage every time. Anything is possible with this multi-faceted fragrance, which takes cues from Parisian profiles.

listings.rawTitle: Zadig & Voltaire This Is Her! Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Elegance and edge distilled, Zadig & Voltaire's This Is Her! Eau de Parfum brings a certain  je ne sais quoi  to your fragrance collection. The profile opens up with a familiar layer of jasmine, adding a petal-rich brightness to your entrance. Journeying into vanilla and roasted chestnut, the bouquet becomes intriguingly complex as it settles on the skin. A recurring theme in the brand's scent portfolio, sandalwood lingers at the very base, imparting an effortlessly chic and milky Parisian flourish. "I like when it leaves a trail, asserts a personality," says founder and art collector Thierry Gillier – a sentiment that echoes through the fragrance’s refined pyramid.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Original Parfum 60ml
listings.description: Lacoste’s Original Parfum is a modern woody signature. It opens with a vibrant burst of bergamot, cardamom, and ginger, combining to create an ambience of citrus and spice. As the scent settles, soft violet and lavender bloom, wrapped in smoky incense. Beneath it all, amberxtreme, patchouli, and tonka bean unfurl gently, imparting rich, comforting notes. Simply mist it over your skin, five inches away, and leave behind a lingering, warm trail.

listings.rawTitle: Coach Women's Gold Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: Coach’s Gold Parfum Spray is a refreshing, fruity fragrance crafted to uplift the senses.  A bright splash of peppercorn sparks the opening with vibrancy, softening into almond blossom at the heart, where florals add an elegant, comforting nuance. As the fragrance deepens, vanilla lends creamy sweetness that melts into golden amber, leaving a trail of warmth and intensity.  The result is a refined harmony of delicacy and depth, creating a versatile scent that transitions from day to night.

listings.rawTitle: Coach Women's Gold Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description: Coach’s Gold Parfum Spray is a refreshing, fruity fragrance crafted to uplift the senses.  A bright splash of peppercorn sparks the opening with vibrancy, softening into almond blossom at the heart, where florals add an elegant, comforting nuance. As the fragrance deepens, vanilla lends creamy sweetness that melts into golden amber, leaving a trail of warmth and intensity.  The result is a refined harmony of delicacy and depth, creating a versatile scent that transitions from day to night.

listings.rawTitle: Alia Scene Stealer Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Bold and commanding with feminine energy, Alia founder Roxie Nafousi celebrates individuality and identity with Scene Stealer Eau de Toilette. Magentic and unapologetic, the aroma invites you to confidently embrace your true self, without hesitation. Commanding attention with every spritz, bergamot and saffron breathe light and luminosity into the scent. At its heart, a bouquet of jasmine and resinous amberwood mingles with a rich base of patchouli and musk to reveal an unforgettable trail that speaks before you do.

listings.rawTitle: Alia Power House Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: A focal point in your fragrance wardrobe, Alia Power House is a scent that amplifies every moment of the day. Opening with smoky tobacco leaf, spiced cardamom, rich rum and crisp apple, this unique blend sparks a confident and ambitious energy. At its heart, guaiacwood and cedar wood create a grounded, magnetic warmth, while a base of amber, oud, and musk creates an unstoppable aura. Rich and self-assured, the fragrance lingers long after you leave, the way presence should.

listings.rawTitle: Alia Main Character Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Step into your own story with the Alia Main Character Eau de Parfum, a fragrance designed to reflect every facet of your identity. Effortlessly cool and calm, the scent embodies self-assurance and confidence with an emboldened spirit in every spritz. Bright top notes of angelica root and turmeric leaf create a fresh, energising opening, while a heart of mimosa, orris, orange blossom, and tonka adds subtle warmth and spice. A base of ambroxan, oakwood and white musk lingers softly, leaving a mesmerising, sophisticated trail.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Born In Roma Uomo Eau de Toilette 10ml
listings.description: Taking the city of Rome as its muse, Valentino’s Born in Roma Uomo Eau de Toilette is an invitation to live life freely. The fragrance represents the intersection in which the past and present collide, paying homage to Italy’s heritage whilst celebrating the joys of everyday life. The scent can be characterised by its unique note juxtaposition. Violet leaf introduces the Eau de Toilette, offering a burst of floral freshness that alludes to the spontaneity of the current time. Sage’s multi-faceted composition lends the fragrance an elegant nature that forever remains timeless, laced with a vetiver accord for a touch of daring smokiness. The bottle’s pyramidal design pays homage to Roman architecture. The eye-catching flacon is covered in studs that descend from black to white, embellished with black leather and a pink Valentino logo.

listings.rawTitle: NUXE MEN Soothing Replenishing Aftershave Balm 75ml
listings.description: Delivering up to 24 hours of hydration, the NUXE MEN Soothing Replenishing Aftershave Balm helps to comfort the feeling of skin post-shave. Infused with patented ash bark oleo extract, the lightweight formula offers powerful hydration while promoting antioxidant protection. Prickly pear extract lends soothing benefits, helping to minimise feelings of tightness and visible redness. Its moisturising gel-cream texture melts onto the skin without feeling greasy or oily.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Flower Bomb Pretty Peony Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Much like the beginning of spring, the Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb Pretty Peony Eau de Parfum 50ml feels bright, fresh and full of life. Opening with a squeeze of strawberry accord, the scent leans into a soft bouquet of peony for a rich floral heart. Grounded by smooth musk that settles close to the skin, creating a scent that’s light, airy and feminine.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne 1 Million Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: The olfactory epitome of money, power and luxury, Rabanne 1Million beholds a character of flamboyant extravagance. A sprig of peppermint and mandarin give a crisp, juicy-cool tone to the introduction, the calm before an explosion of sweet, sun-drenched florals at the heart with an unexpected hint of spice. Notes of leather take centre stage, emulating the expensive smell of the plush leather seats on your private jet. Live your fantasy of excessive wealth and feel like a million dollars with this suave men's fragrance, bottled in a gleaming gold bar for an opulent touch.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Flash Eau de Parfum 60ml
listings.description: Get ready to shine all night with Jimmy Choo’s Flash Eau de Parfum, a fragrance designed with the glamorous party girl in mind.   Adorn yourself head to toe with a scent that sets the night alive, featuring notes of sparkling strawberry and tangerine, the fruity notes dazzle any crowd. White flowers take the stage as the star of the show, exuding femininity and passion - a bouquet that will captivate the audience. Alluring pink pepper dances with sensual tuberose all night long for an addictive trail.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Man Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Exuding a relaxed confidence and unmistakable masculinity, the BOSS Orange for Men EDT Spray boasts an energising aroma that lasts. With top notes of Apple and Coriander sat upon heart notes of Frankincense and Szechuan Pepper, this unique fragrance is perfect for the carefree, optimistic man. Finished with base notes of Vanilla Bean and Bubinga Wood, this spray is presented in a bold bottle, made to resemble a man's defined torso. K.D.

listings.rawTitle: MUGLER Alien Eau de Parfum Natural Spray Refillable - 60ml
listings.description: Mysterious and captivating, Thierry Mugler Alien EDP Refillable Spray (60ml) is an alluring fragrance that's out of this world. Opening with top notes of Indian jasmine, the fragrance moves into a woodsy heart before drying down to a base of warm white amber. Rich and feminine, the bottle is also refillable, meaning you save money in the long run. - L.M.

listings.rawTitle: MUGLER Alien Eau de Parfum Natural Spray Refillable - 90ml
listings.description: An olfactive talisman, designed to reveal the light and creative force of its wearer, Mugler’s iconic Alien fragrance captivates all those who encounter it. The distinctive floral woody aroma centres around the powerful scent of jasmine. Alluring and intoxicating, the enigmatic eau de parfum combines warm cashmeran wood and white amber with jasmine sambac. An elixir that captures the essence of feminine sensuality. Housed in a refill bottle to support sustainable luxury.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Invictus Eau De Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Capturing the powerful magnitudes of masculinity in all its glory, Rabanne Invictus for Him Eau de Toilette emits a magnetic clash of freshness and animalistic sensuality. Crisp nuances of grapefruit, mandarin and marine accords lead into a heart of bay leaf and jasmine, accompanied by a charismatic undertone of guaiac wood and patchouli. The fragrance arrives in a trophy-shaped bottle, representing the scent of victory.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Lady Million Eau De Parfum 80ml
listings.description: Centred around powdery-fresh notes of neroli, orange blossom and jasmine absolute, the carnal symphony of white florals that is Rabanne’s Lady Million exudes sensual, elegant femininity. A luminous opening of bitter orange and raspberry mellow to an indolic heart of soft floral nectars. Patchouli sweetened with honey emerge as the fragrance dries down, grounding the unforgettable scent with a warm depth of animalic undertones. Crafted with a rich eau de parfum concentration for a lasting trail, Lady Million cloaks you in a multifaceted veil that captures the essence of feminine luxury.

listings.rawTitle: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Gold Eau de Parfum - 100ml
listings.description: Indulge your senses with Viva La Juicy Gold Couture EDP 100ml. Boasting a floral fruity scent, the perfume is a decadent rendition of Viva la Juicy that has top notes of wild berries, that are supported with a kiss of honeysuckle and golden amber before melting to base notes of caramel and vanilla. Perfect for women, the addictive fragrance gives off the scent of ultimate glamour. -SA

listings.rawTitle: Versace Crystal Noir Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Be transported to the orient with this Versace Crystal Noir Eau de Toilette. The “floriental” fragrance is very feminine and seductive whilst bearing a pleasantly intense undertone. Sandalwood, cashmeran, vanilla pod and heliotropine form the base notes that bring this pleasant heaviness. The top and middle notes blend fruitiness from blackcurrant, black fig and violet with the floral notes of tuberose, frangipani and jasmine. The garnet glass bottle is designed to represent the facets of a diamond. LB Notes: Top: Blackcurrant, Black Fig, Violet Middle: Tuberose, Frangipani, Jasmine Base: Sandalwood, Cashmeran, Vanilla Pod, Heliotropine

listings.rawTitle: Versace Bright Crystal Eau de Toilette 30ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Yuzu, Ice Accord, Pomegranate Heart Notes: Peony, Magnolia, Lotus Flower Base Notes: Acajou, Plant Amber, Musk The Versace Bright Crystal Eau de Toilette features a fresh, floral fragrance inspired by the strong, confident, yet feminine woman. Sensual and vibrant, the perfume features a musky undertone adding an alluring edge. The perfume opens with refreshing notes of pomegranate, yuzu and ice accord before melting into a floral heart of peony, magnolia and lotus flower. At the base lies the warmth of amber and musk, harmonising this glamorous fragrance. Housed in a sleek, crystal-inspired bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Bright Crystal Eau de Toilette 90ml
listings.description: Versace Bright Crystal is a very feminine floral scent making you feel utterly sophisticated and elegant. The fruity top notes of yuzu, ice accord and pomegranate perfectly complement the floral heart notes of peony, magnolia and lotus flower. Finally, the base notes finish with intense acajou, plant amber and musk. The perfect perfume for the summer months. LB Top notes: Yuzu, Ice Accord, Pomegranate Heart notes: Peony, Magnolia, Lotus Flower Base notes: Acajou, Plant Amber, Musk

listings.rawTitle: Versace Eros for Men Eau de Toilette 30ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Mint Leaves, Lemon Zest, Green Apple. Heart Notes: Ambroxan, Geranium, Tonka Bean. Base Notes: Vanilla, Vetiver, Oak Moss Accord, Cedarwood. The Versace Eros Eau de Toilette offers a revitalising freshness to captivate the senses with a fragrance inspired by the Greek God of love. Beginning with a tangy burst, top notes of mint leaves, lemon zest and green apple offer a harmonious blend of crisp aromas. The earthy richness of ambroxan, geranium and tonka bean envelops the heart of the fragrance, melting into a masculine base of sweet vanilla, vetiver, oak moss accord and cedarwood. The EDT offers an enticing infusion, embodying the enthralling passion of romance.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme La Vie est Belle Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Indulge your senses with the La Vie est Belle Eau de Parfum, Lancôme's bestselling fragrance for her created by three of France's leading perfumers. Represented by Julia Roberts, the luminous perfume is a universal declaration to the beauty of life. A reimagining of a signature scent, it plays with the addition of magnolia essence to create a sparkling olfactory experience. The EDP opens with a ripe burst of pear and blackberry before capturing the romance of orange flower and jasmine sambac at the heart. It settles on a rich base of patchouli essence that has been sustainably sourced to create an opulent olfactive experience. Revamped in an eco-conscious, refillable bottle, the fragrance takes a step toward a brighter tomorrow, celebrating the timeless iconicity of the scent again and again.  Please note: This product does not include a refill.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Eau de Parfum For Her 30ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Freesia, Peony. Heart Notes: Lily of the Valley, Magnolia, Rose. Base Notes: Ambergris, Cedar. Playful and seductive, the Chloé Signature Eau de Parfum blooms with confidence and sophistication. Combining Freesia and Peony with Lily of the Valley, the intoxicating perfume blends Magnolia and bouquets of voluptuous Rose in the heart, laid on a woody base of Ambergris and Cedar. Housed in an elegant bottle, the refreshing EDP offers the perfect scent for everyday wear.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Floral. Top Notes: Wild Berries. Heart Notes: White Violet, Jasmine. Base Notes: Sandalwood. Instantly recognisable with oversized daisy embellishments on its cap, Marc Jacobs Daisy is a true icon in the world of fragrance. Sweet, tangy notes of wild berries pull you in, seducing the senses with a fresh, fruity opening that unfurls to reveal whimsical white flowers at the heart. Sandalwood grounds the fragrance with a warm earthiness and lends depth to the eau de toilette. Charming, youthful and feminine, this EDT is much-loved for daytime wear.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Eau So Fresh Eau de Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Inspired by the original fragrance, Marc Jacobs' Daisy Eau So Fresh Eau de Toilette exudes radiance and playful energy. Combining bright fruits and florals, the fragrance opens with ripe Raspberry and Pear, encompassed in a wild heart of Rose, Apple Blossom and Lychee. To finish, the fragrance settles on a warm Plum and Musk base to create a sophisticated but not too serious olfactory experience. Housed in a daisy topped bottle for a signature finish. Top Notes: Ruby Red Grapefruit, Raspberry, Green Leaves, Pear. Heart Notes: Violet, Wild Rose, Apple Blossom, Lychee, Jasmine Petals. Base Notes: Musks, Plum, Cedarwood.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Eau So Fresh Eau de Toilette 125ml

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Step into a dewy summer’s day with the Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Eau de Parfum . This floral aquatic opens with notes of Lotus, Freesia and Rose, evoking the image of luscious blooms embellished with raindrops. A heart of Lily and Osmanthus adds a unique fresh twist to the fragrance, creating an outdoorsy wanderlust appeal. The sun-drenched florals emit a clean and enveloping scent. A base of Sandalwood Cedar and Ambrette creates a sensual warmth, like summers spent in a lakeside log cabin.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: L'Eau d'Issey Eau de Toilette was Issey Miyake’s first venture into the world of perfumery. The Japanese designer was influenced by a blend of both artistic and natural elements, with his debut scent evoking the image of water on a woman’s skin. Embark on a luminous scent trail of wanderlust and adventure with this delightfully fresh fragrance, composed of delicate flowers, combined with Rose and Lotus. The dewy fragrance was created to evoke the smell springtime flowers, showered in waterfall spray in a rich forest. The Eau de Toilette features a heart of Lily to create a clean, white scent while a base of precious woods adds an earthy warmth to this aquatic floral fragrance. Perfect for both day and night-time wear, this radiant scent will transport your senses to a luscious paradise. The fragrance is housed in an elegant glass flacon, inspired by a view from Mikaye’s apartment depicting the moon suspended over the Eiffel tower.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 125ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Yuzu. Heart Notes: Cinnamon, Nutmeg. Base Notes: Sandalwood. Bask in the glory of sophistication and class with Issey Miyake L’Eau d’Issey Pour Homme Eau de Toilette. Opening notes of sharp Yuzu illuminate alongside spicy Coriander to capture the illusion of a pure, piquant paradise. Accentuating poise and prestige, sweet Cinnamon bridges the gap between fresh citrusy notes and dark, heady accords as it paves the way for the deep, passionate tones awaiting beneath. An alluring blend of subtle spices lends a sensual, spirited element to the luxurious sillage. Aromatic Nutmeg and Saffron simmer and sparkle at the heart of the smooth, seductive fragrance, dispersing to reveal warm, smouldering notes of Musk and Sandalwood below. Fusing light and heavy aromas, the cologne is enigmatic, elegant and modest.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Bottled Night Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Powerful, spicy and exotic, Hugo Boss BOSS Bottled Night Eau de Toilette will become the secret weapon in every man's arsenal of seduction. Intense and seductive, the compelling EDT pairs elegance with edgy, masculine character. Woody notes feature heavily, creating a deeply seductive and alluring fragrance. Birch Leaf and Cardamom combine before settling on a warm base of rich Louro Amarelo.   Top Notes: Birch Leaf. Heart Notes: Cardamom. Base Notes: Louro Amarelo Wood, Musky.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Y Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Intertwining light and dark fougère facets, Y Eau de Parfum is an expression of sensuality, sophistication and strength, echoing the multifaceted personality of the YSL man. This fragrance opens with a burst of powerful freshness, emanating from bergamot, ginger and juicy green apple. A heart of sage and juniper brings a masculine contrast to the elegance of geranium absolute and lavender, the two notes emblematic of the bold Y olfactive signature. In the base, a mysterious blend of sensual wood, frankincense and warm tonka bean creates a sensual warmth, intensified by smokey vetiver. Dare to follow your passions and create your own success with Y Eau de Parfum. Created by master perfumer Dominique Ropion, the Y fragrance is encased in a sleek, modern design, featuring an ombre hue that transitions from dark to light blue.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana The Only One Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Encased within a sleek, glass flacon with new squared, graphic lines and a weighty, transparent base, Dolce & Gabbana’s newest fragrance for women, The Only One Eau de Parfum , encapsulates the essence of sophisticated and hypnotising femininity. Enticing and radiant, with a surprising melange of opposites, the enchanting floral perfume unleashes notes of Violet, combined with subtle touches of zingy Bergamot to create a lively and juicy bouquet with a magnetic pull that beckons the senses. At the heart, seductive notes of rich Coffee are blended with charming Iris. The warm base of Vanilla and Patchouli lends a tactile, comforting quality, enveloping the senses in an opulent embrace. Top Notes: Violet, Bergamot. Heart Notes: Coffee, Iris. Base Notes: Vanilla, Patchouli.

listings.description: Discover Dolce & Gabbana Pour Homme Intenso Eau de Parfum ; a woody aromatic fragrance defined by a new discovery in the olfactory world: the Moepel accord. The Moepel (Milkwood) is a South African tree with a unique odour obtained using Headspace technology, which captures the floral, balsamic and rich honey accents of the flowers and leaves. Fresh notes of Basil and Geranium are enhanced by aromatic Lavender and striking Tobacco, before finishing on a rich, warm base. The fragrance opens with bright fruity notes of Water Melon, Acai Tea and Pear Infusion, creating an exhilarating freshness. The composition reveals a bouquet of florals including Jasmine Absolute, Wild Tuberose and Dewy Honeysuckle. listings.rawTitle: I Love Juicy Couture Eau de Parfum - 50ml
listings.description: Notes: Red Currant, Red Apple, Patchouli, Mandarin Orange, Musk, Lily, Amber, Honeysuckle and Jasmine. Adorn yourself in the sumptuously fruity fragrance notes of I Love Juicy Couture Eau de Parfum. Conforming to the fun-loving, cutting-edge ideology of the brand, the perfume is bursting with refreshingly playful scents that linger in the air and on the skin. Sharp, juicy Red Currant dances joyously with Red Apple, Patchouli and invigorating Mandarin Orange, evoking visions of lively, colourful gardens brimming with fruit trees. Daring and adventurous, the fragrance encourages you to embrace your impulsive, adventurous side, tempting you to give into your wanderlust and explore. The fragrance melts into a smooth, rich blend of creamy Musk, powdery Lily and opulent Amber, exuding confidence and empowerment. Unapologetic and hard to ignore, the dominant aromas contrast pleasantly with the fruity scents, creating an enticing juxtaposition that reminds you of the exciting, hypnotic layers that make up the modern human.   Culminating with delicate Honeysuckle and Jasmine, the elaborate blend is destined to allow you to make a memorable statement wherever you go. The fragrance bottle radiates the spirited, mischievous principles that the brand is known for, allowing it to be an eye-catching element of any room.

listings.description: Fruity Floral Top Notes: Raspberry, Pomelo, Passion Fruit. Heart Notes: Gardenia, Heliotrope, Rose de Mai, Sweet Pea. Base Notes: Musk, Cashmere Woods, Candied Amber. A fragrance that shines with unpredictability, this Juicy Couture eau de parfum combines a selection of luxurious scents for a truly enigmatic sillage. Sharp, refreshing top notes create a burst of clarity that scatters into perplexing layers of deep allure. Take a bite of the ripest fruit with the crisp opening of Raspberry and Passion Fruit. The delectable duo presents a tangy yet inviting sweetness, luring in the senses with its air of succulence. A private floral garden thrives from within: Gardenia, Heliotrope and Sweet Pea form a tangled trellis to thrill and intoxicate. At the base waits the bolder, warmer accords, ensuring unrivalled intensity. Musk and Cashmere Woods add instant depth for an indulgent, crackling effect. Rich Candied Amber marries the fragrance together, lending a sugary yet fiery passion to the EDP that encapsulates its core uniqueness. Housed in an elegant glass flacon, this Juicy Couture perfume is lively, seductive and always unconventional.

listings.rawTitle: Armani SI Passione Eau de Parfum - 30ml

Seductive and sleek, the Armani SI Passione Eau de Parfum is destined to add a daring element to any outfit. As bold and classic as a slick of red lipstick, the fragrance opens with fiery pink pepper and blackcurrant, evoking visions of a crisp, fruity cocktail. A beating, entrancing heart of rose and heliotrope offers a more delicate element, highlighting the vulnerability that we carry within. The amalgamation reaches its crescendo with vanilla and cedarwood, rounding off the blend in a powerful, dominant manner. Encased in a striking, blood-red bottle.

A heart of Red Apple and Dried Fruits creates a crisp, lightly spiced appeal with a bouquet of Rose, Geranium and Oakmoss. listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Fever Eau de Parfum 60ml
listings.description: Floral Gourmand Top Notes:  Black Plum Nectar. Heart Notes:  Heliotrope. Base Notes:  Tonka Bean, Benzoin, Sandalwood. Celebrate the glamourous yet mysterious aura of the Jimmy Choo woman with the  Jimmy Choo Fever Eau de Parfum . This alluring scent invites intrigue under the cover of darkness to hypnotise the senses. The sweet Toffee scent of the original EDP has been replaced by deeper Plum Nectar top notes to create a seductive and sophisticated appeal that’s perfect for a night out. A luxurious heart of purple Heliotrope exudes delectable undertones of cherry, vanilla and almond to sweeten a sultry, yet elegant base of Tonka Bean, Benzoin and Sandalwood. Captivating the true aura of luxury, this glamourous scent exudes a confident sensuality. The jewel-like magenta flacon is faceted to resemble the Venetian Murano chandeliers of the brand’s boutiques and is housed in a metallic satin-like python-print box, synonymous with the brand’s shoes and accessories.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Illicit Flower Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Showcasing its twist on classic floral scents, Jimmy Choo presents the Illicit Flower Eau de Toilette, a graceful, yet rule-bending fragrance for the free-spirited. Fresh facets of sparkling apricot and exhilarating mandarin zest awaken the senses with an invigorating, appealing air to introduce the olfactive adventure. Paired with a soft freesia, rose and jasmine heart, the eau de parfum weaves the nuances of elegant flowers with juicy fruits to strike the perfect balance between delicacy and vibrancy. Sandalwood and sensual musk add a creamy charm, closing the fragrance with a warm, long-lasting trail.

listings.rawTitle: Coach Men's Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Citrus, Pear Heart Notes: Cardamom, Coriander Base Notes: Vetiver, Suede, Ambergris Inspired by mavericks, rebels and radicals, the Men's Eau de Toilette from Coach takes you from the straight and narrow and onto the complex and twisted. Hop upon this train and dive into the gold of the Great Train Robbery, exhilarated by the fresh opening notes of Citrus and Pear. Things heat up as the spicy aroma of Cardamom creeps into the fragrance, and the Police quietly approach. Shots ring out, but you’re already well away, with the fresh, citrus scent of Coriander charging you into a sprint, as you succeed in your great escape. Finally, falling into the warm and comforting musks of Vetiver and Suede, you realise the chase is over. A cheer breaks out amongst your bandits, throwing gold into the air as laughter rings in the alley.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Black Orchid Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: A sultry fantasy, inspired by the rarest of flowers. Tom Ford’s Black Orchid Eau de Parfum Spray laces dark and tempting accords together in a spiced floral fusion, with hints of the extraordinary orchid seeping through. Toasted black truffle collides with sparkling bergamot in an unsuspecting opening, while black orchid and plum mingle in the heart of the fragrance, emboldening the sensual composition. Patchouli grounds the parfum spray with a sweet musky aroma that will only leave you craving more. Housed in a fluted, black glass bottle that is a streamlined, modern interpretation of 1920s and 1930s architecture. The dark paradisial eau de parfum is a timeless fragrance and a homage to daring glamour and iconic style.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Noir Extreme Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Alluring and amber-drenched, the Tom Ford Noir Extreme Eau de Parfum is a must-have for those partial to woody accords. The scent opens with a citrusy spritz of mandarin oil and cardamom, coating your skin in zesty sweetness. This is closely followed by the creaminess of an Indian kulfi heart, combined with orange blossom, jasmine, and rose to lighten and brighten the fragrance. The dry-down settles into a warm base of amber and sandalwood, where you’ll be able to pick up sweet flecks of vanilla.

listings.description: A dark and sultry dream by Tom Ford. The Noir Eau de Parfum encapsulates the duality of feminine-masculine dynamism, where rich feminine florals mingle with a masculine earthiness for a fascinating, gourmand fragrance. Evoking the twin facets of the Tom Ford man, the eau de parfum emits a sophisticated, yet sexy scent. Patchouli and oud wood awaken an animalistic sensuality, delving deeper into the hidden chambers of the fragrance. listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Grey Vetiver Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Tap into your dynamic side with Tom Ford’s Grey Vetiver Eau de Parfum, a woody-spicy elixir that elevates any scent collection. Said to be worn by Hugh Jackman, the fragrance embodies what the designer calls the essence of debonair, charismatic, and provocative masculinity. Vetiver makes up its core, that textured, earthy treasure revered by master perfumers for centuries. In Ford’s hands, this note is remixed and reborn: sharpened by crisp citrus and livened up by colourful nuances. Orange flower and grapefruit introduce an invigorating brightness, while nutmeg and pimento weave a subtle, seductive spice. Woody oakmoss adds a grounding element to the scent pyramid, forging a depth that lingers when you exit the room. The fragrance is housed in a clean, minimalist bottle with matte silver-tone accents and a debossed logo.

Topped with white moss, the decadent fragrance ends with an earthy, grounding finish.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Ombre Leather Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Embodying vast landscapes and sensual heat, Ombré Leather Eau de Parfum from Tom Ford is an androgynous floral-leather fragrance that guides the senses along the path to self-discovery. Rich and spicy warm notes of cardamom and black leather deliver a raw and passionate sensorial experience, reminiscent of the wild west. Unexpected notes of white floral and jasmine sambac caress the senses in a comforting sweetness, inviting you to embrace the open road ahead. Capturing the essence of adventuring into the unknown, the signature scent recalls humble beginnings and simple pleasures.

listings.rawTitle: Armani Stronger With You Intensely Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: Powered by passion, the Armani Stronger with You Intensely Eau de Parfum Pour Homme pushes the boundaries of woody-amber scents in this addictive, concentrated blend. Playing on the contrast between spices and fresh florals in the opening, the fragrance stars pink pepper and lavender notes to capture the olfactive attention. Rich in chestnut accord and sage for depth, the eau de parfum creates a smooth, sensuous sillage on the skin, before giving way to a warm, confident base of amberwood and vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Tiffany & Co. Eau de Parfum for Her 30ml
listings.description: Floral - Musk  Top Note: Vert de Mandarine. Heart Note: Iris. Base Notes: Patchouli, Musk. Capture the luxury, glamour and romance of New York City with the Tiffany & Co. Eau de Parfum . The premier jeweller’s signature scent is a radiant, modern fragrance for the true city girl. Opening with vibrant top notes of Vert de Mandarine, the scent descends into a precious heart of Iris that exudes strength, refinement and sophistication. The elegant fragrance dries down to a sensual finish on the skin with warm nuances of Patchouli wrapped in gentle Musky notes. Sensual and radiant, the sparkling fragrance evokes the magical feeling of diamonds on bare skin. Master Perfumer Daniela Andrier was inspired by her love for gemstones and jewellery to create this contemporary take on the most precious ingredients of traditional haute perfumery. This feminine floral musk fragrance is designed around the noble Iris, a flower long associated with Tiffany as a recurring motif in its jewellery designs. Housed in a crystal bottle inspired by the Tiffany Lucida® and Tiffany Yellow Diamond cuts, the fragrance features a subtle blue tint to illuminate the precise cuts of the bottle and create a diamond-like finish. The neck of the bottle features the Tiffany’s logo and opulent silver detailing. Presented in the signature Tiffany Blue Box®, an internationally recognised symbol of style and sophistication.

listings.description: Miu Miu's L’Eau de Muguet Eau de Parfum is a sparkling floral fragrance that delivers a playful olfactory experience. Offering a contemporary take on the delicate woodland flower lily of the valley, perfumer Daniela Andrier takes inspiration from Miuccia Prada's vision to create an iconic, sensual fragrance. With soft damask rose, the French EDP plays with subtle florals but is built upon a deep, woody and peppery base – creating a vibrant yet natural blend that evokes life. Soft blue-pillowed opaque glass (reminiscent of Miu Miu's signature matelassé) contrasts with a translucent red disk to lend the flacon a graphic quality. The warm tone complements the cool of the bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Bvlgari Eau Parfumée Thé Impérial Eau de Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Created in 2017 by Master Perfumer Jacques Cavallier, the olfactory signature of Bvlgari Hotels & Resorts was originally composed exclusively for the discerning guests of these icons of Italian elegance. In 2026, in tribute to this storied legacy, Eau Parfumée Thé Impérial takes its rightful place within the Eau Parfumée collection. Beloved by travellers from around the world, this signature scent now steps beyond the hotel experience, deepening Bvlgari’s signature olfactory artistry—an inspired vision of nature as an endless source of emotion and refinement. Eau Parfumée Thé Impérial draws its captivating name from an era when empires flourished through the exchange of rare treasures. Tea and citrus—once reserved for royalty and the elite—stood as emblems of prestige and cultural connection. In China, tea blossomed as a sophisticated ritual and symbol of enlightenment, while in Rome, citrus fruits represented radiance and prosperity, adorning imperial banquets and gardens. The word “Impérial” embodies the harmony of these two grand traditions—East and West—reflecting the fragrance’s power to transport the wearer to a world of emperors, opulent courts, and the timeless allure of these prized ingredients. In Eau Parfumée Thé Impérial, radiant accords of Sri Lankan Black Tea intertwine with the sparkling notes of Italian citrus, unveiling a bright and refined Citrus Musk composition. Inspired by the majestic grace of ancient Roman columns, its design is elevated by the iconic glass décolleté – an emblem of sensory indulgence as personal and opulent as fine jewellery. The cap features the distinctive BVLGARI BVLGARI round insignia inspired by the artistry of ancient Roman coins. It features a crackled golden inlay, echoing the refined tradition of celadon ceramics, originating in China a thousand years ago. The flacon unveils a luminous harmony of orange tones, radiating gently as though illuminated from within. This vibrant, uplifting hue conjures images of tea leaves kissed by golden sunlight and citrus fruits ripening in a sun-drenched garden, introducing a fresh colour story to the Eau Parfumée collection.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Devotion For Men Parfum 100ml
listings.description: An Italian olfactive icon, the Dolce&Gabbana Devotion For Men Parfum is a fougère update of the previously released eau de parfum. Intensity in a bottle, it takes cues from Milanese modernity and Sicilian tradition. Updated with lavender in place of lemon, the fragrance opens with the same Mediterranean essence but with an immediately camphorous note. This overture is layered with the essence of roasted coffee beans just beneath, conjuring a morning spent with an espresso cradled in-hand, walking through a lively marketplace. Earthy patchouli anchors everything in the pyramid's base, grounding the scent with integrity. It's housed in a heart-embossed bottle in ode to the beloved original.

listings.rawTitle: Aramis Intuition Eau de Parfum Travel Gift Set
listings.description: Elevate your scent profile with Estée Lauder's Aramis Intuition Eau de Parfum Travel Gift Set, a sophisticated cologne in two formats with a warm, seductive bouquet. First conceived back in 1964 by Bernard Chant, the fragrance was inspired by the classic chypre structure: a combination of fresh, citrusy top notes with a rich, woody base. This breakthrough olfactory mix has cemented itself as a staple in grooming routines, and is updated here with a modern, lavender-topped flourish. Retaining the exclusive Leathery Cuirissima LXR essence, it's cut through with notes of grapefruit, orris and patchouli – adding a punchy drive to the grounded aroma. Conjuring images of New York City, the scent is associated with the dynamic, forthright energy of the metropolis. Set Contents: Aramis Intuition Eau de Parfum 100ml Aramis Intuition Eau de Parfum 10ml

listings.rawTitle: Balmain Cuir Élysées Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: It doesn’t get more decadent than Balmain’s CUIR ÉLYSÉES Eau de Parfum, presented in a rosy, gold-toned bottle made for any vanity. The blend opens with a supple leather impression, lifted by wild raspberry and the soft warmth of spicy baie rose. These notes unfold into a luminous, fruity-floral heart of petalia and green jasmine, creating a vivid, textured bouquet. As it settles, the fragrance melts into a creamy trail of sandalwood, imparting a smooth, lasting scent on the skin. The bottle itself dazzles in a rosy metallic shade, complete with gold-toned accents for a truly elevated touch.

listings.rawTitle: Balmain Rouge Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: A balmy, floral scent, Balmain Rouge Eau de Parfum captures the warmth of golden-hour florals. Opening with the creamy elegance of lily and magnolia flower, the fragrance is softened by botanical iris and osmanthus, lending a delicate nectar-like sweetness with subtle fruity nuances. As the scent evolves, ylang ylang brings a solar warmth to the composition, while georgywood creates a smooth, woody base that lingers on the skin. Vibrant yet sophisticated, the eau de parfum balances floral luminosity with comforting depth, leaving a memorable impression.

listings.rawTitle: Balmain Blanc Galaxie Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Unveil a fragrance where fresh citrus notes, ranging from Buddha’s hand to cédrat, melt into a graceful magnolia heart with Balmain BLANC GALAXIE. Luminous and quietly energising, the scent opens with a refreshing brightness that gradually softens into smooth floral warmth, wrapped in the delicate spice of cardamom. As it settles, the composition deepens into a long-lasting fusion of musky patchouli, creating a finish that feels both earthy and ethereal. The result is a grounded, serene glow that lingers beautifully on the skin.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Fico Di Amalfi Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: A limited-edition Fico Di Amalfi Eau de Toilette, featuring patterns by Laura Gonzalez as part of the La Caletta summer collection, this fragrance celebrates the art of independence and authenticity. Sea blue-hued, it blend captures the invigorating energy of its coastal namesake. A radiant burst of Italian lemon, Calabrian bergamot and grapefruit opens the trail with olfactive vitality, before a sun-warmed heart of fig and jasmine balances the citrus brightness with gentle floral freshness. As it dries, the woody-green base formed by a trifecta of woody notes closes the aroma with a serene flourish.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Bergamotto La Spugnatura Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Acqua Di Parma’s limited-edition Bergamotto La Spugnatura Eau de Parfum is a radiant citrus scent inspired by La Caletta, an ode to independence and finding your own rhythm. Crafted from the centuries-old extraction technique La Spugnatura, this authentic, instantly recognisable aroma features manually obtained bergamot essence to preserve its vibrance and natural strength. Paired with green and floral accents, plus a sun-warmed dry down of woods, the blend balances soft depth with characterful warmth, capturing the charm of Mediterranean days.

listings.rawTitle: Perroy Mahogany Sun Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Capturing sunshine in a bottle, Perroy's Mahogany Sun Eau de Parfum caresses the skin with gourmand, sun-kissed aromas. Floral top notes of frangipani flower bloom into a heart of sweet fig, before melting into an indulgent base of smooth vanilla. Scented to match your mood, each spritz leaves you reminiscing of vanilla ice cream on a sun-drenched beach.

listings.rawTitle: Perroy Gold Fawn Eau de Parfum 15ml
listings.description: Like the first sips of a comforting caramel macchiato, Perroy’s Gold Fawn Eau de Parfum combines the sweetness of vanilla with the warmth of creamy woods. Indulgent yet refined, this grown-up gourmand plays on its amber notes, pairing them with sophisticated spices for an unforgettable trail. In the dry down, smooth sandalwood and cedar dance on the skin with a mesmeric finish, lingering with powerful projection.

listings.rawTitle: Perroy White Denim Eau de Parfum 15ml
listings.description: Capturing the feeling of endless summer, Perroy's White Denim Eau de Parfum balances airy freshness with comforting warmth. Opening with a soft, creamy character, the scent develops into a distinctive salty heart that evokes sun-warmed skin and ocean air. As it settles, woody notes bring depth and texture to the composition, while musky and vanilla-infused facets leave a smooth, lingering trail. Fresh yet enveloping, the fragrance strikes a harmonious contrast between lightness and intensity, creating a scent that feels effortlessly modern.

listings.rawTitle: Perroy Ivory Sky Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Summon calm and confidence in every spritz of Perroy’s Ivory Sky Eau de Parfum. Office‑friendly and ideal for every day, the fragrance serves as an olfactory breath of fresh air with a sensual, woody twist. Featuring bergamot, sandalwood and vetiver, the scent surrounds you in a feeling of quiet clarity - bright citrus softening into smooth, creamy woods, tempered by a clean, earthy depth. A subtle touch of vanilla warms the composition, lingering close to the skin for an intimate finish. Think: a pure sky’s light over the city skyline, swirled together with a complex note or two.

listings.rawTitle: Perroy Pink Fire Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: An olfactory exploration to match your mood, Perroy's Pink Fire Eau de Parfum is an explosive elixir of dangerous fruits and provocative woods. Opening with the juicy, vibrant sweetness of pomegranate and raspberry, the fragrance instantly captures attention. As it evolves, the radiant warmth of amber woods unfolds, smouldering with intensity and sensuality.

listings.rawTitle: Perroy Tangerine Pearl Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: The Perroy Tangerine Pearl Eau de Parfum 100ml opens with a rush of citrus, instantly uplifting and full of energy. Pomelo leads with a crisp, juicy edge, softened by a hint of ginger that adds warming nuances. As it settles, iris brings a smooth, slightly powdery finish that feels clean and refreshing. The scent flows effortlessly from day to evening, leaving a light, radiant trail.

listings.rawTitle: Perroy Ivory Sky Eau de Parfum 50ml

listings.rawTitle: Perroy Blonde Purple Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: A fruity bouquet to behold, the Perroy Blonde Purple Eau de Parfum brings a profound sense of joy to your scent wardrobe. Sunny from the first spritz, the fragrance opens with luscious mango, its juicy sweetness instantly uplifting and vibrant. This tropical brightness is sharpened by blackcurrant, whose tangy, slightly green nuances introduce contrast and intrigue, preventing the fruitiness from ever feeling heavy or saccharine. Ylang‑ylang blooms in the centre, softening the fruit with its banana‑like, custardy floral facets. Creamy and exotic, the floral note echoes the tropical warmth of the mango while gently rounding the sharp edges of blackcurrant, bringing balance and harmony to the mood-boosting pyramid. The result is a seamless transition from bright, juicy freshness into a petal‑soft trail.

listings.rawTitle: Perroy Azure Blush Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: A fruity-floral blend by Perroy, Azure Blush Eau de Parfum captures the vibrancy of tangy candied delights. Bright and bold, this full-of-character fragrance opens with juicy litchi, before a hint of tart rhubarb sharpens the senses. To balance, soft peony mingles with a candy accord, reminiscing upon tuck shop treats of the past and present. Simply spritz across the skin for a boost of olfactive charm.

listings.rawTitle: Perroy Blue Forest Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: A love letter to the wilderness, Perroy's Blue Forest Eau de Parfum is a fresh, woody fragrance that captures the quiet power of nature at dawn. At first spritz, cracked black pepper cuts through the air with an aromatic bite, conjuring the cool clarity of early morning among towering trees. Next, the scent skews woody with a layer of warm cedar, adding resinous texture that reveals itself gradually as the scent wears on. Musks hover over the skin for hours thanks to their inclusion in the base, anchoring the fresh fragrance with a soft, sensual finish.
