listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD White Suede Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: TOM FORD's White Suede Eau de Parfum opens with an intriguing blend of saffron and thyme, where warm spice meets aromatic freshness for a captivating introduction. A subtle infusion of mate adds a green, slightly smoky nuance, bringing depth and modernity. At its heart, supple white leather and soft suede unfold, creating a smooth, enveloping texture that feels both refined and sensual. As it lingers, olibanum and musk leave a warm, skin-like trail.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Vanilla Sex Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Looking for an elevated vanilla scent? This TOM FORD Vanilla Sex Eau de Parfum isn't your typical gourmand, layered with an inimitable blend of notes to distinguish your every entrance. On the first spritz, a velvety ribbon of vanilla tincture from India comes through, complemented by a comforting layer of vanilla absolute. As the fragrance settles, sandalwood essence glides in like polished mahogany, adding a quietly powerful dimension to the pyramid: picture a dimly lit room filled with antique wood and gently flickering shadows. True to the label's signature edge, an animalis accord in the base disrupts the softness of vanilla, leaving behind a complex, musky trail that naturally turns heads. Encased in a gold-tone flacon, the bottle itself is a statement of luxury. It's framed by a sleek clear border and finished with signature branding.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Bois Marocain Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: The TOM FORD Bois Marocain Eau de Parfum opens with a vibrant blend of pink peppercorn and juniper, delivering a crisp, aromatic freshness. As the scent develops, notes of thuya essence and Atlas cedarwood bring a warm, textured depth inspired by sun-warmed forests. Grounded by vetiver, the fragrance settles into an earthy, smoky base that adds a smooth, lasting warmth with a refined, understated character.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Figue Érotique Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Balancing freshness with depth, the TOM FORD Figue Érotique Eau de Parfum showcases the irresistible pull of fig in its fully ripened form. Capturing the nectarous allure of the fruit, the fragrance explores green-floral facets that pair perfectly with Kadota fig accord. Bergamot and ylang ylang brighten the composition with sparkling citrus nuances, before honeyed muscovado, fig leaf and rich vetiver add a refined, resinous edge. Together, the exquisite blend oozes sensual elegance, striking the senses with a truly unique trail.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD White Suede Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: TOM FORD's White Suede Eau de Parfum envelops the senses in a refined blend of soft leather and suede. The fragrance opens with an aromatic fusion of saffron, thyme and mate, where subtle spice meets a fresh herbal edge. At the heart, a smooth accord of white leather and suede creates a soft yet sophisticated depth with a gentle strength. As it settles, frankincense brings a warm, slightly smoky finish, leaving an elegant, long-lasting trail on the skin.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Cherry Smoke Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Dare to take a bite? The TOM FORD Cherry Smoke Eau de Parfum lures the senses like a siren call with multi-facets of fruity, florals and leather. Tempting with an illusion of simplicity, a bouquet of osmanthus and saffron romances the senses alongside sweet, juicy apricot before revealing its dark side. Dark cherry seduces the aroma, taking over with its all-consuming fiery edge, further ignited by soldering smoked woods and seductive balsam.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Rose d'Amalfi Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: The TOM FORD Rose d'Amalfi Eau de Parfum captures a fresh, luminous elegance inspired by the Amalfi Coast. Opening with a rich rose-on-rose accord, the fragrance reveals the depth of exclusive Rose Neoabsolute. As it develops, Italian bergamot adds a sparkling citrus lift, balanced by the soft floral nuance of Rosyfolia rose. A warm base of Peru balsam and heliotrope lends a subtly sweet finish.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Azure Lime Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Capturing the relaxed charm of the Mediterranean, TOM FORD’s Azure Lime Eau de Parfum is an elegant citrus chypre fragrance. Evolving with sparkling sophistication, this eau de parfum opens with bright lime water infusion, underpinned by a fresh, slightly fruity South African buchu note to evoke blue skies over crystalline pools through scent. Warmed by Australian sandalwood, the cologne offers a layered, multi-dimensional trail that lingers on the skin long after first spritzing.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Vanille Fatale Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Rich and bold, Tom Ford’s Vanille Fatale Eau de Parfum captures a medley of smoky-sweet notes. It opens with the striking contrast of Safraleine™, a warm, leathery saffron spice, and Frangipani Scenttrek, a creamy floral accord, before unfolding into a heart of coffee absolute and mahogany wood. The scent deepens into a rich base of roasted barley orpur and vanilla resinoid, leaving behind a warm, enveloping trail. Encased in a chocolate-brown glass bottle inspired by a chess piece, it makes a sleek, refined addition to any fragrance collection.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Santal Blush Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Spritz on second skin-like warmth with the TOM FORD Santal Blush Eau de Parfum. Celebrating the diversity of sandalwood, this eau de parfum enhances its creamy undertones with exotic spices to curate a hypnotic trail. Cinnamon oil, carrot seed oil, benzoin and Sri Lanka Orpur® unite to add heady sensuality, as ylang ylang softens with an airy, uplifting edge. Rich, softly spiced and subtly floral, this woody cologne is sure to take centre stage as your next scent obsession.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Rose Exposed Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: A rose by any other name would smell so seductive with the TOM FORD Rose Exposed Eau de Parfum. The fragrance combines precious florals with leather accords to redefine rose as you know it. An exclusive exploration of rose-on-rose, rose absolute and rose water extract create a spellbinding bouquet, exuding the beauty of romance. Disturbed by white pepper and woods, the scent takes an unexpected twist with a coating of supple leather. Skin-like musk grounds the aroma with an elevated finish.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Electric Cherry Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: The TOM FORD Electric Cherry Eau de Parfum is far from sugary-sweet. Instead, it delivers a vibrant, energising scent that blends bold florals with sharp, juicy notes for a fragrance that instantly enlivens the senses. At its heart, rich morello cherry steps into the spotlight, lifted by the fiery kick of ginger extract. Jasmine sambac adds a lush, seductive floral layer, while ambrettolide brings a soft, musky warmth that lingers on the skin. Pink peppercorn introduces a spark of spice, balanced by the creamy smoothness of pistachio extract. The result is a daring, sensual fragrance with undeniable femme-fatale energy.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Taormina Orange Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Inspired by Sicily’s radiant coastline, TOM FORD's Taormina Orange Eau de Parfum brings a citrus breath of fresh air to your fragrance rotation. Spicy-bright in character, blood orange and cardamom oil open the scent for a bold first impression. As the minutes pass, an orange blossom accord gently softens the trail, reminiscent of Taormina’s idyllic, petal-laden hilltop. You'll detect essences of patchouli and oakmoss in the dry-down, chosen for their earthy-green allure. The final impression is undeniably alfresco, like an Ionian wind drifting through citrus groves.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Myrrhe Mystère Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Darkness and decadence bottled, indulge in the seductive sillage of TOM FORD’s Myrrhe Mystère Eau de Parfum. A rich myrrh duo kicks off the fragrance, gesturing immediately towards intensity. Coming next is a cut of absinthe essence, producing an aromatic greenness that snaps the composition into vivid focus. With time, the fragrance eases into a softer heart – sandalwood lays down a milky foundation, while jasmine lends a gentle floral lift. The dry-down reveals smoky wisps of black leather and absinthe, warmed by TOM FORD’s signature Ultra-Vanille accord.

The eau de parfum moves between fresh and earthy, keeping it interesting from first spritz to dry down.

Leading with tonic-like essences of mandarin and lemon, the exotic elixir marks your entrance into any room with zesty sharpness, recalling colourful market stalls and lemon farms further inland. Beneath the top layer, sprigs of basil and spearmint lend a culinary edge to the citrus brights, adding a herbaceous quality to the escapist aroma. Deepening this texture in the base is a spicy-green accord of shiso leaf, softened by jasmine petals.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN L'Homme Idéal - Eau De Toilette Gift Set
listings.description: For Father’s Day, offer him a gift set with the sensuality and mystery of L’Homme Idéal. Set Contents: L’Homme Idéal Eau de Toilette 100ml The signature almond. An almond that runs through the whole fragrance from the top to the base notes. Illuminated by citrus, rosemary and orange blossom, almond reveals its sensuality in the power of a woody fragrance with leathery accents, blending vetiver and cedar. L’Homme Idéal Shower Gel 75ml With its creamy texture, it leaves skin feeling soft and gives it the inimitable scent of L’Homme Idéal.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy L'Interdit Eau De Parfum Concrete 2.7g
listings.description: A swipe-on rendition of Givenchy’s L'Interdit Eau De Parfum that captures the floral-woody signature of the scent. Inspired by a white flower bouquet, this perfume solid stars notes of orange blossom and tuberose absolute, contrasted against the woody elegance of vetiver. Developed with a melt-in texture that simultaneously hydrates the skin with wear, it lends enhanced fragrance longevity, layering seamlessly with your favourite spray or worn alone for a skin-close scent. Keeping it couture, this travel-friendly stick arrives in the brand’s signature 4G embossed packaging for a touch of luxury.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentleman Society Eau De Parfum 60ml + Travel Size 12.5ml
listings.description: The Givenchy Gentleman Society Eau de Parfum gift set combines the house's iconic scent with a refillable travel spray for effortless wear. Inspired by contrasts, the fragrance combines vibrant aromatics with earthy woods to create a scent that feels both polished and unexpected. An uplifting blend of sage and cardamom introduces the composition, bringing a fresh, herbaceous energy to the opening. At the heart, narcissus absolute lends a floral nuance, while a blend of vetivers from across the globe creates depth, texture and character. Lingering on the skin with a warm, woody finish, the fragrance offers a distinctive olfactive signature designed for every occasion. Set Contents: Givenchy Gentleman Society Eau De Parfum 60ml Givenchy Gentleman Society Eau De Parfum Travel Size 12.5ml

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Lost Eden Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Delve into the world of REPLICA Fantasies, a collection of fragrances from Maison Margiela where surreal ingredients from the imagination of master perfumers offer a new olfactory experience. REPLICA Lost Eden Eau de Parfum is centred around a forbidden fruit accord, created by Master Perfumer Honorine Blanc. Capturing the heart of an imaginary garden, the fragrance opens with juicy red apple, warmed by rich vanilla before deepening into a base of smoky oud for mysterious dimension.

listings.rawTitle: YSL Black Opium Pink Glaze Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: An icon reimagined, YSL's Black Opium Pink Glaze Eau de Parfum turns the signature scent pink with a juicy strawberry addiction. The classic coffee-floral fragrance has been reinterpreted with a 100% naturally extracted strawberry note. It effortlessly melts into head-turning jasmine, before black coffee and amber woods add sensual warmth. The bottle takes on a new shape and shade, lacquered in dark pink to contrast with the black core.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme La Vie Est Belle Very Cherry Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Lancôme’s first-ever woody cherry fragrance, La Vie Est Belle Very Cherry Eau de Parfum celebrates every facet of you through a full-bodied, bold and playful composition. An olfactory contrast of vibrant yet sophisticated aura, the fragrance blends indulgent black cherry with powdery violet leaf absolute, settled on a sensual base of oud wood. Whether for a special occasion or adding a touch of elegance to the everyday, Very Cherry offers a long-lasting scent trail designed to express, not impress. The iconic bottle silhouette is reimagined with a dark cherry gradient and shimmering cherry wings, reflecting the rich and layered creation within.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Eau de Parfum Intense 100ml
listings.description: Powerfully fresh, the Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Eau de Parfum Intense evokes the moment the sea meets the earth in a moment of elemental intensity. Reinterpreting the brand’s signature blend, this eau de parfum amplifies its sensual undertones, spotlighting aquatic-fresh notes and warm woods. Providing a ray of vibrancy, juicy bergamot captivates before an amber dry down lingers with depth to deliver an enduring sillage. Adding to its magnetic allure, the fragrance arrives in a lacquered black flacon to reflect the heady elixir inside.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradigme Le Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Prada Paradigme Le Parfum is a fresh yet comforting fragrance that balances luminous freshness with warm woody depth. From the first spritz, geranium brings a crisp, slightly green floral lift, creating a clean, refined opening. As the fragrance unfolds, creamy vanilla softens the composition with a smooth, comforting warmth before settling into a rich amber base that lingers like a second skin. Elegant, understated and effortlessly modern, the scent is perfect for everyday wear, while the sleek, minimalist bottle reflects its timeless sophistication.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Vendetta Uomo Eau De Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Valentino's VENDETTA Uomo Eau de Parfum is a spicy fragrance that balances invigorating freshness with rich, warming depth. It opens with the zesty brightness of fresh ginger, creating an energetic first impression that feels both uplifting and refined. As the fragrance develops, aromatic cinnamon introduces a warm, spicy heart, adding comforting richness before patchouli settles into the base with an earthy, woody depth. Bold yet sophisticated, the scent is perfect for evening occasions, cooler days or whenever you want to leave a confident, lasting impression.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradoxe Sweet Chemistry Eau De Parfum 100ml Refill
listings.description: A signature scent reimagined, Prada Paradoxe Sweet Chemistry is a fruity floral fragrance that balances sweetness with sharpness. The composition opens with a juicy blackcurrant syrup accord, melting into a radiant orange blossom heart before settling on a creamy base of neroli milk for a modern trail. Available as a refill, the perfume celebrates an ever-evolving, multifaceted femininity.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Vendetta Donna Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Meet the VENDETTA Donna Eau de Parfum, a floral gourmand and woody signature for women by Valentino. Designed for the confident and bold woman, the fragrance blends solar tuberose, a vibrant, liqueur-like red orange nectar accord and enveloping woods for addictive presence. Sandalwood grounds the base with creamy sensuality. The bottle's iconic architectural glass design celebrates Valentino's timeless couture heritage.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme La Vie Est Belle Very Cherry Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Lancôme’s first-ever woody cherry fragrance, La Vie Est Belle Very Cherry Eau de Parfum celebrates every facet of you through a full-bodied, bold and playful composition. listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Ralph's Club New York Parfum 60ml
listings.description: Inspired by the magnetic energy of Manhattan’s nightlife, Ralph's Club New York Parfum by Ralph Lauren is a resinous, spicy scent with rich undertones. Addictive from the first spritz, the cologne opens with ripened blackcurrant, before revealing a smooth oud wood accord. In the base, aged cognac gives the blend its distinctive character, heady yet comforting as it lingers with long-lasting intensity on the skin.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Eau de Parfum Intense 50ml
listings.description: Powerfully fresh, the Giorgio Armani Acqua Di Gio Eau de Parfum Intense evokes the moment the sea meets the earth in a moment of elemental intensity. Reinterpreting the brand’s signature blend, this eau de parfum amplifies its sensual undertones, spotlighting aquatic-fresh notes and warm woods. Providing a ray of vibrancy, juicy bergamot captivates before an amber dry down lingers with depth to deliver an enduring sillage. Adding to its magnetic allure, the fragrance arrives in a lacquered black flacon to reflect the heady elixir inside.

listings.rawTitle: Diesel Only Desire Eau De Parfum 80ml
listings.description: Celebrating self-expression and authenticity, the Only Desire Eau De Parfum by Diesel transforms a traditional vanilla note into a symbol of contemporary fierceness. The brand’s first metallic vanilla is created with luminous aldehydes, acting as an airy nuance that lifts the amber-gourmand facets. Striking yet sumptuous, the blend settles into a creamy heart of orchid, before bourbon vanilla lends lasting intensity and warmth on the skin. Simply spritz onto the pulse points to indulge in the multi-dimensional scent as desired.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Bon Bon Cola Fizz Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Discover a playful gourmand fragrance with a sparkling twist. Viktor & Rolf's Bon Bon Cola Fizz Eau De Parfum opens with the bright zest of lemon, before fizzing into a nostalgic cola accord for a sweet, effervescent feel. As it settles, soft musk brings a smooth, skin-like warmth, balancing the juicy sweetness with clean freshness. Modern, addictive and easy to wear, it’s a vibrant everyday scent with a fun gourmand edge.

listings.rawTitle: Diesel Only Desire Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Celebrating self-expression and authenticity, the Only Desire Eau De Parfum by Diesel transforms a traditional vanilla note into a symbol of contemporary fierceness. The brand’s first metallic vanilla is created with luminous aldehydes, acting as an airy nuance that lifts the amber-gourmand facets. Striking yet sumptuous, the blend settles into a creamy heart of orchid, before bourbon vanilla lends lasting intensity and warmth on the skin. Simply spritz onto the pulse points to indulge in the multi-dimensional scent as desired.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Rose Prick Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Strike a daring balance between beauty and rebellion with the Tom Ford Rose Prick Eau de Parfum. Inspired by a garden of roses, this fragrance opens with a bouquet of Bulgarian rose and rose de mai that unfurls at its heart. Beneath patchouli exhales a woody, chypre depth, while roasted tonka bean smoulders with hints of caramel and vanilla, wrapping the scent in sensual warmth.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Orchid Eau de Parfum Intense Refill 150ml
listings.description: A nuanced floral-gourmand fragrance by Gucci, evoking a kaleidoscope of radiant notes. For a breath of fresh air, spritz on the mesmerising scent of Flora Gorgeous Orchid Eau de Parfum Intense Refill. Expertly layered and faceted, this fragrance balances the contrast between sweetness, salty luminosity and soft florals. Opening with an ozonic accord, before melting into a velvet vanilla orchid heart, the eau de parfum captures the essence of sun-kissed beach breezes. To round out the trail with depth and intensity, a dark cocoa note unveils a warm, addictive charm, lingering on the skin with lasting warmth. Housed in a golden glass flacon to reflect the hours before sunset, this fragrance adds a touch of luxury to your collection.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Pour Homme Intense Eau de Toilette 125ml
listings.description: Imbued with emotional energy, Issey Miyake L'Eau D'Issey Intense Eau de Toilette is a rumbling earthquake of awe-inspiring scent. Cracking open with a luminous fresh fountain of raw natural energy, Bergamot envelops the senses with bursts of sparkling character. Swirling with herbaceous softness, the heart is made up of softer spicy notes before Black Incense cloaks the scent in a dark smokiness. Settling deep into the earth, the fragrance’s vivacity rounds off into a solid presence.

listings.rawTitle: Miu Miu Miutine Intense Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Discover a new chapter of Miutine with the Miu Miu Miutine Intense Eau de Parfum. The bold berry floral fragrance evolves the original scent into a richer dimension with an intense blackberry nectar. The fragrance opens with vibrant top notes of blackberry accord, before unfurling a heart of gardenia and a rich base of bourbon vanilla infusion. The result is a bold, effervescent scent, perfect for seasonal styling. A tribute to Miu Miu's iconic bordeaux matelassé leather handbags, the burgundy lacquered bottle echoes the luxury and deep berry notes of the fragrance within.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Chasing Sunsets Eau de Toilette 30ml
listings.description: Capturing the essence of a tropical sunset is Maison Margiela's Chasing Sunsets Eau de Toilette. Part of the brand's REPLICA collection, designed to recollect memories and moments in time, the fragrance invites its wearer to picture Brazil's Ipanema Beach at sundown, where a symphony of golden-hour tones melts into the horizon. The woody fruity scent is built around addictively tropical mango, elevated by radiant solar white florals and warm, comforting sandalwood. Bask in the olfactory escape and imagine a moment of bliss, where the wind carries a tropical fragrance under the sun's glow.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Born in Roma Donna Intense Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Fusing Valentino’s couture elegance with a contemporary edge, the Born in Roma Donna Intense Eau de Parfum celebrates the culture of Rome at dusk, alight with a golden sunset melting across the city. An amplification of its iconic predecessor, the intense fragrance features an amber floral medley, characterised by a sensual trio of jasmine notes. This flowered heart is complemented by fresh fruits mandarin, bergamot and blackcurrant, enlivening the aroma with an uplifting zest. As the scent warms on the skin, rich nuances of benzoin resin and creamy vanilla add a magnetic, mesmeric allure, while granting longevity of wear.

listings.rawTitle: LOVENOTES by Ariana Grande Vanilla Suede Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Veiling the skin with a sensuous, delectable fragrance, Ariana Grande’s LOVENOTES Vanilla Suede Eau De Parfum devotes itself to spreading love through scent, conveying a message of appreciation and affection with every spritz. Each LOVENOTES blend is a love letter from Ariana to the world, with Vanilla Suede being her woody-musk curation dedicated exclusively to the UK. Opening with sparkling bergamot, the EDP draws in the olfactive attention with its lush allure, before notes of intimate sandalwood and rice milk melt with warm, woody passion. Emerging from the perfume’s irresistible heart, comforting vanilla bean accord enhances the creamy trail with its rich longevity, as liquid musk lends a cocooning second-skin finish.

listings.rawTitle: MUGLER Angel Nova Eau de Parfum Refill Bottle 100ml (Worth £130)
listings.description: Top Notes: Raspberry, Lychee. Heart Notes: Damask Rose. Base Notes: Akigalawood, Benzoin. Envelop yourself in the sumptuous notes of MUGLER’s Angel Nova Eau de Parfum natural spray. Sweet and delectable, the perfume opens with notes of juicy Raspberry and enticing Lychee, evoking visions of crisp, icy sorbets as you lie in a sun-kissed garden. The fragrance radiates confidence and empowerment, with notes of powdery, floral Damask Rose conjuring images of velvety petals swaying in a summer breeze. The blend takes an innovative turn with the upcycling of the Damask Rose, allowing the brand to produce a heightened, intoxicating version of the flower. This process allows the extraction of the Rose to be sustainable and eco-friendly, utilising the powers of biotechnology to create a truly original finished scent. The fragrance reaches its crescendo with Akigalawood and Benzoin, finishing the cocktail in an addictive, unignorable manner. The free-spirited, whimsical pink of the instantly-recognisable star bottle exudes power and an unapologetic sense of femininity.

listings.rawTitle: YSL MYSLF Eau de Toilette Intense 60ml
listings.description: Amp up your scent wardrobe with the YSL MYSLF Eau de Toilette, a long-lasting woody skin musk fragrance providing up to eight hours of intensity. Bold and masculine, vibrant notes of bergamot and orange blossom are intensified through woody depths and white musk for a minerally fresh second-skin sensation. Undressed for the first time, the see-through bottle unveils the intensely deep grey elixir, with a new atomiser that offers three times longer spray duration*. *compared to the existing MYSLF Eau de Parfum.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Just Perfect Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: An interpretation of the original Marc Jacobs perfume, Just Perfect Eau de Parfum celebrates being entirely and boldly yourself with a timeless signature fragrance. Bold, addictive and rebellious, the fragrance opens with a juicy burst of strawberry, passionfruit and mandarin. This is blended with sensual jasmine, creamy vanilla and sticky caramel for an irresistible edge. Housed in an iridescent, opaque glass bottle, the perfume is topped with a glittery bow and white charms - a nod to the daring, ambery fruity fragrance within.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Dylan Blue EDT 100ml Vapo
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Fougère Top Notes: Bergamot, Fig Leaves, Grapefruit. Heart Notes: Violet, Black Pepper, Ambrox, Papyrus. Base Notes: Saffron, Tonka Bean, Incense. Immerse yourself in the fresh, woody facets of Versace’s Dylan Blue Eau de Toilette. The EDT is a seductive force to admire, blended with precious natural ingredients. Characterised by high-quality musk, the fragrance is edged in carnal detail. Bergamot, fig leaves and grapefruit offer a vibrant opening, crashing into a wave of aquatic notes. Violet, black pepper and papyrus power the heart, before plunging to the pulsating depths of tonka bean, saffron and incense. The EDT sets in a warm, sensual dry down.

listings.rawTitle: Coach Women's Gold Parfum Spray 90ml
listings.description: Coach’s Gold Parfum Spray is a refreshing, fruity fragrance crafted to uplift the senses.  A bright splash of peppercorn sparks the opening with vibrancy, softening into almond blossom at the heart, where florals add an elegant, comforting nuance. As the fragrance deepens, vanilla lends creamy sweetness that melts into golden amber, leaving a trail of warmth and intensity.  The result is a refined harmony of delicacy and depth, creating a versatile scent that transitions from day to night.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradigme Le Parfum 150ml Refill
listings.description: Prada Paradigme Le Parfum Refill makes sure you never run out of your favourite scent. A fresh yet comforting fragrance that balances luminous freshness with warm woody depth. From the first spritz, geranium brings a crisp, slightly green floral lift, creating a clean, refined opening. As the fragrance unfolds, creamy vanilla softens the composition with a smooth, comforting warmth before settling into a rich amber base that lingers like a second skin. Elegant, understated and effortlessly modern, the scent is perfect for everyday wear, while the sleek, minimalist bottle reflects its timeless sophistication.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Phantom Parfum Refill 200ml
listings.description: Preserve and refill your retro-futurist chromatic Phantom bottle, while prolonging the seductive aura of the Phantom Eau de Parfum thanks to this refillable format. Phantom is a visionary masterpiece dedicated to men who never play by the rules. This delightfully enthralling potion captures the thrill of masculinity, reworking dark mysterious accords with the utmost refinement. Evolving with a seductive and daring edge, the masculine scent is crafted with intense nuances of lavender, vanilla and sensual vetiver to portray an elevated trail of assertive facets. The refill helps to reduce the impact on the environment by using 63% less plastic and 47% less glass* *Compatible with Rabanne Phantom Parfum 150ml Bottle only.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Mon GUERLAIN Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Mon Guerlain Eau de Parfum is a fragrance that enhances exceptional raw materials: french lavender, sambac jasmine, sandalwood and vanilla tahitensis. It expresses the quintessence of a history replete with experiences, nourished by success, expertise and generosity, all infused with the same passion since 1828.

listings.rawTitle: Elie Saab Girl of Now Eau de Parfum - 90ml
listings.description: Embodying the vivacious spirit of the modern woman, Elie Saab's Girl of Now Eau de Parfum is a gourmand floral fragrance inspired by spontaneity and playfulness. Inspired by Lebanon, the scent opens with roasted pistachio and sparkling pear for an addictive opening. Bitter almond and orange blossom unite at the heart to create an exclusive ormond flower accord. Tonka bean, almond milk and patchouli leave a final trail, reinforcing the Elie Saab signature.  Elegant and jewel-like, the perfume bottle is adorned with a delicate blue and gold enamel flower, inspired by the house's couture.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Eros Flame Bundle Set
listings.description: A fragrance duo inspired by intense passion, the Versace Eros Flame Set captures the unpredictable, wild nature of desire as reflected through the citrus-woody olfactory. Hosted in a fiery-red bottle emblazoned with Versace’s iconic Medusa head, the set contains both full-size and travel-size editions. Set Contents: Eros Flame Eau de Parfum Vapo 100ml Opening with a hypnotic burst of Italian lemon, tangerine and bitter orange, the fragrance is balanced by wild rosemary and black pepper. Sensual masculinity underscores the fragrance with base notes of Texas cedar and patchouli heart, working alongside rich and creamy vanilla to velvetise the fresh fragrance. The scents infuse and enhance one another, an EDP that will set your heart ablaze. Eros Flame Eau de Parfum 10ml A travel-sized companion to the citrus-woody fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Soleil Neige All Over Body Spray 150ml
listings.description: Soleil Neige is a ray of solar light – a breath of winter air that conjures sun on fresh alpine snow. Radiant and exhilarating, it captivates with bright citrus, white florals and musk. TOM FORD’s winter world conjures the thrill of a day on the slopes that melts into the celebratory warmth of après-ski. A cool burst of bright and green citrus gives way to a bouquet of winter white florals and rose absolute. The fluted flacon is glazed in a warm-white hue paired with the gleam of sliver-toned accents, evoking the luminosity of sun on snow.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild Eau So Intense Eau De Parfum Pen Spray 10ml
listings.description: With Daisy Wild Eau So Intense, Marc Jacobs adds a bright, free-spirited note to the familiar floral favourite. Bursting open with a radiant banana blossom accord, the scent unfolds into a sensuous bouquet of jasmine and tuberose, before settling into a warm base of amber and sandalwood. Sun-drenched, woody nuances bring an unexpected wildness. Encased in the signature Daisy bottle, reimagined in ombré hues and vivid tones, the fragrance evokes a sunlit walk through the wild, with a fresh yet intense, playful yet grounded olfactive trail.

listings.rawTitle: NEOM Wellbeing Sensuous Essential Oil Blend
listings.description: Blended to have a rich and spicy aroma, the NEOM Sensuous Essential Oil Blend harnesses the power of flowers to create a fragrance designed to be used during relaxation. Containing Frankincense, Ylang Ylang and Patchouli, the woody, aromatic scent can be used at any time to refresh your surroundings and revitalise the senses. Formulated with an additional 13 essential oils, the blend is incredibly pure, bring you closer to the natural world. Best used with Neom's Wellbeing Pod, but can be added into your pamper routine in place of any other essential oil.

listings.rawTitle: Estée Lauder Bronze Goddess Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Treat yourself to a luminous bouquet with the Estée Lauder Bronze Goddess Eau de Parfum, an opulent symphony of notes that captures the warmth of an endless summer. Establishing a bright and playful hook, bergamot, lemon and mandarin kick off the fragrance with a golden appeal, conjuring sunlit skin and long-awaited coastal escapes. Next in the pyramid is a joint tropical accord of tiare flower and coconut, caressed by jasmine and lavender and offset by a slightly bitter hit of neroli. Supporting the solar notes above, a base of myrrh, vetiver and amber imbues the composition with a warm, resinous depth that lingers into sunset. The fragrance is housed in a deep magenta faceted bottle, complete with a turquoise-embellished, wave-rippled cap.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Born in Roma Coral Donna Eau de Parfum for Her 100ml
listings.description: Experience a Roman escape with Born in Roma Coral Donna from Valentino. As coral light fills the skyline, the fruity floral fragrance makes this moment yours with a new twist on your Italian fantasy. Opening with a juicy sensation, sparkling strawberry and bergamot energise the scent with a zesty beginning. A floral heart of jasmine grandiflorum reveals a bright expression of modern femininity, with a lightness and charm reminiscent of the audacious Valentino woman. Grounding the base, cedar and vetiver releases earthy undertones for a memorable trail that lingers all day. The fragrance is housed in a glass bottle inspired by Rome at sunset with the quintessential Valentino rock studs.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Nectarine Blossom & Honey Cologne - 30ml
listings.description: Bursting with fresh fruit, Jo Malone London Nectarine Blossom and Honey Cologne embodies the vibrancy of the stalls at Covent Garden’s famous markets. Uplifting like an early morning breeze, the cologne sets you up for a day of playful excitement. Juicy Cassis offers a top note of intense ripeness finished with a crisp edge to refresh and revitalise the senses. Sweetening into a smooth stream of Acacia Honey, the scent becomes luxuriously indulgent, balanced by accents of Blossoms and Beeswax for a deeper, richer scent. With a base of Peach, the fragrance is wrapped in a delicious velvety texture with the essence of succulent flesh turning rosy in the sunlight.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Si Nude Bloom Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Refresh your fragrance collection with Giorgio Armani’s Sì Nude Bloom Eau de Parfum – a luminous composition that balances fresh and floral notes. The scent opens with blackcurrant, delivering a crisp, juicy aroma that feels vibrant yet delicately tart. As it develops, rose emerges at the heart, introducing an airy floral layer that’s smooth and uplifting. Patchouli settles at the base, rounding out the composition with subtle warmth while allowing the brighter notes to shine through. Light yet distinctive, it transitions seamlessly from day to evening, leaving a bright trail that lingers on the skin.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun Banana Rush Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Channel your inner femme fatale with the Juliette Has a Gun Banana Rush Eau de Parfum, an elevated take on banana with a dessert-like edge. Banana opens the trail with a confident fruity flourish, warmed by maple syrup for a sweet (not saccharine) overture. Just below, coconut is sharpened by frangipani flower, adding a tropical dimension to the pudding-laced profile. In the base, vanilla and sandalwood join forces as a lasting, sensuous duo to ground the near-edible blend above. Playful yet luxurious, reach for the fragrance when you want to make a unique olfactory statement.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette Has a Gun Lady Vengeance Eau de Parfum 7.5ml
listings.description: Rich and confident, Juliette Has A Gun’s Lady Vengeance bottles the art of seduction. The feminine Eau de Parfum empowers its wearer with every spritz. The elegance of Bulgarian rose pairs with earthy patchouli to create a sophisticated sillage, finished with vanilla for its warm, creamy facets. The flacon represents the powerful energy of the scent within, pairing a jet-black colourway with eye-catching embellishments.

listings.rawTitle: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Spices Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Turn up the heat in your fragrance wardrobe with the Emporio Armani Stronger With You Spices Eau de Parfum. A limited‑edition evolution of the original, the bold composition offers a spicy twist on the signature amber fougère. Vibrant citrus and black pepper extract open the scent, sparking immediate sensory impact. In the heart, saffron pulses with lightly bittersweet warmth, while a swirl of hot spices and aromatic lavender diva essence drives the fragrance’s powerful fougère core. As time goes on, vanilla bourbon premium extract takes over, delivering a warm, boozy finish that lingers long after the first spritz. Crafted for a strong projection and longevity, the scent is encased in a metallic, terracotta‑toned flacon inspired by sun‑scorched desert dunes.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Million Gold For Her Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Another core favourite from the pioneering brand, the Rabanne Million Gold For Her Parfum offers an intensely floral, golden bouquet. Enveloping the senses in a floral surge to begin with, solar ylang ylang is caressed by sweet jasmine in the top layer. Sandalwood and a floral woody accord add grounding elements to the olfactive pyramid, infusing the ultra-feminine fragrance with a sophisticated impulse. The luminous result is inspired by one of the brand's archival scents, dialled up in intensity for a perfume that lights up your presence. The scent is outfitted in a gradient-style bottle, with a faceted exterior and a debossed logo cap.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Noir Extreme Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Tom Ford Noir Extreme Parfum embodies contrasting counterparts, where sophistication meets seduction. The rich, intensified fragrance opens with the daring spice of cardamom, balanced by the fiery warmth of Shimoga ginger. As it deepens, the scent unveils its heart of exotic tonka bean, melting into the earthy, smoky richness of guaiac wood for an irresistibly sensual finish. Decanted into a gold-toned flacon, the bottle's clean, rectangular silhouette is accented with a textured, ribbed cap that adds a tactile contrast, symbolising the layered complexity of the scent.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Orange Blossom Cologne - 100ml
listings.description: A burst of freshness under a sweltering summer sun, Jo Malone London Orange Blossom Cologne is a crisp oasis amidst towering green vegetation. Clementine Flower sparkles at the surface, brimming with a sweet tang like a citrusy nectar dripping from garden vines. Blooming at the heart of the fragrance, Orange Blossom along with Water Lily mingle into a floral medley that’s warmed by White Lilac’s gentle spice. To sweeten the arrangement, Orris brings an air of powdery Parma Violets and binds together the other notes into a shimmering bouquet. Green Vetiver evokes the leafiness of foliage with a balsamic undertone reminiscent of the forest floor.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Love Exclusive Eau de Toilette Spray 150ml
listings.description: Discover the Marc Jacobs Daisy Love Eau de Toilette; a radiant, addictive fragrance that combines fresh and floral accords to create a luxurious olfactory experience. Created by master perfumer, Alberto Morillas, the EDT opens with sweet cloudberries and delicate daisy petals, before settling on a warm base of cashmere musks and clean driftwood for a gourmand twist. Housed in an elegant bottle with the signature oversized daisy cap.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana The One Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Dolce&Gabbana presents The One, a fragrance for women which captures the elegance and delicacy of femininity. Opening with a burst of delectable fruits, the scent blends vibrant bergamot and fresh mandarin with luscious lychee and peach. A floral heart settles at the core with blooming lily and rose, intertwined with exotic jasmine, for a light expression of decadence and demure. Classic and contemporary accords fuse at the base with an exceptional blend of vanilla, amber, and musk, finished with a hint of vetiver. The flacon of Dolce&Gabbana’s The One Eau de Parfum pays homage to the tradition of perfumery with its golden hue.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Arancia Di Capri EDT 100ml
listings.description: Inspired by the turquoise waters lapping against Capri’s golden-hued coves, the Acqua Di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Arancia Di Capri Eau de Toilette captures the warmth of sun-soaked tangerine groves and the citrus-scented air of the island. Top notes of Italian orange, mandarin and lemon open the fragrance, while a heart of petitgrain and cardamom adds aromatic warmth. A base of caramel and musk lends a soft, lingering finish. Housed in the brand's iconic Art Deco-inspired bottle, the deep blue glass mirrors the hues of the Mediterranean Sea.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Vetiver & Golden Vanilla Cologne Intense 50ml
listings.description: Transport your senses to the paradisial Madagascan coastline with the Vetiver and Golden Vanilla Cologne Intense by Jo Malone London. Amongst the woodland, vetiver emerges, swaying in the breeze to emit a warm and earthy aroma. The powerful fragrance opens with a blend of cardamom and grapefruit tea accords, weaving between vetiver bourbon, creating a smoky yet elegant allure. Vanilla bourbon adds a sensuality to the scent, complementing the vetiver heart and enhancing the deep, delectable nuances.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss The Scent Intense For Him Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Formed like a magnetic pull, Hugo Boss The Scent Intense For Him Eau de Parfum 50ml offers a deeper, richer take on the original fragrance. Signature Maninka fruit lends a smooth, gourmand nuance, layered with warm amber for a lasting impression. Rich and textured, the scent exudes confidence with a distinctly masculine character. Housed in a dark, lacquered bottle with metallic accents, the fragrance reflects the strength and depth within its composition.

listings.rawTitle: Clarins Lotus Oil Combination/Oily Skin 30ml
listings.description: A targeted treatment for oily and combination skin types, the Clarins Lotus Oil helps to reduce excess sebum and shine through the power of 100% natural extracts. Rich in rosemary, geranium and lotus botanicals, the lightweight formula purifies the skin and reduces the appearance of enlarged pores to support a smoother, more refined texture. Hazelnut oil is infused to deliver soothing moisture, supporting a plumper finish and supple feel, all while the blend’s aromatherapeutic scent uplifts the senses as you pat it into the skin.

listings.rawTitle: Baobab Collection Max 10 Pearls Black
listings.description: Notes: Black Rose, Ginger. Adorn your home with the luxurious scent of Baobab’s Pearls Black candle. Elegant and mysteriously seductive, Black Rose is ignited by fiery Ginger. Adding a divine opulence to any space, the fragrance captures the essence of a precious and elusive natural beauty. The hand-poured scented candle is housed in an artisan glass vessel, speckled with flecks of black to mimic the tones of natural pearls. Designed in collaboration with renowned artistic photographer Peter Lippman, the scented candle offers both visual and sensorial appeal, epitomising luxury home fragrance and premium craftsmanship. Approximate burn times by size: Max 10: 60 hours Max 16: 150 hours Max 24: 400 hours Max 35: 800 hours

listings.rawTitle: Estée Lauder Bronze Goddess Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Treat yourself to a luminous bouquet with the Estée Lauder Bronze Goddess Eau de Parfum, an opulent symphony of notes that captures the warmth of an endless summer. Establishing a bright and playful hook, bergamot, lemon and mandarin kick off the fragrance with a golden appeal, conjuring sunlit skin and long-awaited coastal escapes. Next in the pyramid is a joint tropical accord of tiare flower and coconut, caressed by jasmine and lavender and then sharpened by a slightly bitter hit of neroli. Supporting the solar notes above, a base of myrrh, vetiver and amber imbues the composition with a warm, resinous depth that lingers into sunset. The fragrance is housed in a deep magenta faceted bottle, complete with a turquoise-embellished, wave-rippled cap.

listings.rawTitle: Armani Code Eau de Toilette Spray 200ml
listings.description: An iconic fragrance entering a new era, Giorgio Armani introduces Armani Code Eau de Toilette. Representing the forward-thinking, modern man, the Eau de Toilette takes a spin on the signature fragrance. Encompassed in a new statement, refillable bottle, the scent is both sleek and stylish in aroma and appearance. Opening with luxurious citrus notes from Italian green mandarins and intoxicating exotic amber, an aroma is formed that exudes mystery and seduction. At its heart features aromatic cedarwood, striking and sophisticated for the established man.

listings.rawTitle: Mugler Angel Stellar Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: A celestial twist on a classic gourmand, Angel Stellar Eau de Parfum infuses Mugler’s iconic DNA through a prism of unexpected luminosity. Vivid bergamot opens the fragrance with a bright, tangy lift before melting into a creamy pistachio accord, leaving a sweet, salty and smooth olfactive trail. Anchored by soft vanilla and a veil of rich woods, the fragrance boasts powdery nuances for warmth and depth. Encased in an electric cobalt star, it’s like a fantasy reimagined in scent.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Si Passione Red Bloom Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Blossom into spring with the Giorgio Armani Si Passione Red Bloom Eau de Parfum, a floral fragrance with facets of woods. The fragrances awakens the senses with a cocktail of bergamot, blackcurrant and raspberry, embarking on a new zest for scent. Blooming with iris pallida and two facets of rose, the bouquet of fresh florals romance and flirt with sensual vanilla bourbon. Finalised with cashmeran, the fruity-floral fragrance is elevated with an elegant, amber dry down.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Cobalt Absolute Eau de Parfum 150ml
listings.description: A balance of earthy depth and sweet warmth, Carolina Herrera’s Bad Boy Cobalt Absolute is a compelling choice for evening wear. Defined by its bold woody-vanilla profile, the scent is favoured for its smoothness and intensity. It opens with fresh, aromatic notes of blue lavender and blue sage, creating a clean yet subtly earthy introduction. At the heart, geranium meets white truffle – an unexpected pairing that blends green, slightly minty facets with a rich, musky edge. As it dries down, golden vanilla and oakwood emerge, wrapping the skin in creamy, almost marshmallow-like warmth, grounded by a smoky, earthy finish.

listings.rawTitle: Miu Miu Muitine Eau de Parfum 50ml Gift Set (Worth £128)
listings.description: For a study in sweet subversion, Miu Miu’s Miutine Eau de Parfum Spring Gift Set reimagines an iconic chypre through a mischievous, modern lens. The brand’s new feminine fragrance opens with wild strawberry from the French-bred Mara des Bois variety, its ripe, lightly effervescent freshness playfully twisted with gourmand touches of vanilla. At the heart, a gardenia accord unfolds – creamy and softly green, with a subtle fruitiness that bridges the opening and base. As it dries down, earthy patchouli oil anchors the sweetness, creating a bold contrast that feels both sensual and rare. Unconventionally feminine and quietly rebellious, Miutine captures the essence of Miu Miu in a memorable scent for the modern It-girl, housed in a matelassé glass bottle and crowned with a luxe gold cap. Set Contents: Miu Miu Muitine Eau de Parfum 50ml Miu Miu Muitine Eau de Parfum 10ml

listings.rawTitle: The White Company Lime & Bay Large Home Scenting Set
listings.description: Surround your home with the uplifting vibrant notes of The White Company Lime & Bay Large Home Scenting Set. Infused with enlivening citruses, the home fragrance trio captures the vitality of a blooming Mediterranean garden. Each delicate fragrance is laced with a bright scent of lime, grapefruit, orange blossom and bay leaf to awaken the senses with this invigorating fusion. Housed within a sophisticated white box, the collection makes the perfect gift for someone special. Set Contents: Lime & Bay Signature Candle 140g Lime & Bay Diffuser 150ml Lime & Bay Home Spray 100ml

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentleman Eau de Parfum Sport 100ml
listings.description: Inspired by the focus and drive of athletes, Givenchy Gentleman Eau de Parfum Sport 100ml delivers a fresh take on citrus and woody notes. The scent leads with a lively quartet of lemon, lifted by lavender and clary sage, before moving into a smooth heart of narcissus absolute and vetiver. As it settles, amber woods and musk create a clean, long-lasting trail. The signature bottle is reworked with a black gradient finish that reveals a cool blue hue, punctuated by a flash of red for a sharp, energetic sign-off.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentleman Society Eau de Parfum 200ml
listings.description: An aromatic adventure that redefines modern masculinity, Givenchy’s Gentleman Society Eau de Parfum is a woody-floral fragrance emblematic of the suave, sensual and sophisticated. A fresh fusion of sage and cardamom open the trail with a vibrant spiced scent, flirting with the florality of wild narcissus absolute before a rich vetiver quartet welcomes warm woods. Cedar and sandalwood unite in a creamy olfactive matrimony, adding an addictive, heady edge to the bold composition, while vanilla grants a subtle sweetness that lingers on the skin. Inspired by couture designs of the House, the eau de parfum’s bottle is embossed with the brand's 4G crest in silver, contrasted against the black lacquered finish for a distinguished look. Bottle made from 15% post-consumer recycled glass.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Mon GUERLAIN Eau De Parfum Intense 30ml
listings.description: The Mon Guerlain fragrances are a fragrant manifesto of today's femininity. A multi-faceted woman: strong, free and sensual. Discover Mon Guerlain Eau de Parfum Intense, a sensual and unique woody amber. The vanilla tincture, artisan-produced by Guerlain, blends with vanilla Tahitensis and smoldering patchouli. They accompany lavender and sandalwood, forming a unique and sensual woody amber composition. "Mon Guerlain Intense is a confident sensual enveloping signature, that no ones forgets. It is this heavy dose of lush vanilla that creates an addictive quality, while offering up plenty of elegance and mystery" - Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfumer The “quadrilobe” bottle, created in 198, established itself as one of Guerlain’s iconic bottles. Simple and graphic, it echoes an alchemist’s bottle and owes its name “quadrilobe” to its stopper, which is formed from one piece to obtain a shape resembling four lobes. One century later, beautifully enhanced by a luxurious glass weight and a golden adornment, this bottle offers a contrast between strong taut lines and sensual curves, expressing contemporary femininity.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Mandarine Basilic Eau De Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Juicy and tangy mandarin flesh transcended by the aromatic freshness of basil, then energised by green tea over a background of woody notes. Create your own signature by pairing Mandarine Basilic with: Nerolia Vetiver, Bergamote Calabria, Rosa Rossa, Nettare Di Sole or Flora Cherrysia. To create your own olfactory signature, select your favourite duo among recommended options and spray each Aqua Allegoria on your skin one by one in equivalent quantities. Mandarine Basilic is also available in travel size, to slip into your bag and carry around with you.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD F***ing Fabulous Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Unleash your decadent, daring side with Tom Ford’s F***ing Fabulous atomizer. The spray bursts forth with notes of leather, caressing the senses and evoking opulent, luxurious and dimly-lit visions. Brimming with the confidence to encourage you to express your innermost fantasies, the spray enters its mid-section with aromas of Clary Sage and Lavender, mingling hypnotically with Bitter Almond and mouth-watering Vanilla. Splashes of Tonka Bean enliven and captivate, while Blonde Woods offer a rich, creamy element to the otherwise delightfully chaotic mix. Ideal for the person who knows exactly who they are as the dominant, powerful and adventurous formula makes you impossible to ignore, with the convenient travel-size making the spray perfect for top-ups on the go.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Tobacco Vanille Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: A taste of true luxury, Tom Ford’s Tobacco Vanille Eau De Parfum sparks a sensorial journey. Its warm, spiced facets are nothing short of opulent, smouldering in the air like the ghost of a firework. Centred around creamy vanilla, the fragrance is charged with a sweet, silky twist. Tobacco flower creates sensual smokes that tug at our senses, channelling the private, dusky glow of an English gentleman’s club. The scent is stirred by modern influences, succumbing to a rich, confident sillage. Wrapped in wood sap and cocoa, indulgence is mandatory in this maze of pure intoxication. Poised, powerful and justly proud: reinvent the wheel with Tom Ford’s iconic, spicy EDP.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Olympéa Elixir Eau de Parfum Intense 80ml
listings.description: Unleash your inner goddess with every spritz of Rabanne's Olympéa Elixir, an intense, feminine signature that embodies the warmth of the sun on the skin through its fruity gourmand profile. Capturing the sun-drenched aura of golden hour, the fragrance opens with a sparkling burst of juicy pineapple, warmed by a radiant blend of precious jasmine and the tropical twist of monoi. The bottle's iconic design has been adorned with gold and a hanging charm that reflects the luminous intensity of the fragrance within.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier La Belle Rosea Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Unveil Jean Paul Gaultier's La Belle Rosea, a floral, aquatic and amber Eau de Parfum that radiates like a precious stone. A crystalline aquatic accord opens with freshness, followed by a blooming heart of peony. At the base, vanilla unleashes its sensual notes for an embrace that lingers on the skin. Embodying a sublime Garden of Eden adorned with gold and crystals, the classic sculptural torso perfume bottle is illuminated by the orange-pink fragrance within, complemented by a golden floral jewel set within a garnet. Spritz the perfume as your final accessory to captivate everyone's gaze.

listings.rawTitle: The Body Shop Dewberry Fragrance Mist 100ml
listings.description: Start your day with a spritz of The Body Shop's Dewberry Fragrance Mist, a lightweight body spray that bottles refreshing, fruity notes for a playful spirit. A blend of dewberry and green leaves is elevated by a bouquet of cool eucalyptus, jasmine, freesia and white lily, before settling on a grounding base of cedarwood and musk.

listings.rawTitle: The Body Shop White Musk Eau de Toilette 30ml
listings.description: Experience one of The Body Shop's most iconic scents in the form of a delicate Eau de Toilette. White Musk brings together fresh, airy notes with sensual musk for an empowering, timeless fragrance. Clean aldehydic notes blend with floral lily of the valley, powdery jasmine and comforting white musk for a signature scent that endures. Layer with the White Musk Body Lotion for even more intensity and longevity.

listings.rawTitle: Elie Saab Le Parfum Eau de Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Adorning the body like a couture dress, Elie Saab's Le Parfum Eau de Parfum is an invitation to the Lebanese couturier's universe. The solar floral chypre fragrance is a floral bouquet blooming with intense femininity. Radiant like the sun at its peak, orange blossom meets delicate jasmine flower, before being warmed by honey rose, patchouli and cedarwood. Faced like a jewel, the perfume bottle is an ode to light, sparkling with transparency and reflecting the radiant, sensual scent within.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Omnia Crystalline Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Crispy. Luminous. Pure. Reveal your light through OMNIA. Evoking the purity and clarity of crystal, the iconic BVLGARI Omnia Crystalline is a luminous Eau de Toilette signed by Master Perfumer Alberto Morillas. A fragrance inspired by the aquatic transparency of the lotus flower, sublimated by the airy generosity of a white peony. Omnia Crystalline is a delicate scent evolving through watery crispy notes of nashi pear, the vegetal freshness of bamboo and ending on the warmth of balsa wood softened by an accord of crystal musks. The new flacon design pays tribute to Omnia's iconic shape while staying true to its inimitable original scent, which remains untouched. Like a frame of light, an invitation to rediscover the iconic fascination of Omnia from a new, more precious perspective. Two rings smoothly flowing into each other through two detachable elements, unveiling the fragrance's atomizer and introducing a new concept for this iconic flacon. Like a shining secret at the heart, an elegant rose gold colored frame on the cap brings Bulgari's DNA as a jeweler to the core of one of its most iconic feminine fragrance collections. Faithful to its original design representing the symbol of infinity, the new flacon captures every single drop of light. Top Notes: The fragrance opens with a duo bathed in light. The crispness of nashi pear accord is enhanced by the freshness of a bamboo accord. Heart Notes: A delicate alliance transports the heart of the fragrance towards floral and resolutely feminine tones. The aquatic transparency of lotus accord is tinged with the purity of a white peony note. Dry Down Notes: At dry-down, the warm balsa wood accord reveals a tender woody trail combined with the soft sensuality of a crystal musks accord.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: An invitation to free your fantasies with confidence, Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia Eau de Parfum for women is the third Gucci fragrance to join the #FloraFantasy collection. Transporting you to a world of radiant floral power, the soft and sensual scents of Magnolia Essence, Dewberries Accord, and Patchouli Essence combine to create an empowered women's Eau de Parfum. The bottle, adorned with a mesmerising flora pattern and a captivating shade of purple, symbolises the limitless potential that lies within you. An unwavering ally to the Flora woman who seeks to explore all possibilities, this delightful fragrance is a unique bouquet full of joyful floral strength, that reminds you to trust yourself and free your fantasies. Miley Cyrus is the #FloraFantasy protagonist, guiding us on a journey through an enchanted world of heightened reality and anime adventure. With her free, rebellious spirit, she draws us towards the boundless potential of the world around us, like an intuitive reminder that with Gucci Flora Eau de Parfum Collection by your side, you can confidently conquer any challenge that lies before you.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Wood Sage & Sea Salt & Grapefruit Scent Layering Gift Set
listings.description: Elevate your fragrance ritual by mastering the art of scent layering. This bundle combines two Jo Malone colognes to curate a fragrance wardrobe tailored to every mood and moment. Set Contents: Wood Sage & Sea Salt 30ml A grounded yet effortlessly fresh scent, where earthy sage intertwines with the crisp tang of sea salt, sweeping your senses into a windswept escape. Subtle, natural and endlessly calming, this essence carries the spirit of the ocean wherever you go. Grapefruit 9ml Awaken your senses with a sharp, uplifting burst of grapefruit. A refreshing note, it adds an invigorating layer to your scent profile that energises, refines, and leaves behind a trail of understated elegance.

listings.rawTitle: BOSS Bottled Beyond Refill Eau de Parfum for Him 200ml
listings.description: Memorably bold and long-lasting, amplify your presence with BOSS' Beyond Eau de Parfum for Him. Fronted by global ambassador Bradley Cooper, this standout scent makes a confident entrance into your aftershave collection. The composition opens with a vibrant burst of ginger, delivering a zesty, peppery freshness that awakens the senses. As it settles, smooth leather emerges, adding a smoky, resinous depth that’s equal parts refined and magnetic. Lending itself to evenings that demand impact, the Beyond EDP is for leaving your mark in olfactory form

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden White Tea Eau Fraiche Eau de Toilette Spray 100ml / 3.3 fl.oz.
listings.description: A vibrant iteration of Elizabeth Arden’s White Tea fragrance, the White Tea Eau Fraiche Eau de Toilette is a fresh, floral spray that encourages a sense of olfactive well-being. Developed with VivaScentz™, a patented technology that harmonises key notes, the eau de toilette supports an uplifting, energising effect. Nuances of blood orange open the scent trail with a zesty freshness, before gentle lily of the valley and water lily accords melt in the middle. Grounding the aroma are notes of tonka bean, blonde woods and warm musks, giving the fragrance a comforting depth and longevity on the skin.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Perfect Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: A more uplifting and intimate interpretation of the classic Perfect scent, Perfect Eau de Toilette is a celebration of individuality, inviting you to embrace your true self with every spritz. The floral fragrance offering from Marc Jacobs exudes joy, exhilarating the senses with its cheerful notes. Spicy pink peppercorn and polygonum lend the long-lasting EDT its signature freshness, complemented by a rich daffodil accord in the heart. Underpinned by cedarwood’s warm, earthy facets, the fragrance provides an invigorating olfactory experience. The eclectic 100ml flacon draws inspiration from the scent within. The bottle combines Marc Jacobs’ signature round shape with an abundance of eye-catching charms, tinted with a pale blue colour for a touch of fun.

listings.rawTitle: Floral Street Electric Rhubarb Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Rhubarb, Lemon, Bergamot. Heart Notes: Islang Gardenia, Orange Flower Tunisia, Jasmine Sambac. Base Notes: White Cedarwood, Marine Accord, Liquid Musks, Santal Austral. Expect the unexpected with FloralStreet’s Electric Rhubarb Eau de Parfum, a bubbly, white-floral fragrance to charm the senses. Like a bottle of fizz on a balmy summer afternoon, the scent is bright and effervescent. English rhubarb opens with a tangy-sweet tone, blossoming into a heart of flowers. Revealing depths of Australian sandalwood, the EDP settles on a warm, sensuous base. Sunny, radiant skies are paired with an unpredictable blast of salty sea air in this luminous fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Zadig & Voltaire This Is Really Her! Eau de Parfum Intense 50ml
listings.description: Defying the rules of perfumery as you know it, the Zadig & Voltaire This Is Really Her! Intense unleashes your bold side with an unconventional arrangement of floral amber accords. Redefining the iconic This Is! story, the fragrance opens with sparkling pink berries and green basil rose accents, creating an electrifying first impression. At its heart, a metallic rose and chestnut accord adds shimmering depth while the base reveals a seductive blend of labdanum, patchouli and sandalwood for lasting allure. Housed in a metallic-inspired bottle with 15% recycled glass, the stylish flacon embodies day-to-night chic and edgy elegance, capturing the sparkling energy of Parisian nights.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN L’Homme Idéal Eau De Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Guerlain decodes men’s aspirations and creates for them a concentrate of ideal: L'Homme Idéal Eau de Toilette. A transcendent almond from top notes to base notes, as an inspiration from Jicky.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Shalimar Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: L'Eau de Parfum Shalimar is a mythic fragrance with bergamot, iris and vanilla notes ; an intense wake with a touch of impertinence, always glowing which embodies skin-caressing sensuality with a hint of the forbidden. Inspired by the passionate love story between an emperor and an Indian princess, Shalimar, which means "temple of love" in Sanskrit, symbolises the promise of eternal love forevermore. It is a fragrance of desire. In 1925, the Shalimar bottle designed by Raymond Guerlain won first prize at the Paris Decorative Arts Exhibition. Its curves were inspired by the basins of the famous Shalimar gardens. The fan stopper with its sapphire transparency recalls the garden's eternally gushing water.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD F***ing Fabulous Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Named in true Tom Ford fashion, this Eau de Parfum is ‘F***ing Fabulous’. Characterised by a distinct leathery scent, this fragrance is inspired by all things fabulous and decadent. With a name that says it all, the seductive nature of this fragrance is direct and explicit. While almond is blended with iris to create a rich heart, the floral accord provides depth, sweetening the perfume. Merging with the full-bodied note of cashmeran, this unorthodox fragrance is multifaceted, designed for a wearer that is impossible to define.  Warm, spicy, intense, intoxicating – this fragrance takes the mind on an olfactive journey, cloaking the body with a sense of contrast and complication. Housed in the label’s signature matte black bottle, in a shape inspired by the clean architectural lines of a chess piece. Presented in a matte black set-up box to give you a truly luxurious experience.

listings.rawTitle: The Merchant of Venice Murano Andalusian Soul Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: The Merchant of Venice Murano Andalusian Soul Eau de Parfum is a sunlit journey through the aromatic lands of Morocco and Southern Spain. From the very first touch, savoury herbs and sweet clover mingle with the resinous warmth of turpentine and Indian sandalwood, while hints of rosemary and orange blossom lend a fresh, sparkling lift. The fragrance evokes golden afternoons under radiant skies, the gentle warmth of Mediterranean breezes, and the timeless allure of distant coastal markets. Each note unfolds like a story, bright, sophisticated, and utterly feminine, leaving a lingering trail of elegance and mystery. Encased in a bottle of glowing yellow and orange, Andalusian Soul mirrors the sun-drenched landscapes it celebrates, capturing both the spirit and the sensual warmth of its origins.

listings.rawTitle: AERIN Fleur De Peony Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: An ode to the peony bringing beauty to any celebration, AERIN’s Fleur De Peony Eau de Parfum showcases a fusion of luminous fruity and floral accords. The fragrance is part of a collection inspired by Aerin Lauder's travels, experiences and memories, capturing the celebratory touch of peonies at her own wedding. The fragrance unites soft pink peonies with tropical notes of lychee to evoke the euphoria of new love. At the base, sandalwood adds comforting warmth for a long-lasting scent trail.

listings.rawTitle: Miller Harris Feuilles de Tabac Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Woody Aromatic. Top Notes: Italian Bergamot, French Sage, Siberian Pine Needle. Heart Notes: Cuban Cascarilla Oil, Pimento Berries. Base Notes: Indonesian Patchouli, Tonka Bean, French Tobacco Leaf. A memorable marriage of honeyed tobacco and smouldering spices, Miller Harris’ Feuilles de Tabac embodies the essence of masculinity. Classic and timeless but relevant and modern in appeal, the fragrance opens with a clove-like aroma that unfolds into a bassline of earthy, smoky and slightly sweet notes. Resinous, incense-like hues fused with a steady undertone of musky patchouli and tonka bean bring harmony to the composition for a full-bodied dry-down. Vegan. Free from phthalates, artificial colourants, parabens and formaldehydes.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Fico Di Amalfi La Riserva Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Envelop yourself in the sweetness of the Mediterranean with the Blu Mediterraneo Fico di Amalfi La Riserva Eau de Parfum from Acqua di Parma. Radiant and juicy, it bursts with mandarin and blood orange for a sunlit, succulent character that feels bright yet refined. At its heart, orris and fig create a creamy green harmony, blending effortlessly with citrus before settling into a warm, musky trail of tonka bean, ambrettolide and orcanox.

listings.rawTitle: Miller Harris Oud Eclat Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: London perfumery Miller Harris present Oud Éclat, a poetic alchemy of woody notes evoking a deep forest setting. Beneath the canopies of towering fir trees and cashmere wood, a field of marigold blossoms radiate a spiced floral sweetness, grounded by warm, resinous nuances of nutmeg and smoky leather. Sophisticated with a sense of mystery, the eau de parfum’s seductively sweet aftertaste creates an unforgettable fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Aromatherapy Associates Breathe Pure Essential Oil Blend 10ml
listings.description: With a crisp, soothing scent, Aromatherapy Associates’ oil blend helps to uplift the senses. It’s infused with notes like pine and eucalyptus, creating a cool profile that’s incredibly refreshing. The oil’s clarifying presence is perfect for using when enjoying a moment of mindfulness throughout the day.

listings.rawTitle: Molton Brown Sunlit Clementine & Vetiver Eau De Parfum
listings.description: Molton Brown’s Sunlit Clementine and Vetiver Eau de Parfum reimagines and refines the citrus scent category, blending nature’s most vibrant nuances with its richest notes for a sophisticated, sun-fresh fragrance. Capturing the air of a laid-back summer’s eve, the eau de parfum opens with ripened clementine, lime and mandarin, each bathed in warm golden rays. A signature of bourbon vetiver adds depth and elegance to the cologne, leading smoothly to an infusion of roasted hazelnut, cushioned moss and creamy fig leaves. Soft suede closes the trail with an easy, elegant aroma, lingering on the skin with quiet confidence.

listings.rawTitle: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Rosé Eau de Parfum - 100ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Sparkling Fresh William Pear, Italian Mandarin, Jasmine Petals. Heart Notes: White Peony, Jasmine Sambac, Rose Centifolia Absolute. Base Notes: Ambrox, Orris Absolute, Benzoin. Dazzle and captivate with the Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Rosé Eau de Parfum. This exuberant scent toasts to endless celebrations, opening with top notes of Sparkling Fresh William Pear, Italian Mandarin and Jasmine Petals. The sweet, fruity opening sparks joy and optimism with a light citrus effervescence, revealing a blooming floral heart. At the centre of the fragrance, a bouquet of White Peony, Jasmine Sambac and Rose Centifolia Absolute exudes lust for life, welcoming endless possibilities. In the base, Ambrox, Orris Absolute and Benzoin warm the fragrance with a glowing sensuality. Celebrate life with Viva La Juicy Rosé.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Wild Bluebell Cologne - 100ml
listings.description: Filled with the whimsy of an enchanted forest, Jo Malone London Wild Bluebell Cologne takes you on a magical journey through a blooming sapphire sea. Wild and untamed, Bluebell is an enigmatic floral that beckons from sunlit groves. Nestled amongst leafy green notes, petals become dewy and crisp with an underlying sense of spicy clove emanating from the woodland trail. A sumptuous, silky heart of Persimmon fuses a subtle peachy scent to the clean top notes for a creamier blend that settles into a light White Musk. This powdery base feels like a fresh spring breeze, blowing the flowers into a soft and comforting cloud.

listings.rawTitle: Baobab Collection Max 16 Pearls White
listings.description: Notes: Jasmine, White Musk. Baobab’s Pearls collection of scented candles pays tribute to the iridescent beauty of the milky gemstone, which have long been symbols of love and purity, and coined the ‘tears of the gods’. To reflect the collection’s theme, the candles are presented in pearlescent glass jars, expertly hand-blown by the house’s skilled artisans to create an ornate piece. Fusing powdery floral hues of Jasmine with the heady perfume of White Musk, the White Pearls edition unleashes an intoxicating aroma, that fills the air with an intimate ambiance. Featuring a centred wick that ensures a slow and even burn, the scented candle offers a long-lasting olfactory experience. Approximate burn times by size: Max 10: 60 hours Max 16: 150 hours Max 24: 400 hours Max 35: 800 hours

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Vetiver & Golden Vanilla Cologne Intense 100ml
listings.description: Transport your senses to the paradisial Madagascan coastline with the Vetiver and Golden Vanilla Cologne Intense by Jo Malone London. Amongst the woodland, vetiver emerges, swaying in the breeze to emit a warm and earthy aroma. The powerful fragrance opens with a blend of cardamom and grapefruit tea accords, weaving between vetiver bourbon, creating a smoky yet elegant allure. Vanilla bourbon adds a sensuality to the scent, complementing the vetiver heart and enhancing the deep, delectable nuances.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Honeysuckle & Davana Cologne - 100ml
listings.description: If the Honeysuckle & Davana Cologne by luxury fragrance house Jo Malone London were a colour, it would be yellow, warmed with sunshine. Bright and spirited, the scent evokes a dreamy spring day in the rolling green hills of the picturesque British countryside. The floral perfume fuses the fruity, liquorice tang of davana with the sweet twist of quintessentially English flower honeysuckle. It encapsulates bucolic nuances with an undercurrent of moss, recalling the verdant scent of undergrowth dew with fresh rain, lending an earthy and woody cushion that balances with perfection. Presented in an elegant glass flacon, crowned with a silver lid, the perfume arrives in Jo Malone’s signature cream box, embellished with a satin black bow.

listings.rawTitle: TRUDON Carmen Parfum 15ml
listings.description: Ignite the senses with TRUDON Carmen Parfum, a bold woody fragrance with a spirited edge and a richly textured finish. Bergamot and grapefruit bring a bright citrus opening, warmed by the rich depth of rhum. At the heart, oak wood, clove, labdanum and patchouli create a smoky, resinous character, while light tobacco, ambroxan, grained leather and moss leave a dry, textured trail. The travel-size bottle keeps you fresh wherever you go.

listings.rawTitle: Baobab Collection Max 16 Platinum
listings.description: Notes:  Amber, Grapefruit, Vetiver. Refined with a masculine edge, Baobab’s ‘Platinum’ scented candle has a distinguished aroma with a complex, multi-layered profile. The candle is stored in a precious glass that creates an ethereal glow as it catches the light of the flame within. Sleek and understated, it’s easy to merge this home fragrance accessory with your existing room décor. Grapefruit creates a clean, citrus element, its coolness contrasting with Amber's molten depths, simmering below the surface. Vetiver’s earthy accent creates a sturdy rootedness, connecting the aroma to the natural world, adding a smokiness to the candle’s base. Approximate burn time: 150 hours.

listings.rawTitle: Baobab Collection Max 16 Aurum
listings.description: Notes: Precious Jasmine, Divine Musk. A sophisticated addition to your home’s interior décor, Baobab’s luxurious scented candles bring a comforting homely vibe with the added pleasure of intoxicating scents. Hand-poured into elegant glass jars, yellow gold from the outside and rose gold from the inside, the candle’s flickering flames illuminate your room with a festive glow, creating an inviting ambiance. Powdery floral notes of Jasmine married with a deep, musky backdrop transport the senses back in time, to pleasant memories of yesteryears. Featuring four wicks for an even and slow burn, the ornate candle makes for an exquisite gift or garnish on your mantlepiece. Approximate burn times by size: Max 10: 60 hours Max 16: 150 hours Max 24: 400 hours Max 35: 800 hours

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Cologne Intense Collection 5x9ml
listings.description: Offering five different fragrances for all occasions, the Jo Malone London Cologne Intense Collection provides a selection of scents to suit your mood. From smoky woods to creamy, sensual nuances, the set allows you to discover the variety and notoriety of Jo Malone colognes. Set Contents: Oud and Bergamot Cologne Intense 9ml A warm oud base melts into the skin, evoking a mysterious allure, clarified by crisp bergamot and orange notes. Velvet Rose and Oud Cologne Intense 9ml A magnetic blend of the darkest Damask rose, wrapped in resinous oud to emit a rich, animalistic aroma. Clove emboldens the intense scent with spiced nuances making their presence known. Scarlett Poppy Cologne Intense 9ml Radiant red poppies dance amongst velvety iris and creamy tonka bean to create a deep, floral intensity. Myrrh and Tonka Cologne Intense 9ml Hand-harvested with the finest ingredients, the perfume is infused with lavender, omumbri myrrh and tonka bean to create a rich and exotic perfume. The luxury cologne adds a velvety depth that sweeps up the senses in a warm embrace. Cypress and Grapevine Cologne Intense 9ml Romantic and archaic, the aromatic perfume is infused with cypress, grapevine and moss to transport the senses to a world of sensuality and unrivalled magnificence. The bold fragrance empowers the hero within to discover new depths.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Forte Nerolia Vetiver Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: The Aqua Allegoria fragrance collection celebrates the wonders of the world. Each creation pays tribute to nature’s beauty and sweeps us up in a discovery of exceptional raw ingredients and notes, beautifully enhanced by our perfumer-explorers.
