Discover Nerolia Vetiver Forte, a neroli radiated with light, enveloped by the generosity of a creamy fig accord, the warmth of vetiver and the almond notes of the tonka bean. “I created a neroli gilded by the rays of a setting sun, and awakened by the power of vetiver." - Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfumer. Aqua Allegoria Forte, the intense collection, is a warm and enveloping journey to the heart of the world’s wonders: Eaux de Parfum celebrating the intense beauty of nature, revealed by the golden rays of a setting sun. A powerful symbol of Guerlain's commitment to the planet, the Aqua Allegoria Forte fragrances contain more than 90% natural origin*. The French beetroot alcohol used in their formulas comes from a network committed to responsible farming.  *In accordance with the ISO 16128, calculation including water.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Les Légendaires Idylle Eau De Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Idylle is part of Guerlain’s Legendary fragrance collection. A collection made of emblematic fragrances, composed for more than a century by 5 generations of Perfumers. These mythical pioneer perfumes compose a unique olfactive library, that the Maison Guerlain endeavours to preserve. In this combination of the chypre sensuality and the intimate facet of white musks with a bouquet of flowers, the symbol of a declaration of love, Thierry Wasser expresses the sensuous and romantic idea of the idyll. Designed by Raymond Guerlain, its iconic “inverted heart” bottle is underscored with graceful scrolls typical of Art Nouveau. Its avant-garde stopper, in the form of a hollowed heart, evokes the delicate romanticism of this perfumery masterpiece and represented a real technical feat at the time.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Rose Prick Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Wild but delicate, enticing but dangerous, Tom Ford’s ‘Rose Prick’ Eau de Parfum finds the perfect balance between beauty and vanity. Characterised by the scent of warm florals, this fragrance was inspired by Tom Ford’s private rose garden. Guiding the senses on an olfactive journey through a blossoming garden, this fragrance reflects the magnificence of mother nature. The uplifting hues of Bulgarian Rose and Rose de Mai are grounded by the perfume’s fiery edge, creating an accord filled with contrast. Intensified by the potent note of Patchouli, the perfume is illuminated by its woody base, capturing every element of floral beauty. Housed in an opaque rose-pink bottle, mattified for a signature Tom Ford touch. Capped with a black metal inset, the contrasting colours reflect the sense of duality central to this scent.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Eau de Grey Vetiver Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Tap into your dynamic side with Tom Ford’s Grey Vetiver Eau de Toilette, a woody-spicy elixir that elevates any scent collection. The fragrance embodies what the designer calls  the essence o f  debonair, charismatic, and provocative masculinity . Vetiver makes up its core, that textured, earthy treasure revered by master perfumers for centuries. In Ford’s hands, this note is remixed and reborn: sharpened by crisp citrus and livened up by colourful nuances. Orange flower and grapefruit introduce an invigorating brightness, while nutmeg and pimento weave a subtle, seductive spice. Woody oakmoss adds a grounding element to the scent pyramid, forging a depth that lingers when you exit the room. The fragrance is housed in a clean, minimalist bottle with matte silver-tone accents and a debossed logo.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Rose Prick Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: The Tom Ford Rose Prick Eau de Parfum 30ml captures a new take on rose, opening with a vivid trio of Bulgarian blooms cut through with a hint of Sichuan pepper and turmeric. The floral heart feels fresh and lively, softened by Indonesian patchouli that lends a dry, earthy tone. As it settles, roasted tonka and tolu balsam bring warmth with smooth caramel and vanilla tones. Inspired by a private rose garden, the scent feels intimate yet expressive, leaving a long-lasting floral, chypre aroma in its wake.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Black Orchid Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Tom Ford’s Black Orchid Eau de Toilette embodies seduction and fantasy. Reimagining the classic Black Orchid fragrance, the sensual unisex scent is made to tempt all. Opulent bergamot and exotic ylang-ylang open this fragrance with a hypnotic burst. Rare and distinctive, black orchid resonates at the heart, while exquisite musk intertwines to provoke allure and mystery. Patchouli settles in, mingling with the deeper accords to create a sweet, enticing aroma. Tom Ford ensures luxury and indulgence with every scent inspired by the glamorous past. The opulent fragrance is encased within a sophisticated, sleek black bottle, with a stylish ribbed texture influenced by the architecture of the 1920s and 1930s.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Bitter Peach Eau de Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description: Jump into the juicy depths of Tom Ford’s Bitter Peach Eau de Parfum, a succulent scent that unites fruity frivolity with a sensual edge. A cocktail of peche de vigne and Sicilian blood orange reveals a sultry sweetness to satisfy your sweet tooth with the syrupy centre of ripe peaches. Rum-infused davana oil shifts the tone with a strong, seductive core. Complete with a patchouli base, the fragrance excites the senses with a hint of spice and desire.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Rose Prick All Over Body Spray 150ml
listings.description: Offering a lighter, airier take on the iconic floral scent, the TOM FORD Rose Prick All Over Body Spray 150ml is designed for a quick, all-over refresh. A blend of Bulgarian rose and turmeric opens the scent with a crisp, slightly spiced tone, leading into Indonesian patchouli and Sichuan pepper for a soft, earthy twist. As it settles, roasted tonka and tolu balsam add warmth with a hint of sweetness. The 360-spray design allows for easy application across the body, making it ideal for layering or wearing alone, leaving a fresh, floral olfactive trail.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Absolus Allegoria Tabac Sahara Eau de Parfum 125ml
listings.description: Absolus Allegoria, the absolute fragrance collection, is an enchanting and mysterious journey to the heart of the world’s wonders once night falls: fragrance trails celebrating deep and powerful nature, revealed by striking contrasts in the moonlight. Discover Tabac Sahara, a captivating nocturnal journey to the heart of the desert. Mysterious and smoky wreaths of tobacco meet the sensual addiction of a raspberry accord, beautifully enhanced by the warmth of an ambergris accord. Through its tangy freshness, the red berry creates a vibrant contrast with tobacco’s golden nuances, suggesting the pink halo that surrounds the dunes at nightfall. "Tabac Sahara is the perfume of a desert of pink dunes by starlight. The encounter of tobacco’s golden nuances with a pink raspberry note.” - Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfume Creation Director & Perfumer. A powerful symbol of Guerlain’s commitment to the planet, the Absolus Allegoria fragrances contain more than 90% natural-origin* ingredients. The French beetroot alcohol used in their formulas comes from a network committed to responsible farming. Tabac Sahara comes in the Allegoria collection’s emblematic bottle which is made in France and crafted from 15% recycled glass. It takes on an enigmatic purple shade, reminiscent of the dunes by starlight. Its unscrewable spray and transparent lacquer allow it to be recycled more easily. *in accordance with ISO 16128, calculation includes water.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Les Légendaires Insolence Eau De Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Insolence is part of Guerlain’s Legendary fragrance collection. A collection made of emblematic fragrances, composed for more than a century by 5 generations of Perfumers. These mythical pioneer perfumes compose a unique olfactive library, that the Maison Guerlain endeavours to preserve. Insolence is a spark in the eyes, an intrepid smile. Insolence is a careless grace, an ironic elegance, an amused silence. Created in 2006, Insolence celebrates this surprising, free and daring femininity. An impertinent, floral and fruity creation which is built around an overdose of violet, orange blossom and red berry notes. Designed by Raymond Guerlain, its iconic “inverted heart” bottle is underscored with graceful scrolls typical of Art Nouveau. Its avant-garde stopper, in the form of a hollowed heart, evokes the delicate romanticism of this perfumery masterpiece and represented a real technical feat at the time.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Les Légendaires Jicky Eau De Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Jicky is part of Guerlain's Patrimoine Collection. A collection made of emblematic fragrances, composed for more than a century by 5 generations of Perfumers. These mythical pioneer perfumes compose a unique olfactive library, that the Maison Guerlain endeavours to preserve. Jicky is a magical fragrance that blends sparkling top notes with warm and delicate base notes. At the time of its creation, women may have found Jicky puzzling, but men adopted it immediately. Today, this fresh and vigorous fragrance is the delight of women and men alike. Why the name Jicky? From his student days, Aimé Guerlain kept the enamoured memory of a young woman named Jicky to whom he paid a beautiful homage with one of his most wonderful olfactory creations. By pure coincidence, the diminutive of his nephew Jacques was also Jicky. Designed by Raymond Guerlain, its iconic “inverted heart” bottle is underscored with graceful scrolls typical of Art Nouveau. Its avant-garde stopper, in the form of a hollowed heart, evokes the delicate romanticism of this perfumery masterpiece and represented a real technical feat at the time.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Forte Rosa Rossa Eau de Parfum Refill 200ml
listings.description: The Aqua Allegoria fragrance collection celebrates the wonders of the world. Each creation pays tribute to nature’s beauty and sweeps us up in a discovery of exceptional raw ingredients and notes, beautifully enhanced by our perfumer-explorers. Discover the Rosa Rossa Forte refill format and refill your precious Aqua Allegoria bottle in one simple step. Rosa Rossa Forte, majestically blooming sweet roses bathed in light, paired with a juicy white peach over a deliciously woody base. « Rosa Rossa Forte is a sunset rose, an intense, fruity and velvety rose. » - Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfumer. Aqua Allegoria Forte, the intense collection, is a warm and enveloping journey to the heart of the world’s wonders: Eaux de Parfum celebrating the intense beauty of nature, revealed by the golden rays of a setting sun. The 200 mL refill extends the life cycle of the Aqua Allegoria bottle without compromising on quality. The spray unscrews manually to top up the bottle with a user-friendly refill, fitted with an anti-spill system. It cannot be used alone and is only compatible with refillable 75 mL and 125 mL bottles.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Les Légendaires Samsara Eau De Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Samsara is part of Guerlain’s Legendary fragrance collection. A collection made of emblematic fragrances, composed for more than a century by 5 generations of Perfumers. These mythical pioneer perfumes compose a unique olfactive library, that the Maison Guerlain endeavours to preserve. Samsara is an elixir of seduction for a woman who has found harmony and balance, which is notably conveyed through the composition's raw materials : the sandalwood and a jasmine used only for religious offerings until then. Designed by Raymond Guerlain, its iconic “inverted heart” bottle is underscored with graceful scrolls typical of Art Nouveau. Its avant-garde stopper, in the form of a hollowed heart, evokes the delicate romanticism of this perfumery masterpiece and represented a real technical feat at the time.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Granada Salvia Eau De Toilette 75ml
listings.description: A delicious pomegranate accord transported by the freshness of blackcurrant, cypress, lemon and bergamot notes, with an elegant twist of sage and rose over a white musk, moss and patchouli background. Create your own signature by pairing Granada Salvia with: Bergamote Calabria, Herba Fresca, Rosa Rossa, Flora Cherrysia or Flora Salvaggia. To create your own olfactory signature, select your favourite duo among recommended options and spray each Aqua Allegoria on your skin one by one in equivalent quantities.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Rose Naturelle Intense Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: A modern scent inspired by the strength and spontaneity of nature, infused with the free-spirit of the Chloé woman. Rose Naturelle Intense Eau de Parfum is reminiscent of a serene natural setting, taking you back to the essentials with an organic rose accord and sensuous woody notes. The composition is introduced with fresh nuances of bergamot and neroli. Rose essence intertwines with a sweet, slightly smoky oakwood accord, before diffusing into an intoxicating base of sandalwood and cedar. The feminine fragrance is housed in a vintage-inspired bottle, embellished with a chic recycled ribbon and wrapped in an intense green hue. 100% natural origin ingredients. Vegan.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Le Nectar Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Embodying the true-to-self nature of the Chloé woman, Le Nectar Eau de Parfum captivates with its fresh, ambery fragrance. Rooted in the 1970s spirit that still influences the house, the perfume blends sparkling bergamot with opulent orange blossom and neroli essential oil. At the base, balmy tonka absolute, amber and patchouli create rich, earthy depth. The refillable fragrance is presented in the iconic pleated glass bottle, with an amber hue and golden ribbon.

listings.rawTitle: Baobab Collection Maxi Max Feathers
listings.description: Notes: Black Rose, Oud Wood. The Boabab Collection Max Feathers scented candle is a luxurious addition to any space, captivating the senses with an opulent fragrance. The sensual softness of black rose is infused with the rich depths of oud wood, uplifting your surroundings with a seductive aroma. Crafted with hand-blown glass, the candle features black inlays, enveloping the sides in an elegant feathered effect. Available in various sizes, the candle features an enticing balance of fragrance while the flame will burn in harmony with the indulgently sleek design. Approximate burn times by size: Max 10: 60 hours Max 16: 150 hours Max 24: 400 hours Max 35: 800 hours

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentleman Original Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Make a statement with Givenchy’s Gentleman Original Eau de Toilette, a rich fragrance that represents timeless, masculine seduction. Created in 1975 by Hubert de Givenchy, the scent embodies the confidence and modernity of the Givenchy Gentleman. The EDT is introduced with a spicy elixir of tarragon and cinnamon, instantly invigorating the senses. Patchouli lends the scent a musky aroma, uplifted by earthy vetiver accord. Creating an intoxicating scent trail, the fragrance is grounded in smoky Russian leather.

listings.rawTitle: Baobab Collection Max 10 Sand Siloli
listings.description: Find a scent to savour in the Baobob Collection Max 10 Sand Siloli Candle, a four-wick design that injects luxury into your home. Picture a woodland retreat, where cedar trees rise and the scent of bark lingers in the air. A crisp breeze carries green lemon, cutting through the warmth like sunlight through leaves. Rich tonka bean settles softly, wrapping the forest in sweet, smoky calm. The candle’s scent trail is predominantly woody, brightened by citrus and grounded in creamy vanilla. Note the mysterious yet refreshing glow trail it leaves in your chosen room. Encased in a hand-blown glass, with brown and beige layers that add tonal depth, the design slots into all kinds of décor.

listings.rawTitle: Aromatherapy Associates Revive Pure Essential Oil Blend 10ml
listings.description: Experience the invigorating aromas of Aromatherapy Associates’ Revive Pure Essential Oil Blend. Designed to reenergise, the 100% natural oil blend contains a refreshing mix of grapefruit, bergamot and neroli to help stimulate the senses. Welcome the fragrance into your chosen room by pairing with The Atomiser for diffusion, or add a few drops to your wrists or a warm bath and inhale the rejuvenating scent.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London English Pear & Freesia & English Oak & Hazelnut Scent Layering Gift Set
listings.description: Elevate your fragrance ritual by mastering the art of scent layering. This bundle combines two Jo Malone colognes to curate a fragrance wardrobe tailored to every mood and moment. Set Contents: English Pear & Freesia 30ml A versatile blend of fruit and florals into a light, wearable scent that creates a comforting yet sophisticated essence that is both familiar and distinctive. English Oak & Hazelnut 9ml Dry and slightly smoky, English oak leads the way, its strength softened by the solid, creamy warmth of hazelnut, creating a comforting, harmonious balance.

listings.rawTitle: Baobab Collection Max 24 Arabian Nights
listings.description: Encased in endlessly patterned glass screen printed with 24-karat gold, the Baobab Arabian Nights candle filters its light into a soft, golden glow. More than decoration, it transforms your space into a haven of poetry and comfort. Within unfolds a dance of contrasts as saffron’s radiant fire meets the dark gravity of oud, while incense drapes a smoky veil between them, grounding, uplifting, and deeply evocative. Approximate burn times by size: Max 10: 60 hours Max 16: 150 hours Max 24: 400 hours Max 35: 800 hours

listings.rawTitle: K by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Parfum - 100ml
listings.description: Aromatic, Spicy, Woody Top Notes : Blood Orange, Cardamom, Juniper, Sparkling Citrus. Heart Notes : Geranium, Sage, Lavandin, Fig Nectar. Base Notes : Patchouli, Vetiver, Nagarmotha, Cedar. Feel like royalty with the K by Dolce and Gabbana Eau de Parfum. An aromatic blend of spicy and woody notes, the fragrance captures the effortless elegance and timeless sophistication of the Dolce and Gabbana man. Opening with a citrus and herbaceous fusion of Orange and Juniper, the fragrance uplifts the senses, guiding the mind through an olfactive journey. As the top notes begin to fade, the middle notes take control. Diving into the potent heart, intense hues of Lavandin are seamlessly blended with the aromatic note of Sage, merging to complicate the cologne. Drying down to the earthy base notes, Patchouli, Vetiver and Cedar intertwine to guide the fragrance into its final form. These musky hues mellow the cologne, lingering on the skin to ignite the senses.   Housed in a glass bottle, blue-tinted for optimism. Topped with a silver-tone crown, the cologne cloaks the skin with noble scents.

listings.rawTitle: Baobab Collection Max 16 Sand Sonora
listings.description: Enlighten your evening with a moment of relaxation with the Baobab Sand Sonora candle. Housed in a hand-blown glass, each piece is expertly crafted by skilled artisans, making every candle uniquely its own. A harmonious blend of warmth, joy, and earthiness fills your space, releasing an uplifting yet calming energy. The exotic spice of saffron leads the way, gracefully giving way to the bright cheer of mirth, and finally settling into the deep, grounding embrace of patchouli. Approximate burn times by size: Max 10: 60 hours Max 16: 150 hours Max 24: 400 hours Max 35: 800 hours

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy L'Interdit Rouge Ultime Eau de Parfum 80ml
listings.description: Givenchy opens a new Rouge chapter with the L'Interdit Rouge Ultime Eau de Parfum, a fragrance for women who wish to embark on a new level of sensuality. The daring opening takes a risk with accords of fresh neroli and orange blossom, establishing a citrus beginning but interrupted by sambac jasmine. At its core, tuberose and cocoa shell seduce the fragrance, intertwining for an irresistibly rich heart. Elements of the earth inspire the base with a bouquet of musky patchouli which mingles with evergreen ambroxan and luxurious vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: TRUDON Mortel Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Created by master perfumer Yann Vasnier, Trudon’s Mortel Eau de Parfum is described as a “revolutionary drive that combines virile force and natural harmonies”. The mystical, spicy scent is warm and opulent, blending cistus and incense with a heart of black pepper and myrrh. Presented in a hand-blown glass vessel with a pine green rippled cap, designed by Pauline Deltour to resemble the coveted Cire Trudon scented candles, the genderless perfume is housed within a luxury branded gift box.

listings.rawTitle: TRUDON II Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Reminiscent of evergreen forests and a celebration of the elements, Trudon’s II Eau de Parfum blends earthy notes with rich, aromatic hints. Fusing green leaves, bitter orange and exhilarating pine tones, the scent captures the essence of a crisp breeze. Warmed by juniper and cedarwood, before an incense base lingers with smoky subtlety to deepen the trail, the eau de parfum promises long-lasting projection and power with each spritz.

listings.rawTitle: NEST New York Lychee Rose Eau De Parfum 50 mL/1.7 fl oz.
listings.description: The essence of a summer garden party, captured in scent and bottled in NEST New York’s Lychee Rose Eau De Parfum. Blending fruits and florals, this luminous fragrance builds its signature with a vibrant combination of rose absolute and fresh lychee. Accentuated with notes of pink champagne and just-ripened raspberry, it lingers with a sparkling, radiant trail, that can be worn alone or paired with the brand’s body mists or perfume oils as desired.

listings.rawTitle: NEST New York Lychee Rose Travel Spray 8 mL/.27 fl oz.
listings.description: The essence of a summer garden party, captured in scent and bottled in NEST New York’s travel-sized Lychee Rose Eau De Parfum. Blending fruits and florals, this luminous fragrance builds its signature with a vibrant combination of rose absolute and fresh lychee. Accentuated with notes of pink champagne and just-ripened raspberry, it lingers with a sparkling, radiant trail, that can be worn alone or paired with the brand’s body mists or perfume oils as desired.

listings.rawTitle: Olfactive O Floral Smoke Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Distinguish your scent wardrobe with the Olfactive O Floral Smoke Eau de Parfum – an incisive, award-winning creation that gives florals an otherworldly, unconventional twist. The composition opens with a dynamic burst: black pepper brings a jolt of spice, violet leaf adds a fresh, cut-grass greenness, and orange blossom rounds the trio with its warm, glowing floralcy. As the fragrance evolves, texture deepens; tuberose takes centre stage in the heart, offering its signature voluptuous richness. Imagine a dimly lit atelier at dusk: velvety blooms resting in a crystal vase, soft light catching the petals, and fine tendrils of incense drifting through the room. Narcissus slices through the haze with sharp clarity, while myrrh wraps the middle notes in a smooth, resinous embrace and eases the blend toward its finale.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana The One Eau de Parfum Intense 30ml
listings.description: A fragrance for the unmissable femme fatale, the Dolce & Gabbana The One Eau de Parfum Intense gives your scent rotation the upgrade it truly needs. If you’re drawn to gourmands, spice and florals, this signature olfactive wraps all three into a deliciously multi-faceted experience. It opens with a luminous burst of pink pepper, an immediate spark of warmth and vibrancy that turns heads without overpowering the senses. As the fragrance settles, it melts into a lush heart of jasmine, where creamy petals and warm floral tones ripple with unmistakable femininity. Beneath it all, expect a rich, addictive base of vanilla, giving the EDP its ambery, slightly gourmand signature that lingers long after the first spritz.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Un Jardin en Mediterranee Eau de Toilette Spray 100ml
listings.description: The first in the Parfums-Jardins collection, created in 2003, Un Jardin en Mediterranee eau de toilette evokes a walk through a secret Tunisian garden exuberantly overflowing with trees and flowers. It is an unusual oasis combining olfactory, visual and tactile sensations, by Jean-Claude Ellena.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Man In Black Parfum 200ml Refill
listings.description: Elementally inspired by fire, BVLGARI Man In Black Parfum ignites your scent arsenal with bold intensity. True to BVLGARI’s signature of unexpected contrasts, the fragrance opens with a striking spice accord, fused with elemi essence for a smoky, resinous lift – an aromatic intro that evokes the orange-red glow of flames. A powdery, creamy heart follows, softening the heat with a skin-like sensuality. Anchoring the composition is a base of dark woods and benzoin, their musky, enveloping richness strengthening one another. Sense as they linger in your wake, like drifting embers. The flacon itself is rendered in classic black, finished with gold-tone branding for a strong, decisive flourish.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Man Wood Essence Parfum 60ml
listings.description: Bvlgari Man Wood Essence Parfum is crafted in a way only Bvlgari dares. Being the woodiest creation in the collection, its structure reveals every facet of this natural element: profound, textured, mysterious. Like a wood rooted in the ground, darker and veined with mystery. The intense wood blend accord – patchouli, cedarwood and guaiac wood, among the others - generates a refined ambery olfactive vibrancy that radiates in a masculine elegant aura. The elemental force is part of a deeper inspiration that unites the entire Bvlgari Man collection. At its heart lies the Circle of Nature: a visual and narrative journey through the geometry of nature, capturing the eternal essence of the elements. For Bvlgari Man, the Circle of Nature holds profound meaning. More than just a shape, it’s a timeless and ever-flowing force that governs all life; the eternal essence of nature. The timeless Bvlgari Man bottle translates the inspiration of a darker wood into a more layered visual expression – a dark cap crowns a deep brown glass base that gradually fades into a lighter hue. The removable cap reveals a circular aluminium plate engraved with the BVLGARI BVLGARI logo - reflecting the Circle of Nature concept.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden Sunflowers Edt Spray (100ml)
listings.description: Pure sunshine in a bottle! This fresh and flowery fragrance transports you to a field of tall, bright, swaying sunflowers. Elizabeth Arden Sunflowers Eau de Toilette Spray exudes femininity and will leave you feeling bright and radiant from head to toe. Elizabeth Arden Sunflowers Eau de Toilette Spray contains a sparkling blend of bergamot, melon, peach, jasmine, sandalwood, lemon, rose and moss. This exhilarating combination is uplifting and refreshing, ideal for use during the summer months and perfect for casual or evening wear. This fruity and flowery fragrance will leave you feeling fresh and upbeat.

listings.rawTitle: Baobab Collection Max 24 Pearls Black
listings.description: Notes: Black Rose, Ginger. Adorn your home with the luxurious scent of Baobab’s Pearls Black candle. Elegant and mysteriously seductive, Black Rose is ignited by fiery Ginger. Adding a divine opulence to any space, the fragrance captures the essence of a precious and elusive natural beauty. The hand-poured scented candle is housed in an artisan glass vessel, speckled with flecks of black to mimic the tones of natural pearls. Designed in collaboration with renowned artistic photographer Peter Lippman, the scented candle offers both visual and sensorial appeal, epitomising luxury home fragrance and premium craftsmanship. Approximate burn times by size: Max 10: 60 hours Max 16: 150 hours Max 24: 400 hours Max 35: 800 hours

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Love Eau de Toilette 100ml and Daisy Love Drops Exclusive Bundle
listings.description: Perfect for at-home and on-the-go scenting, Marc Jacobs’ Daisy Love Eau de Toilette and Daisy Love Drops Bundle features the full-sized floral perfume and the new fragrance-filed capsules. Set Contents: Daisy Love Eau de Toilette 100ml A radiant, addictive fragrance that combines fresh and floral accords to create a luxurious olfactive experience. The eau de toilette opens with sweet cloudberries and delicate daisy petals, before settling on a warm base of cashmere musks and clean driftwood to grant a gourmand twist. Daisy Drops Love for Her, 30 Capsules A set of single-dose fragrance capsules designed to conveniently fit in your bag or pocket for any time topping up. Filled with the same luscious scent as the perfume, simply twist, squeeze and apply to the skin for long-lasting freshness.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Arancia Di Capri La Riserva Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Composed through a slow two-month maceration process, the Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Arancia di Capri La Riserva Eau de Parfum 50ml is inspired by Capri’s textured coastline and citrussy aromas. The scent begins with a burst of sunlit citrus thanks to nuances of Italian blood orange and mandarin, brightened by the freshness of petitgrain bigarade. Notes of rosemary and Italian basil weave an aromatic accord, softened by a trace of sea air. As the fragrance settles, cedarwood, ambrettolide and suede emerge, leaving a soft lingering warmth. The deep blue bottle mirrors the strength of the scent, echoing the depths of the Mediterranean itself.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Mirto Di Panarea La Riserva Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Harness the rich landscape of Italy with the Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Mirto Di Panarea La Riserva Eau de Parfum. Coming under the citrus aromatic family, the fragrance opens with a sharp and crisp blast of citrus and green herbs. Cedrat—a variation of lemon—is complemented by earthy green sage and juniper berry essence. This bold introduction is balanced by essences of myrtle, lavender and rich myrrh absolute, taken conceptually from the vegetation of volcanic fields in the region. Cradling the above in the pyramid's base are patchouli and labdanum, distinguishing the sillage with a leathery, lingering depth. The fragrance is crafted using a two-month maceration process, helping to dial up the depth and texture. It's housed in a sea-blue bottle with an Art Deco-inspired label.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Colonia Eau de Cologne 50ml
listings.description: Start each day with a taste of the Mediterranean with Acqua Di Parma’s signature citrus blend, Colonia Eau de Cologne. The zesty aroma bottles up metropolitan life as an awakening aroma. Effortlessly elegant and radiantly refined, the fragrance opens with a cocktail of lemon, orange and bergamot. At its core, a bouquet of lavender, rose and verbena flourishes at the heart for a subtle reminder of the natural world. Vetiver, sandalwood and patchouli bring the scent to life with decadence and sophistication. Crafted with luxury in mind, the fragrance’s flacon celebrates the Art Deco movement with its transparent glass and classic black cap.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Colonia Pura Eau de Cologne 50ml
listings.description: The Acqua di Parma Colonia Pura Eau de Cologne reimagines the house’s classic citrus signature with a fresh perspective. Bright notes of Italian bergamot, orange and petitgrain open the scent, giving way to a heart of jasmine sambac, narcissus and coriander for added depth and warmth. A base of cedarwood, patchouli and musk lends a clean finish. Presented in the brand’s iconic Art Déco-inspired bottle with clear glass and a black cap, the perfume makes a luxurious addition to your collection.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Flora Salvaggia Eau De Toilette Refill 200ml
listings.description: Refill your precious Aqua Allegoria bottle in one simple step with the Flora Salvaggia refill format. A revitalising watermelon note refreshes a wildflower accord tinged with the powdery facets of iris and violet, and illuminated by a bouquet of white flowers. Create your own signature by pairing Flora Salvaggia with: Bergamote Calabria, Rosa Rossa, Granada Salvia or Flora Cherrysia. To create your own olfactory signature, select your favourite duo among recommended options and spray each Aqua Allegoria on your skin one by one in equivalent quantities.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN La Petite Robe Noire Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: In La Petite Robe Noire’s perfume wardrobe, I am the Original Dress. A perfumed creation by Guerlain: An eau de parfum embroidered of the most beautiful "black" notes of perfumery. The legendary "heart-shaped" bottle has been boldly reinterpreted with a modern touch. Its crystalline transparency, fading from black to powdery pink, reveals an iconic little black dress. I am absolutely essential and utterly irresistible. I am the chic and very glamorous perfumed creation by Guerlain. I am La Petite Robe Noire.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Les Légendaires Jardin De Bagatelle Eau De Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Jardins de Bagatelle is part of Guerlain’s Legendary fragrance collection. A collection made of emblematic fragrances, composed for more than a century by 5 generations of Perfumers. These mythical pioneer perfumes compose a unique olfactive library, that the Maison Guerlain endeavours to preserve. Jardins de Bagatelle is for women who always perfume themselves for the pleasure of seduction as well as for their own pleasure and enjoyment. These gardens are redolent with a multitude of white flowers, varieties of rose, hyacinths, daffodils and narcissus of exceptional luminosity, to the great delight of anyone who loves nature. Designed by Raymond Guerlain, its iconic “inverted heart” bottle is underscored with graceful scrolls typical of Art Nouveau. Its avant-garde stopper, in the form of a hollowed heart, evokes the delicate romanticism of this perfumery masterpiece and represented a real technical feat at the time.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Héritage Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Inspired by yesterday's generations, Héritage is a fragrance dedicated to the men of tomorrow. It opens with aromatic freshness, succeeded by the subtlety of a warm spicy accord on a woody dry-down with shades of the Orient. Héritage, for a man who is at once a trustee for tradition and a herald of a new spirit.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Nerolia Vetiver Eau De Toilette 125ml
listings.description: The floral radiance of Calabrian neroli, accentuated by vetiver and refreshed by basil, fused with a delicious fig accord. Create your own signature by pairing Nerolia Vetiver with: Bergamote Calabria, Orange Soleia, Mandarine Basilic or Pera Granita. To create your own olfactory signature, select your favourite duo among recommended options and spray each Aqua Allegoria on your skin one by one in equivalent quantities.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Rosa Rossa Eau De Toilette Refill 200ml
listings.description: Refill your precious Aqua Allegoria bottle in one simple step with the Rosa Rossa refill format. Joyfully diverted by sparkling, fruity notes of blackcurrant and lychee, rose blooms on a creamy, powdery and musky bed of sandalwood. Create your own signature by pairing Rosa Rossa with: Bergamote Calabria, Pera Granita, Flora Cherrysia, Mandarine Basilic, Granada Salvia or Flora Salvaggia. To create your own olfactory signature, select your favourite duo among recommended options and spray each Aqua Allegoria on your skin one by one in equivalent quantities. Rosa Rossa is also available in travel size, to slip into your bag and carry around with you.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Les Légendaires Après L'Ondée Eau De Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Après L'Ondée is part of Guerlain’s Legendary fragrance collection. A collection made of emblematic fragrances, composed for more than a century by 5 generations of Perfumers. These mythical pioneer perfumes compose a unique olfactive library, that the Maison Guerlain endeavours to preserve. Created by Jacques Guerlain in 1906, Après L'Ondée is a celebration of the sunshine after the rain. In this bouquet of powdery flowers, Jacques Guerlain orchestrated its floral note around violet, iris and vanilla nuances. Designed by Raymond Guerlain, its iconic “inverted heart” bottle is underscored with graceful scrolls typical of Art Nouveau. Its avant-garde stopper, in the form of a hollowed heart, evokes the delicate romanticism of this perfumery masterpiece and represented a real technical feat at the time.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Habit Rouge Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Habit Rouge Eau de Toilette is a classic of elegance, glorified by the freshness of citrus notes. Created in 1965, Habit Rouge was the first ambery fragrance for men in perfumery. From the moment of its launch, this tribute to Guerlain's passion for the dressage of horses created an element of surprise with its scents of sensual and bold vanilla. With its modern geometry and mastery of form, Habit Rouge has an eternally elegant French appeal. Habit Rouge embraces a dandy man who dares everything, combining sophistication and refinement. He lives his life fervently and distinguishes himself with a trail of extreme sensuality.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Pamplelune Eau De Toilette Refill 200ml
listings.description: Refill your precious Aqua Allegoria bottle in one simple step with the Pamplelune refill format. The radiant and tangy liveliness of grapefruit elevated by the vibrant, fruity note of blackcurrant bud. The patchouli imbues the scent with its intense sensuality. Create your own signature by pairing Pamplelune with Bergamote Calabria or Orange Soleia. To create your own olfactory signature, select your favourite duo among recommended options and spray each Aqua Allegoria on your skin one by one in equivalent quantities. Pamplelune is also available in travel size, to slip into your bag and carry around with you.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Herba Fresca Eau De Toilette 125ml
listings.description: A note of fresh herbs sparkling with dew and springtime flowers, energised by a bunch of spearmint leaves and connected by a green tea accord. Create your own signature by pairing Herba Fresca with: Bergamote Calabria, Pera Granita, Orange Soleia or Granada Salvia. To create your own olfactory signature, select your favourite duo among recommended options and spray each Aqua Allegoria on your skin one by one in equivalent quantities.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Mon GUERLAIN Sparkling Bouquet Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: The Mon Guerlain fragrances are a fragrant manifesto of today's femininity. A multi-faceted woman: strong, free and sensual. Discover Mon Guerlain Sparkling Bouquet, a smiling fruity fresh amber. The fragrance impression of a radiant personality. A fragrance faceted like a jewel, which revisits Mon Guerlain’s essential ingredients in a fruity and intensely luminous register. The essential lavender-vanilla duo is beautifully enhanced by a sparkling pear note and a luminous Sambac jasmine. A captivating fruity fresh amber sillage with a magnetic charm. "It’s a pear-lavender sorbet which melts onto burnt vanilla." - Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfumer The “quadrilobe” bottle, created in 1908, established itself as one of Guerlain’s iconic bottles. Simple and graphic, it echoes an alchemist’s bottle and owes its name “quadrilobe” to its stopper, which is formed from one piece to obtain a shape resembling four lobes. One century later, beautifully enhanced by a luxurious glass weight and a golden adornment, this bottle offers a contrast between strong taut lines and sensual curves, expressing contemporary femininity.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Shalimar Eau De Toilette 90ml
listings.description: The Eau de Toilette wake is characterised by bergamot, iris and vanilla notes. It leaves an unforgettable memory and embodies skin-caressing sensuality with a hint of the forbidden. Inspired by the passionate love story between an emperor and an Indian princess, Shalimar, which means "temple of love" in Sanskrit, symbolises the promise of eternal love forevermore. It is a fragrance of desire. In 1925, the Shalimar bottle designed by Raymond Guerlain won first prize at the Paris Decorative Arts Exhibition. Its curves were inspired by the basins of the famous Shalimar gardens. The fan stopper with its sapphire transparency recalls the garden's eternally gushing water.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Vétiver Eau De Toilette 150ml
listings.description: In the 1950s, the Guerlain family decided to create a fragrance based on the surprising roots of vetiver. After a few trials, the Guerlain Perfumer succeeded in making a subtle dosage that recalls the exhalations of the earth in the pale dawn light. This evocation of the world's first morning is enriched with a woody accord and the refined elegance of spices and tobacco to give rise to a rare and sophisticated fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Aqua Allegoria Granada Salvia Eau De Toilette Refill 200ml
listings.description: Refill your precious Aqua Allegoria bottle in one simple step with the Granada Salvia refill format. listings.rawTitle: Fresh Sugar Lychee Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: The Sugar Lychee Eau de Parfum is a luscious scent offering from Fresh that offers a moment of serenity with each spritz. The warm fragrance is reminiscent of the soothing aroma left in the atmosphere after a spring shower, marrying fresh grapefruit, lychee and lime blossom with delicate florals. Balanced against rich nuances of amber and tonka bean, the lightweight scent exudes elegance. The packaging is simple yet sophisticated. Housed in an apothecary-style glass bottle, the flacon is a stylish addition to your fragrance collection.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Electric Cherry Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: The TOM FORD Electric Cherry Eau de Parfum is far from sugary-sweet. Instead, it delivers a vibrant, energising scent that blends bold florals with sharp, juicy notes for a fragrance that instantly enlivens the senses. At its heart, rich morello cherry steps into the spotlight, lifted by the fiery kick of ginger extract. Jasmine sambac adds a lush, seductive floral layer, while ambrettolide brings a soft, musky warmth that lingers on the skin. Pink peppercorn introduces a spark of spice, balanced by the creamy smoothness of pistachio extract. The result is a daring, sensual fragrance with undeniable femme-fatale energy.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Taormina Orange Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Inspired by Sicily’s radiant coastline, TOM FORD's Taormina Orange Eau de Parfum brings a citrus breath of fresh air to your fragrance rotation. Spicy-bright in character, blood orange and cardamom oil open the scent for a bold first impression. As the minutes pass, an orange blossom accord gently softens the trail, reminiscent of Taormina’s idyllic, petal-laden hilltop. You'll detect essences of patchouli and oakmoss in the dry-down, chosen for their earthy-green allure. The final impression is undeniably alfresco, like an Ionian wind drifting through citrus groves.

listings.rawTitle: NEST New York Indigo Travel Spray 8 mL/.27 fl oz.
listings.description: Inspired by the founder's 1992 trip to Europe, NEST New York's Indigo Eau de Parfum is an exploration of the Mediterranean, bursting with fruits and spices. The fragrance blends Italian lemon, orange bergamot, Moroccan tea, cashmere woods, and wild figs from the South of France, offering a moment of bliss with every spritz.

listings.rawTitle: Miu Miu Eau Bleue Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Spring may be its muse, but the Miu Miu L’Eau Bleue Eau de Parfum wears beautifully year-round, imparting fresh and floral notes wherever you go. Picture a sun-dappled morning in a Parisian garden. The fragrance opens with the crisp sparkle of lily of the valley, a bell flower essence that crops up consistently in the French label's flacons and perfumes. Violet leaf blooms at the heart, luminous and verdant, adding a cool, elegant lift. Anchored by a textured core of white musk, the drydown hums with a woody trail that lingers softly in the air. The bottle is a turquoise matelassé glass flacon adorned with a pastel yellow disc – an extra luxe flourish to the design.

listings.rawTitle: Moschino Toy 2 Eau de Parfum Vapo 100ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Floral - Woody Top Notes: Mandarin, Magnolia, Granny Smith Apple. Heart Notes: Jasmine Petals, Peony, White Currant. Base Notes: Amber Wood, Sandalwood, Crystalline Musk. Moschino Toy 2 Eau de Parfum is a unique second edition of the brand's iconic teddy bear fragrance. A floral and woody perfume, it opens with a burst of crisp granny smith apple, nestled amongst a bouquet of magnolia and mandarin. Its velvety heart welcomes a splash of elegant jasmine petals enhanced with notes of peony and white currant. The sparkling and vivacious EDP surrenders to a warm, woody dry-down powered by amber wood and sandalwood to create extra body, plus crystalline musk for added radiance and softness. Housed in a distinctive teddy bear-shaped bottle made from transparent glass with opaque finishing touches and gold collar.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London English Pear & Freesia Cologne 30ml
listings.description: Inspired by modern British culture, Jo Malone London creates bespoke and luxurious fragrances synonymous with quintessential British style. Jo Malone London English Pear and Freesia Cologne is the epitome of autumn. The sensuous eau de toilette opens with the mellow freshness of just-ripe Pear cocooned in a blossom of cool white Freesias, an accord that lends the EDT a delicate yet distinctive scent. Patchouli, a deep, woody note, takes hold at the base to create a sensual, timeless and lasting cologne. Arrives in the brand's iconic cream box with ribbon accent.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Grapefruit Cologne - 100ml
listings.description: Transport your senses to the shores of coastal Spain, as the scent of sun-drenched grapefruit groves fills the air.  Jo Malone London's Grapefruit Cologne  opens with luminous, fresh notes of Grapefruit to provide an invigorating zest. A fresh, herbal heart of Rosemary entwines accents of Lavender, Camphor and Mint to add an aromatic clarity to this sunny fragrance. A base of dewy moss cushions the fragrance in an earthy warmth. Truly uplifting, this cologne expertly blends herbal and citrus notes to brighten your spirits.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Grapefruit Cologne - 30ml
listings.description: Transport your senses to the shores of coastal Spain, as the scent of sun-drenched grapefruit groves fills the air.  Jo Malone London's Grapefruit Cologne  opens with luminous, fresh notes of Grapefruit to provide an invigorating zest. A fresh, herbal heart of Rosemary entwines accents of Lavender, Camphor and Mint to add an aromatic clarity to this sunny fragrance. A base of dewy moss cushions the fragrance in an earthy warmth. Truly uplifting, this cologne expertly blends herbal and citrus notes to brighten your spirits.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Honeysuckle & Davana Cologne - 30ml
listings.description: If the Honeysuckle & Davana Cologne by luxury fragrance house Jo Malone London were a colour, it would be yellow, warmed with sunshine. Bright and spirited, with a scent that evokes a dreamy spring day in the rolling green hills of the picturesque British countryside, the floral perfume fuses the fruity, liquorice tang of Davana with the sweet twist of quintessentially English flower Honeysuckle. The brainchild of master perfumer Anne Flipo and Jo Malone’s Celine Roux, the cologne expertly encapsulates bucolic nuances with an undercurrent of Moss, recalling the verdant scent of undergrowth dew with fresh rain, lending an earthy and woody cushion that balances with perfection. Presented in an elegant glass flacon, crowned with a silver lid, the eau de parfum arrives in Jo Malone’s signature cream box, embellished with a satin black bow.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Lime Basil & Mandarin Cologne 100ml
listings.description: The Lime Basil and Mandarin Cologne is a signature fragrance from Jo Malone. Quintessentially British and luxurious, Jo Malone has gained a global presence for its elegant scents. This fragrance perfectly blends citrus and herbal hues, revealing a unique scent which is both revitalising and relaxing. Cool and confident, this fragrance evokes a Caribbean breeze, transporting you to a world of calm. Drying down to the base note of Amberwood, the cologne leaves you with a comforting presence, familiar and warming.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Wood Sage & Sea Salt Cologne - 100ml
listings.description: Breathe in the sea breeze with the Jo Malone London Wood Sage and Sea Salt Cologne, bringing the ocean closer to home. Aromatic and musky, ambrette seeds evoke a sandy shore pebbled with pearly stones and shells. Classic sea salt gives the fragrance its unique character and texture, freshening the scent like a rolling wave crashing against a towering cliff. Underneath the spray, sage’s earthiness ties together every note, linking the airy mist back to its roots in the seabed. With a woody intensity but playful heart, this cologne uplifts and revitalises your senses.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez Narciso Poudrée Eau de Parfum - 30ml
listings.description: Capture the allure of attraction with the Narciso Rodriguez Narciso Poudrée Eau de Parfum. The blush-pink bottle reflects the sensuality of skin, mirroring the fragrance’s seductive rendezvous between velvety jasmine, warming wood and powdery musc. Tender top notes of jasmine and Bulgarian rose are scattered like fallen petals over a mysterious base of white and black cedars and vetiver. Unified by a powdery musk heart, this alluring EDP encapsulates the intimate appeal of bare skin, in an elegant feminine fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Poppy & Barley Eau de Cologne 100ml
listings.description: Brought back by popular demand, the Jo Malone Poppy and Barley Eau de Toilette originally starred as a limited-edition scent in the 2018 English Fields collection. The fragrance features a fruity-floral blend, calmed with a tender and skin-like powdery warmth. Evocative of red poppies dancing in the wind among strands of barley and bran, this inviting scent is complemented with fruity accords of blackcurrant and softened with powdery notes of white musk. The poppy is a quintessential symbol of the English countryside, its inherent fragility cocooned by stable barley and bran. The scent combines Red Rose and green notes to evoke the vibrant colours of the poppy field and the living landscape of a harvest summer. Fig, Blackcurrant and Violet notes add a youthful sweetness, soothed by a Bran Absolute to emulate the nourishing warmth of the barely fields. White Musk adds a cotton-like softness for a light, powdery dry down. This inviting scent emulates the aesthetically vibrant appeal of the poppy fields and the soft texture of barely, to transport your senses to a summers day in rural England.

listings.rawTitle: OUAI North Bondi Eau De Parfum
listings.description: Floral; Aromatic Top Notes: Bergamot, Apple Blossom, Raspberry, Italian Lemon. Heart Notes: Rose de Mai, Jasmine, Violet. Base Notes: Patchouli, Sandalwood, White Musk. Soak up the seductive scent of Australia’s beaches with OUAI’s North Bondi EDP ; a nuanced blend of rich florals and sheer white musk, inspired by the meeting of the city and the sea at Sydney’s Bondi Beach. Bursting open with a citrusy wave of crisp and tangy fruit notes that expertly blends Bergamot and Apple Blossom with Sicilian Lemon and Raspberry, the fragrance bleeds into a heart of rich floral blossoms. Hints of Rose, Jasmine and Violet are engulfed by a musky-earthy backdrop of Patchouli, Sandalwood and White Musk, leaving behind an intoxicating sillage.

listings.rawTitle: Elie Saab Le Parfum in White Eau de Parfum - 30ml
listings.description: Created for life’s most special occasions, ELIE SAAB Le Parfum In White Eau de Parfum is a radiant floral-fruity fragrance that captures elegance and femininity.  Sparkling mandarin and red fruits blend with a bouquet of jasmine, orange blossom and juicy peach, before settling into a sensual trail of white musks and patchouli. Perfect for weddings, celebrations and evening events, the scent leaves a luminous impression. The fragrance is housed in a jewel-inspired bottle, adorned with deep ivory tones and golden accents for a luxurious finishing touch.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Luna Rossa Black Eau de Parfum - 50ml
listings.description: Amber Top Notes: Bergamot. Heart Notes: Angelica, Patchouli. Base Notes: Amber, Coumarin, Musk. Inspired by the Prada Luna Rossa sailing challenge, the Prada Luna Rossa Black Eau de Parfum invites endless possibilities for exploration, whether within the cityscape or outdoors. The vivacious fragrance opens with an electrifying citrus note of Bergamot to evoke the thrill of the competition. The scent reveals a woody heart of Angelica and Patchouli to bring the senses back to nature. A rich, sophisticated base of Amber, Coumarin, Musk lingers to create a sensual appeal. This exhilarating masculine scent boasts an expert blend that slowly builds and crashes with seductive energy to create an unforgettable impression.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Luna Rossa Black Eau de Parfum - 100ml
listings.description: Amber Top Notes: Bergamot. Heart Notes: Angelica, Patchouli. Base Notes: Amber, Coumarin, Musk. Inspired by the Prada Luna Rossa sailing challenge, the Prada Luna Rossa Black Eau de Parfum invites endless possibilities for exploration, whether within the cityscape or outdoors. This exhilarating masculine scent boasts an expert blend that slowly builds and crashes with seductive energy to create an unforgettable impression.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Candy Eau de Parfum - 80ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Amber Gourmand Top Note: White Musk. Heart Note: Benzoin. Base Note: Caramel Accord. The Prada Candy Eau de Parfum is a feminine fragrance, offering a unique medley of bewitching notes. Beginning with the soft florals of white musk, the EDP is awakened with an elegant aroma that melts into the seductive heart of benzoin. The top notes are complimented with the succulent base of caramel, captivating the senses with an enticing sweetness. This eccentric infusion forms a scent reminiscent of the fearless and bold nature of the Prada woman.

listings.rawTitle: Prada La Femme Eau de Parfum - 100ml
listings.description: Floral; Woody Top Notes: Frangipani, Honey. Heart Notes: Tuberose, Ylang-Ylang. Base Notes: Vetiver, Vanilla. A call to feel richly and deeply, Prada La Femme Eau de Parfum  is an emotive fragrance that shifts through an expressive olfactory journey. Taking you by the hand, the scent leads you through fields lined with Frangipani’s unconventional wake, weaving through stems of Ylang-Ylang and Tuberose along the way. Layered with smooth Beeswax and creamy Vanilla, a sumptuous velvety texture wraps around the senses, settling into Vetiver’s comforting soils as a woody afterthought. Like a faraway land, the perfume’s solar luminosity glows in a golden warmth, mirrored by its honeyed colour that’s housed in a luxurious bottle and white box.

listings.rawTitle: Prada L'Homme L'Eau Eau de Toilette - 100ml
listings.description: Woody; Green; Floral Top Notes: Mandarin Essence, Green Notes. Heart Notes: Iris, Red Ginger, Neroli. Base Notes: Amber, Sandalwood. Fresh, crisp and verdant, with juxtaposing hints of spice and discreet warm undercurrents, Italian luxe fashion house Prada’s L’Homme L’Eau de Toilette  boasts a harmoniously balanced composition that’s clean and contemporary. Pulling you in with spirited head notes of citrus and leafy accords, the men’s fragrance bleeds into an intoxicating heart of powdery blossoms tinged with a zap of energising Ginger, before delving into a prolonged resinous base of Amber and Sandalwood. Light and airy, yet highly sensual and provocative, the eau de toilette bedazzles the senses with unanticipated contradictions. Bottled in a curved glass flacon bearing the original brand logo and wrapped in pale blue saffiano leather. Made in Spain.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau D'Issey Pour Homme Wood & Wood Eau de Parfum Intense - 50ml
listings.description: Cloak your skin in the inviting scent of the Issey Miyake L'Eau D'Issey Pour Homme Wood & Wood Eau de Parfum Intense. Inspired by the rich and comforting hues of the mighty oak, the fragrance is punctuated with potent notes. The opening of Grapefruit is both invigorating and uplifting, a zingy fragrance to attract attention. Next, the fragrance makes way for the woody heart, as notes of Cedar and Sandal fuse to intensify the perfume. Finally, the base of Patchouli finishes the fragrance with a musky aroma, enveloping the skin while seducing the senses. Housed in a sleek and sophisticated tinted glass bottle, topped with a woody cap.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana The One for Men Eau de Parfum - 50ml
listings.description: Spicy Woody Top Notes : Neroli, Cypress, Cardamom. Heart Notes : Musky Cashmeran. Base Notes : Leather, Patchouli, Cistus Labdanum. Enhancing the original fragrance, The Only One for Men Intense Eau de Parfum from Dolce & Gabbana captures masculine elegance. The spicy, aromatic opening has a faint but underlying sweetness, a wonderful contradiction that entices the room’s attention. Drying down to the hypnotic heart, the musky impression of this accord oozes confidence and charisma, complicating the cologne. Finally, the indulgent base of Leather is woody and smoky, enveloping the skin with its seductive powers. Housed in a sleek black bottle embellished with touches of gold, the effortless elegance of this scent is reflected in the exterior.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana The Only One Eau de Parfum Intense - 30ml
listings.description: Floral Top Notes : Italian Mandarin, Crispy Green Apple, Neroli Essence. Heart Notes : Orange Blossom, Jasmine, Coconut. Base Notes : Dark Vanilla, Cedarwood, Cashmere. Mysterious and enticing, The Only One Intense Eau de Parfum from Dolce & Gabbana captures the room’s attention. Housed in a sleek black bottle, elegant yet understated, this fragrance seduces the senses, symbolizing the indefinable allure of a confident woman. Drawing you in, the fragrance opens with the fresh notes of Mandarin and Apple, enhancing the cologne with an exhilarating aroma. Diving into the heart, a seamless blend of Orange Blossom, Coconut and Jasmine intensifies the perfume, creamy and comforting. Finally, the enigmatic base of Dark Vanilla and Cedarwood creates a captivating aura, enveloping the skin with its mesmerizing scent.

listings.rawTitle: Tiffany & Co. & Love for Her Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Top Notes:  Blue Basil, Blackcurrant, Grapefruit. Middle Notes:  Neroli, Jasmine, Tuberose Flower. Base Notes:  Blue Sequoia, Vetiver, Cedarwood. Like a timeless piece of jewellery,  Tiffany & Co Love for Her Eau de Parfum  is a tribute to modern love, enduring and complex. Blue Sequoia unifies the jewellery makers’ luxurious fragrance collection, a vibrant woody note that evokes an effortless elegance. Created by renowned perfumers Honorine Blanc and Marie Salamagne, ‘Love for Her’ is a floral, woody scent. The scent opens with diamond-like twinkling notes such as Blue Basil, exclusively developed for Tiffany. Paired with bright Grapefruit, this botanical creates a crisp and refreshing opening. At the heart of the scent, a sweet floral bouquet of Neroli blends with Blue Sequoia to inspire romance. A rich, woody base of Vetiver and Cedarwood deepen the fragrance to create a sophisticated, feminine composition.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Her London Dream Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Lemon, Fresh Ginger. Middle Notes: Rose, Peony. Base Notes : Musk, Amber. Capture the beauty of a creative metropolis with the Burberry Her London Dream Eau de Parfum. Quintessentially British, Burberry reflects the excitement of London life with an uplifting accord.  Inspired by those dream-like moments in romance and love, the fragrance is effortlessly natural, spectacularly fresh and truly fabulous. Sparkling and hopeful, the perfume opens with vibrant notes of Lemon and Fresh Ginger, invigorating the senses and bursting with joy. Giving way to the floral heart notes of Rose and Peony, the bouquet at the centre of this fragrance defines the perfume. Paying homage to the Burberry girl attitude, the fragrance looks to inspire beauty and celebrate freedom, creating a perfume that is impossible to forget. Finally, the fragrance dries down to the woody notes of musk and amber, a comforting accord that invites the room’s attention. Housed in an elegant bottle, with a pale gold tint to represent the understated sophistication of the perfume.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Explorer Eau de Parfum 60ml
listings.description: Discover an invitation to adventure with the Explorer Eau de Parfum as the scent summons you on an aromatic journey. The olfactory expedition opens with Italian bergamot. Lavish and opulent, the citrus fruit evokes mystery and suspense for the adventure ahead. Adding to the luxury of this fragrance, vetiver from Haiti expands geographic horizons with a rich, evergreen twist. Deep, musky patchouli from Indonesia settles for a taste of exclusivity, revealing a lust for adventure with its earthy trail. The bottle imitates the earth’s two hemispheres, recalling the destinations embarked on by the fragrance. Montblanc’s star emblem rests at the bottom, representing the six glaciers of the highest mountain in Europe.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Explorer Eau de Parfum 100ml

listings.rawTitle: Bon Parfumeur 701 Eucalyptus Coriander Cypress Eau de Parfum - 15ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Grapefruit, Bergamot, Pineapple. Heart Notes: Pepper, Rosemary, Eucalyptus, Nutmeg. Base Notes: Incense, Liatris, White Wood, Amber. Captivate everybody you meet with Bon Parfumeur’s ‘701’ Eucalyptus, Coriander and Cypress Eau de Parfum. The intoxicating fragrance opens with notes of tangy Grapefruit, juicy Bergamot and fun-loving Pineapple, allowing the amalgamation to create a whimsically fruity cocktail that is guaranteed to enchant and charm. The hearts notes of the perfume reveal a simmering spiciness, with scents of fiery Pepper, herby Rosemary, potent Eucalyptus and Nutmeg contrasting delightfully with the crispness of the top notes. Aromatic and sensual, the fragrance reaches a dramatically smouldering crescendo, with base notes of hypnotic Incense, Liatris, delicate White Wood and sweet Amber. The blend exudes empowerment and an authentic sense of self, making it ideal for the person that knows exactly who they are and wants to express that in a daring, explorative way. The olfactory journey takes an unexpected and thrilling turn with a secret, hidden note of Cannabis, which is only detectable to some.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Explorer Eau de Parfum 200ml
listings.description: Woody Aromatic Top Notes:  Bergamot, Pomarose®, Sage Heart Notes:  Vetiver, Leather, Sandalwood Base Notes:  Patchouli, Ambrofix, Akigalawood® Built around values of tradition, passion, art, handcrafting and precision, luxury brand  Montblanc  introduces the  Explorer Eau de Parfum . This fragrance provides an invitation to a fantastic journey and an irresistible call for adventure. The Eau de Parfum opens with vivavious top notes of Pomarose®, Sage and Bergamot revealing the bright, energetic and optimistic side of the fragrance’s heart.  Providing an unexpected contrast to the fresh opening, the woody and aromatic fragrance urges the senses to journey to the luscious, vast landscapes of South-Western Hati, with rich notes of Vetiver, along with Sandalwood and Leather to create a rugged yet contemporary appeal. In the base, Indonesian Patchouli invites us along a mysterious trail deep into the rainforest, complemented by notes of Ambrofix and Akigalawood®.  This unconventional fragrance is housed in a sleek bottle, crafted from thick glass to give a premium finish. The design echoes the earth’s two hemispheres, recalling the multiple destinations explored during this olfactory expedition. The brand’s iconic star emblem rests at the bottom of the bottle, representing the six glaciers of the highest mountain in Europe. Wrapped in a saffiano leather-effect sleeve, the bottle is finished with a gunmetal-effect cap, inspired by vintage cars. These premium details further evidence the brand’s commitment to craftsmanship of the highest quality. Discover Explorer Eau de Parfum and embrace the power of man and nature. Adventure knows no limits. Winner of Best New Male Fragrance* *COPRA 2020

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Absolus Allegoria Cuir Intense - Eau de Pafum Gift Set
listings.description: Discover this limited edition gift set with two Guerlain must-haves. Adorned in an enchanting, deep purple design, this year’s set is a true ode to elegance, to offer or to cherish. Set Contents: Absolus Allegoria Cuir Intense Eau de Parfum 125ml Cuir Intense steps into the secrecy of the night to reveal leather’s true power and contrasts. While cedar, sandalwood and tobacco notes underscore leather’s darkest accents, Osmanthus accord bring out its soft light. Absolus Allegoria Santal Royal Hair Mist 40ml Santal Royal Hair Mist elegantly perfumes hair, leaving a sensual lingering scent true to Santal Royal Eau de Parfum. It unfolds in a play of subtle contrasts between dark leather notes, the oud accord and the luminosity of floral notes of jasmine and rose.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera La Bomba Intensa Eau de Parfum Refillable 50ml
listings.description: Housed in Carolina Herrera’s iconic butterfly bottle, La Bomba Intensa Eau de Parfum celebrates all things free-spirited and fearless with its floral-amber blend. Combining a joyful energy with refined elegance, this fragrance calls upon notes of juicy wild berries to open, before melting into a soft petalled heart of orchid. What lingers in the dry down is a bold red amber signature, powerful yet comforting, luring the senses in with its confident and effortlessly magnetic allure. The 50ml bottle arrives in a refillable format.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier La Favorite Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Unveiling an intense and addictive amber floral signature, the Jean Paul Gaultier La Favorite Eau de Parfum is a spectacular scent blend for the bold. Sensual yet sophisticated, this fragrance balances a radiant Queen of the Night note with the rich, liquor-like depth of benzoin. Melting into a vanilla-amber dry down, tonka bean underpins the perfume with its creamy composition, lingering long after you first spritz. Housed in an iconic JPG flacon, this fragrance is sure to take pride of place on your dresser and solidify itself as a firm favourite.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne 1 Million Black Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: An icon reimagined. Rabanne reinvents its heritage with an amber-woody twist, writing a bold new chapter with 1 Million Black Eau de Parfum. Promising an amplified trail for up to 48 hours, this fragrance captures the magnetism and allure of ebony woods paired with creamy vanilla. Rich and sensual, it's spiked with vibrant tropical fruits that cut through the warmth with a fresh contrast, leaving a sillage that carries you from day to night.

At the base, rich vanilla creates the unapologetically feminine signature that's impossible to resist. Arriving with a seductive new statement in bold red, the bottle is adorned with the iconic diamond-inspired gem.

listings.rawTitle: Estée Lauder Glimmer Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: A sparkling blend by Estée Lauder, the Glimmer Eau de Parfum uplifts the senses with a radiant amber-floral aroma. Opening with a bright rosy raspberry blend, the fragrance delivers a freshness that develops into a warmer, more enveloping scent. In the heart, notes of macaron rose, vanilla bean and cashmeran shimmer with a smooth, skin-like softness, before a base of patchouli, amber and tonka bean mingle with cosy woods and a whisper of sweetness. Made for life and all its memorable moments, let this addictive eau de parfum wrap the senses in its luminous sillage.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN L’Heure Bleue - Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Between day and night, a deep blue embraces the sky: it is the blue hour. A moment with an electrifying effect, when everything shifts and anything becomes possible. Inspired by this natural phenomenon, L’Heure Bleue Eau de Parfum captures the scent of the sky in this moment suspended in time. An amber floral perfume with an addictive fragrance trail. The crystalline freshness of the sky meets the velvety softness of iris and vanilla. An invitation to make every moment a “blue hour”: an hour when anything is possible. “I wanted to capture the blue hour with the same tenderness as Jacques Guerlain’s L’Heure Bleue in 1912. It’s a perfume that enfolds us in its powerful yet gentle and intimate scent”, Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Director of Perfume Creation and Perfumer. A real Guerlain icon, the inverted heart bottle – the original bottle for L’Heure Bleue in 1912 – has now been revisited. Adorned in a gradation of blue, like a fragment of sky between day and night, it is distinguished by its name in gold lettering. A jewel bottle, fashioned with precision and topped with a ring embellished with blue. A precious object designed to be refilled and stand the test of time.
