A real Guerlain icon, the inverted heart bottle – the original bottle for L’Heure Bleue in 1912 – has now been revisited. Adorned in a gradation of blue, like a fragment of sky between day and night, it is distinguished by its name in gold lettering. A jewel bottle, fashioned with precision and topped with a ring embellished with blue. A precious object designed to be refilled and stand the test of time. The 200ml refill extends the life of your L’Heure Bleue bottle without compromising on quality. The spray can be unscrewed by hand, allowing the bottle to be easily refilled using a user-friendly, anti-drip system. This refill cannot be used on its own. It is compatible with the rechargeable L’Heure Bleue bottles in 30ml, 50ml, and 100ml formats.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN L’Heure Bleue - Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Between day and night, a deep blue embraces the sky: it is the blue hour. A moment with an electrifying effect, when everything shifts and anything becomes possible. Inspired by this natural phenomenon, L’Heure Bleue Eau de Parfum captures the scent of the sky in this moment suspended in time. An amber floral perfume with an addictive fragrance trail. The crystalline freshness of the sky meets the velvety softness of iris and vanilla. An invitation to make every moment a “blue hour”: an hour when anything is possible. “I wanted to capture the blue hour with the same tenderness as Jacques Guerlain’s L’Heure Bleue in 1912. It’s a perfume that enfolds us in its powerful yet gentle and intimate scent”, Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Director of Perfume Creation and Perfumer. A real Guerlain icon, the inverted heart bottle – the original bottle for L’Heure Bleue in 1912 – has now been revisited. Adorned in a gradation of blue, like a fragment of sky between day and night, it is distinguished by its name in gold lettering. A jewel bottle, fashioned with precision and topped with a ring embellished with blue. A precious object designed to be refilled and stand the test of time.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Veggies Cologne Trio (Worth £177)
listings.description: A trio of in-season fragrances from the veggie patch. Three limited-edition colognes: vibrant Scarlet Beetroot, smooth Velvety Butternut and delightful Carrot Blossom. Exclusive Saving. Worth £177, Yours for £150.

listings.rawTitle: Miu Miu Miutine Intense Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Discover a new chapter of Miutine with the Miu Miu Miutine Intense Eau de Parfum. The bold berry floral fragrance evolves the original scent into a richer dimension with an intense blackberry nectar. The fragrance opens with vibrant top notes of blackberry accord, before unfurling a heart of gardenia and a rich base of bourbon vanilla infusion. The result is a bold, effervescent scent, perfect for seasonal styling. A tribute to Miu Miu's iconic bordeaux matelassé leather handbags, the burgundy lacquered bottle echoes the luxury and deep berry notes of the fragrance within.

listings.rawTitle: Estée Lauder Glimmer Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: A sparkling blend by Estée Lauder, the Glimmer Eau de Parfum uplifts the senses with a radiant amber-floral aroma. Opening with a bright rosy raspberry blend, the fragrance delivers a freshness that develops into a warmer, more enveloping scent. In the heart, notes of macaron rose, vanilla bean and cashmeran shimmer with a smooth, skin-like softness, before a base of patchouli, amber and tonka bean mingle with cosy woods and a whisper of sweetness. Made for life and all its memorable moments, let this addictive eau de parfum wrap the senses in its luminous sillage.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy L'interdit Elixir Eau de Parfum 80ml
listings.description: Givenchy L’Interdit Elixir Eau de Parfum is a floral, woody gourmand fragrance that opens with the dark, indulgent sweetness of black cherry. As the scent unfolds, the iconic white floral bouquet of orange blossom, tuberose and jasmine sambac brings a luminous, sensual contrast. Deep and intense, notes of rum, davana and vanilla add a warm, addictive richness, leaving a captivating trail on the skin. Housed in a jewel-like bottle inspired by a ruby, the fragrance makes a lasting impression from first spritz to final dry-down.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Her Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Top Notes : Blackcurrant, Blueberry, Raspberry. Heart Notes : Jasmine Accord, Violet Accord. Base Notes : White Woods, Musk, Dry Amber. Quintessentially British, Burberry presents the Her Eau de Parfum. The first Gourmand perfume from this classic brand, the fragrance is so sweet you could eat it, seamlessly blended with fruity and floral notes. Opening with a burst of berries, the perfume invigorates the senses, as the vibrant fruits complement one another. Diving into the delicate heart of Violet and Jasmine, the fragrance is filled with a bouquet of beauty, simultaneously rich and gentle. Finally, the perfume dries down into the woody notes of Amber and Musk, darkening the accord with a potent base. Bold and full of life, this exhilarating perfume captures the excitement of city life, the bustling nature of London and the thrilling centre of a creative metropolis. Housed in a pale pink glass bottle, the fragrance is luxurious but understated, gently elegant and powerfully potent.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Fame Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Crafted in France, Rabanne’s Fame Eau de Parfum captures the magnetism of Parisian nights and the allure that surrounds the city. Sophisticated yet playful, the fragrance imparts an intense woody chypre scent with a soft jasmine heart, striking the perfect balance between fierce and feminine. The contemporary eau de pafum begins its olfactive adventure with juicy nuances of bergamot, tantalising the senses with a sumptuous, slightly citrusy aroma. Precious jasmine melts into a hypnotic incense, musk and sandalwood base, closing the trail with hints of smoked amber richness. The golden elixir arrives in a one-of-a-kind bottle, a figurine dressed in black and gold chainmail couture, making the eau de parfum the perfect centrepiece on any dresser.

listings.rawTitle: Estée Lauder Glimmer Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: A sparkling blend by Estée Lauder, the Glimmer Eau de Parfum uplifts the senses with a radiant amber-floral aroma. Opening with a bright rosy raspberry blend, the fragrance delivers a freshness that develops into a warmer, more enveloping scent. In the heart, notes of macaron rose, vanilla bean and cashmeran shimmer with a smooth, skin-like softness, before a base of patchouli, amber and tonka bean mingle with cosy woods and a whisper of sweetness. Made for life and all its memorable moments, let this addictive eau de parfum wrap the senses in its luminous sillage.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Fame The Couture Edition Eau de Parfum 80ml
listings.description: Dressed in a high-fashion furred ensemble, Rabanne’s Fame The Couture Edition Eau de Parfum captures the addictive allure of Parisian night-life, fast-paced yet sophisticated with a touch of sensual energy. Joining the Fame family, the fragrance reveals your most seductive side, oozing with notes of smoked incense, balmy vanilla and vibrant iris, brushing the senses just like soft fur on the skin. Its limited-edition amber-floral scent trail lingers to create a memorable olfactive signature, demanding the attention of all those nearby and stealing the spotlight for all the right reasons.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre L'Eau Nue Parfum de Peau 90ml
listings.description: The first alcohol-free Parfum de Peau by Yves Saint Laurent, Libre L'Eau Nue Parfum de Peau is a cocktail of fruity-floral accords for you to delight in. Layered with mandarin, lavender, and orange blossom, this oil-based fragrance offers a luxe take on zingy, citrusy themes. The sun-kissed scent recalls sultry evenings spent on Mediterranean sands, gracing the skin with a compellingly juicy aroma and a radiant glow. A slight herbaceous touch keeps it sophisticated without toning down the inherent vibrance. Allow the scent to diffuse into a romantic, dimensional bouquet as you go about your day, spraying it in your hair too for a complete sensorial experience.

listings.rawTitle: K by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Top Notes:  Blood Orange and   Sicilian Lemon. Heart Notes:  Clary Sage, Geranium and Lavender. Base Notes:  Cedarwood, Vetiver, Patchouli. Own your crown with  K by Dolce & Gabbana Eau de Toilette.  Designed to embody the scent of the modern-day man, and the strength and passion he exudes as he cares for his family and blazes his own trail. Infused with energising Blood Orange, the reassuring, dependable scent of Clary Sage juxtaposed with sweet Patchouli, this fragrance is for the man who isn’t afraid to show his vulnerable side. Regally finished with a bejewelled crown, handcrafted with 24-carat gold particles, this majestic bottle is a constant reminder of the king you truly are.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy L'Interdit Eau de Parfum Rouge 80ml
listings.description: Housed inside an enticingly elegant bottle rests a fragrant lacquer that glows red from within. The Givenchy L'Interdit Eau de Parfum Rouge captures the essence of passion, obsession and thrill, symbolised by a scorched flower. Illuminating top notes of blood orange and red spice intertwine with a bouquet of orange blossom and sambac jasmine. The smouldering scent settles on a rich base of sandalwood and patchouli, leaving a provocative trail of spicy accords.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Intense Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Intensify your fragrance with the Yves Saint Laurent Libre Intense perfume. Fuelled by fierce sensuality, the perfume is a celebration of tension, merging seemingly disparate notes to create a totally unique scent. Taken from the French word for free, the parfum is inspired by YSL’s dedication to independence and expression. Harnessing the power of a truly liberated woman, the fragrance is simultaneously strong and intense, but also graceful and delicate. Sourced from all around the world, the bottle houses fragrances from France alongside hues from Morocco, transcending boundaries to create a cross-cultural fusion. Opening with an unusual accord, the fragrance merges the invigorating note of Tangerine with the soft scent of Lavender. Next, the perfume dives into the floral heart, guiding the senses on an olfactive journey through blossoming gardens. Moving slowly to the base, the fragrance finds its final form. Seamlessly blending the woody hue of Vetiver with the warm note of Vanilla, the bittersweet base continues this theme of contrast, igniting the senses with a smoky perfume. Gold tinted, the glass bottle reflects YSL’s fiery sense of optimism, finished with flamboyant gold-tone branding. Topped with a black cap, the design finished with dainty embellishments.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent’s Libre Eau de Parfum pays homage to the house’s most defining and enduring value: passionate and defiant freedom. Breaking from convention, the emblematic scent combines Aromatic French Lavender, found in classic Fougere perfumery, with luminous solar accords. This daring contradiction blurs masculine and feminine facets to create a distinctive, unisex appeal. Vibrant top notes of Tangerine, Neroli and aromatic Lavender exhilarate, revealing a sun-drenched heart of Jasmine and radiant Moroccan Orange Blossom. A creamy base of Madagascan Vanilla and White Musks wraps the composition in effortless sophistication. The sculpted bottle is entwined with a golden YSL Cassandra Logo, featuring a deep 'V' cut-out, with an, asymmetric black lacquer cap. Akin to the fashion house’s couture tailoring, the sensual fragrance offers a high-fashion amalgamation of menswear and womenswear, embodying signature YSL attitude. Unapologetically fierce, authentic and free.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Irresistible Eau de Parfum Nectar 50ml
listings.description: Treat yourself to a new bouquet with the Givenchy Irresistible Eau de Parfum Nectar, a floral-gourmand fragrance set to become your next signature. Amped up on the floral front, the scent opens up with a top layer of neroli essence, subtly honeyed and fresh in flavour. Just beneath, a trio of roses accord unfurls into a full-bodied yet soft core, whisking you away to red-rich botanical gardens set against cloudless skies during the peak of summer. For a contemporary twist, the base reveals a coupling of pistachio and vanilla wood, providing a warm gourmand aftermath for you to savour. Petal-rich and feminine to the core, the pink-hued scent is held within a faceted glass bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentleman Eau de Parfum Reserve Privee 100ml
listings.description: The Givenchy Gentleman Eau de Parfum Reserve Privee is a heady, whisky-inspired fragrance for the sophisticated man. Embodying timeless elegance, the scent is an intoxicating duet of sophisticated floral accords and rich amber, offering a refined finish. Refreshing bergamot introduces the fragrance, invigorating the senses with a sweet yet spicy aroma. The EDP unfurls into a heart of iris and chestnut, adding depth and intensity to the scent. Creating an intoxicating scent trail, the fragrance is wrapped in amber and smoky whisky.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradoxe Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: An invitation to express all dimensions of your identity, Prada’s Paradoxe Eau de Parfum is designed as a celebration of being never the same, always yourself. The refillable feminine fragrance encapsulates the essence of Prada, exploring multi-dimensional self-expression and liberation. The floral ambery fragrance opens with light, crisp notes of neroli, extracted as the flower blooms to capture its freshness. At the heart, amber accords add a vibrant warmth, leading into an intense and long-lasting depth of a new musk molecule. A reinvention of Prada’s iconic triangle logo, the Paradoxe bottle arrives with a tilted, yet powerfully grounded design. The triangular-shaped bottle is softened with rounded corners, while the coral pink fragrance within contrasts with Prada’s black coat of arms.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Luna Rossa Carbon Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Inspired by the collision of nature and technology, Prada Luna Rossa Carbon explores the contrast between freshness and depth. The fragrance opens with crisp bergamot and cool peppermint, creating an invigorating first impression. At the heart, lavender intertwines with metallic ambroxan, lending a clean, aromatic edge. A base of patchouli and tonka bean grounds the composition, rounding out the scent with smooth, understated warmth. Housed in a sleek, industrial-inspired bottle, the translucent black design makes a striking addition to any collection.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent MYSLF Eau de Parfum 60ml
listings.description: MYSLF, a fragrance by Yves Saint Laurent that invites you to express your individuality. The bright Eau de Parfum is an expression of modern masculinity, for the individual that embraces emotion and each of their unique nuances. Featuring global fragrance ambassador Austin Butler, the refillable fragrance is characterised by a fresh bergamot accord, laced with earthy woods. At the heart lies radiant orange blossom absolute, intertwining with seductive Ambrofix™ in a scent juxtaposition reminiscent of a man’s multi-faceted personality. The bottle’s high-shine finish reveals a reflection of yourself, representative of the scent’s inviting confidence. Topped with an angular lacquered cap, the bottle exudes luxury.

listings.rawTitle: Aramis Intuition Intense Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Rich, deep, and addictive, the Aramis Intuition Intense Eau de Parfum reveals a darker, more powerful expression. Cool juniper berry and sharp black pepper ignite the senses, leading into aromatic lavender softened by honeyed osmanthus. As it settles, creamy vanilla and rich oakwood unfold, wrapped in Cuirissima LXR, Aramis’ exclusive leather essence.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Si Nude Bloom Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Refresh your fragrance collection with Giorgio Armani’s Sì Nude Bloom Eau de Parfum – a luminous composition that balances fresh and floral notes. The scent opens with blackcurrant, delivering a crisp, juicy aroma that feels vibrant yet delicately tart. As it develops, rose emerges at the heart, introducing an airy floral layer that’s smooth and uplifting. Patchouli settles at the base, rounding out the composition with subtle warmth while allowing the brighter notes to shine through. Light yet distinctive, it transitions seamlessly from day to evening, leaving a bright trail that lingers on the skin.

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Cheeky Biquini Mist 90ml
listings.description: Taking cues from Rio’s renowned nude beach, Praia do Abricó, Sol de Janeiro’s Cheeky Biquini Mist is a playful cocktail of fruity notes designed to spruce up your day-to-day aroma. The opening spills out in vivid colour: a cocktail of apricot nectar, fresh peach and ripe açai, like fruit split open under a cloudless sky. As the initial spritz wears on, notice the nuances just below – raspberry juice offers a subtle tartness, while crushed orange blossom lends a gorgeous floral softness to the bouquet. To finish, sheer vanilla and golden honey accord melt into amber, evoking a summer feel that pairs wonderfully with minimal layers.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Cypress & Grapevine Cologne Intense 30ml
listings.description: The Jo Malone London Cypress & Grapevine Cologne Intense captures a crisp woodland landscape with a long-lasting, lingering trail. Cypress opens with clean, resinous nuances, giving the scent its fresh, uplifting tone. At the centre, grapevine brings depth, while an earthy blend of cedarwood, vetiver and ripe fruit leads the way. Amber settles at the base, adding a smooth finish that stays close to the skin. Spritz onto wrists, neck and pulse points to let the fragrance unfold throughout the day.

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Refresco Paraiso Mist 90ml
listings.description: Among Sol de Janeiro’s destination-inspired scents, Refresco Paraíso whisks you to Rio’s secluded Grumari Beach, where lush jungle spills onto golden sand. Rainforest orchid and crushed jungle leaves open the scent, sharpened by slices of juicy lime. As it wears on, the sea air drifts in, offsetting bright citrus with freshness that resembles a gentle tropical mist. Banana leaf adds a smooth, watery green essence, evoking broad leaves slick with moisture and the gentle rhythm of waves breaking just beyond the treeline. In the base, Brazilian blue cactus meets musk – softening the wildness above.

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa 62 Jelly Perfume Balm 4g
listings.description: Soft, sweet and perfectly packable, the Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa 62 Jelly Perfume Balm offers a mini moment of the brand’s iconic scent, evoking sun-soaked beaches. The solid balm glides smoothly onto skin, releasing the warm, gourmand notes of pistachio and almond, layered with heliotrope and jasmine petals, and settling into a soft base of vanilla, salted caramel, and sandalwood. The compact formula allows for precise application, making it ideal for quick touch-ups throughout the day or evening. Travel-ready and pocket-perfect, the Jelly Perfume Balm transforms your favourite body mist into a swipeable, skin-soft jelly.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Amber Labdanum Cologne Intense 100ml
listings.description: Bring a touch of autumn to your scent wardrobe with Jo Malone Amber Labdanum Cologne Intense, where resinous richness meets the sun-soaked Mediterranean. Top notes of bitter orange sparkle like sunlight bouncing off golden hills, brightening your aroma as you wander from A to B. One layer down, labdanum lends its balmy warmth, anchored by the delicate blooms of wild cistus. Finally, base notes of creamy vanilla and roasted oak cocoon the profile in softness, conjuring sun-warmed terraces and rugged stone paths at the close of day. Housed in a simple glass bottle, this scent comes ready to infuse your day (or evening) with an inimitable woody allure.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Ever So Fresh Eau de Parfum for Women 75ml
listings.description: A sparkling fragrance with an effervescent charm, Marc Jacobs’ Daisy Ever So Fresh offers an invigorating olfactory experience. The latest addition to the quintessential Daisy Marc Jacobs collection, the fragrance marries soft florals with sun-soaked citrus accords for a vibrant finish. An energising elixir of mandarin, mango and pineapple introduce the scent, uplifted by a floral bouquet of rosewater and orange blossom. Inspiring spontaneity with its youthful spirit, the fragrance settles onto a warm bed of cashmere woods.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradoxe Eau de Parfum 90ml
listings.description: An invitation to express all dimensions of your identity, Prada’s Paradoxe Eau de Parfum is designed as a celebration of being never the same, always yourself. The refillable feminine fragrance encapsulates the essence of Prada, exploring multi-dimensional self-expression and liberation. The floral ambery fragrance opens with light, crisp notes of neroli, extracted as the flower blooms to capture its freshness. At the heart, amber accords add a vibrant warmth, leading into an intense and long-lasting depth of a new musk molecule. A reinvention of Prada’s iconic triangle logo, the Paradoxe bottle arrives with a tilted, yet powerfully grounded design. The triangular-shaped bottle is softened with rounded corners, while the coral pink fragrance within contrasts with Prada’s black coat of arms.

listings.rawTitle: Kylie Cosmic Intense Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Ignite your senses with the Cosmic Kylie Jenner Intense Eau de Parfum, the newest fragrance in the cosmic universe. This bold, ambery gourmand evolution of the original Cosmic is creamier, warmer and even more compelling. It features heightened vanilla notes and decadent benzoin that, when paired together, leave a lasting impression. Housed in the original sculptural bottle now dressed in a deep, fiery red, the outside is a reflection of the fragrance’s smouldering allure and intensity.

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa 68 Jelly Perfume Balm 4g
listings.description: Compact and travel-ready, swipe, stack and go with the Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa 68 Jelly Perfume Balm, a jelly-like formula that delivers up to ten hours of concentrated fragrance. This fuss-free perfume solid stars the same notes as the brand’s beloved Cheirosa 68 scent, brimming with sparkling florals and sun-warmed fruits that transport the senses to sea-breezed shores. To open, pink dragonfruit and lychee lend an air of freshness, before sheer vanilla and sun musk warm on the skin with wear. Designed to be layered with your favourite Sol body care formulas and fragrance mists, the jelly balm enhances your aroma and is ideal for topping up throughout the day, while boasting up to 1,000 swipes per stick.

listings.rawTitle: Ariana Grande Cloud Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Radiating joy and positivity, the Cloud Eau de Parfum by ARIANA GRANDE promises an uplifting olfactory experience. The opening notes of bergamot and pear lend the scent its dreamy freshness, married with lavender blossom for a floral touch. As the fragrance unfurls, mouth-watering nuances of crème de coconut and praline begin to emerge, adding a sweet richness to the perfume that lingers on the skin, before finishing with an irresistible whipped cream and musk blend. The design of the bottle is as whimsical as the scent within. Nestled inside a cloud, the fragrance is an eye-catching addition to your scent collection.

listings.rawTitle: Balmain Rose de Soie Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Silky rose water drifting into rich roasted tonka beans, emboldening the floral scent with candied-rose sweetness. Florals surge instantly: vivid rose water sparked by piquant baies roses. At the heart, sunlit orange blossoms illuminate all the facets of fresh pink roses. Rich roasted tonka unfolds, releasing sweet undertones of caramel. Its warmth sweeps into a creamy, musky, candied-rose trail, soft as silk. A new olfactive elegance emerges – bold and resolutely Balmain. The clear glass bottle features a rose-candy cap and label evocative of soft, silky hues. The design takes inspiration from the 1946 Balmain Élysées 64-83. It retains the unique striated gilded collar and angled label, while adding dimension to the new lozenge shape with the signature Balmain rayure and PB monogram.

listings.rawTitle: Miu Miu Miutine Intense Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Discover a new chapter of Miutine with the Miu Miu Miutine Intense Eau de Parfum. The bold berry floral fragrance evolves the original scent into a richer dimension with an intense blackberry nectar. The fragrance opens with vibrant top notes of blackberry accord, before unfurling a heart of gardenia and a rich base of bourbon vanilla infusion. The result is a bold, effervescent scent, perfect for seasonal styling. A tribute to Miu Miu's iconic bordeaux matelassé leather handbags, the burgundy lacquered bottle echoes the luxury and deep berry notes of the fragrance within.

listings.rawTitle: EXCLUSIVE Goldfield & Banks Ingenious Ginger Deluxe Gift Set (Worth £197)
listings.description: Dabble in the world of contemporary Australian perfumery with the EXCLUSIVE Goldfield & Banks Ingenious Ginger Deluxe Gift Set, centred around a luminous hero note of red back ginger. Sun‑drenched and softly sensual, the scent whisks you away to a far-flung tropical escape. Zesty Brazilian mandarin, Italian bergamot and lemon brighten the opening, giving way to a lush heart of white florals, magnolia and warm woods. At the centre of the bouquet blooms ginger lily – a tribute to the founder’s favourite flower, a complex native botanical that captures the soul of the fragrance house. Vanilla, amber and Australian sandalwood warmly round off the olfactive pyramid, lingering sensually on the skin. The set's contents are housed in an embossed gift box for a final luxurious flourish. Set Contents: Ingenious Ginger Eau de Parfum 100ml  Ingenious Ginger Travel Spray 10ml  Luxury Vegan Leather Travel Case

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Livin'A Vida Cheirosa Set (Worth £55)
listings.description: Inspired by the sunshine-soaked shores of Rio, Sol de Janeiro’s Livin'A Vida Cheirosa Set features five bestselling scents in travel-friendly formats. Dip into familiar fruity blends, opt for gourmand vanilla classics or try something new with this colourful collection. From the pistachio-vanilla signature of Cheirosa 62 to the rich, sugared violet and sandalwood depth of 59, no two days need to smell the same. Set Contents: Cheirosa 62 30ml Cheirosa 91 30ml Cheirosa 59 30ml Cheirosa 68 30ml Cheirosa 48 30ml

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa 62 Perfume Mist 240ml
listings.description: Featuring the brand's cult-favourite scent of the iconic Bum Bum cream, Sol de Janeiro's Cheirosa 62 Mist transports the senses to a hot summer's day on the luscious coast of Rio. Warming notes of pistachio and almond mingle with a floral bloom of jasmine petals, settling on a base of sandalwood and salted caramel accords. Evoking a ‘holiday in a bottle’ scent, the body mist provides a vibrant, long-lasting aroma and all-day freshness. Packaging may vary.

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Limited Edition Cheirosa To Go Set
listings.description: Never be without your Cheirosa 62™ fragrance with Sol de Janeiro's Limited Edition Cheirosa To Go Set. The compact duo includes a jelly perfume balm, a mini perfume mist, and a convenient keychain holder, perfect for fragrance touch-ups throughout the day. Set Contents: Cheirosa 62 Jelly Perfume Balm 4g A pocket-sized fragrance essential, the jelly perfume balm is an alcohol-free, twist-up stick format that glides on a concentrated scent that lasts for up to 10 hours. Perfect for on-the-go top-ups, post-gym freshen-ups or evening refreshes. Cheirosa 62 Perfume Mist 30ml Capturing the Brazilian spirit, the fragrance mist combines sun-drenched notes of creamy pistachio, salted caramel, jasmine petals and vanilla for an irresistible, sunny scent.

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa 62 Perfume Mist 90ml
listings.description: Featuring the brand's cult-favourite scent of the iconic Bum Bum cream, Sol de Janeiro's Cheirosa 62 Mist transports the senses to a hot summer's day on the luscious coast of Rio. Warming notes of pistachio and almond mingle with a floral bloom of jasmine petals, settling on a rich base of sandalwood and salted caramel accords. Evoking a ‘holiday in a bottle’ scent, the body mist provides a vibrant, long-lasting aroma and all-day freshness. Packaging may vary.

listings.rawTitle: Sabrina Carpenter Sweet Tooth Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Satisfy your sweetest cravings with Sweet Tooth by Sabrina Carpenter. Dreamt up from Sabrina’s love for all things dessert, this delectable Eau de Parfum is a sugar-kissed treat for the senses. Top notes of bergamot and candied ginger melt into a swirl of chocolate marshmallow, creating a mouthwatering first impression. At its heart, a creamy blend of jasmine petals, coconut milk and Madagascan vanilla serves up confectionery heaven. Finally, warm cashmere wood and sugared musks leave a lingering finish for that final sugar rush. Sweet Tooth is the perfect guilty pleasure to add to your fragrance repertoire, housed inside a playful chocolate bar-shaped bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa 68 Perfume Mist 240ml
listings.description: Embodying paradise on earth, the Cheirosa 68 Perfume Mist is a sparkling floral perfume from the iconic fragrance experts at Sol de Janeiro. Symbolic of a tropical paradise, thrilling top notes of pink dragonfruit and lychee transcend the senses to exotic shores and unknown delights. Carrying on a distant sea breeze, fresh notes of Brazillian jasmine, ocean air and hibiscus add an uplifting freedom to the scent, while creamy vanilla and rich sun musk add a sensual heat to the body mist. Fresh, floral and fun, the dreamy body spray embraces the senses to create the feel of an endless summer. Packaging may vary.

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Leite Café Perfume Mist
listings.description: Capturing the pleasure of enjoying a freshly brewed, sweetened coffee, the Sol de Janeiro Leite Café Perfume Mist offers a comforting escape with every spritz. The fragrance blends an intense latte accord with a splash of creamy coconut milk and a lychee sorbet for a frothy, decadent trail. Apply to your skin, hair and clothes for a scent that feels like your first sip of morning coffee.

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Leite Nectar Perfume Mist
listings.description: Capturing the delectable comfort of a Brazilian pavê de pêssego, the Sol de Janeiro Leite Nectar Perfume Mist offers an indulgent escape with every spritz. Drawing inspiration from the biscuit-layered peach dessert, notes of juicy peach melt into creamy coconut milk and vanilla to satisfy your sweet tooth. Apply to your skin, hair and clothes for a scent that makes you feel like there's room for dessert.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Hero Eau de Parfum for Men 50ml
listings.description: Sincere, courageous and ever-evolving, Burberry Hero Eau de Parfum for men embodies the spirit of the modern man. Leading with fresh nuances of pine needles, the instinctive scent captures the essence of a forest by the English coastline. Offset by the rich warmth of benzoin and incense, it boasts a soulful olfactive trail that lingers long after its first impression. Descending into its signature base, a trio of warm cedarwood oils represents hero strength to add depth and power. Housed in an elegant oak-coloured bottle with gold accents, Burberry Hero invites you to surpass limits and embrace the extraordinary within.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent’s Libre Eau de Parfum pays homage to the house’s most defining and enduring value: passionate and defiant freedom. Breaking from convention, the emblematic scent combines Aromatic French Lavender, found in classic Fougere perfumery, with luminous solar accords. This daring contradiction blurs masculine and feminine facets to create a distinctive, unisex appeal. Vibrant top notes of Tangerine, Neroli and aromatic Lavender exhilarate, revealing a sun-drenched heart of Jasmine and radiant Moroccan Orange Blossom. A creamy base of Madagascan Vanilla and White Musks wraps the composition in effortless sophistication. The sculpted bottle is entwined with a golden YSL Cassandra Logo, featuring a deep 'V' cut-out, with an, asymmetric black lacquer cap. Akin to the fashion house’s couture tailoring, the sensual fragrance offers a high-fashion amalgamation of menswear and womenswear, embodying signature YSL attitude. Unapologetically fierce, authentic and free.

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa '40 Perfume Mist 240ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Black Amber Plum, Crème de Cassis. Heart Notes: Jasmine Bloom, Brazilian Orchid. Base Notes: Vanilla Woods, Warm Musk. Immerse yourself in the aromas within the Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa '40 Hair & Body Fragrance Mist. Perfect for taking on the go, it mist imparts a burst of black amber plum and jasmine bloom, allowing you to daydream of smouldering, sun-kissed beaches. Scents of vanilla woods dance playfully with creamy warm musk, offering a hypnotic cocktail that lingers on the skin and in the air. Warm and sweet, the hair and body spray is ideal for people that want to express their sensual sides. Packaging may vary.

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa 59 Perfume Mist 240ml
listings.description: The latest addition to the Sol de Janeiro scent experience, Cheirosa 59 Perfume Mist exudes a joyful and uplifting fragrance. Notes of vanilla orchid, sugared violet and sheer sandalwood intertwine to create a rich, warm and sweet scent that transports its wearer to a Brazilian sunset. Inspired by the year 1959, when singer João Gilberto released the bossa nova album, Chega de Saudade (aka No More Blues), the mist embraces your skin and hair with the warmth of whipped amber, velvet plum and fresh vetiver. Packaging may vary.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani I Will Eau de Parfum 60ml
listings.description: A bold expression of modern masculinity, Giorgio Armani's I Will Eau de Parfum leaves an intense and unmistakable trail. The fresh fragrance opens with notes of Calabrian bergamot, leading into a heart of soft lavender essence. At the base, dark woods and rich leather add a smoky sensuality to Madagascan vanilla. Encased in a striking black and gold architectural bottle, the perfume lasts up to 24 hours*, transitioning effortlessly from day to night. *Consumer test, 69 subjects.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana L'Imperatrice Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Lavish in the flamboyant energy of Dolce & Gabbana L'Imperatrice Eau de Toilette. For charismatic women who desire to live as movie stars, the striking EDT blends exotic fruits with bright pink florals, all balanced on a musky base. Opening with vibrant notes of rhubarb and juicy kiwi, the magnetic fragrance dives into a fresh heart of watermelon, before succumbing to a deep base centered around musk and sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradigme Le Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Prada Paradigme Le Parfum is a fresh yet comforting fragrance that balances luminous freshness with warm woody depth. From the first spritz, geranium brings a crisp, slightly green floral lift, creating a clean, refined opening. As the fragrance unfolds, creamy vanilla softens the composition with a smooth, comforting warmth before settling into a rich amber base that lingers like a second skin. Elegant, understated and effortlessly modern, the scent is perfect for everyday wear, while the sleek, minimalist bottle reflects its timeless sophistication.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Million Gold Elixir Parfum Intense 100ml
listings.description: A gilded ode to extravagance, Rabanne’s Million Gold Elixir Parfum Intense exudes luxury with its rich, unapologetically powerful nuances. The iconic woody fragrance steps into deeper territory, layering sunlit mandarin and smooth vanilla over a base of creamy sandalwood. Inspired by the richness of niche blends, yet stamped with Rabanne’s unmistakable signature, it delivers an unforgettable olfactive trail that lingers long after the first spritz.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Born in Roma Donna Eau de Parfum for Her 100ml
listings.description: Inspired by Rome, a city where past and present coexist, Valentino's Born in Roma Donna Eau de Parfum celebrates living life freely and embracing heritage. The modern haute couture fragrance balances sensuality and vibrancy for a luxurious, feminine scent that invites its wearer to be unapologetically themselves. An opulent top note of jasmine sambac mingles with a woody heart of cashmeran, adding a lively twist with its unusually spicy note. A cool base of vanilla bourbon invites a rich leathery aspect for a distinctive, captivating scent reminiscent of Rome's street culture. Instantly iconic, the bottle is adorned with a recognisable stud pattern taking inspiration from Roman architecture.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera La Bomba Eau de Parfum 80ml
listings.description: Carolina Herrera La Bomba is bold, radiant, and utterly unforgettable. From the very first spritz, a showstopping burst of exotic pitaya delivers a juicy thrill that electrifies the senses, setting the stage for a fragrance that demands attention. As it settles, sultry red frangipani and delicate cherry peony bloom at its heart, evoking an air of intimacy and unapologetic femininity. A radiant infusion of solar vanilla gradually emerges, wrapping you in warmth and leaving behind a trail of joy, sensuality, and sweet memory. Housed in a refillable bottle with a delicate butterfly silhouette, La Bomba is as striking in design as it is in scent.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera La Bomba Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Carolina Herrera La Bomba is bold, radiant, and utterly unforgettable. A radiant infusion of solar vanilla gradually emerges, wrapping you in warmth and leaving behind a trail of joy, sensuality, and sweet memory. Housed in a refillable bottle with a delicate butterfly silhouette, La Bomba is as striking in design as it is in scent.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme La Vie Est Belle Very Cherry Eau De Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Lancôme’s first-ever woody cherry fragrance, La Vie Est Belle Very Cherry Eau de Parfum celebrates every facet of you through a full-bodied, bold and playful composition. An olfactory contrast of vibrant yet sophisticated aura, the fragrance blends indulgent black cherry with powdery violet leaf absolute, settled on a sensual base of oud wood. Whether for a special occasion or adding a touch of elegance to the everyday, Very Cherry offers a long-lasting scent trail designed to express, not impress.

listings.rawTitle: Kylie Cosmic Intense Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Ignite your senses with the Cosmic Kylie Jenner Intense Eau de Parfum, the newest fragrance in the cosmic universe. This bold, ambery gourmand evolution of the original Cosmic is creamier, warmer and even more compelling. It features heightened vanilla notes and decadent benzoin that, when paired together, leave a lasting impression. Housed in the original sculptural bottle now dressed in a deep, fiery red, the outside is a reflection of the fragrance’s smouldering allure and intensity.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Goddess Amber Vanilla Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Bottling a journey of strength, confidence and self-discovery, Burberry's Goddess Amber Vanilla Eau de Parfum is a new expression of a signature scent. The composition opens with luminous lavender essence and a maple syrup accord. The signature gourmand trio of vanilla extracts has a new dimension, now elevated by a caramelised, roasted vanilla for a captivating edge. At the base, an ambery accord leaves a long-lasting impression of sensual warmth. Evoking the dusky, golden glow of a sunset, the perfume's bottle features a square glass structure, amber gradient and refillable design, finished with the signature golden cap and medallion.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Born in Roma Uomo Intense Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Continuing the story of Born in Roma, UOMO Intense pays homage to the electric nightlife of Italy’s beautiful city, seducing the senses with its hypnotic aroma. The vibrant scent offering combines Valentino’s couture elegance with Rome’s street culture to create a powerful fragrance. With its clash of fresh and smoky notes, the Eau de Parfum is both thrilling and playful. Creamy vanilla pairs with zesty bergamot and mandarin for an exciting opening, intensified by a blend of nutmeg and lavandin in the fragrance’s heart. Lending the scent its captivating character, the fragrance is finished with deep, earthy nuances of vetiver. Valentino’s signature studded bottle draws inspiration from Roman architecture. Combining a rich black colour with vibrant white and tempting red, the ombré flacon is an eye-catching addition to your fragrance collection.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent LIBRE Berry Crush Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Complete your fragrance arsenal with the Yves Saint Laurent LIBRE Berry Crush Eau de Parfum – a daring, red‑berry twist on the iconic LIBRE signature. The scent opens with a vivid burst of raspberry and mandarin, a gourmand introduction that’s mouth‑watering and irresistibly indulgent. As the fragrance unfolds, the juicy brightness gives way to sensuous florals: orange blossom and lavender lend balance and elegance, preserving the unmistakable LIBRE DNA while adding a sweeter, more flirtatious nuance. Finally, the base settles into a warm, creamy trail of bourbon vanilla and musk, wrapping the berries in velvety depth. To complete the experience, the bottle is finished with a sophisticated gold‑tone monogram, a timeless sign‑off to this bold new chapter in the LIBRE story.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent MYSLF Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: MYSLF, a fragrance by Yves Saint Laurent that invites you to express your individuality. The bright Eau de Parfum is an expression of modern masculinity, for the individual that embraces emotion and each of their unique nuances. Featuring global fragrance ambassador Austin Butler, the refillable fragrance is characterised by a fresh bergamot accord, laced with earthy woods. At the heart lies radiant orange blossom absolute, intertwining with seductive Ambrofix™ in a scent juxtaposition reminiscent of a man’s multi-faceted personality. The bottle’s high-shine finish reveals a reflection of yourself, representative of the scent’s inviting confidence. Topped with an angular lacquered cap, the bottle exudes luxury.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau de Parfum 100ml Refill (Worth £163.33)

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Rio Radiance Perfume Mist 90ml
listings.description: Capturing the essence of a sun-soaked beach day in a bottle, the Sol de Janeiro Rio Radiance Perfume Mist veils the skin in a bright, tropical aroma. The refreshing scent combines creamy coconut milk with warm, earthy nuances of sand, uplifted by crisp white florals at the heart. A dry down of vanilla lends a sweet fragrance, wrapped in rich amber for a tantalising finish. Packaging may vary.

listings.rawTitle: Mood Stones Kylie Jenner Collection Eau De Parfum Velvet Brew 50ml
listings.description: The Kylie Cosmetics Moodstones Collection Velvet Brew Eau de Parfum wraps the senses in warm ambery spice with a smooth, indulgent character. Opening with creamy hazelnut and juicy plum, the fragrance creates a rich, inviting first impression that feels both comforting and sophisticated. As it develops, coffee flower and orange blossom bring a delicate floral brightness, balancing the gourmand warmth with an airy elegance. Housed in a glossy brown bottle inspired by the collection's signature stone silhouette, the fragrance leaves a cosy, long-lasting trail, perfect for evenings, cooler days and intimate occasions.

listings.rawTitle: Mood Stones Kylie Jenner Collection Eau De Parfum Cashmere Muse 50ml
listings.description: Soft and luminous, every spritz of Kylie Cosmetics Moodstones Collection Cashmere Muse creates a bright, airy first impression. Opening with sparkling bergamot accord and mandarin blossom, the fragrance feels fresh and effortlessly uplifting. As it develops, a radiant heart of ylang-ylang and frangipani adds a soft floral warmth, before settling into a comforting base of tonka absolute and salted musk. Sitting close to the skin, the scent leaves a delicate, long-lasting trail, making it the perfect companion for daytime brunches, weekend plans and moments when you want a subtle yet distinctive signature fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Emporio Armani Power of You Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Emporio Armani’s Power of You Eau de Parfum is a radiant fruity fragrance designed to leave a lasting impression. Opening with a vibrant maracuja passion fruit accord, the scent delivers an instant burst of juicy sweetness that feels fresh, uplifting and effortlessly confident. At its heart, a luminous frangipani accord blooms with creamy floral warmth, adding a soft, sun-kissed elegance that enhances the fragrance’s addictive appeal. As the scent settles, vanilla absolute wraps the skin in smooth, indulgent warmth, creating a sensual trail that lingers from day to night.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Vendetta Donna Eau De Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Meet the VENDETTA Donna Eau de Parfum, a floral gourmand and woody signature for women by Valentino. Designed for the confident and bold woman, the fragrance blends solar tuberose, a vibrant, liqueur-like red orange nectar accord and enveloping woods for addictive presence. Sandalwood grounds the base with creamy sensuality. The bottle's iconic architectural glass design celebrates Valentino's timeless couture heritage.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme La Vie Est Belle Eau de Parfum Refillable Recharge 100ml (Worth £130)
listings.description: Indulge your senses in   the Lancôme La Vie Est Belle Eau de Parfum Refillable Recharge, Lancôme's bestselling fragrance for her created by three of France's leading perfumers. Represented by Julia Roberts, the luminous perfume is a universal declaration to the beauty of life. A reimagining of a signature scent, it plays with the addition of magnolia essence to create a sparkling olfactory experience. The EDP opens with a ripe burst of pear and blackberry before capturing the romance of orange flower and jasmine sambac at the heart. It settles on a rich base of patchouli essence to create an opulent olfactive experience. This refill is designed to top up your existing bottle, allowing you to enjoy the timeless fragrance again and again.

listings.rawTitle: This Works Choose Calm Kit
listings.description: Presenting a carefully curated trio of daily essentials, the Choose Calm Kit from aromatherapy experts this works is designed to create a sense of harmony of the body and senses. Set Contents: Stress Check Mood Manager 10ml Suitable for the body and home, this multi-purpose spray helps to soothe the senses and encourage a tranquil atmosphere. Enriched with a serene blend of ylang ylang, neroli and patchouli, the spray boasts an innovative delivery system which allows the fragrance to be gradually released throughout the day. Stress Check Roll-On 5ml A handbag-friendly roll-on which seeks to invigorate the senses with a refreshing blend of eucalyptus, frankincense and lavender oil. Stress Check Kind Hands 30ml An intensely moisturising hand cream that helps to relieve dry skin. Infused with the quintessential Stress Check fragrance, the cream is ideal for use after hand sanitiser, offering instant nourishment while protecting the hands against environmental aggressors.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradoxe Eau de Parfum Refill 100ml (Worth £163.33)
listings.description: An invitation to express all dimensions of your identity, Prada’s Paradoxe Eau de Parfum is designed as a celebration of being never the same, always yourself. The feminine fragrance refill encapsulates the essence of Prada, exploring multi-dimensional self-expression and liberation. The floral ambery fragrance opens with light, crisp notes of neroli, extracted as the flower blooms to capture its freshness. At the heart, amber accords add a vibrant warmth, leading into an intense and long-lasting depth of a new musk molecule. Discover endless use of your Prada triangular bottle with this fragrance refill.

listings.rawTitle: Ariana Grande Cloud Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Radiating joy and positivity, the Cloud Eau de Parfum by ARIANA GRANDE promises an uplifting olfactory experience. The opening notes of bergamot and pear lend the scent its dreamy freshness, married with lavender blossom for a floral touch. As the fragrance unfurls, mouth-watering nuances of crème de coconut and praline begin to emerge, adding a sweet richness to the perfume that lingers on the skin, before finishing with an irresistible whipped cream and musk blend. The design of the bottle is as whimsical as the scent within. Nestled inside a cloud, the fragrance is an eye-catching addition to your scent collection.

listings.rawTitle: NEOM Perfect Night's Sleep Wellbeing Discovery Collection
listings.description: The Perfect Night’s Sleep Wellbeing Discovery Collection features four self-care essentials, each scented with NEOM’s iconic floral fragrance, that invite a moment of stillness before you settle down to rest. Set Contents: Perfect Night’s Sleep Mist 30ml Blended with 16 pure essential oils, this luxurious mist soothes the senses with its 100% natural fragrance. Simply spritz onto your pillow ahead of sleep as part of your nighttime routine. Perfect Night's Sleep Magnesium Body Butter 30ml This creamy body lotion from the Perfect Night’s Sleep collection utilises shea butter, magnesium and coconut oil to help provide a moisture boost. After use, skin feels irresistibly soft and supple. Perfect Night's Sleep Bath Foam 50ml NEOM’s best-selling bath foam pampers the skin and senses with a spa-like treatment. The nourishing formula pairs marshmallow extract with aloe and sweet almond to hydrate and soften. Perfect Night's Sleep Travel Candle 75g Create a serene atmosphere with this travel-sized candle. Offering a burn time of 20 hours, the candle imbues your bedroom with a floral aroma that exudes tranquility.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum for Women 100ml
listings.description: The power within. Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum for Women tells a story of self-discovery. The new campaign follows Emma Mackey and the pride of lionesses. Radiating confidence, strength and kindness, Emma embodies the spirit of Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum. The Scent Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum is a unique gourmand aromatic fragrance led by a powerful trio of vanillas. On top, a vanilla infusion with woody tonalities, at the heart vanilla caviar with a rich sweetness, and at the base a vanilla absolute enriched with luminous lavender. The Bottle Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum for women is encased in an elegant square-shaped bottle designed to be refilled. An elegant design, Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum is the first refillable perfume by Burberry.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London English Pear & Freesia Cologne 9ml
listings.description: An ode to Autumn, the English Pear and Freesia Cologne by Jo Malone London evokes the crisp freshness of a golden morning in fall. Ripened King William pear begins the olfactory journey with a juicy facet, tantalising the senses as it dances on a bed of white freesias. The coolness of the delicate, yet distinctive, floral heart is emboldened by a sensuous selection of warm woods like patchouli and musk, evoking an earthy aroma and enhancing the fragrance’s longevity. The cologne is housed in a quintessential Jo Malone London glass bottle, timeless and instantly recognisable.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Born in Roma Uomo Intense Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Continuing the story of Born in Roma, UOMO Intense pays homage to the electric nightlife of Italy’s beautiful city, seducing the senses with its hypnotic aroma. listings.rawTitle: NEOM Wellbeing Complete Bliss Essential Oil Blend 10ml
listings.description: Fill your home with the delectable scents within the NEOM Complete Bliss Essential Oil Blend. Enriched with essential oils and naturally-derived ingredients, the scent is bursting with notes of Moroccan Blush Rose, leaving a powdery, invigorating fragrance that lingers in the air. Juicy Fresh Lime and fiery Black Pepper add memorable, daring elements to the oil blend, evoking adventurous, opulent visions. Finished with a luxurious blend of 14 precious oils, the fragrance is destined to create an ambience worth basking in.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Eros Eau de Parfum 200ml
listings.description: Inspired by the Greek god of love, the Versace Eros Eau de Parfum embodies the impassioned hero, seducing the senses with a medley of masculine aromas. The fragrance opens with the bite of citrus, infusing Italian lemon with the unique hint of candied apple. A verdant heart of geranium flower and clary sage essence softens into an earthy base. Cedarwood, vetiver and patchouli are complimented by the sweetness of vanilla, completing this spirited expression of fervour and bravery.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradoxe Intense Eau de Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Embodying fierce femininity, Prada’s Paradoxe Intense Eau de Parfum explores the complexity yet comfort of floral amber fragrances, exuding an enveloping warmth through enigmatic expression. A harmonious blend of amber and jasmine reveals a paradoxical intensity, fusing delicacy with power to strike the perfect balance of boldness. An undertone of moss welcomes a familiar woodiness, nostalgic and instantly recognisable, granting the perfume a long-lasting, addictive scent trail. Arriving in a refillable flacon with a contrasting brand coat of arms, the fragrance conveys iconicity through simplicity.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro The Most Wanted Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Introducing The Most Wanted Parfum, a charismatic scent from Azzaro that invites you to flirt with danger. The addictive fragrance is inspired by a man who dares to play by his own rules, someone who lives life to the fullest and challenges destiny. Its powerful character can be attributed to a blend of caramel and spicy cardamom. Married with woody amber for added warmth and depth, the perfume tantalises the senses with every spritz. The design of the bottle pays homage to the magnetic scent within. Featuring a barrel-inspired silhouette and a jet-black colourway, the flacon commands attention.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone Cologne Intense Discovery Collection 5x1.5ml
listings.description: Find your new favourite fragrance with Jo Malone’s Cologne Intense Discovery Collection, a five-piece trial set featuring the brand’s best-selling scents. Set Contents: Scarlet Poppy Cologne Intense 1.5ml A floral cologne with notes of scarlet poppy, ambrette and creamy tonka bean. Velvet Rose & Oud Cologne Intense 1.5ml Spicy and warm with hints of clove and Damask rose. Oud & Bergamot Cologne Intense 1.5ml A mysterious and charming scent with cedarwood and bergamot accords. Cypress & Grapevine Cologne Intense 1.5ml Fresh and light with woody undertones. Myrrh & Tonka Cologne Intense 1.5ml Reminiscent of lush, golden sands with nuances of lavender and tonka.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradigme Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Prada Paradigme rewrites the rules of masculine fragrance with a refined, avant-garde signature. Built from the base up in a reversed olfactive structure, the ambery woody eau de parfum reveals its depth from the start as warm resins and Guaiac wood form a rich foundation. A floral twist of bourbon geranium and airy musks brings lift and light, while a calabrian bergamot heart adds freshness. The bottle mirrors Prada’s iconic triangle in a bold tilt, lacquered in a gradient of deep black to green for a scent shaped by new perspectives.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Exclusive Perfect Eau de Toilette Pen Spray 10ml
listings.description: Take your favourite scent wherever you go with the Marc Jacobs Perfect Eau de Toilette Pen Spray. Arriving in a travel-sized edition, the iconic scent uplifts the senses in just a spritz. Joyful and bright, the luminous fragrance celebrates individualism and originality. The intimate scent opens with vibrant pink peppercorn and earthy polygonum. A heart of white daffodil adds a delicate floral aroma before settling with a dry down of cedarwood. Whether looking for a new signature scent or a convenient way to enjoy one you love, the fragrance pen fits perfectly inside your handbag or pocket.

listings.rawTitle: Travalo Perfume Pod Atom Atomiser 5ml Pink
listings.description: Revolutionising the way you travel with your favourite scents, Travalo’s Perfume Pod stores and carries up to 5ml of fragrance in a compact container. The Genie-S patented device takes the liquid directly from the original bottle and keeps it safe and secure while you’re on the go. Arriving in a sleek pink colour, the easy-to-use pod allows you to enjoy your desired scent wherever you may be.

listings.rawTitle: Coach Wild Rose Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Coach Wild Rose is a sensual scent that embodies the untamed beauty of wildflower fields. The evening fragrance is inspired by the brand’s signature prairie floral prints, capturing the essence of free-spirit. Refreshing redcurrant introduces the scent, invigorated by sunny, spicy nuances of bergamot. A floral bouquet of rose and jasmine sambac uplift the fragrance, diffusing into an earthy base of crystal moss and ambroxan for an intoxicating finish.   The bottle features a chic ombré gradient inspired by romantic summer afternoons, embellished with a luxurious burgundy hangtag.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme La Vie est Belle Vanille Nude Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Blending the radiant essence of solar jasmine from France with the sweet warmth of glazed bourbon vanilla from Madagascar, La Vie Est Belle Vanilla unveils a fragrance that is intimate and inviting yet never overpowering. It opens as a floral escape sparkling with a burst of citrus brightness and luminous white petals touched by the elegance of solar jasmine. As the scent lingers, a clean, sensual caress of white musk envelops the skin, evoking a lasting feeling of joy and serenity with every note's intensity lasting up to 5 hours*.  *Self-assessment test, 69 women.

listings.rawTitle: Zadig & Voltaire This Is Her! Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Elegance and edge distilled, Zadig & Voltaire's This Is Her! Eau de Parfum brings a certain  je ne sais quoi  to your fragrance collection. The profile opens up with a familiar layer of jasmine, marking your entrance with a petal-rich brightness. Journeying into vanilla and roasted chestnut, the bouquet becomes intriguingly complex as it settles on the skin. A recurring theme in the brand's scent portfolio, sandalwood lingers at the very base, imparting an effortlessly chic and milky Parisian flourish. "I like when it leaves a trail, asserts a personality," says founder and art collector Thierry Gillier – a sentiment that echoes through the fragrance’s refined pyramid.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss BOSS Bottled Elixir Parfum Intense for Him 100ml
listings.description: A new take on a contemporary classic. Launching 25 years after the original scent, The Hugo Boss BOSS Bottled Elixir invites you to find your inner light. The eau de parfum captivates the senses with each olfactive chapter. A warm blend of incense and cardamom introduce the scent, juxtaposing against the earthy nuances of vetiver and patchouli at its heart. Lending new depth and intensity to the perfume, the fragrance finishes with a bold cedarwood and labdanum blend, embodying sophistication. The unique glass bottle channels the spirit of the modern BOSS man. Its contrasting black and gold finish and brushed cap exudes elegance.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss BOSS Bottled Elixir Parfum Intense for Him 50ml
listings.description: A new take on a contemporary classic. Launching 25 years after the original scent, The Hugo Boss BOSS Bottled Elixir invites you to find your inner light. The eau de parfum captivates the senses with each olfactive chapter. A warm blend of incense and cardamom introduce the scent, juxtaposing against the earthy nuances of vetiver and patchouli at its heart. Lending new depth and intensity to the perfume, the fragrance finishes with a bold cedarwood and labdanum blend, embodying sophistication. The unique glass bottle channels the spirit of the modern BOSS man. Its contrasting black and gold finish and brushed cap exudes elegance.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Jasmine Absolute Eau de Parfum Absolute 30 ml
listings.description: Honouring a decade of the original, Carolina Herrera pays homage to the original fragrance’s core note with Good Girl Jasmine Absolute Eau de Parfum Absolute. At its heart, its signature jasmine accord unveils an irresistible luminosity, heightened by surrounding gourmand notes. Mandarin and blackcurrant uplift the senses, while creamy almond and indulgent toffee tempt you with a sweet but sensual final impression.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Luna Rossa Carbon Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: The Prada Luna Rossa Carbon Eau de Parfum delivers a crisp, invigorating scent that feels both modern and refined. It opens with a bright burst of sweet lavender to awaken the senses, before transitioning seamlessly into the subtly spicy warmth of anise for added depth and character. As the fragrance settles on the skin, woody notes of cypress emerge, leaving a clean, refreshing trail that lingers with understated elegance.

listings.rawTitle: Emporio Armani Power of You Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Emporio Armani’s Power of You Eau de Parfum is a radiant fruity fragrance designed to leave a lasting impression. Opening with a vibrant maracuja passion fruit accord, the scent delivers an instant burst of juicy sweetness that feels fresh, uplifting and effortlessly confident. At its heart, a luminous frangipani accord blooms with creamy floral warmth, adding a soft, sun-kissed elegance that enhances the fragrance’s addictive appeal. As the scent settles, vanilla absolute wraps the skin in smooth, indulgent warmth, creating a sensual trail that lingers from day to night.

listings.rawTitle: YSL Black Opium Pink Glaze Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: An icon reimagined, YSL's Black Opium Pink Glaze Eau de Parfum turns the signature scent pink with a juicy strawberry addiction. The classic coffee-floral fragrance has been reinterpreted with a 100% naturally extracted strawberry note. It effortlessly melts into head-turning jasmine, before black coffee and amber woods add sensual warmth. The bottle takes on a new shape and shade, lacquered in dark pink to contrast with the black core.

listings.rawTitle: Moncler Pour Homme Sunrise Eau de Parfum 60ml
listings.description: Moncler’s Pour Homme Sunrise Eau de Parfum encapsulates the breathtaking moment where the sun and the mountains meet. The fragrance is bold and fresh, opening with a burst of pink peppercorn, before unfurling into a velvety suede accord. Lending earthiness to the scent, the EDP finishes with the refined nuances of Haitian vetiver. The iconic bottle embodies the audacious nature of the scent within. Pairing a gun metal colour with a ribbed exterior, the flacon exudes confidence.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Over Red Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Offering a playful twist on the classic Black Opium fragrance, the Yves Saint Laurent Over Red Eau de Parfum blends juicy cherry with bright florals and black coffee to create a sweet yet thrilling olfactory experience. Laced with mandarin essence, the EDP uplifts the senses with a brightening jasmine and orange blossom elixir, wrapped in the smooth, creamy nuances of vanilla. Finished with earthy patchouli, the refreshing fragrance exudes sensuality.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Ombre Leather Eau de Parfum 150ml
listings.description: Evoking the vast landscapes and sensual heat of the West, Ombré Leather Eau de Parfum from Tom Ford is an androgynous floral-leather fragrance that guides the senses along the path to self-discovery. Revealing itself like a landscape in layers, rich notes of black leather accord are texturised with patchouli and vetiver for an addictive scent trail. Unexpected notes of white floral and jasmine sambac embody wild desert beauty, inviting you to embrace the open road ahead. Capturing the essence of adventuring into the unknown, the signature scent layers amber and moss to conjure the hear of rock and sand.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Blush Eau de Parfum 80ml
listings.description: Discover a fragrance that exemplifies romance and allure with Carolina Herrera’s Good Girl Blush Eau de Parfum. Embody your light feminine side with notes of fresh rose and sensual vanilla. Italian bergamot and juicy mandarin open this scent with a delectable citrus kick, accompanied by luxurious almond oil. At its heart settles exotic ylang-ylang and elegant rose oil, providing a sophisticated and classic touch. Provoke allure and seduction with hints of rich vanilla and tonka bean, that adds a deepness to the base. The uniquely shaped bottle takes the form of a stiletto high heel. Providing glamour and class, the pink stiletto embodies the beauty of the Carolina Herrara fashion house.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb Eau de Parfum - 50ml
listings.description: Unshackle a floral explosion with Viktor & Rolf’s iconic Flowerbomb Eau de Parfum, an addictive profusion of floral notes and warm woody undertones for sensory bliss. The seductive fragrance opens with sparkling top notes of tea, bergamot and freesia, interwoven into a vibrant bouquet of sambac jasmine, cattleya orchid and centifolia rose. Warm, resinous hues of amber, cashmeran and patchouli seep in for the dry down, adding substance, depth and richness to the trail for a harmonious blend. Like all editions in Viktor & Rolf’s Flowerbomb family, the EDP is presented in a diamond grenade glass bottle with rose gold accents for a touch of designer luxury.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Luna Rossa Carbon Eau de Toilette - 50ml
listings.description: Fresh Fougère Heart Notes: Lavender, Soil Tincture, Watery Notes, Metallic Notes. Base Notes: Patchouli, Ambroxan. Top Notes: Bergamot, Pepper. Prada interpretate the exhilarating contemporary scent of carbon to create a sports inspired scent. The Prada Luna Rossa Carbon Sport Eau de Toilette opens with elegant masculine notes of Lavender and Soil Tincture, contrasted with a metallic accord, evoking innovation and speed. Strong and defiant, the fragrance blends steam-distilled botanicals and synthetics to combine both feats of nature and engineering. The mineral and amber fougere embodies the high-tech nature of the modern Prada man. Woody notes of Patchouli and Ambroxan in the heart electrify a revitalising base of Italian Bergamot and Pepper. The EDT is housed in a sleek masculine flacon with a carbon-black and red sports-inspired design.

listings.rawTitle: Armani Code Eau de Parfum 125ml
listings.description: Sophisticated sensuality, the Code Eau de Parfum by Armani invites the senses on a sumptuous amber-wood journey. Opening with a fresh, radiant blend, before melting into an aromatic heart and musky base, the fragrance draws the olfactive attention and captures it with a magnetic allure. A luminous citrus trio of mandarin, bergamot and lemon essence imbue an exhilarating air upon first impressions, followed by the botanical vibrancy of rosemary and lavender. The eau de parfum’s signature toasted tonka bean accord adds intensity and warmth to its composition, paired with creamy vanilla and cedar to grant a carnal second-skin-like scent.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Eau de Parfum Refillable 100ml
listings.description: Embodying the essence of free-spirited femininity, the Chloé Eau de Parfum Refillable is a planet-friendly fragrance, designed to be refilled once empty. Releasing a floral bouquet, the eau de parfum is laced with luminous rose nuances, enhanced by peony and delectable notes of honeyed lychee, jasmine and freesia. Light and airy, the scent seeps into a sensual undertone of warm amber, cedarwood and elegant oakmoss to add an earthy depth.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez Pure Musc for Her Eau de Parfum - 100ml
listings.description: This delicate offering from Narciso Rodriguez provides a tender interpretation of the brand’s cult classic fragrance. Pure Musc for Her is housed in a sleek black and white bottle, signifying the scent’s refreshing play on contrasts, balancing purity with a provocative allure. The original signature musc is reinterpreted and refined, with a disarming innocence and a rich depth. The stunning white floral bouquet is warmed by luxurious Cashmeran. Citrus notes add a lightly sparkling vibrancy to this addictive scent. This EDP captures the senses with a breezy and care-free lust for life.

listings.rawTitle: The White Company Seychelles Mini Home Scenting Set
listings.description: Create a welcoming atmosphere with The White Company’s Seychelles Mini Home Scenting Set. The luxurious trio imbues your living space with a soothing aquatic aroma that exudes tranquility. Featuring a contrasting blend of fresh and warm accords, including amber, vanilla and coconut, the set transforms your home into an idyllic paradise. Set Contents: Seychelles Votive Candle 75g Seychelles Mini Home Spray 15ml Seychelles Mini Diffuser 50ml

listings.rawTitle: Versace Crystal Emerald Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Relish in the confident DNA of Versace Crystal Emerald Eau de Parfum, a floral composition where botanical grace meets velvety musk. Crafted for signature appeal, this fragrance unfolds as an opulent bouquet, opening with the sunlit sparkle of Calabrian bergamot and luminous citrus essences – a contemporary brightness that marks your entrance into a room. Imagine stepping into a dewy garden at first light, the air alive with delicate jasmine and tender rosebuds, petals glistening with morning mist. Now, let that same essence linger into the hush of a winter evening, where soft, dessert-like vanilla and ambery wood drift through the air, cocooning the senses in gentle warmth. The base reclines into a sensual blend of white musk and Brazilian tonka bean.

listings.rawTitle: Cosmic 2.0 by Kylie Jenner Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Cosmic 2.0 is a celestial scent offering from Kylie Jenner that draws inspiration from the ascent of the sun. The whimsical floral fragrance encapsulates the beauty of dawn with its embracing elixir of florals, fruits and woods. At its opening is a serene juxtaposition of spicy and sweet accords. Featuring juicy pear and pink pepper, the Eau de Parfum whisks the senses away to another realm, laced with a vanilla orchid and lavender bouquet for added sensuality. As the scent warms on the skin, nuances of amber begin to unfurl, lending the fragrance its captivating aura.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradoxe Intense Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Embodying fierce femininity, Prada’s Paradoxe Intense Eau de Parfum explores the complexity yet comfort of floral amber fragrances, exuding an enveloping warmth through enigmatic expression. A harmonious blend of amber and jasmine reveals a paradoxical intensity, fusing delicacy with power to strike the perfect balance of boldness. An undertone of moss welcomes a familiar woodiness, nostalgic and instantly recognisable, granting the perfume a long-lasting, addictive scent trail. Arriving in a refillable flacon with a contrasting brand coat of arms, the fragrance conveys iconicity through simplicity.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent MYSLF Le Parfum 100ml
listings.description: A radicalisation of the original scent, Yves Saint Laurent's MYSLF Le Parfum offers a more intense, more powerful and more sensual olfactive experience. The refillable fragrance layers lavish orange blossom with textured woods, embodying an expression of modern masculinity and the statement of embracing all your facets and emotions. The floral-wood fusion opens with a fresh burst of bergamot, warmed by a medley of spices including black pepper, cardamom and cinnamon. Beating at the heart, orange blossom absolute creates a rich, honeyed facet that drys down to reveal woods and a silky vanilla bourbon infusion. Sleek, timeless and expertly crafted, the perfume bottle is adorned with matte black lacquering and the iconic YSL Cassandre logo sculpted into the glass.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Black Orchid Eau de Parfum 150ml
listings.description: A sultry fantasy, inspired by the rarest of flowers. Tom Ford’s Black Orchid Eau de Parfum Spray laces dark and tempting accords together in a spiced floral fusion, with hints of the extraordinary orchid seeping through. Toasted black truffle collides with sparkling bergamot in an unsuspecting opening, while black orchid and plum mingle in the heart of the fragrance, emboldening the sensual composition. Patchouli grounds the parfum spray with a sweet musky aroma that will only leave you craving more. Housed in a fluted, black glass bottle that is a streamlined, modern interpretation of 1920s and 1930s architecture. The dark paradisial eau de parfum is a timeless fragrance and a homage to daring glamour and iconic style.

listings.rawTitle: RITUALS The Ritual of Karma  Lotus Flower & White Tea Car Air Freshener 2x3 g
listings.description: Scenting your car with an uplifting air of soft florals, Rituals The Ritual of Karma Delicately Sweet Lotus & White Tea Car Air Freshener set stars a clip-on wooden plaque and two refill pods. Sleek and stylish, this fragrance holder utilises the airflow from your car vents to circulate the fresh lotus, white tea and sandalwood aroma. Thoughtfully balanced with orange flower, soft lemon and skin-like musk, the blend revitalises the senses, all while leaving your car interior clean-smelling with a touch of comforting warmth. Includes: 1 x Wooden Holder 2 x Refill Pods 3g

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo With Love Eau de Parfum 40ml
listings.description: Invigorate your scent ritual with Jimmy Choo I Want Choo With Love Eau de Parfum, a fragrance that unfolds like a story on the skin. Opening with a bright zing of mandarin and orange flower petals, the perfume's bouquet begins on an invigorating sensory note. As the formula settles, florals bloom at its heart, with hibiscus flower complementing delicate freesia. Relish in the seductive dry-down as vanilla and moody musks feature at the perfume's creamy core.

listings.rawTitle: Coach Women Cherry Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Inspired by the vibrant energy of New York City, the Coach Women Cherry Parfum captures the uplifting fruity-floral core of glossy cherry. Irresistibly playful, this effervescent fragrance leads with a bright burst of the fruit, rich and heady yet fiercely fresh. Balanced on a petal-soft blend of sambac jasmine and warmed by gentle wood nuances of patchouli, it rounds out into a fully realised trail, that’s confident, charismatic and lingers on the skin with lasting intensity.

listings.rawTitle: The White Company Winter Fragrance Oil 15ml
listings.description: Embrace the magic of winter with this enchanting fragrance oil. Warm, spicy cinnamon and rich, comforting clove mingle with zesty, uplifting orange to create the ultimate festive ambience. Evoking feelings of joy, nostalgia, and cosy contentment, it instantly fills your home with the scent of Christmas. Perfect for electronic diffusers or potpourri, this irresistible blend transforms any space into a warm, inviting haven of seasonal delight.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Oud Wood Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Invite your senses along a journey of mystery and intrigue with the Oud Wood Eau de Parfum Spray. This exotic and unmistakably distinctive cologne features Tom Ford’s pioneering composition of exotic woods and spices to evoke visions of smoky, incense-filled temples. The earthy fragrance is underpinned by a rare, precious oud wood, enveloping the wearer in its rich and dark blend of sensuality and strength. Exotic spices and cardamom add further warmth to the eau de parfum, complemented by natural elements of sandalwood, rosewood and amber. Confident and seductive, this intoxicating and elusive scent embodies the Tom Ford man. Oud Wood is housed in a smoked grey private blend bottle, inspired by the architectural appeal of a chess piece.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Gaultier Divine Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: A scent for the modern-day goddess, Jean Paul Gaultier’s Gaultier Divine Eau de Parfum radiates mystery and confidence through a dazzling marine floral olfactory. The fragrance embraces the world of Gaultier, celebrating the divinity of women, their power and uniqueness. The start of an eternal addiction, top notes of calypsone, pink berry and bergamot are caressed with a salty kiss. A floral bouquet of solar lily, jasmine and ylang-ylang is revealed before nestling into delicious airy meringue and musk. Striking with its voluptuous cones and curves, the bottle flaunts a corset gilded with gold. Allow the aura of Gaultier Divine to radiate forever thanks to the refillable bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Estée Lauder Bronze Goddess Eau Fraiche 10ml
listings.description: Feel the heat with the Estée Lauder Bronze Goddess Eau Fraîche. Creamy and sensual, this radiant adaptation of the brand's cult fragrance is inspired by the irresistible allure of summer skin. With notes of velvety tiare flower, creamy coconut and glowing amber, the fragrance evokes visions of balmy summer evenings. Sandalwood and vanilla create an effortless sensuality.

listings.rawTitle: Estée Lauder Bronze Goddess Eau de Parfum Travel Size 10ml
listings.description: Treat yourself to a luminous bouquet with the Estée Lauder Bronze Goddess Eau de Parfum, an opulent symphony of notes that captures the warmth of an endless summer. Establishing a bright and playful hook, bergamot, lemon and mandarin kick off the fragrance with a golden appeal, conjuring sunlit skin and long-awaited coastal escapes. Next in the pyramid is a joint tropical accord of tiare flower and coconut, caressed by jasmine and lavender and then sharpened by a slightly bitter hit of neroli. Supporting the solar notes above, a base of myrrh, vetiver and amber imbues the composition with a warm, resinous depth that lingers into sunset. The fragrance is housed in a deep magenta faceted bottle, complete with a turquoise-embellished, wave-rippled cap.

listings.rawTitle: Armani Stronger With You Absolutely Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
