listings.rawTitle: Armani Acqua Di Gio Homme Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Giorgio Armani introduces Acqua di Giò Eau de Parfum: a fragrance for the future. Meeting the values of a new generation, through its innovative Refill bottle and sustainably sourced ingredients. Discover the infinite power of the sea encapsulated through a powerful combination of marine, aromatic and woody notes. Acqua di Giò Eau de Parfum is refillable in every format. Giorgio Armani’s commitment to forest preservation is woven into the creation of the new Aqua di Gio Eau de Parfum. A fragrance that is both captures the essence of aquatic freshness and is mindful of the planet.

listings.rawTitle: Armani Acqua Di Gio Homme Profondo Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Dive in deep with the Armani Acqua Di Gio Homme Profondo Eau de Parfum, a marine-inspired fragrance that summons the courage and vigour of the ocean. Rehoused in an updated flacon, the scent remains the same classic formula - just in a new bottle. Refreshing notes of bergamot and green mandarin crash together to create a crisp and clean surface that blends into an icy plunge to awaken the senses. At its core, lavender, rosemary and cypress reveal a strong fougere heart that liberates the soul and body. Darkening at the base, patchouli and woods ground the scent at the sea's deep depths, while musk and amber add a warming quality to the uncertainty of the seafloor.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN La Petite Robe Noire Le Flacon Coeur Eau de Parfum 20ml
listings.description: Guerlain’s iconic La Petite Robe Noire Eau de Parfum has now inspired a never-seen-before, travel-friendly, refillable bottle: the Flacon Coeur. Its travel-friendly shape makes it easy to slip into your bag and to carry around everywhere, at all times. A new creation that captures the irresistible free spirit of the most Parisian fragrances of the House. Inspired by the inimitable Parisian style, La Petite Robe Noire is an ode to freedom and love, the embodiment of elegance and style, an invitation to joie de vivre and irreverence. A characterful sillage in homage to the rose. A tailor-made rose embroidered with the finest black notes in perfumery. Combining rose essence with the tender, naturally honeyed scent of a damascena rose absolute, Guerlain has allowed a new rose to bloom. The distinctive and utterly recognisable rose that is La Petite Robe Noire's signature… Combined with almond, red berries and bergamot notes, black cherry gives La Petite Robe Noire's sillage a gourmand sophistication and an irresistible fruity accent. If the heart shape and design of this new bottle seems instantly familiar, that’s because it follows in the footsteps of another icon in Guerlain’s fragrance heritage: the famous "inverted heart" bottle. First created in 1912 for L'Heure Bleue and then reissued for La Petite Robe Noire in 2012, this timeless bottle forms the inspiration of this part-classic, part-modern bottle and its innovative new size.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Absolus Allegoria Santal Royal Eau de Parfum 125ml
listings.description: The Allegoria fragrance collection celebrates the wonders of the world. Each creation pays tribute to nature’s beauty and sweeps us up in a discovery of exceptional raw ingredients and notes, beautifully enhanced by our perfumer-explorers.  Discover Santal Royal, a rare and precious wood majestically rising up in the penumbra. A fragrance trail that unfolds in a play of subtle contrasts between dark leather notes, the oud accord and the luminosity of floral notes of jasmine and rose. ""In addition to its elegant woody and light facets, sandalwood has a certain freshness, that’s at once creamy and richly deep. Its intrinsic suppleness allows it to meld freely with certain spicy or floral notes, to which it lends body and soul.""  - Thierry Wasser, Guerlain Master Perfumer  Absolus Allegoria, the absolute fragrance collection, is an enchanting and mysterious journey to the heart of the world’s wonders once night falls: fragrance trails celebrating deep and powerful nature, revealed by striking contrasts by moonlight. A powerful symbol of Guerlain's commitment to the planet, Absolus Allegoria fragrances contain up to 90% natural-origin*. The French beetroot alcohol used in their formulas comes from a network committed to responsible farming. Santal Royal comes in the Allegoria collection’s emblematic bottle which is made in France using 15% recycled glass. Featuring a removable spray pump and transparent lacquer finish, its design can be easily recycled.  *90% to 94% of ingredients are of natural origin, in accordance with ISO 16128, calculation includes water.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Les Légendaires Terracotta Eau de Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Discover Terracotta, a fragrance bursting with sunshine, inspired by the glowing radiance of Terracotta. An immediate escape to a faraway exotic paradise. Guerlain Master Perfumer, Thierry Wasser, has interpreted the iconic Terracotta Powder to create fragrance that bursts with sunshine. This highly-faceted perfume opens with fresh and addictive bergamot notes. A faceted citrus fruit that is zesty, green and floral, bergamot is often dubbed “Calabria's green gold” and is one of the House's favourite raw materials. The heart of the fragrance reveals a tiare flower ylang-ylang accord, a flower that grows in the Comoro Islands. Too fragile to be shipped, once picked it is immediately made into an essential oil using fire distillation. Ylang-ylang essence has a sunny, floral scent.  The signature reveals a sensual, soft, all-enveloping vanilla note. One of Guerlain's favourite notes, the vanilla signature draws floral and almond accents. Featuring the Tahitensis vanilla varietal, the fragrance takes on a richly gourmand, cocoon-like facet. Designed by Raymond Guerlain in 1912, its iconic “inverted heart” bottle is underscored with graceful scrolls typical of Art Nouveau. A true technical feat, its avant-garde stopper, in the form of a hollowed heart, evokes the delicate romanticism of this perfumery masterpiece.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Absolus Allegoria Epices Exquises Eau de Parfum 125ml
listings.description: The Allegoria fragrance collection celebrates the wonders of the world. Each creation pays tribute to nature’s beauty and sweeps us up in a discovery of exceptional raw ingredients and notes, beautifully enhanced by our perfumer-explorers.  Discover Épices Exquises, an evocation of an enchanting sensory journey. Inspired by the spicy aromas of cardamom-flavoured coffee, Thierry Wasser beautifully enhances the contrasts of precious spices in a fragrant chiaroscuro that awakens the senses. Cardamom reveals the exhilarating elegance of its fresh facets on contact with a warm, full-bodied and sensual base, tinged with black pepper and woody notes of oud, patchouli and sandalwood. listings.rawTitle: Cosmic by Kylie Jenner Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Trending for its transcendent aroma, Cosmic by Kylie Jenner Eau de Parfum launches an out-of-this-world collision of celestial florals and galactic amber accords. Embarking on its descent to Earth with star jasmine and blood orange notes, the scent takes you on an olfactive journey to the stars. At its core, golden amber and red peony create a divine fusion that transports your senses to otherworldly galaxies. Creamy vanilla and crisp musk complete the fragrance alongside magnetic cedarwood that grounds the scent for a rich, warming finish. The perfume’s unique flacon is specially crafted to imitate a piece of art from another universe. Designed to fit perfectly into the palm of your hand, the curved shape adds a modern twist to any dressing table.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy L'Interdit Eau de Parfum Absolu 50ml
listings.description: Reinventing the iconic scent, Givenchy’s L'Interdit Eau de Parfum Absolu redefines convention by breaking the boundaries of fragrance with a newly found intensity. Deeper and richer than before, the scent takes a smoky twist on the revered floral fragrance. For those who dare to be different, the fragrance opens with warming neroli and spiced cardamon to liberate the senses with a zesty fusion. Signature to the original L'Interdit, a floral heart proudly displays a bouquet of white florals, including orange blossom, tuberose and jasmine for a moment of refined femininity. Inviting you to free yourself from convention, contrasting accords of tobacco and vetiver bring a smoky quality to the scent with a warming, woody dry down of patchouli. Individuality and self-expression leave a lasting impression with this unforgettable, lingering trail. The bottle is redesigned with a darkened lacquer to represent the contrast between light and dark within the scent.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Pomegranate Noir Cologne 9ml
listings.description: Sweeten the senses with the Jo Malone London Pomegranate Noir Cologne. Refreshing nuances of juicy pomegranate fuse with floral heart notes of casablanca lily, seasoned with spicy pink pepper. This aromatic aroma settles on rich woody base notes of guaiacwood and patchouli, creating a warm and sensual scent.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Wood Sage & Sea Salt Cologne 9ml
listings.description: Breathe in the sea breeze with the Jo Malone London Wood Sage and Sea Salt Cologne, bringing the ocean closer to home. Aromatic and musky, ambrette seeds evoke a sandy shore pebbled with pearly stones and shells. Classic sea salt gives the fragrance its unique character and texture, freshening the scent like a rolling wave crashing against a towering cliff. Underneath the spray, sage’s earthiness ties together every note, linking the airy mist back to its roots in the seabed. With a woody intensity but playful heart, this cologne uplifts and revitalises your senses.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Lime Basil & Mandarin Cologne 9ml
listings.description: The Lime Basil and Mandarin Cologne is a signature fragrance from Jo Malone. Quintessentially British and luxurious, Jo Malone has gained a global presence for its elegant scents. This fragrance perfectly blends citrus and herbal hues, revealing a unique scent which is both revitalising and relaxing. Cool and confident, this fragrance evokes a Caribbean breeze, transporting you to a world of calm. Drying down to the base note of Amberwood, the cologne leaves you with a comforting presence, familiar and warming.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Peony & Blush Suede Cologne 9ml
listings.description: Inspired by modern British culture, Jo Malone London creates bespoke and luxurious fragrances synonymous with quintessential British style. Charming and exquisite, Jo Malone London Peony and Blush Suede Cologne opens with the crisp and juicy bite of Red Apple before succumbing to a floral heart of Peony; a delicate accord that brings a subtle green freshness with hints of Rose and Honey. Luxurious and seductive, the eau de toilette settles on a plush bed of Blush Suede, which rounds off the fragrance with a soft and sensual opulence.

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa 76 Perfume Mist 240ml
listings.description: Get lost in the rhythm of Rio at dusk with the Sol de Janeiro Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa 76 Perfume Mist. The fragrance invites you to experience the intoxicating energy of a spontaneous evening, with enchanting amber floral notes taking you from dusk to dawn. Rich black currant and pear nectar melt into a hypnotic heart of midnight jasmine, vanilla crème and freesia. Alluring amber woods and caramelised patchouli add an intensified warmth and sensuality that lingers until sunrise.

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa 76 Perfume Mist 90ml

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Omnia Crystalline Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Built around the same signature accords of the eau de toilette, the BVLGARI Omnia Crystalline Eau de Parfum is an intense interpretation of the woody-floral fragrance. Pushing the boundaries of olfactive craftmanship, perfumer Alberto Morillas takes inspiration from precious gemstones, infusing the scent with sparkling, striking nuances. Expressing its radiant florality is a blend of jasmine, sourced from the “Flower Gems of India” program, and green tea lotus, pairing perfectly with the sweetly sophisticated scents of nashi pear and green mandarin essence. Underpinning the eau de parfum is a refined sandalwood base, laced with luminous musks for a second skin-like finish. Committing to its original design, the fragrance arrives in a curved interlocked flacon with a warmed rose gold touch.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Barenia Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Perfumer Christine Nagel presents her chypre for Hermès: a sensual fragrance of rare, unforgettable elegance. Barénia is a skin perfume, bringing together strength and softness. It expresses the instinctive, captivating facets of a woman. An unstoppable woman. The living embodiment of freedom. Barénia eau de parfum blends exhilarating butterfly lily with the delicacy of the miracle berry, and envelops them in oakwood and an intense patchouli. An elusive, stirring and surprising chypre with a sensuous texture. Created by Philippe Mouquet and inspired by the Collier de Chien bracelet, the bottle balances gentle elliptical curves with the power of the metal plate adorned with domed pyramid studs.    At the heart of the jewel-like Barénia bottle is one final stud, its shape molded into the glass.  The 100ml, 60ml and 30ml bottles can be replenished using the 125ml refill, sold separately. A responsible act, integral to an object created to last.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé L’Eau de Parfum Intense for Women Refill 150ml
listings.description: Capturing the emotion and energy of the Chloé woman, Chloé L’Eau de Parfum Intense for Women exudes joy, optimism and freedom through its addictive floral fragrance – an expression of the power of women according to Chloé. The scent opens with vibrant, juicy notes of raspberry, complementing the sensuality of rose that lies beneath. As if captured at any moment of the day, the floral heart note embodies the fresh morning rose, the rich opening of midday rose and the sweet honeyed evening rose, taking its wearer on an olfactive journey. At the base, a bouquet of ambery woods unfolds, including musky ambrox, smooth cashmeran and warm cedar. Reinvented for L’Eau de Parfum Intense, the famous pleated Chloé bottle is stamped with a sleek black and ecru label for a modern look, alongside a deep garnet ribbon to reflect the fragrance’s floral composition. Use this 150ml Refill to top up your 30ml, 50ml and 100ml fragrance when it runs out and enjoy the long-lasting scent trail, perfect for any occasion.

listings.description: The Hinoki and Cedarwood Cologne Intense takes the Japanese wilderness as its muse. Earthy and distinctively fresh, the fragrance transports the senses to a tranquil forest, evoking images of endless trees and greenery. The immersive scent marries a clean aromatic accord with warm, rich nuances of hinoki, soothing the senses as the cologne wears on the skin. Grounded in cedarwood, the fragrance offers a serene olfactive escape.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum Intense 100ml
listings.description: Created by Olivier Cresp, the Dolce&Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum Intense unites vibrant floral facets with creamy amber nuances in a rich gourmand medley. Revisiting the original fragrance with deeper, more enveloping notes, the eau de parfum opens with distinctive hazelnut, a warm and comforting aroma, before being enhanced by luminous orange blossom for a fresh edge. Milky vanilla lends a sensuous allure, drying down on the skin with a luxurious, long-lasting sillage.

listings.rawTitle: AERIN Rose De Grasse Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Part of a collection that celebrates the founder’s favourite flower, AERIN’s Rose De Grasse Eau de Parfum 50ml explores the many facets of the rose. The elegant floral perfume is inspired by the rare, special roses that grow in Grasse, France. The fragrance blends the rare hundred-petalled rose centifolia with rich notes of Bulgarian rose and pure rose absolute for a scent that evokes the timeless beauty of the beloved flower.

listings.rawTitle: AERIN Mediterranean Honeysuckle Eau de Parfum Travel Spray 7ml
listings.description: Inspired by the vibrant tapestry of the Mediterranean, AERIN’s Mediterranean Honeysuckle Eau de Parfum Travel Spray transports the senses to sun-drenched sands and sparkling seas with its radiant floral citrus scent. The sweet nuances of honeysuckle, carried on a warm summer’s breeze, opens the fragrance composition with a heady presence, while a zesty note of gardenia mingles with pink grapefruit for a fruity-fresh finish.

listings.rawTitle: AERIN Amber Musk Eau de Parfum Travel Spray 7ml
listings.description: Like a warm embrace and soft cashmere on the skin, AERIN’s Amber Musk Eau de Parfum Travel Spray is inspired by the cosiness of a grand fireplace, aglow on a cold frosted night to bring a comforting warmth with an authentic, musk scent. Refined yet familiar, the fragrance features notes of honeyed rose centifolia and velvety amber to imbue an inviting aroma, before a musk dry down grants second-skin-like intensity and longevity. The brand’s scent wardrobe is designed to be layered, allowing you to pair Amber Musk with lighter, fresher facets for a customisable olfactive trail.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Eau De Rhubarbe Écarlate Hand and Body Cleans Gel Bottle 300ml
listings.description: Eau de rhubarbe ecarlate expresses the joyful and generous freshness of the colognes in the form of a hand and body cleansing gel. Another way to wear fragrance. Eau de rhubarbe ecarlate expresses the freshness of crisp rhubarb and tangy lantana, mingled with elegant musk notes. The straight lines of the bottle are embellished with scarlet, emblematic of Eau de rhubarbe ecarlate, and two signature details: the H imprint of the base and the Clou de Selle engraved on the pump. The bottle is made of recyclable glass. The Eau de rhubarbe ecarlate hair and body shower gel refill can be used to replenish the 300 ml bottle. A responsible gesture, integral to an object created to last. A rich and environmentally friendly gel that forms a pleasant, easy-rinse lather. Leaving the skin delicately perfumed and soft.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Boss Bottled Absolu Eau De Parfum Intense 100ml
listings.description: Hugo Boss presents the Boss Bottled Absolu Eau De Parfum Intense, a masculine fragrance that envelops the skin in an irresistible roasted signature scent. Modern but memorable, the multi-faceted fragrance reveals a sophisticated scent that captures the power of the BOSS man. Opening with a distinctive leather accord, the aroma is rooted in richness and elegance. Patchouli and myrrh command the senses with vigour and sensuality, while met with a cedarwood-amber base to enhance the temptation of the scent. The perfume is held within a double-lacquered flacon, complete with an opulent, gilded cap to finalise the exquisite presentation of this woody fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Armani Si Passione Intense Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Si Passione Intense is a vibrant scent offering from Armani that enthralls the senses with every spritz. The Eau de Parfum is an olfactive exploration of the heart’s truest desires, veiling the skin in a captivating aroma that exudes sensuality. The fragrance marries fresh, juicy nuances of pear with a rich jasmine accord, lending a comforting warmth to the multi-faceted scent. In the base, vanilla grounds the Eau de Parfum with a delicious sweetness, creating a romantic sillage.

listings.rawTitle: Goldfield & Banks Mystic Bliss Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: The Goldfield & Banks Mystic Bliss EDP is an aromatic floral fragrance inspired by the allure and enchantment of Flinders Island. Another addition to the Native Collection, the scent reflects the beauty of the Aurora Australis with the starry night sky of Tasmania in mind. This wintery fusion embodies the cooling air of the Antarctic through the delicate nuances of fig, mint, and cardamom. At its adventurous core, clary sage mingles with geranium and orris for a grounding earthy twist. Cedarwood and sandalwood soothe the senses with the magnetism of the outdoors, while vetiver and labdanum finish the scent with a luxurious dry down.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Myrrh & Tonka Cologne Intense 9ml
listings.description: Discover your new signature scent with Jo Malone London's Myrrh and Tonka Cologne Intense. Unique and distinctive, the fragrance opens with top notes of aromatic lavender, incorporating an air of masculine elegance. A heart of omumbiri myrrh exudes a rich sensuality with warm amber notes, instantly addictive and inviting. The fragrance is underpinned by a base of creamy tonka bean, revealing nuances of indulgent vanilla and almond with a luxurious tobacco accent. This unisex cologne offers impressive longevity with an irresistible spiced warmth.

listings.rawTitle: Sabrina Carpenter Caramel Dream Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Playful and flirty just like the pocket-rocket sensation herself, Sabrina Carpenter’s Caramel Dream appeases your craving for a sweet treat. Housed within the iconic chocolate bar-shaped bottle, the pearlescent flacon is reimagined with a caramel twist. Symbolising the many forms of the syrup delight, the Eau de Parfum whips up a velvety recipe to satisfy the senses. Provoking a tempting opening, creamy almond milk mingles with refreshing freesia for a hint of romance, before fusing with sugared lemon and orange zest for a light and airy introduction. Still wanting more, the heart unleashes a darkened desire for candied cravings as indulgently rich dark chocolate bean combines with lustrous vanilla and irresistible orange blossom. A honeyed dry down of deep sandalwood flirts with caramelised amber, as the pair lures patchouli and musk to complete this sensual gourmand treat.

listings.rawTitle: Ariana Grande MOD Vanilla Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Bursting with sensuality, Ariana Grande’s MOD Vanilla takes an elevated twist on the classic gourmand with an intoxicating trial that will become unforgettable. Opening with a vibrant blend, the scent disrupts the senses with juicy dark plum and pink freesia, heightened by creamy musk for a powerful beginning to a modern fragrance. At its core, orris butter mingles with white praline to exude a sense of luxury and refinement in this intimate display of accords. Vanilla and cocoa allow you to embark on the scent’s intricate complexities, seducing you with its alluring, sweetened notes for a fragrance so addictive you will return for more.

listings.rawTitle: Ariana Grande MOD Blush Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Inspired by the singer’s ethereal aesthetic, the Ariana Grande MOD Blush fragrance showcases a duality of sweet and sumptuous notes with its sparkling fruity-amber blend. Celebrating free-spirited fierceness, the refined scent begins with a lush medley of passionfruit, bergamot and bright raspberry, energised by pink pepper to exhilarate the senses. A floral bouquet featuring dew-kissed magnolia and satin-soft rose petals imbues an air of blossoming freshness, before evolving into a warm, dreamy dry down of ambrox and musk. Housed in a sleek, contoured flacon, the fragrance stands out amongst your Ariana Grande perfume collection with a contemporary edge.

listings.rawTitle: Ariana Grande Pink Cloud Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Characterised by sensuous woods and delicious gourmand accords, Ariana Grande’s Pink Cloud is an empowering fragrance that inspires you to be the most confident version of yourself. The uplifting scent is bursting with freshness. Marrying a juicy blend of berries with dragon fruit and pink pineapple, the perfume invigorates the senses with every spritz. A delicate bouquet of vanilla orchid and blush ambrette lends the fragrance a comforting character, wrapped in a warm, comforting embrace of praline for a captivating finish. The bottle’s iconic cloud silhouette is reimagined with a playful pink tint, alluding to the optimistic nature of the scent within.

listings.rawTitle: Laboratory Perfumes Helios Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Inspired by lazy Tuscan afternoons, the Helios Eau de Toilette from Laboratory Perfumes marries citrus notes with woody undertones to transport its wearer to Mediterranean moments. Opening notes of citrus, bergamot, orange and grapefruit intertwine with a floral heart of rose and lily of the valley. Contrasting at the base, wood, amber, cedar, moss and musk elevate this sensorial fragrance, evoking feelings of being surrounded by the beauty of Italian nature.

listings.rawTitle: Fenty Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Fenty Beauty's Eau de Parfum embodies the sensuality and confident allure of its eponymous founder, Rihanna. Taking you on an olfactive journey, the conflicting aroma creates rising tension between sweet and spicy. A tantalising cocktail of blueberry and tangerine tempt passersby with juicy nuances that linger. The accord that changed it all, creamy magnolia mingles with a bouquet of rose and geranium in a luxurious floral twist. Settling against the skin, clean musk brings a comforting tone with woody patchouli to enhance the trail's longevity. The iconic bottle radiates warmth and heat with its glossy brown lacquer, inspired by Rihanna's centralisation of the colour brown.

listings.rawTitle: Le Monde Gourmand Oud Sahara Perfume Oil Rollerball 30ml
listings.description: An opulent spiced scent by Le Monde Gourmand. Perfume Oil Rollerball captures the open air of the desert, spiked with unmistakable oud and exotic woods on a warm day. Opening with a rich vanilla accord, the fragrance balances bright bergamot with sensuous woods to create a well-rounded, resinous trail. A newly-improved higher fragrance concentration ensures optimal longevity, while an infusion of apricot oil supports the formula to nourish the skin with wear and add a subtle glow. Paired with the brand’s gourmand offering, you can create a customisable scent signature by layering this rollerball perfume.

listings.rawTitle: Le Monde Gourmand Crème Brulee Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Break through the caramelised top of Le Monde Gourmand Crème Brulee Eau de Parfum to uncover a scent that whisks you away to a dessert lover’s paradise. The nutty warmth of roasted almond and the juicy allure of black plum greet you like the first bite. At its heart, midnight iris blooms, adding a velvety essence to the sweetness. Finally, musk clouds and a rich rum accord swirl together, leaving behind a sugary scent trail that satisfies your cravings with every spritz.

listings.rawTitle: Le Monde Gourmand Sucre de Coton Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: A day at the carnival awaits with Le Monde Gourmand’s Sucre de Coton Eau de Parfum. The addictively sweet scent draws inspiration from cotton candy, tempting the senses with a delectable confection reminiscent of a funfair. The first bite of the fragrance oozes with juiciness, thanks to a refreshing blend of mixed berries. Nuances of pink cyclamen add a light floralcy to the perfume, whipped up with a tasty vanilla sugar accord at its olfactive crescendo.

listings.rawTitle: Le Monde Gourmand Miel Bébé Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Indulge your senses in the nectar of Miel Bébé Eau de Parfum by Le Monde Gourmand, a honeyed fragrance sweetened with lush floral notes to satisfy your sweet tooth. Transporting you to a fruitful garden in full bloom, the scent opens with juicy mandarin and honey blossom accords to leave behind an addictive gourmand trail. At the centre, earthy sandalwood grounds the fragrance with a woody richness, while rich praline reinforces the velvety warmness of this syrupy scent.

listings.rawTitle: Le Monde Gourmand Lait de Coco Perfume Oil Rollerball 30ml
listings.description: Capturing the very essence of sun-warmed coconut, Le Monde Gourmand’s Lait de Coco Perfume Oil Rollerball is a best-selling scent, capable of whisking the senses away to tropical planes where every day is a beach day. Hanging above stretches of powdery white sands, creamy coconut ripens, while nuances of bergamot dance along crystal-clear waters. Vanilla praline indulges the composition in a slightly toasted, warm trail, underpinning the milky coconut with an inviting allure. Fresh, delicious and reminiscent of summer, roll on this fragrance whenever you need a slice of sunshine.

listings.rawTitle: Le Monde Gourmand Santal Supreme Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Synonymous with sophistication and elegance, the Le Monde Gourmand Santal Supreme Eau de Parfum boasts an exceptional blend of grounding, earthy notes. Fresh yet classic, the fragrance opens with ripened fig and Haitian vetiver in a celebration of the natural world. At its heart, violet leaves add a touch of floral sweetness to the scent for harmonious balance. Complete with sandalwood musks, the aroma is grounded with a wearable woody nuance that is sure to turn heads in every room.

listings.rawTitle: Le Monde Gourmand Oud Sahara Eau de Parfum 30ml

Paired with the brand’s gourmand offering, you can create a customisable scent signature by layering this perfume.

listings.rawTitle: Le Monde Gourmand Angel Soiree Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Tease the senses with the tantalising aroma of Angel Soirée, a whimsical scent offering from Le Monde Gourmand that envelops the skin in a delectable mélange of accords. Made in collaboration with TikTok creator Caroline Stern, the fragrance invites its wearer on an olfactive journey to paradise. The opening is bursting with mouth-watering fruits. Fleshy apricot and juicy strawberry marry with pink marshmallow, lending the perfume its signature sweetness. A heavenly mixture of rose-infused milk and magnolia evoke images of cherubs playing in a spring garden, embraced by vanilla praline for a serene finish.

listings.rawTitle: Le Monde Gourmand Santal Supreme Perfume Oil Rollerball 30ml
listings.description: Synonymous with sophistication and elegance, the Le Monde Gourmand Santal Supreme Perfume Oil Rollerball boasts an exceptional blend of grounding, earthy notes. Fresh yet classic, the fragrance opens with ripened fig and Haitian vetiver in a celebration of the natural world. At its heart, violet leaves add a touch of floral sweetness to the scent for harmonious balance. Complete with sandalwood musks, the aroma is grounded with a wearable woody nuance that is sure to turn heads in every room.

listings.rawTitle: Le Monde Gourmand Peche Delicieuse Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: In collaboration with Jade Bodley, Le Monde Gourmand’s limited-edition Pêche Délicieuse Eau de Parfum is an irresistible fragrance nectar, brimming with juicy peach notes and velvety caramel accords. Part of the brand’s Coterie of Creators, this carefully curated scent celebrates the artistry of perfumery with three new flavoursome fragrances. Pêche Délicieuse is ideal for lovers of freshly baked goods, oven-warmed sweet treats and juicy fruit puddings. Starring a succulent line up of cinnamon, cocoa, orange and vanilla nuances, the honey-like sweetness of the perfume lingers on the skin long after the first spritz to satiate your senses. Wear alone or pair with the brand's Chai Épicé Eau de Parfum for a sultry-spiced edge.

listings.rawTitle: Le Monde Gourmand Citron Glacé Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Light and vibrant, with a sugary hit of freshness, Le Monde Gourmand’s Citron Glacé Eau de Parfum offers a zesty twist on a traditionally sweet fragrance. The scent plays on the juxtaposition of sharp, tangy lemon and rich jasmine, perfectly balancing the two accords with rock sugar to create a unique aroma. Spritz over the skin as desired for an exhilarating citrus rush.

listings.rawTitle: Le Monde Gourmand Açai Baie Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Sweet, juicy and unconditionally inviting, the Le Monde Gourmand Açai Baie Eau de Parfum offers a fresh aromatic aroma that radiates sunshine. Opening with the tangy sparkle of acai berry, the scent transcends into delicate muguet blooms, adding a whisper of floral nuances to balance the vibrant fruitiness. The journey concludes on a warm, creamy base of vanilla musk, wrapping your senses in a soft, irresistible embrace.

listings.rawTitle: Le Monde Gourmand 000 Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Perfect for wearing alone or layering as part of your fragrance wardrobe, Le Monde Gourmand’s 000 offers a clean, classic scent that pairs perfectly with you. The Eau de Parfum is both fresh and warm. Marrying zesty bergamot with crisp freesia and waterlily, the fragrance exudes sophistication, wrapped in a creamy sandalwood accord to create a sensual, skin-like sillage.

listings.rawTitle: Le Monde Gourmand Thé Matcha Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Unwind with Le Monde Gourmand's Thé Matcha Eau de Parfum. Creamy yet earthy, the refreshing scent indulges the senses like a mid-afternoon café treat. Expertly blended like the drink itself, the fragrance opens with a sip of warming green tea. At the heart, a bouquet of freesia releases a sweet but clean scent with elements of multi-faceted florals. Amber tops off the fragrance as a grounding and comforting finish to an addictive trail.

listings.rawTitle: Le Monde Gourmand Pistachio Brûlée Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Experience the sweetness of Le Monde Gourmand with the Pistachio Brûlée Eau de Parfum. The first of its kind, and marking the beginning of the brand, the fragrance features mouth-watering notes that will leave you craving more. Milk vanilla mousse tempts the senses with a sweet treat, before mingling with vibrant pistachio that lingers on the skin with a delicate richness. Completing the gourmand dream, vanilla bean closes the scent with a satisfying twist.

listings.rawTitle: Le Monde Gourmand Chai Épicé Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Le Monde Gourmand’s Chai Épicé Eau de Parfum feels like your favourite autumn ritual captured in a bottle. The scent story begins with the sweetness of ripe and softly spiced violet fig. As the fragrance unfolds, muguet musk weaves a delicate, velvety warmth, while the grounding nuances of blonde woods linger, adding a creamy conclusion. It’s an amber-gourmand scent reminiscent of chai-dusted afternoons and golden sunsets.

listings.rawTitle: Le Monde Gourmand Macaron Rosé Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: A modern interpretation of a beloved flower, Le Monde Gourmand’s Macaron Rosé Eau de Parfum is a light, dewy scent with an irresistibly indulgent twist. The fragrance centres around two types of rose, lending the perfume its sophisticated character. As the scent wears on the skin, an unexpected rush of sweetness hits, as nuances of Turkish Delight are revealed. Allow this refreshing floral elixir to uplift the senses as you are bathed in its aromatic cloud.

listings.rawTitle: Le Monde Gourmand Crème Vanille Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Embrace the warmth and comfort of amber with the Crème Vanille Eau de Parfum. Le Monde Gourmand’s best-selling fragrance is like a cosy hug, soothing the senses with its welcoming aroma. The scent layers creamy apricot with the rich yet delicate aroma of jasmine, creating a skin-like sillage that wears down with a subtly sweet finish. Addictively indulgent, the fragrance is wrapped in a mouth-watering blend of amber and brown sugar, leaving its wearer with an inviting aura.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss BOSS The Scent Magnetic Eau de Parfum for Her 50ml
listings.description: An olfactive depiction of a power couple, BOSS The Scent Magnetic Eau de Parfum 50ml captures the essence of chemistry with its mesmerising trail. A dark, textured osmanthus flower accord is juxtaposed against sensuous white musk to create an enticing scent juxtaposition. Lending an irresistible warmth, the fragrance is wrapped in an amber accord, tantalising the senses with every spritz. The design of the bottle represents the thrilling character of the perfume within. The multi-faceted flacon features a deep purple hue and is topped with an icy-gold cap, finished with the signature BOSS logo.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss BOSS The Scent Elixir Parfum Intense for Her 50ml
listings.description: A potion of pure magnetism, BOSS The Scent Elixir Parfum Intense for Her inflames the senses with its hypnotic, highly concentrated composition. This irresistible, seductive fragrance smoulders with woody and floral contrasts, capturing the essence of passion and power. The scent ignites with a spark of fresh pink peppercorn, setting ablaze a journey into the heart of belladonna, a flower as enticing as it is enigmatic. As heated tension reaches its peak, a rich amber accord unfurls, leaving golden trails of femininity and strength. The Elixir reinvents empowering sensuality in a striking flacon featuring the BOSS logo on deep-red lacquered glass. Its multi-faceted shape captures the flicker of flames within, while a Double-B monogrammed warm-gold cap crowns the elixir, a bold reflection of the sensorial showdown inside. More than a fragrance, it embodies the strong, undeniable chemistry flowing between a power couple, evoking seduction, intensity and allure.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss BOSS The Scent Magnetic Eau de Parfum for Him 50ml
listings.description: An intense iteration of the brand’s original formula, Hugo Boss’ BOSS The Scent Magnetic Eau de Parfum captivates the senses with its mesmeric woody blend. Oozing sophisticated sensuality, the powerful fragrance opens with invigorating top notes of Maninka fruit, an ingredient exclusive to the brand, that grants an instantly recognisable allure. Bran absolute balances with creamy vanilla to capture a seductive amber-woody dry down, topped with hints of authentic leather that tantalises and lends a long-lasting trail.

listings.rawTitle: HUGO BOSS BOSS The Scent Le Parfum For Her Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: An intense iteration of the brand’s iconic The Scent spray, Hugo Boss’ BOSS The Scent Parfum for Her ignites the senses with each sparkling spritz of the floral-amber fragrance - capturing the chemistry flowing between a power couple. Showcasing the balance between spiced pink peppercorn, orange blossom and vetiver, the perfume unleashes an alchemy of irresistible notes, sweet yet warm, that lingers long after the first mist. Grounded by airy akigalawood in the base, the fragrance closes on a lush, sensual allure, ensuring you’ll command the olfactive attention of those around you. The Scent Parfum is housed in a striking flacon featuring the BOSS logo on deep-plum lacquered glass and a Double-B monogrammed rose-gold cap, echoing the warm, addictive scent within.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss BOSS The Scent Eau de Toilette for Him 100ml
listings.description: An irresistible amber-woody fragrance by Hugo Boss. The BOSS The Scent Eau de Toilette ignites the senses with its sensuous blend, underpinned by bold contrasts of fresh and fierce nuances and their undeniable chemistry. Opening with a spiced, exhilarating air of ginger oil, the cologne captures the olfactive attention immediately. This energising accord is met with the more mellow, suave Maninka fruit facet, crafted exclusively for the brand. Rounding the scent trail is a warm leather note, anchoring the fragrance and finishing with an authentic, sensual edge, increasing the tension between the distinguishing top note. Housed in a refillable bottle featuring the BOSS logo, the sensual, striking glass flacon showcases the fiery-coloured cologne inside. All sizes are designed to be refillable with the 200ml refill bottle, sold separately. Screw the 200ml refill onto the neck of the 50ml, 100ml or 200ml bottle and automatically stops filling to deliver the optimal amount of fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss BOSS The Scent Elixir Parfum Intense for Him 100ml
listings.description: A portrayal of raw intensity, BOSS The Scent Elixir Parfum Intense for Him takes the original BOSS The Scent fragrance to unparalleled levels of depth and magnetism. This rich, ambery-leathery-woody composition fuses fiery contrasts, creating an irresistible, captivating force. The fragrance ignites with the red-hot spice of pimento, leading into a heart of vibrant lavandin absolute, harvested from the sun-drenched fields of Provence. As tension reaches its peak, a warm, woody base of Caledonian sandalwood smoulders on the skin, leaving a long lasting masculine scent that boasts confidence and allure. Housed in a striking ruby-toned flacon, the multi-faceted design reflects the sensorial showdown within this charismatic scent. The deep-red lacquered glass, emblazoned with the BOSS logo, is crowned by a double-B monogrammed warm-gold cap as a symbol of strength and power. More than a fragrance, BOSS The Scent Elixir for Him captures the undeniable chemistry flowing between a power couple, embodying bold sensuality and unwavering intensity.

listings.description: The TOM FORD Black Lacquer Eau de Parfum has an addictive opening of black lacquer and vinyl. From the first spritz, it creates a dark, polished allure as velvety dark peony softens the composition. Enriched by the warm, resinous depth of olibanum, the scent settles into a refined base of Makassar ebony and cedarwood atlas, wrapping the skin in smooth, smoky woods.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Eau D'Ombré Leather Eau de Toilette Spray 50ml
listings.description: Rich, luminous notes meet in the Tom Ford Eau D'Ombré Leather Eau de Toilette Spray. The wildly radiant composition fuses rich amber, vanilla, leather and invigorating spices to capture the essence of a new day rising over the American West. Fresh ginger, coriander and cardamom spark an aromatic introduction that fuels a glowing leather accord. Grounded by a flame of amber and honeyed woods, the Eau de Toilette presents a sensual and enticing scent trail.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Her Eau de Parfum Intense 50ml
listings.description: Unleash your inner muse with the lushly-layered Burberry Her Eau de Parfum Intense, a magnetic fragrance that elevates your signature scent to new heights. Crafted for a multi-faceted allure, this perfume boldly embraces its character, leading with vibrant wild strawberry and radiant notes of orange blossom. Beyond this delectable gourmand blend lies a warmly-woody amber core, grounding a seductive aroma that envelops you as you enter bustling bars or sunset soirées. Encased in a modern lacquered matte-pink bottle, this expression of refined femininity from the British brand is as striking as it is elegant. The scent retains the addictive charm of the original while leaving a stronger impression, paving the way for cherished memories. Keep this exquisite fragrance for yourself or gift its richness to a loved one.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Nomade Lumière d'Égypte Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: An olfactive expedition awaits with the Chloé Nomade Lumière D'Égypte Eau De Parfum 75ml. Drawing inspiration from the birthplace of founder Gaby Aghion, the fragrance transports the senses to the beautiful landscapes of Egypt. The opening takes its wearer on a journey along the Nile. Featuring fresh, aquatic nuances of blue lotus and a sensuous jasmine accord, the scent evokes images of the river and its beautiful surrounding vegetation. As the fragrance unfurls, a kyphi accord unveils itself, paying homage to ancient Egyptian perfumery with a warming blend of sandalwood, cinnamon bark and myrrh. The luxurious flacon takes sunlight as its muse, featuring a luminous gold colour and glowing accents. Tied with a dusky blue knot, Chloé Nomade Lumière D'Égypte is an eye-catching addition to your scent collection.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Born In Roma Donna Extradose Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Paying homage to Rome at dusk, Valentino’s Born in Roma Extradose Donna Eau de Parfum celebrates the eternal city and its vibrant allure. The fragrance opens with a trio of luminous jasmine twinkling across the river Tiber, as warming benzoin nuances enhance the amber sweetness of the scent. An undercurrent of creamy vanilla ties the olfactive trail together, weaving hints of velvety depth throughout the perfume to encourage a long-lasting silage that exuberates from the skin. Housed in the brand’s prismatic studs, the fragrance nods to the Aristo punk evenings held in the city, highlighting its bold and brazen allure.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Born In Roma Uomo Extradose Parfum 100ml
listings.description: An ode to the eternal city of Rome and its classic yet contemporary duality, Valentino’s Born in Roma Extradose Uomo Eau de Toilette is an aromatic, fougère fragrance that dares to be bold. Showcasing its core vanilla nuance that unites the Born in Roma collection, the cologne opens with an addictive infusion, warmed by vetiver to lend a leather-like edge. Fresh and floral lavandin vibrates with a multi-layered luminosity, before spiced accords tie the trail with piquant pleasantness, leaving a long-lasting silage that lingers on the skin. Housed in the brand’s iconic prismatic studs, the bottle reflects the fierce fragrance within.

listings.description: Stronger With You is a head-turning fragrance from Armani that commands attention. Centred around a warm chestnut accord, the scent creates an unforgettable impression with its daring blend of notes. Leathered nuances of vanilla lend the perfume depth and warmth, intensified with the sharpness of pink pepper. Lavender lends an unexpected floralcy, complementing the fragrance’s spicy facets for a smooth, thrilling finish. The intensity of Armani’s Stronger With You Parfum is represented in the bold aesthetic of its flacon. Featuring a rich, amber colour, the bottle exudes power.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Glitter Eau de Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent’s iconic floral fragrance, now reimagined with a sultry gourmand twist. Black Opium Glitter is utterly irresistible, inviting its wearer on an olfactive exploration of pleasure. The Eau de Parfum stars a marshmallow musk accord that adds a sexy sweetness to the fragrance. Electrified with the scent’s quintessential black coffee accord, juicy fruits and a luminous bouquet of orange blossoms, the fragrance intoxicates the senses with every spritz. The 90ml bottle takes on a new dazzling form. Featuring a sparkling silver colour and a pink glass window, the gem-like flacon is unapologetically provocative.

A blend of aldehydes and musks ground the aroma to create a seamless fusion from first spritz to time spent on the skin, warming with wear but always keeping its radiant distinctiveness. Encased in a pink-tinted flacon, the fragrance emulates the colours of rhubarb, entwined within the elixir to show its influence and union with each accord.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Man Extreme Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: The Man Extreme Eau de Parfum 50ml invites you on a hedonistic journey to the depths of sensuality with its reimagining of the classic Jimmy Choo fragrance. Crafted for those seeking a sultry addition to their scent repertoire, Man Extreme enchants with a beguiling blend of amber, red thyme and black pepper. At the same time, the heart unveils a herbal balance of geranium and clary sage, while the darkly sweet base notes of tonka bean and vetiver lend the fragrance a magnetic quality. Housed in a crimson crocodile lacquered flask, the aroma concludes with an uplifting hint of lemon.

Cushioned amongst the crystal moss, cashmeran lends a mineral inflection, while saffron weaves between accords with its lively spiced signature. Closing the trail, rich patchouli connects the senses with the earth thanks to its grounding profile, tying the warm, woody and multi-dimensional nuances together in one seamless fragrance blend.

Powered by notes of ginger, bergamot, saffron, palo santo and amber, the EDP awakens and enlivens the senses. No One Elsie 10ml Inspired by Adam’s grandmother’s greenhouse, this fresh yet sophisticated scent opens with rhubarb and crisp tomato leaf for an earthy introduction. Delicate notes of redcurrant and honeysuckle weave amongst them while vetiver and palo santo provide depth. Future Bloom 10ml A floral medley with zesty mandarin hints. Succulent cassis and tart rhubarb lead to make way for a softer, more gentle blend of jasmine and lily of the valley, before settling on a warm base of vanilla and white musk. A Kind of Floral 10ml  Uniting zested lemon, peach and pink pepper with a trio of sweet florals, musk and sandalwood, this fresh yet warm fragrance strikes the perfect balance of classic and contemporary.

listings.rawTitle: Sabrina Carpenter Cherry Baby Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Get date night ready with Sabrina Carpenter’s perfume, Cherry Baby. The Eau de Parfum starts the night with a fruity cocktail, met by a touch of romance and makes sure you stay until dessert. Making the third edition to her fragrance collection, Sabrina takes a seductive twist on the iconic scent, Sweet Tooth. Inspired by a Cosmopolitan cocktail, sparkling cherry is the star note in this scent, sweetened by glazed apple and plum nectar. A bouquet of red poppy and peony blossom flirts with vanilla orchid, romancing those who cross her path. Tempting yet addictive, an aroma of dark chocolate swirls with brown sugar provoking a warming, gourmand embrace. Patchouli and musk leave behind a seductive trail that leaves the senses unable to forget her.

listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY Very Irresistible Eau de Parfum Spray 80ml
listings.description: Delve into a feminine wonderland of floral elegance with the Givenchy Very Irresistible Eau de Parfum. Evoking glamour and spontaneity, the sweet fragrance opens with sensual notes of star anise intertwined with a floral bouquet of roses. Descending into a rich base of smooth vanilla and patchouli accords, the opulent perfume offers an indulgent and long-lasting scent trail.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Devotion for Men Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: An olfactive narration of love and commitment, combined with intimate memories of Sicily. Dolce&Gabanna’s Devotion for Men Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml offers a captivating olfactory experience. The authentic essence of the Mediterranean can be attributed to a juxtaposition of fresh lemon and rich, strong coffee. This harmonious blend is reminiscent of perfumer Olivier Cresp’s childhood, where he sampled drinks in a café with his father. Laced with earthy patchouli, the scent whisks the senses away to a blissful moment in time. The flacon pays homage to its feminine counterpart, showcasing Dolce&Gabanna’s signature Sacred Heart across the bottle’s front.

listings.rawTitle: Q by Dolce&Gabbana Parfum 100ml
listings.description: A fragrance designed to make its wearer feel like a contemporary queen, Q by Dolce&Gabbana exudes radiant and refined feminine energy. The 100ml Parfum Spray fuses vibrant citrus fruits with a delicate bouquet of florals. Sparkling notes of Sicilian lemon and red orange are elevated by jasmine petals. A heart of sweet cherry and creamy heliotrope seduce the senses, before base notes of cedarwood and musk give the perfume an intense, addictive edge.

listings.rawTitle: K by Dolce&Gabbana Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Inspired by the hills of Tuscany, Dolce&Gabbana’s K Parfum Spray showcases the fragrance’s strong woody peaks and soft spiced valleys that mingle to complete this scent composition and exude the aura of unfaltering confidence. Characterised by a fresh citrus melange of lemon, juniper berries and blood orange nuances, the spray opens on a buoyant blend, before heady notes of geranium, sage and fig nectar rally a spiced, honeyed core that melts onto the skin. A woody dry down starring patchouli, nagarmotha and cedar grants the fragrance’s longevity and olfactive power, crowning the eau de parfum with a bold, fearless finish. Taking on an intense regal blue, the flacon is adorned by a refined lapis lazuli dome nestled into a circlet to interpret the scent within.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentleman Society Eau de Parfum Ambrée 100ml
listings.description: Enter a new chapter of Givenchy’s Gentleman Society with the Eau de Parfum Ambree, a tantalising twist on the iconic scent for those born to stand out. Celebrating the essence of masculinity, clary sage and nutmeg open the scent with an enticing blend of one-of-a-kind accords. The heart reveals a boldness of character, a signature to the Gentleman series, with a quartet of vetiver and narcissus. Reinvented with a spicy turn, an amber fusion resonates through the scent of balsam, tobacco and tasuki vanilla. Lacquered entirely in black, the sophisticated flacon is marked with an elegant champagne golden crest synonymous with the fashion house of Givenchy.

listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY Very Irresistible Eau de Toilette Spray 80ml
listings.description: Inspired by five variances of rose, Givenchy’s Very Irresistible Eau de Toilette emanates a delicate feminine freshness through a symphony of floral and aromatic accords. Brightening the petal-powered bouquet is star anise, opening the scent with spicy-sweet and warm nuances, heightened by juicy lemon zests. An armful of roses exudes luscious, dreamy notes, captivating the essence of carefree romanticism and free-spirited femininity. Housed in a sleek pink bottle, the eau de toilette offers a contemporary twist on a classical scent.

listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY Gentleman Society Eau de Parfum Extreme 200ml
listings.description: Crafted with Givenchy savoir-faire, Gentleman Society Eau de Parfum Extrême is composed of exceptional raw materials, carefully chosen for their optimum olfactory qualities. Top notes of clary sage are heightened with ice-cold peppermint and fiery nutmeg creating an immediate aromatic and spicy twist. The mysterious heart reveals the original Gentleman Society accord, blending narcissus absolute and iris concrete, contrasted by the signature quartet of vetiver. A powerful and unexpected coffee extract absolute develops out of this accord. Paired with peppermint essence, the coffee note seems iced revealing a new and extremely textured facet. At the base, woody notes of cedar and sandal are deepened by patchouli essence and vanilla absolute, perfecting this deep trail. Inspired by couture, the iconic design of the Gentleman bottle is reinterpreted for a new high-impact look. The deep black lacquer finish is enhanced with the Givenchy signature: the 4G logo, emblazoned like a crest, in a striking new gunmetal finish.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Afternoon Delight Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Transport the senses to a cosy café on a Parisian corner with Maison Margiela’s Replica Afternoon Delight Eau de Toilette, a warm, uplifting aroma that indulges you in freshly baked pastries and sweet-tooth scents. Delectable yet light, the gourmand fragrance showcases a display of confectionary notes, centered around a golden madeleine accord. As you unwind and enjoy your moment of me-time, the eau de toilette blends creamy sandalwood and Madagascan vanilla to enhance your olfactive escapism, while fresh musk rounds the scent of with a refined and finely crafted finish that lingers on the skin long after the first spritz.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Beach Blossom Cologne 50ml
listings.description: The essence of paradise, perfectly encapsulated in a scent. Jo Malone London’s Beach Blossom Cologne pays homage to the beautiful shores found in the Seychelles, evoking images of towering palm trees, sun-soaked sands and azure waters. The fragrance offers a moment of olfactive bliss. Refreshing coconut water marries sparkling nuances of lime, representing the salty sea breeze that lingers in the air. Laced with sensuous tonka bean, the cologne settles on the skin with a warm, creamy finish. The 50ml bottle features a rounded silhouette and an ombré cream-orange design. Topped with a grandiose disc, the flacon represents the serene nature of the scent within.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Grapefruit Cologne 9ml
listings.description: Transport your senses to the shores of coastal Spain, as the scent of sun-drenched groves fill the air. Jo Malone London's Grapefruit Cologne opens with luminous, fresh notes of grapefruit to provide an invigorating zest. A fresh, herbal heart of rosemary entwines accents of lavender, camphor and mint to add earthiness to this sunny fragrance. A base of dewy moss cushions the fragrance in warmth. Truly uplifting, this cologne expertly blends herbal and citrus notes to instantly refresh the skin.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Terre d'Hermès Eau de Parfum Intense 50ml
listings.description: Created by Hermès perfumer Christine Nagel, Terre d'Hermès eau de parfum intense reveals a deeper, more intimate facet of the inner fire that animates the Earth and man. The eau de parfum intense is a deep, woody fragrance that combines fiery bergamot with burning wood and the mineral notes of intense lava stone.

listings.rawTitle: Billie Eilish Your Turn Eau De Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Entering a new chapter, the Eilish by Billie Eilish Your Turn EDP makes a statement by intertwining playfulness with intrigue. Inspired by Billie's admiration for modern art, the unique flacon mimics a stacked dice, sheathed with a silver chrome finish. The scent opens with a vibrant display of bergamot and cardamom, before enlivening ginger warms for an invigorating twist. A blooming bouquet of jasmine mingles with velvety peach skin and an air of coconut water to reveal a soft, sensual heart. Creating an unforgettable finish, an alluring fusion of sandalwood, musk and amber lingers against the skin with an all-consuming trail.

listings.rawTitle: Cosmic 2.0 by Kylie Jenner Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Cosmic 2.0 is a celestial scent offering from Kylie Jenner that draws inspiration from the ascent of the sun. The whimsical floral fragrance encapsulates the beauty of dawn with its embracing elixir of florals, fruits and woods. At its opening is a serene juxtaposition of spicy and sweet accords. Featuring juicy pear and pink pepper, the Eau de Parfum whisks the senses away to another realm, laced with a vanilla orchid and lavender bouquet for added sensuality. As the scent warms on the skin, nuances of amber begin to unfurl, lending the spray its bewitching aura.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau D'Issey Eau de Parfum Intense 50ml
listings.description: Inspired by the vastness of the ocean, Issey Miyake L’Eau d’Issey Eau de Parfum Intense is a floral-aquatic fragrance that evokes the sensation of fresh sea air and boundless horizons. Opening with a posidonia accord, reminiscent of sun-drenched seagrass, the scent unfolds into nuances of ylang-ylang, lending a soft floral radiance. At the base, warm vanilla lingers, adding depth to the composition. Housed in a sleek, elongated bottle that mirrors the silver reflection upon the water's surface, the fragrance is an ode to nature’s alluring intensity.

listings.rawTitle: Floral Street Sweet Almond Blossom Perfume Mist 125ml
listings.description: Made in collaboration with the Van Gogh Museum, Floral Street’s Sweet Almond Blossom Perfume Mist pays homage to Vincent Van Gogh’s eponymous oil painting. The fragrance is whimsical and ethereal, a daydreamer’s fantasy. A fusion of pink pomelo, passionfruit and apple blossom lends the scent its enchanting character, bringing to mind images of beautiful blue skies and fluffy clouds. This freshness is amplified by a crisp matcha tea accord. Rounding off the sillage, a warming base of vanilla and tonka bean juxtaposes against the perfume’s light, airy heart, laced with sandalwood for a creamy finish. The fine body mist also provides skincare benefits, utilising the soothing properties of rose water to nourish and hydrate with every spritz.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Black Cedarwood & Juniper Aftershave Moisturiser 45ml
listings.description: Nourish your skin with the Jo Malone London Black Cedarwood & Juniper Aftershave Moisturiser. Designed specially for men, the hydrating cream cares for skin post-shave. Feeling weightless against the skin, the moisturiser visibly soothes the face. Hyaluronic acid envelops the skin in a veil of moisture, while antioxidants help to protect against external aggressors, such as pollution. Complete with a refined woody scent, the formula reveals an aroma of cedarwood and juniper.

listings.rawTitle: AERIN Tuberose Gardenia Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Timeless and elegant, the AERIN Tuberose Gardenia Eau de Parfum is a classic composition with a modern twist. Celebrating the magnificence of two beautiful white florals, the scent honours the memories of Aerin Lauder’s memories. Opening with blooming gardenia, the fragrance enchants the senses with a light and airy beginning. At its heart, a bouquet of tuberose and carnation creates an ambrosial floral feel, while creamy vanilla exudes a luxurious finish to this multi-faceted fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Aesop Karst Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Aesop’s Karst Eau de Parfum takes water as its muse in this refreshing fragrance. The scent encapsulates the energy of the sea to create an aromatic perfume that is as tranquil as it is powerful. Forming a part of the Othertopias collection, a range inspired by worlds within worlds, the fragrance opens with an uplifting blend of bergamot and pink pepper, cooled by a sharp juniper accord. As the scent wears on the skin, herbaceous nuances of rosemary and sage begin to unfurl, followed by an earthy woody base for a captivating finish.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Hero Parfum Intense For Men 100ml
listings.description: A new addition to the Hero family, Burberry’s Hero Parfum Intense 100ml introduces a stronger, intensified fragrance with the addition of a rich leather accord. A signature trio of cedarwood oils leads the scent, layered with notes of invigorating black pepper. Amplified by a new deep leather note, the fragrance captures the power and daring spirit of the Burberry man. Created with a deep-brown hue and angular design, the refillable bottle is an abstract reinterpretation of a horse’s hoof, detailed with the Burberry logo.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Million Gold For Her Eau de Parfum Refillable 90ml
listings.description: Making a grand floral entrance, Rabanne’s Million Gold for Her Eau de Parfum oozes glittering confidence and sensuality thanks to its symphony of white flowers. The multi-faceted fragrance is opened by vibrant rose nuances, before melting into the soft, alluring bouquet of suede-like white florals. At its dry-down, mineral musk contrasts the gentle medley with a sea-kissed coolness, lingering on the skin to showcase the perfume’s versatility. Housed in a refillable crown jewel, the golden-tinted flacon reflects the rich honey-like elixir within.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Rose Exposed Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Experience the luxury of florals with the Tom Ford Rose Exposed Eau de Parfum, a tantalising scent that combines sweet nuances with rich leather accords. Opening with a magnetic fusion of white and pink pepper, the aroma surrounds the senses with a warming trail. At the heart, a bouquet of rose and orange blossom exudes a spellbinding aroma, accented by musk, sandalwood and leather.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Oud Minerale Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Embark on a new adventure with the Tom Ford Oud Minérale Eau de Parfum, a fragrance that summons the elements of the earth and sea into one hypnotic aroma. Water and wood combine to produce a sensational array of accords, powered by a rich oud aura. Fresh pink peppercorn mingles with oceanic accords to reveal a tantalising celebration of nature. Elements of salt and seaweed embark on a mystical journey out to sea, while fir, amber and agarwood remain grounded on earth. A smouldering oud blend ignites the scent with sensual, deep woods that dry down at the base, with rich musk that clings to the skin for a trail that lingers.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Eau de Soleil Blanc Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Ascend into the sun’s golden rays with the Tom Ford Eau de Soleil Blanc Eau de Toilette. Sparkling citrus gives way to radiant florals for a fragrance that exudes hypnotic warmth, as if kissed by the sun. The scent opens with uplifting citrus fruits, elevated by an addictive pistachio accord and spicy cardamom. A bouquet of tuberose, ylang ylang and orange blossom is balanced with amber and coco de mer for a warming finish. The sleek, ribbed glass bottle is adorned with gold-toned accents, reflective of the rich elixir it holds.

Clean yet sensual, it embodies effortless individuality and timeless allure.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Eau Parfumée Thé Blanc Eau de Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Inviting the senses on a serene stroll through a botanical garden, the BVLGARI Eau Parfumée Au Thé Blanc Eau de Cologne has been reformulated with a natural tea for a more refined finish. Rediscover the iconic scent as it captures a feeling of olfactive comfort, thanks to its gentle floral medley, cocooned within white tea extracted from China. The fragrance’s signature white musk base remains, imbuing its sparkling warmth that completes the trail with depth and longevity. Fresh yet unforgettable, the flacon is inspired by the proud elegance of ancient Roman columns to reiterate its compelling allure.

The citrus-aromatic cologne blends the crispness of green tea with the brightness of neroli petals, softened by a lift of bergamot. The result is sheer and fresh, evoking early morning light over a garden landscape. Worn close to the skin, the scent leaves a subtle trail that lingers long after each spritz.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Pour Femme Eau de Parfum Intense 50ml
listings.description: Causing a scene once again, Jean Paul Gaultier makes a provocative return with Scandal Pour Femme Eau de Parfum Intense, an addictive aroma that diffuses an irresistible floral trail. As the night unwinds, captivating spiced cardamom is met by a bouquet of ylang ylang to uncover a rich decadence that combines pleasure and desire. Creamy vanilla unveils a tempting, gourmand twist as sensuality and passion ripple through the scent to leave behind an unforgettable aroma.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Pour Homme Eau de Parfum Intense 50ml

The intensified fragrance opens with enlivening clary sage for an earthy nuance that tempts the senses. A heart of leather is intensified by sensual vetiver for a seductive ending to an unforgettable scent.

The twilight settles with dark tonka and cashmere woods, ready to embrace the darkness.

A bouquet of tuberose, ylang ylang and orange blossom is balanced with amber and coco de mer for a warming finish. The sleek, ribbed glass bottle is adorned with gold-toned accents, reflective of the rich elixir it holds.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: The Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue Pour Homme Eau de Toilette Spray is one to ignite your senses: a dynamic, seasonal fragrance that harnesses the essence of Italy. Opt for this blend of oils suffused with light, woody, aromatic accords. Sliced through by Sicilian lemon, the dynamic scent rests on an earthy, seductive base of Indonesian patchouli. In the citrus-oaky mix is a subtly herbaceous rosemary layered in the middle, adding depth to the core fragrance. Sophisticated and adventurous, with a tangy top-note twist, the spray is encased in a frosted bottle with sinuous lines that nods to the ceramics of the Amalfi Coast. An embossed logo moniker signs it off with a designer flourish.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue Pour Homme Capri In Love Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Dive into the exhilarating waters of Capri, as Dolce&Gabbana’s Light Blue Love In Capri Pour Homme Eau de Parfum Spray captures the island’s magnetic charm. Inviting the senses on a sea-breezed journey, the fragrance opens with black pepper, before a vibrant heart of Capri green fig harmoniously contrasts against the spiced allure. Refining the aroma is a sophisticated base of patchouli, warming the scent and providing a long-lasting trail. Topped with an enamelled cap, the bottle is embellished with motifs of Caprese blue majolica for a decorative finish.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue Capri In Love Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: The Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue Love In Capri Eau de Parfum Spray is a seductive summer scent with a tropical balance of accords. With a romantic scent profile, the Capri-inspired fragrance opens with a revitalising hit of jasmine. Wild cardamom, a species that grows in tropical Africa and Madagascar, adds a peppery spice that’s cut through by a heart note of crisp apple. Imagine evenings spent in charming piazzas and days surrounded by lush vegetation, as the nuanced composition lingers and evolves with you. Made by Emilie Coppermann exclusively for Dolce&Gabbana, the floral-spicy perfume brings coastal depth to your line-up of fragrances.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue Eau de Toilette Spray 200ml
listings.description: The Dolce&Gabbana Light Blue Eau de Toilette Spray is a woody, fruity fragrance with an irresistibly escapist olfactory profile. Based on a hearty note of cedarwood, the designer scent boasts a long-lasting light trail wherever you go. The blend of fragrance oils is suffused with carefully balanced accords, like Granny Smith apple and Sicilian lemon, evoking scenes of orchards and Mediterranean gardens. Concocted exclusively by Olivier Cresp, the aromatic, addicting spray is encapsulated in a breezy blue-tinged frosted bottle, stamped with the signature DG monogram.

listings.rawTitle: Ghost Deep Night Eau de Toilette Spray 90ml
listings.description: Deep and mysterious like the darkness of night, the Ghost Deep Night Eau de Toilette Spray evokes confidence, bottled. The unapologetically bold fragrance blends moon flower with juicy peach and creamy sandalwood for a rich, sensual finish that endures. Whether feeling daring or dreamy, embrace your aura with Ghost's velvety amber olfactory.

listings.rawTitle: Ghost Orb of Night Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: Inspired by a rendezvous beneath a rose moon, Ghost’s Orb of Night Eau de Parfum Spray mesmerises with gourmand nuances and ethereal florals. Romance is revealed with alluring cherry-almond, flirting with a bouquet of orange blossom, freesia and jasmine. Caramel melts upon a base of warm sandalwood and white musk, capturing the transformative moments of sundown and sunrise. Elevate your scent ritual from dusk until dawn, with the crescent-shaped bottle offering a seamless refill experience.

listings.rawTitle: GUERLAIN Absolus Allegoria Ambre Samar Eau de Parfum 125ml
listings.description: Ambre Samar depicts the magic of a red moonlit night in a perfume full of contrasts. Dark and mysterious wreaths of frankincense and ambergris are illuminated by a flamboyant amber accord with sensual vanilla and honey accents. A chiaroscuro creation, inspired by the spectacular light that bursts forth from the darkness during a lunar eclipse. Absolus Allegoria, the absolute fragrance collection, is an enchanting and mysterious journey to the heart of the world’s wonders once night falls: fragrance trails celebrating deep and powerful nature, revealed by striking contrasts in the moonlight.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Orange Marmalade Cologne 100ml
listings.description: Inspired by the British tradition of marmalade making, the Jo Malone London Orange Marmalade Cologne melts together zested orange and cashmere woods in a sweet citrus scent. Characterised by a vibrant, tangy profile, the fragrance reminisces orange peel being warmed on the stove, simmering into a golden nectar that uplifts the senses. Its grounding woody base adds depth and dimension, delivering long-lasting, tantalising intensity with each spritz across the skin.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Buongiorno Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: Elevate your scent wardrobe with Acqua di Parma’s Buongiorno Eau de Parfum, an aromatic-green fragrance that harnesses the freshness of an Italian morning. A sparkling quintet of lemon essence, spearmint, basil, rosemary and petitgrain opens the scent, a bright overture that’s both vibrant and deeply refreshing. This coupling of citrus and herbs creates a colourful green hit with a bitter undertone, emanating complexity as you enter a room. As it mellows, lavandin essence and mandarin leaves accord contribute their light floral texture, bridging the profile's dry-down into cedarwood, amber and soft musk.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild Intense Eau de Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description: With Daisy Wild Eau So Intense, Marc Jacobs adds a bright, free-spirited note to the familiar floral favourite. Bursting open with a radiant banana blossom accord, the scent unfolds into a sensuous bouquet of jasmine and tuberose, before settling into a warm base of amber and sandalwood. Sun-drenched, woody nuances bring an unexpected wildness. Encased in the signature Daisy bottle, reimagined in ombré hues and vivid tones, the fragrance evokes a sunlit walk through the wild, with a fresh yet intense, playful yet grounded olfactive trail.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London English Pear & Sweet Pea Cologne 10ml
listings.description: Filled with full-bodied fruit nuances, the Jo Malone London English Pear & Sweet Pea Cologne uplifts the senses with its fresh, tempting accords. Juicy Williams pear buds at the opening of the fragrance, warmed by the mellow accents of pastel sweet peas, evoking the sentiment of strolling through a crisp green garden on a spring afternoon. Powdered white musk enhances the scent trail, cocooning the cologne in an airy softness that lingers long after the very first spritz.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Myrrh & Tonka Cologne Intense 10ml
listings.description: An editor's personal favourite, the Jo Malone London Myrrh & Tonka Cologne Intense offers a veil of sensual warmth best suited to chilly seasons. The formula’s heart note, omumbiri myrrh, adds an ancient touch to the fragrance, inspired by the luscious sand dunes of the Namib – home to the myrrh tree. This is complemented by light, herbaceous lavender layered softly over the top. At the core, a wholesome layer of tonka bean and vanilla ripples through, creating a warm, woody undercurrent. Envelop yourself in the cologne's woody scent profile.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Intense Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Discover another side of Flora and experience moments of unforgettable bliss with Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Intense. This floral woody gourmand fragrance combines the lush, sweet, and juicy characteristics of fruit with the delicate and fresh aspects of flowers. It enhances the floral sensuality of the gardenia flower with rich, woody tones. Its explosion of unfiltered joy and burst of pure pleasure quickens the pulse and makes the heart beat louder. This maximalist Eau de Parfum Intense offers a new experience of Flora's signature Gucci scent. Ignited by an untamed floral energy, its vegan, natural ingredients open with invigorating Italian Mandarin Essence to bring a sunny surge of penetrating pleasure. At the heart of this perfume for women, creamy Gardenia Accord entwines with Hedione for a burst of full-bodied floral opulence. Overflowing with blushing green glory, the air fills with sparkling brilliance, pushing the florality to another dimension. Enhancing the floral sensuality further still is the earthy Sandalwood Essence. With its rich, woody tones, a comforting trail of softness transforms joy into bliss, cocooning the senses in a vibrant aura of exhilaration. The result is sensual and elegant, perfect for expressing your joy on every occasion. For those who appreciate the depth and richness of a high-quality, floral fragrance. Dressed in sumptuous fuchsia, the House’s iconic Flora pattern adorns the bottle and outer packaging. The most intense perfume in the Flora collection glows with ‘Intense’ in bold gold lettering on both. As the sun shines upon the bottle, it transforms from mysterious to magnificent. Be enraptured by the energy. Bewitched by the bliss. Embrace the mesmerising joy of this astonishing aroma with Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Intense.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty For Him Eau de Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Extending a loving invitation to explore, create and connect with our truest selves, Gucci Guilty Pour Femme and Pour Homme fragrances relaunches with a campaign starring A$AP Rocky, Julia Garner and Elliot Page. An ode to self-acceptance, friendship and love in all its forms, Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Eau de Parfum for Men presents an aromatic Fougère, that inspires a fresh take on blending sensuality with living authentically. Suggestive and unexpected, Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Eau de Parfum for Men is a woody, aromatic and spicy aftershave fragrance created to provoke self-confidence and acceptance from within. Rose and Chili Pepper present an unexpected and invigorating retro vibe, while Patchouli and Cedarwood accentuate this Eau de Parfum for men’s richness and sensuality. Encapsulated in a fully metallised bottle, the seductive scent is dressed in dark anthracite, with a matching cap. The design is finished with the house’s emblematic Interlocking G logo.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Jasmine For Her Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Enter a new dimension of unbound freedom with Gucci Flora Gorgeous Jasmine Eau de Parfum for women. Bursting with sensual Grandiflorum Jasmine, this is the second Gucci fragrance to join the cheery world of #FloraFantasy. Its energy of inner joy is further enhanced by the elongated turquoise bottle, while the House’s distinctive Flora by Gucci pattern seals the design with a magical touch. Once again fronted by multi-platinum selling recording artist, songwriter and trailblazer Miley Cyrus, the latest #FloraFantasy campaign continues into a luminous bedroom, while scenes tinted in pastel hues create the film’s surreal spirit and draw the viewer into an anime dream.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Parfum For Him 50ml
listings.description: Extending a loving invitation to explore, create and connect with our truest selves, Gucci Guilty Pour Femme and Pour Homme fragrances relaunches with a campaign starring A$AP Rocky, Julia Garner and Elliot Page. The aromas open with a mild and more modernised hint of French Lavandin and uplifting Lemon, marrying perfectly with the warmth of Juniper. The true essence of its aroma is magnified at the heart with the deep ambery signature of Cistus combined with the floral fragrance of Orange Flower and a spicy Nutmeg. Finally, the mysterious elegance of Patchouli is reinforced with a woody and musky sensation. The Gucci aftershave is housed in a sleek, dark anthracite bottle that features the brand's iconic interlocking Gs, mirroring the scent within.
