listings.rawTitle: Burberry Touch Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Top Notes : California Orange, Blackcurrant, Dewberry, Pink Peppercorn. Heart Notes: Jasmine, Madonna Lily, Peach, Raspberry, Tuberose. Base Notes: Cedarwood, Oak Moss, Vanilla. Capture the effortless elegance of Burberry with the Touch Eau de Parfum. Merging fruity and floral notes, this fabulous fragrance is simultaneously rich and delicate, bold but graceful, modest yet intimidating, reflecting the essence of the Burberry woman. Inspired by sensuality and the intoxicating potential of the most delicate touch, the fragrance seduces the senses with a feeling of intimacy. The vibrant top notes, characterised by fruits and berries, burst through the perfume only subdued by the delicate floral heart of Jasmine and Lily. Finally, the notes of Cedarwood and Vanilla intermingle to create a bittersweet base, forming a comforting accord that lingers. Simultaneously clean and fresh, the perfume feels vibrant and modern, seamlessly blending notes to complement one another. Designed by the French icon, Fabien Baron, the bottle retains an understated elegance, the clean lines topped with a wooden cap.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Basil & Neroli Cologne - 100ml
listings.description: Available globally, quintessentially British brand Jo Malone has built an impressive reputation for luxury bath and body products. Boasting an extensive fragrance portfolio and unafraid to test new waters when it comes to blending scents, the brand continues to garner a devoted following inspired by their creativity. Jo Malone London Basil and Neroli Cologne is the embodiment of clean and fresh with an unexpected undercurrent of complexity. Emerging with a tentative herbaceous air, Basil’s peppery freshness opens a spicy green landscape that’s more sophisticated than simple cut-grass. Neroli’s delicate white petals bloom in honey-sweet clusters, brightening the fragrance like sunlight on an overcast day. Finished off with fresh laundry drying on the line, White Musk’s powdery clean notes envelop the cologne and bring together a picturesque afternoon. Housed in a rectangular bottle that’s reminiscent of Jo Malone’s townhouse in London, it’s truly the scent of British summertime.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Blackberry & Bay Cologne - 100ml
listings.description: Rewind to calmer, light-hearted days with the nostalgia-inducing Jo Malone London Blackberry and Bay Cologne . Opening notes of luscious Blackberry entice the senses and provide an immediate burst of delicious fruitiness, both sweet and slightly tangy for added vivacity. Delicately floral Bay Leaves release a leafy, herbaceous aroma, combining to recall childhood memories of frolicking and fruit-picking in summer gardens. Bright and light top notes subside to reveal rich, heady Cedarwood waiting at the base of the fragrance. This deep, smouldering scent blends effortlessly with clear, fruity top notes to evoke an oaky warmth simmering beneath the surface: carefree, confident, enigmatic.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Blackberry & Bay Cologne - 30ml
listings.description: Rewind to calmer, light-hearted days with the nostalgia-inducing Jo Malone London Blackberry and Bay Cologne . Opening notes of luscious Blackberry entice the senses and provide an immediate burst of delicious fruitiness, both sweet and slightly tangy for added vivacity. listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Earl Grey and Cucumber Cologne - 100ml
listings.description: Evoking a quaint scene set in a lush, verdant garden speckled with powder pink bouquets of English roses and purple sprigs of Lavender, luxury fragrance house Jo Malone London ’s Earl Grey and Cucumber Cologne carries the senses to a traditional British high tea party. A white linen-covered table topped with crunchy and succulent cucumber sandwiches and steaming, hand-painted porcelain teapots of citrusy Earl Grey tea charge the air with an earthy aroma. Counterpoised by sweet, musky notes of honey drizzled over bite-sized treats and creamy vanilla custard-filled pastries, the refined fragrance boasts a composition of harmonious contrasts.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London English Oak & Hazelnut Cologne - 100ml
listings.description: Available globally, quintessentially British brand Jo Malone has built an impressive reputation for luxury bath and body products. Boasting an extensive fragrance portfolio and unafraid to test new waters when it comes to blending scents, the brand continues to garner a devoted following inspired by their creativity. Filled with the whimsy of an enchanted forest, Jo Malone London English Oak and Hazelnut Cologne embodies the rustling of a dimly lit woodland grove. Crunchy Green Hazelnut adds notes of freshness that sparkle like morning dew with a warm nutty undercurrent. Mossy tree trunks and crisp foliage emerge with Cedarwood at the cologne’s heart and Roasted Oak deepens into a dark hollow. Earthy and enticing, this is a fragrance that leaves a lingering memory settled firmly on your skin.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London English Pear & Freesia Cologne 100ml
listings.description: Inspired by modern British culture, Jo Malone London creates bespoke and luxurious fragrances synonymous with quintessential British style. Jo Malone London English Pear and Freesia Cologne is the epitome of autumn. The sensuous eau de toilette opens with the mellow freshness of just-ripe Pear cocooned in a blossom of cool white Freesias, an accord that lends the EDT a delicate yet distinctive scent. Patchouli, a deep, woody note, takes hold at the base to create a sensual, timeless and lasting cologne. Arrives in the brand's iconic cream box with ribbon accent.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Lime Basil & Mandarin Cologne 30ml
listings.description: The Lime Basil and Mandarin Cologne is a signature fragrance from Jo Malone. Quintessentially British and luxurious, Jo Malone has gained a global presence for its elegant scents. This fragrance perfectly blends citrus and herbal hues, revealing a unique scent which is both revitalising and relaxing. Cool and confident, this fragrance evokes a Caribbean breeze, transporting you to a world of calm. Drying down to the base note of Amberwood, the cologne leaves you with a comforting presence, familiar and warming.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Mimosa & Cardamom Cologne - 30ml
listings.description: Let the Mimosa and Cardamom Cologne from Jo Malone seduce your senses. This fragrance is reminiscent of the ladies’ powder room, a scent evocative of sophistication and effortless elegance. Opening with the complex scent of Cardamom, this fragrance blends sweet, woody and spicy hues, enticing intrigue and attraction. The heart of Mimosa puts a floral twist on the cologne that is sweet, warm, and powdery. Drying down into the comforting base note of Tonka Bean, the fragrance leaves the skin with a scent that is intense and woody with a subtle vanilla edge.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Nectarine Blossom & Honey Cologne - 100ml
listings.description: Bursting with fresh fruit, Jo Malone London Nectarine Blossom and Honey Cologne embodies the vibrancy of the stalls at Covent Garden’s famous markets. Uplifting like an early morning breeze, the cologne sets you up for a day of playful excitement. Juicy Cassis offers a top note of intense ripeness finished with a crisp edge to refresh and revitalise the senses. Sweetening into a smooth stream of Acacia Honey, the scent becomes luxuriously indulgent, balanced by accents of Blossoms and Beeswax for a deeper, richer scent. With a base of Peach, the fragrance is wrapped in a delicious velvety texture with the essence of succulent flesh turning rosy in the sunlight.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Peony & Blush Suede Cologne 30ml
listings.description: Inspired by modern British culture, Jo Malone London creates bespoke and luxurious fragrances synonymous with quintessential British style. Charming and exquisite, Jo Malone London Peony and Blush Suede Cologne opens with the crisp and juicy bite of Red Apple before succumbing to a floral heart of Peony; a delicate accord that brings a subtle green freshness with hints of Rose and Honey. Luxurious and seductive, the eau de toilette settles on a plush bed of Blush Suede, which rounds off the fragrance with a soft and sensual opulence. Arrives in the brand's iconic cream box with ribbon accent.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Pomegranate Noir Cologne 100ml
listings.description: Daring and sensual, Jo Malone London Pomegranate Noir Cologne embodies the feeling of slipping on a red dress and getting ready to face the world. Jewelled and dripping with rich, ruby coloured nectar, Pomegranate acts as an exotic top note that’s spiced with Pink Pepper for a bold twist. Casablanca Lily deepens this fresh surface, delving into a headier crescendo of scent that’s simultaneously feminine and empowering. Warming the cologne is Guaiacwood’s smoky undertones and Patchouli’s dark musk, settling into a shadowy base of mystery. An enigmatic temptress, the Pomegranate Noir Cologne is the woman everyone at the party wants to know.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Red Roses Cologne - 100ml
listings.description: Immerse your senses in a luxurious crimson bouquet with the Jo Malone London Red Roses Cologne . This voluptuous blend combines seven of the world’s most exquisite roses to convey an air of exhilarating romance. A hint of lemon provides a sparkling opening, illuminating velvety petals and crushed violet leaves, for a clear and modern take on a classic floral. Glistening in gold, a base of honeycomb underpins the fragrance with sweet nectar notes, inviting the senses along the path of a secret garden.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Wild Bluebell Cologne - 30ml
listings.description: Filled with the whimsy of an enchanted forest, Jo Malone London Wild Bluebell Cologne takes you on a magical journey through a blooming sapphire sea. Wild and untamed, Bluebell is an enigmatic floral that beckons from sunlit groves. Nestled amongst leafy green notes, petals become dewy and crisp with an underlying sense of spicy clove emanating from the woodland trail. A sumptuous, silky heart of Persimmon fuses a subtle peachy scent to the clean top notes for a creamier blend that settles into a light White Musk. This powdery base feels like a fresh spring breeze, blowing the flowers into a soft and comforting cloud.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez Pure Musc for Her Eau de Parfum - 30ml
listings.description: This delicate offering from Narciso Rodriguez provides a tender interpretation of the brand’s cult classic fragrance. Pure Musc for Her is housed in a sleek black and white bottle, signifying the scent’s refreshing play on contrasts, balancing purity with a provocative allure. The original signature musc is reinterpreted and refined, with a disarming innocence and a rich depth. The stunning white floral bouquet is warmed by luxurious Cashmeran. Citrus notes add a lightly sparkling vibrancy to this addictive scent. This EDP captures the senses with a breezy and care-free lust for life.

listings.description: This delicate offering from Narciso Rodriguez provides a tender interpretation of the brand’s cult classic fragrance. Pure Musc for Her is housed in a sleek black and white bottle, signifying the scent’s refreshing play on contrasts, balancing purity with a provocative allure. The original signature musc is reinterpreted and refined, with a disarming innocence and a rich depth. The stunning white floral bouquet is warmed by luxurious Cashmeran. Citrus notes add a lightly sparkling vibrancy to this addictive scent. This EDP captures the senses with a breezy and care-free lust for life.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Eau de Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Amber Top Notes: Bergamot. Heart Notes: Coconut Wood. Base Notes: Tonka Bean. Fresh and powerfully seductive, Jean Paul Gaultier’s Le Beau Eau de Toilette invites you into a garden of temptation and attraction between La Belle and La Beau, the opulent new fragrances from the French fashion house. Greeting the senses with a crisp introduction of Bergamot, it bleeds into a heart of Coconut Wood anchored by a base of creamy Tonka Bean. Presented in the brand's signature torso-shaped bottle and cylindrical tin.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Eau de Toilette 125ml
listings.description: Amber Top Notes: Bergamot. Heart Notes: Coconut Wood. Base Notes: Tonka Bean. Fresh and powerfully seductive, Jean Paul Gaultier’s Le Beau Eau de Toilette invites you into a garden of temptation and attraction between La Belle and La Beau, the opulent new fragrances from the French fashion house. Greeting the senses with a crisp introduction of Bergamot, it bleeds into a heart of Coconut Wood anchored by a base of creamy Tonka Bean. Presented in the brand's signature torso-shaped bottle and cylindrical tin.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier La Belle Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Jean Paul Gaultier invites us along on a luminous scent trail with La Belle Eau de Parfum . Settle down for a cosy evening with your lover as this alluring scent radiates feminine sensuality. The Eau de Parfum features a base of sweet roasted Vanilla pods caressed by nuances of white chocolate and salted caramel, irresistible and delectable like a dessert. A heart of fresh Bergamot uplifts the warmth of the base, adding a sparkling freshness. An accord of juicy Green Pear invites an opening that is both mouth-wateringly sweet and crisp. The fragrance provides impressive longevity, settling on the skin with a vanilla dry-down, illuminated by sweet notes to bring you closer to that special someone. A true evocation of feminine beauty, La Belle veils you in a confident and empowering sensuality. The classic Gaultier flacon, updated with a ruby red tint and a necklace of fairy-tale roses in bloom.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Poppy & Barley Eau de Cologne 30ml
listings.description: Brought back by popular demand, the Jo Malone Poppy and Barley Eau de Toilette originally starred as a limited-edition scent in the 2018 English Fields collection. The fragrance features a fruity-floral blend, calmed with a tender and skin-like powdery warmth. Evocative of red poppies dancing in the wind among strands of barley and bran, this inviting scent is complemented with fruity accords of blackcurrant and softened with powdery notes of white musk. The poppy is a quintessential symbol of the English countryside, its inherent fragility cocooned by stable barley and bran. The scent combines Red Rose and green notes to evoke the vibrant colours of the poppy field and the living landscape of a harvest summer. Fig, Blackcurrant and Violet notes add a youthful sweetness, soothed by a Bran Absolute to emulate the nourishing warmth of the barely fields. White Musk adds a cotton-like softness for a light, powdery dry down. This inviting scent emulates the aesthetically vibrant appeal of the poppy fields and the soft texture of barely, to transport your senses to a summers day in rural England.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme Idole Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Floral - Chypre Top Notes:  Bergamot Essence. Heart Notes:  Rose Essence, Rose Absolute, Rose Water, Jasmine Infusion, Jasmine. Base Notes:  Patchouli Essence, Cedar Essence, Vanilla Extract. Discover a true revolution in fragrance with the  Lancôme Idole Eau de Parfum,  the brand's first clean floral chypre, housed in the thinnest bottle to date.  The fragrance opens with a refreshing Bergamot Essence and descends into a garden of signature Lancôme roses. Sustainably sourced Rose Essence, Rose Absolute and Rose Water fuse with Jasmine Infusion and Jasmine to create a fresh and elegant floral infusion. The luminous floral heart lends a dewy, yet radiant freshness that doesn’t smell artificial in the slightest. A base of Patchouli Essence, Cedar Essence and Vanilla Extract adds a creamy and sophisticated depth to the fragrance without being heavy or cloying. Light enough for even daytime wear, this glowing Eau de Parfum boasts impressive longevity. The fragrance was created by three female perfumers, resulting in a true evocation of modern, empowered femininity. The fragrance is housed in a refillable 15mm thick flacon, designed by Architect, Chafik Gasmi, making Idole the world’s slimmest perfume bottle in history. Not only is this jewel-like flacon visually stunning, it is also perfectly portable and great for travel. Radiate feminine strength with this beautifully clean floral fragrance: made by women, for women. Winner of the 'Best Blockbuster Fragrance' in the Vogue Beauty Awards 2020, the perfume has been recognised for its meaningful initiatives around sustainability.

listings.rawTitle: Elie Saab Le Parfum in White Eau de Parfum - 50ml
listings.description: Created for life’s most special occasions, ELIE SAAB Le Parfum In White Eau de Parfum is a radiant floral-fruity fragrance that captures elegance and femininity.  Sparkling mandarin and red fruits blend with a bouquet of jasmine, orange blossom and juicy peach, before settling into a sensual trail of white musks and patchouli. Perfect for weddings, celebrations and evening events, the scent leaves a luminous impression. The fragrance is housed in a jewel-inspired bottle, adorned with deep ivory tones and golden accents for a luxurious finishing touch.

listings.rawTitle: Elie Saab Girl of Now Eau de Parfum - 30ml
listings.description: Embodying the vivacious spirit of the modern woman, Elie Saab's Girl of Now Eau de Parfum is a gourmand floral fragrance inspired by spontaneity and playfulness. Inspired by Lebanon, the scent opens with roasted pistachio and sparkling pear for an addictive opening. Bitter almond and orange blossom unite at the heart to create an exclusive ormond flower accord. Tonka bean, almond milk and patchouli leave a final trail, reinforcing the Elie Saab signature.  Elegant and jewel-like, the perfume bottle is adorned with a delicate blue and gold enamel flower, inspired by the house's couture.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 200ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Yuzu. Heart Notes: Cinnamon, Nutmeg. Base Notes: Sandalwood. Bask in the glory of sophistication and class with Issey Miyake L’Eau d’Issey Pour Homme Eau de Toilette. Opening notes of sharp Yuzu illuminate alongside spicy Coriander to capture the illusion of a pure, piquant paradise. Accentuating poise and prestige, sweet Cinnamon bridges the gap between fresh citrusy notes and dark, heady accords as it paves the way for the deep, passionate tones awaiting beneath. An alluring blend of subtle spices lends a sensual, spirited element to the luxurious sillage. Aromatic Nutmeg and Saffron simmer and sparkle at the heart of the smooth, seductive fragrance, dispersing to reveal warm, smouldering notes of Musk and Sandalwood below. Fusing light and heavy aromas, the cologne is enigmatic, elegant and modest.

listings.rawTitle: K by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Top Notes:  Blood Orange and   Sicilian Lemon. Heart Notes:  Clary Sage, Geranium and Lavender. Base Notes:  Cedarwood, Vetiver, Patchouli. Own your crown with  K by Dolce & Gabbana Eau de Toilette.  Designed to embody the scent of the modern-day man, and the strength and passion he exudes as he cares for his family and blazes his own trail. Infused with energising Blood Orange, the reassuring, dependable scent of Clary Sage juxtaposed with sweet Patchouli, this fragrance is for the man who isn’t afraid to show his vulnerable side. Regally finished with a bejewelled crown, handcrafted with 24-carat gold particles, this majestic bottle is a constant reminder of the king you truly are.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Luna Rossa Carbon Eau de Toilette - 100ml
listings.description: Fresh Fougère Heart Notes: Lavender, Soil Tincture, Watery Notes, Metallic Notes. Base Notes: Patchouli, Ambroxan. Top Notes: Bergamot, Pepper. Prada interpretate the exhilarating contemporary scent of carbon to create a sports inspired scent. The Prada Luna Rossa Carbon Sport Eau de Toilette opens with elegant masculine notes of Lavender and Soil Tincture, contrasted with a metallic accord, evoking innovation and speed. Strong and defiant, the fragrance blends steam-distilled botanicals and synthetics to combine both feats of nature and engineering. The mineral and amber fougere embodies the high-tech nature of the modern Prada man. Woody notes of Patchouli and Ambroxan in the heart electrify a revitalising base of Italian Bergamot and Pepper. The EDT is housed in a sleek masculine flacon with a carbon-black and red sports-inspired design.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Luna Rossa Carbon Eau de Toilette - 150ml
listings.description: Fresh Fougère Heart Notes: Lavender, Soil Tincture, Watery Notes, Metallic Notes. Base Notes: Patchouli, Ambroxan. Top Notes: Bergamot, Pepper. Prada interpretate the exhilarating contemporary scent of carbon to create a sports inspired scent. The Prada Luna Rossa Carbon Sport Eau de Toilette opens with elegant masculine notes of Lavender and Soil Tincture, contrasted with a metallic accord, evoking innovation and speed. Strong and defiant, the fragrance blends steam-distilled botanicals and synthetics to combine both feats of nature and engineering. The mineral and amber fougere embodies the high-tech nature of the modern Prada man. Woody notes of Patchouli and Ambroxan in the heart electrify a revitalising base of Italian Bergamot and Pepper. The EDT is housed in a sleek masculine flacon with a carbon-black and red sports-inspired design.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Candy Eau de Parfum - 50ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Amber Gourmand Top Note: White Musk. Heart Note: Benzoin. Base Note: Caramel Accord. The Prada Candy Eau de Parfum is a feminine fragrance, offering a unique medley of bewitching notes. Beginning with the soft florals of white musk, the EDP is awakened with an elegant aroma that melts into the seductive heart of benzoin. The top notes are complimented with the succulent base of caramel, captivating the senses with an enticing sweetness. This eccentric infusion forms a scent reminiscent of the fearless and bold nature of the Prada woman.

listings.rawTitle: Prada La Femme Eau de Parfum - 50ml
listings.description: Floral; Woody Top Notes: Frangipani, Honey. Heart Notes: Tuberose, Ylang-Ylang. Base Notes: Vetiver, Vanilla. A call to feel richly and deeply, Prada La Femme Eau de Parfum  is an emotive fragrance that shifts through an expressive olfactory journey. Taking you by the hand, the scent leads you through fields lined with Frangipani’s unconventional wake, weaving through stems of Ylang-Ylang and Tuberose along the way. Layered with smooth Beeswax and creamy Vanilla, a sumptuous velvety texture wraps around the senses, settling into Vetiver’s comforting soils as a woody afterthought. Like a faraway land, the perfume’s solar luminosity glows in a golden warmth, mirrored by its honeyed colour that’s housed in a luxurious bottle and white box.

listings.rawTitle: Prada L'Homme L'Eau de Toilette - 50ml
listings.description: Woody, Amber, Aromatic Top Notes : Neroli, Violet. Heart Notes : Geranium, Iris, Pepper. Base Notes : Amber, Cedar Wood, Patchouli. Prada’s L’Homme takes a modern stance on traditional masculinity. It is a fragrance defined by contrast and compliment; the classic male Fougère is present in the hues of Neroli, Geranium and Patchoili, whilst femininity is hinted at by the Prada signatures of Iris and Amber. The stereotypically male and female hues are juxtaposed, revealing a scent which challenges outdated ideas of gender roles and binary oppositions. Subverting the ideas of masculinity, Prada offers a scent that is in touch with modern times; a scent that is simultaneously strong and gentle, undercutting themes of toxic masculinity. Floral and woody notes collide, evoking an earthly scent that is simultaneously fresh and familiar. Wrapped in Saffiano Leather, the bottle fashions a classic Prada design. Finished with clear glass and silver tone accents, the fragrance creates an aura which is simple yet elegant.   Made in Spain

listings.rawTitle: Prada L'Homme L'Eau de Toilette - 150ml
listings.description: Woody, Amber, Aromatic Top Notes : Neroli, Violet. Heart Notes : Geranium, Iris, Pepper. Base Notes : Amber, Cedar Wood, Patchouli. listings.rawTitle: Prada L'Homme L'Eau Eau de Toilette - 50ml
listings.description: Woody; Green; Floral Top Notes: Mandarin Essence, Green Notes. Heart Notes: Iris, Red Ginger, Neroli. Base Notes: Amber, Sandalwood. Fresh, crisp and verdant, with juxtaposing hints of spice and discreet warm undercurrents, Italian luxe fashion house Prada’s L’Homme L’Eau de Toilette  boasts a harmoniously balanced composition that’s clean and contemporary. Pulling you in with spirited head notes of citrus and leafy accords, the men’s fragrance bleeds into an intoxicating heart of powdery blossoms tinged with a zap of energising Ginger, before delving into a prolonged resinous base of Amber and Sandalwood. Light and airy, yet highly sensual and provocative, the eau de toilette bedazzles the senses with unanticipated contradictions. Bottled in a curved glass flacon bearing the original brand logo and wrapped in pale blue saffiano leather. Made in Spain.

listings.rawTitle: AERIN Amber Musk Eau de Parfum - 100ml
listings.description: Like a warm embrace and soft cashmere on the skin, AERIN’s Amber Musk Eau de Parfum is inspired by the cosiness of a grand fireplace, aglow on a cold frosted night to bring a comforting warmth with an authentic, musk scent. Refined yet familiar, the fragrance features notes of honeyed rose centifolia and velvety amber to imbue an inviting aroma, before a musk dry down grants second-skin-like intensity and longevity. The brand’s scent wardrobe is designed to be layered, allowing you to pair Amber Musk with lighter, fresher facets for a customisable olfactive trail.

listings.rawTitle: AERIN Amber Musk Eau de Parfum - 50ml
listings.description: Like a warm embrace and soft cashmere on the skin, AERIN’s Amber Musk Eau de Parfum is inspired by the cosiness of a grand fireplace, aglow on a cold frosted night to bring a comforting warmth with an authentic, musk scent. listings.rawTitle: AERIN Mediterranean Honeysuckle Eau de Parfum - 100ml
listings.description: Inspired by the vibrant tapestry of the Mediterranean, AERIN’s Mediterranean Honeysuckle Eau de Parfum transports the senses to sun-drenched sands and sparkling seas with its radiant floral citrus scent. The sweet nuances of honeysuckle, carried on a warm summer’s breeze, opens the fragrance composition with a heady presence, while a zesty note of gardenia mingles with pink grapefruit for a fruity-fresh finish.

listings.rawTitle: AERIN Mediterranean Honeysuckle Eau de Parfum - 50ml
listings.description: The oh-so-sweet Mediterranean Honeysuckle Eau de Parfum from AERIN evokes the fresh yet relaxing atmosphere of a gorgeous Greek island. The shade of the luxurious marble lid is reminiscent of the deep blue Mediterranean Sea, filled with mystery and wonder. The floral citrus theme of the fragrance transports the mind to the quiet tranquillity of crystal-clear water, a deep breath of the Grapefruit and Mandarin Oil is intoxicating, you can almost feel grains of sand on the fingertips and warm rays of sunshine on the shoulders. The final notes of Lily of the Valley and Jasmine Sambac take you to a garden of flowers. Fresh. Aromatic. Rejuvinating.

listings.rawTitle: AERIN Hibiscus Palm Eau de Parfum - 100ml
listings.description: A lazy island breeze, the AERIN Hibiscus Palm Eau de Parfum is an exotic blend of blooming florals set against a backdrop of beaches dusted with white sands and fringed with overgrown palms. Baking under the golden glow of the sun reflecting off the waves, the fragrance exudes the relaxation of a far-away luxury retreat. Opening with Hibiscus Palm and Lotus Flower, the scent has a powerful, floral presence, supported by Ylang-Ylang’s heady sweetness and Frangipani’s fruity edge. Ginger’s spice peppers through the perfume’s layers, sharpening and balancing the delicate swirl of White Blossoms. Finishing with a decadent base of sweet Coconut Milk and Vanilla, the fragrance settles into an indulgent trail mixed with lingering Musks. Housed in an elegant bottle with a decorative lid featuring a warm orange stone that radiates the energy of a tropical landscape.

listings.rawTitle: AERIN Ikat Jasmine Eau de Parfum - 50ml
listings.description: Celebrating the mystifying powers of a jasmine scent, the AERIN Ikat Jasmine Eau de Parfum becomes a quintessential basic of elegance and charm. Exuding a sense of rich indulgence, the perfume is equal parts in capturing femininity and power. Pure but inviting, a bouquet of jasmine opens the scent with an air of freshly cut white petals that evoke a fresh and lively aroma. At the heart, tuberose releases an intense floral scent with sensual undertones that lure you in. Finished with luxurious sandalwood, the base settles into warming richness, adding heat and passion to the sultry mix.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Eau de Toilette 30ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Floral. Top Notes: Wild Berries. Heart Notes: White Violet, Jasmine. Base Notes: Sandalwood. Instantly recognisable with oversized daisy embellishments on its cap, Marc Jacobs Daisy is a true icon in the world of fragrance. Sweet, tangy notes of wild berries pull you in, seducing the senses with a fresh, fruity opening that unfurls to reveal whimsical white flowers at the heart. Sandalwood grounds the fragrance with a warm earthiness and lends depth to the eau de toilette. Charming, youthful and feminine, this EDT is much-loved for daytime wear.

listings.rawTitle: Armani Si Passione Intense Eau de Parfum - 30ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Woody Floral Top Note: Blackcurrant Nectar. Heart Notes: Jasmine Absolute. Base Notes: Vanilla Extract, Patchouli Essence. Discover the fervent vibrations of the Armani Si Passione Intense Eau de Parfum. The fragrance begins with the eccentric sweetness of blackcurrant nectar, seducing the senses with a budding infusion of nature’s delights. The heart of the fragrance is captivated by jasmine absolute, offering a floral softness to compliment the enlivened top note. The botanical celebration is enveloped in the warm undertones of vanilla extract, harmonised with the musky base of patchouli essence. Immerse yourself in this impassioned expression of femininity.

listings.rawTitle: Armani Si Passione Intense Eau de Parfum - 50ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Woody Floral Top Note: Blackcurrant Nectar. Heart Notes: Jasmine Absolute. Base Notes: Vanilla Extract, Patchouli Essence. listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Top Notes: White Pepper, Black Pepper, Italian Green Bergamot Heart Notes: Cedarwood, Sage Base Notes: Tonka Bean, Absolut of Cocoa, Amberwood The rebellious counterpart to Carolina Herrera’s ‘Good Girl’ fragrance, Bad Boy Eau de Toilette embodies the duality of the modern man, resulting in a scent that is both strong and sensitive. This confident fragrance opens with energetic notes of Pepper and Bergamot in an electrifying blend. Cedarwood and Sage provide a seductive and captivating heart. This intoxicating fragrance is underpinned by rich base notes of creamy Tonka Bean, luxurious Absolut of Cocoa and Amberwood. The warm base notes reveal an empowering sensitivity and vulnerability, contrasting the audacious top notes in a magnetic blend. Bad Boy strikes like lightning, instantly seducing with its bold fusion of contrasts. The sophisticated, lightning-shaped flacon reflects the multifaceted nuances within the scent, celebrating the diversity of contemporary manhood.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Top Notes:  White Pepper, Black Pepper, Italian Green Bergamot Heart Notes:  Cedarwood, Sage Base Notes:  Tonka Bean, Absolut of Cocoa, Amberwood The rebellious counterpart to  Carolina Herrera’s  ‘Good Girl’ fragrance,  Bad Boy Eau de Toilette  embodies the duality of the modern man, resulting in a scent that is both strong and sensitive. listings.rawTitle: Moschino Toy Boy Eau de Parfum 50ml Vapo
listings.description: Top Notes: Italian Bergamot, Pink Berries, Indonesian Nutmeg, Pear, Elemi. Heart Notes: Clove, Rose Absolute, Flax Flowers, Magnolia. Base Notes: Cashmeran, Haitian Vetiver, Ambermax, Sylkolide. Daring and playful, the ‘Toy Boy’ Eau de Parfum encapsulates the bold nature of Moschino. The label is known for experimental silhouettes and proportions, and this fragrance is housed in a sleek, black teddy bear-shaped bottle. Opening with a floral, fruity blend, the cologne entices excitement with its seductive accord. Seamlessly moving into the spicy heart, clove and magnolia bring a woody edge to the fragrance, complicating the aroma. Finally, the musky base notes of vetiver and amber darken the fragrance, grounding the perfume with earthy hues.

listings.rawTitle: Molton Brown Jasmine and Sun Rose Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Chypre. Top Notes: Bergamot, Cassis, Raspberry. Heart Notes: Jasmine, Rose, Cistus Labdanum. Base Notes: Patchouli, Musk, Tonka Bean. Olfactive Signature: Plumy Davana. Escape into a moonlit garden in the Nile Delta with Molton Brown’s Jasmine and Sun Rose Eau de Parfum. An ode to modern femininity, the fragrance evokes the intoxicating scent of night jasmine. Unveiling youthful top notes of bergamot, cassis and raspberry, the aroma unfolds into a delicate heart of rose and cistus labdanum. Transitioning into an earthy base of patchouli, musk and tonka bean, you are transported to an ethereal floralscape in Northern Egypt. The captivating fragrance is perfect for eveningwear.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden White Tea Mandarin Blossom Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: The Elizabeth Arden White Tea Mandarin Blossom Eau de Toilette offers a fresh, citrusy twist on a much-loved classic. Designed for layering with other fragrances in the collection, the eau de toilette has a bright, sparkling presence that encapsulates a breezy summer’s day. Blending ocean spray with sweet fruity notes, the fragrance has a crisp clarity that awakens and invigorates the senses. Balancing warmth with an airy, feather-light surface, the wearer will be treated to equal parts comforting nostalgia and new experiences. Combine with other Elizabeth Arden White Tea scents to discover a unique mix that melds with your personality perfectly.

listings.rawTitle: NARCISO RODRIGUEZ Narciso Ambree Eau de Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Envelop yourself in the bold and intriguing scents of the NARCISO RODRIGUEZ Narciso Ambree Eau de Parfum. The sweet, floral fragrance is encased in a delicate, sleek peach bottle, highlighting the fun-loving elegance of the perfume. The cocktail of scents opens with top notes of rich, smooth Frangipani and opulent Ylang Ylang, evoking visions of bright, bustling summer parks with colourful flowers bursting into life. The fragrance reaches its centre with bold, dominant heart notes of Musk, merging intriguingly with the top notes and creating an alluring contrast that lingers in the air and on the skin. Exciting and sensual, the perfume captures the freedom and self-expression of the modern woman blazing her own trail. Base notes of earthy Amber, creamy Cedarwood, mouth-watering Vanilla and sumptuous Casherman finish the fragrance in a well-rounded, balanced manner, creating an unforgettable clash that highlights the self-confidence and vulnerability that allows us all to be human. Spray onto your pulse points and prepare to make a memorable entrance wherever you go.

listings.rawTitle: K by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Parfum - 50ml
listings.description: Aromatic, Spicy, Woody Top Notes : Blood Orange, Cardamom, Juniper, Sparkling Citrus. Heart Notes : Geranium, Sage, Lavandin, Fig Nectar. Base Notes : Patchouli, Vetiver, Nagarmotha, Cedar. Feel like royalty with the K by Dolce and Gabbana Eau de Parfum. An aromatic blend of spicy and woody notes, the fragrance captures the effortless elegance and timeless sophistication of the Dolce and Gabbana man. Opening with a citrus and herbaceous fusion of Orange and Juniper, the fragrance uplifts the senses, guiding the mind through an olfactive journey. As the top notes begin to fade, the middle notes take control. Diving into the potent heart, intense hues of Lavandin are seamlessly blended with the aromatic note of Sage, merging to complicate the cologne. Drying down to the earthy base notes, Patchouli, Vetiver and Cedar intertwine to guide the fragrance into its final form. These musky hues mellow the cologne, lingering on the skin to ignite the senses.   Housed in a glass bottle, blue-tinted for optimism. Topped with a silver-tone crown, the cologne cloaks the skin with noble scents.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Intense Eau de Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Intensify your fragrance with the Yves Saint Laurent Libre Intense perfume. Fuelled by fierce sensuality, the perfume is a celebration of tension, merging seemingly disparate notes to create a totally unique scent. Taken from the French word for free, the parfum is inspired by YSL’s dedication to independence and expression. Harnessing the power of a truly liberated woman, the fragrance is simultaneously strong and intense, but also graceful and delicate. Sourced from all around the world, the bottle houses fragrances from France alongside hues from Morocco, transcending boundaries to create a cross-cultural fusion. Opening with an unusual accord, the fragrance merges the invigorating note of Tangerine with the soft scent of Lavender. Next, the perfume dives into the floral heart, guiding the senses on an olfactive journey through blossoming gardens. Moving slowly to the base, the fragrance finds its final form. Seamlessly blending the woody hue of Vetiver with the warm note of Vanilla, the bittersweet base continues this theme of contrast, igniting the senses with a smoky perfume. Gold tinted, the glass bottle reflects YSL’s fiery sense of optimism, finished with flamboyant gold-tone branding. Topped with a black cap, the design finished with dainty embellishments.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Explorer Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Discover an invitation to adventure with the Explorer Eau de Parfum as the scent summons you on an aromatic journey. The olfactory expedition opens with Italian bergamot. Lavish and opulent, the citrus fruit evokes mystery and suspense for the adventure ahead. Adding to the luxury of this fragrance, vetiver from Haiti expands geographic horizons with a rich, evergreen twist. Deep, musky patchouli from Indonesia settles for a taste of exclusivity, revealing a lust for adventure with its earthy trail. The bottle imitates the earth’s two hemispheres, recalling the destinations embarked on by the fragrance. Montblanc’s star emblem rests at the bottom, representing the six glaciers of the highest mountain in Europe.

listings.rawTitle: Tocca Florence Eau de Parfum Travel Spray 20ml
listings.description: Top Notes : Italian Bergamot, Grapefruit Leaves, Green Pear, Apple. Heart Notes : Ivory Gardenia, Crushed Violet Petals, Jasmine, Tuberose, Blue Iris. Base Notes : Blonde Wood, White Musk. Cloak your skin in the elegant hues of the  Florence Eau de Parfum  from  Tocca.  Drawing inspiration from the sophistication of old-world Paris, the fragrance creates a sense of nostalgia with its floral bouquet of notes. Often vintage-inspired, the Italian beauty brand is favoured for its feminine fragrances and delicate hues. Romantic and hopeful, the perfume opens with a careful accord of Pear, Apple and Grapefruit, merging fruity and citrus notes to create an uplifting aroma. Diving into the rich heart, the fragrance inspires wanderlust with a flourishing collection of Violet, Jasmine and Iris, guiding the mind on an olfactive journey through a garden in full bloom. Finally, the fragrance gives way to the potent base notes of Blonde Wood and White Musk, merging, mingling and mellowing as the fragrance melts into its final form.

listings.rawTitle: Tocca Cleopatra Eau de Parfum Travel Spray 20ml
listings.description: Floriental Top Notes: Bitter Grapefruit, Lush Greens, Cassis Bud. Heart Notes: White Jasmine, Peach Nectar, Tuberose. Base Notes: Warm Patchouli, Golden Amber, Rich Vanilla Musk. Inspired by the ancient, iconic seductress, Tocca ’s Cleopatra embodies the beauty, passion and confidence of the modern woman. Enveloping you in a floral coat of freshly-picked blooms, the fragrance opens with a concoction of sparkling Grapefruit and Cassis bud, transitioning seamlessly into a hint of lush, verdant greens. Powdery hues of heady white florals creep in at the heart; a bouquet of White Jasmine, Peach Nectar and musky Tuberose that creates a slightly-honeyed, intoxicating layer, before delving into warmer depths. An oriental dry-down that combines notes of Indian Patchouli, Amber and rich, creamy Vanilla creates a lasting, luxuriant sillage that seduces the senses. Boasting a long-wearing eau de parfum concentration, the opulent concoction is bottled in a travel-friendly flacon crowned with a vintage gold top and adorned with a logo plaque.

listings.rawTitle: Tocca Stella Eau de Parfum Travel Spray 20ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Blood Orange, Watery Accord. Heart Notes: White Freesia, Wild Diamond Orchids, Spicy Lily. Base Notes: Sheer Musk, Sandalwood. Feel radiant and luminous every time you envelop yourself in the sumptuous aromas of Tocca Stella Eau de Parfum. The perfume instantly evokes images of lightness and spontaneity, as top notes of juicy Blood Orange and crisp, clean Watery Accord begin the sensual journey. Pleasantly contrasting, the boldness of the Blood Orange and the elegance of the Watery Accord are a constant reminder of the empowerment and vulnerability that make up the modern woman. Heart notes of smooth White Freesia, tantalising Wild Diamond Orchids and fiery Spicy Lily conjure free-spirited and fun-loving visions, as the playful clash of aromas linger in the air and on the skin. Flirtatious and whimsical, the heart notes blend into a deliciously intoxicating cocktail that encourage you to embrace your carefree, happy-go-lucky side more often. The fragrance reaches a dramatic crescendo with base notes of creamy, opulent Sheer Musk and rich, luxurious Sandalwood, drawing the exhilarating expedition through the various scents to a close. The uniquely-crafted blend works to inspire and invigorate, prompting you to seize each day with a hopeful and curious perspective on life.  Encased in a striking bottle that is topped with an engraved, bronze-toned lid, the travel spray is ideal for popping into your bag to take with you on the go.

listings.rawTitle: Tocca Stella Eau de Parfum 50ml

listings.rawTitle: Bon Parfumeur 401 Cedar Candied Plum Vanilla Eau de Parfum - 15ml
listings.description: Amber Top Notes : Cypress, Incense, Elemi, Bergamot. Heart Notes : Candied plum, Cinamon leaves, Cedar, Patchouli. Base Notes : Labdanum, Sandalwood, Musk, Vanilla. Warm, sweet, vibrant – Bon Parfumeur’s 401 Eau de Parfum is punctuated with intoxicating notes. From the very opening, this fragrance is intense, merging the herbaceous hue of Cypress with the potent note of Incense. Enlivened by the invigorating Bergamot edge, the opening is filled with contrasting layers. Diving into the gourmand heart, the fragrance seamlessly blends the woody hues of Cedar and Patchouli with the sweet scent of Candied Plum. The fragrance finds its final form in the musky base, mixed with the hue of Vanilla to create a bittersweet ending. Velvety, seductive, sweet – cloak the body with a fragrance that is as complicated as you are.

listings.rawTitle: Bon Parfumeur 802 Peony Lotus Bamboo Eau de Parfum - 15ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Violet, Blackcurrant, Osmanthus. Heart Notes:  Freesia, Peony, Rose Velvet. Base Notes: Musk, Ambrette. A bouquet of earth and water, Bon Parfumeur 802 Peony Lotus Bamboo Eau de Parfum combines delicate florals with an aquatic accord. Fresh and green, the Peony blooms under the morning dew, warmed by the summer sun to a delicate and powdery scent with a sensual hint of creaminess. This multi-faceted scent evolves on the skin, revealing a vibrant floral accord infused with notions of rain, sea, flowers and white, cottony musk. Heady and fresh yet sensual, this intriguing scent embodies springtime.

listings.rawTitle: Bon Parfumeur 901 Nutmeg Almond Patchouli Eau de Parfum - 15ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Mandarin, Grapefruit, Ginger. Heart Notes: Black Pepper, Chilli, Nutmeg, Almond. Base Notes: Patchouli, Musk, Tonka Bean, Vanilla. The Bon Parfumeur 901 Eau de Parfum sets fresh top notes against a deeply seductive base. It is a journey of curiosity and contradiction, whisking the senses to a plane of pure luxury. Mandarin and Grapefruit offer a crisp, almost bitter opening, softened by the sweetness of spiced Ginger. Black Pepper and Chilli cause an inferno at the core, rousing the delectable nuances of Nutmeg and Almond. Restoring equilibrium, Tonka Bean and Vanilla slip through the EDP with sweet, creamy hints. A twist of spices and leather, this fragrance charms with paradoxical defiance. Warm, smooth and exquisitely unique, allow the eau de parfum to grace the air with sensual citrus accords.

listings.rawTitle: Armani He Eau de Toilette - 50ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Musk Notes: Japanese Yuzu Accord, White Musk, Cardamom, Accord Vetiver Armani He Eau de Toilette provides a fresh, aromatic accord to intimacy. Invigorating Japanese yuzu provides a vibrant opening, enveloped in the sensual warmth of white musk. Cardamom electrifies with a spiced allure, whilst a base of precious woods provides timeless elegance and refinement. The fragrance is housed in a sleek, minimalist flacon that magnetically attracts its counterpart Armani Her, synergising in harmony as an unforgettable fragrance duet.

listings.rawTitle: Goutal Tenue de Soiree Eau de Parfum - 50ml
listings.description: Ready yourself for romance and possibility with the sensual fragrance. As alluring as adorning your neck with a bespoke Bakelite necklace, the perfume opens with notes of juicy Red Fruits, instantly offering an element of seduction and temptation. Your skin seems to glimmer and smoulder, allowing you to turn heads as you step out onto the dimly-lit Parisian streets. The air is warm and low, stirring musical notes drift in the summer breeze, as scents of Patchouli enliven and caress your senses. Exuding confidence and self-belief, the fragrance is perfect for the person that knows exactly who they are, and wants to express it in a truly authentic manner.

listings.rawTitle: Goutal Tenue de Soiree Eau de Parfum - 100ml
listings.description: Ready yourself for romance and possibility with the sensual fragrance. listings.rawTitle: Goutal Nuit et Confidences Eau de Parfum - 50ml
listings.description: Oriental Notes: Bergamot, Frankincense, Tonka bean, Vanilla, White Musks, Pepper. At the stroke of midnight, Goutal’s ‘Nuit et Confidences’ unveils a dizzying enigma cloaked in the mists of refinement. Drawing upon Annick Goutal’s intimate connection with intellectuals and artists alike, the fragrance characterises the Parisian elite in a masquerade of sensual, oriental notes. An exuberant murmur in the liquefied evening air, this is a scent of abstract art and smooth jazz. Rising up into Bergamot’s inextinguishable light, the perfume maintains a cool, charismatic edge while conjuring full-bodied substance with Pepper’s strength. A mesmerising illusion of Tonka Bean and Frankincense captivate and command attention before softening into White Musks and Vanilla like a sigh of contentment. Feminine and elusive, the fragrance is a silky slice of moonlight in a sophisticated dining room. The bottle is finished with a flourish of satiny indigo fabric woven into a decorative pompom. Designed to reflect the essence of the Milky Way, the Eau de Parfum is an eccentric, artistic reimagining of the night.

listings.rawTitle: Goutal Nuit et Confidences Eau de Parfum - 100ml
listings.description: A masquerade of sensual notes, Goutal’s Nuit et Confidences Eau de Parfum captures the moments during which you can be whoever you want. The fragrance is an embodiment of abstract art and smooth jazz, attracting attention with a magnetic aura. Top notes of bergamot and mandarin offer a zesty introduction, before revealing a full-bodied heart of black pepper and incense. Mesmerising tonka bean softens into a blend of vanilla and white musks, adding a feminine and elusive touch. Finished with a flourish of satiny indigo fabric woven into a decorative pompom, the bottle is designed to reflect the eccentric, artistic essence of the fragrance it holds.

listings.rawTitle: Goutal Etoile d'Une Nuit Eau de Parfum - 100ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Iris Middle Notes: Rose Base Notes: Raspberry Founded by fragrance pioneer Annick Goutal, Goutal Paris continues interpret the emotion of a moment, inspiring travels and landscapes, and the essence of iconic characters, in its fragrances. Etoile d'Une Nuit captures a woman’s anticipation before heading out for the night. She takes out her favourite powder, caressing her skin with light strokes of the brush and ties a silk scarf around her neck. Exuding Parisian elegance, the feminine fragrance evokes the sensual appeal of bare skin infused with the scent of makeup, a powdery cloud with soft and creamy cosmetic accents. Intertwining delicate blooms of Rose and Iris, the fragrance epitomises femininity. A sweet, fruity base of Raspberry hints at a flirtatious spirit. Highlighting her vivacious personality, the captivating scent ensures that all eyes are on her. The fragrance is housed in a decorative bottle with a forest green gradient design and a lustrous ribbon charm.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Born in Roma Donna Eau de Parfum for Her 50ml
listings.description: Inspired by Rome, a city where past and present coexist, Valentino's Born in Roma Donna Eau de Parfum celebrates living life freely and embracing heritage. The modern haute couture fragrance balances sensuality and vibrancy for a luxurious, feminine scent that invites its wearer to be unapologetically themselves. An opulent top note of jasmine sambac mingles with a woody heart of cashmeran, adding a lively twist with its unusually spicy note. A cool base of vanilla bourbon invites a rich leathery aspect for a distinctive, captivating scent reminiscent of Rome's street culture. Instantly iconic, the bottle is adorned with a recognisable stud pattern taking inspiration from Roman architecture.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Born in Roma Uomo Eau de Toilette for Him 100ml
listings.description: Taking the city of Rome as its muse, Valentino’s Born in Roma Uomo Eau de Toilette is an invitation to live life freely. The fragrance represents the intersection in which the past and present collide, paying homage to Italy’s heritage whilst celebrating the joys of everyday life. The scent can be characterised by its unique note juxtaposition. Violet leaf introduces the Eau de Toilette, offering a burst of floral freshness that alludes to the spontaneity of the current time. Sage’s multi-faceted composition lends the fragrance an elegant nature that forever remains timeless, laced with a vetiver accord for a touch of daring smokiness. The bottle’s pyramidal design pays homage to Roman architecture. The eye-catching flacon is covered in studs that descend from black to white, embellished with black leather and a pink Valentino logo.

listings.rawTitle: MUGLER Angel Nova Eau de Parfum Natural Spray Refillable - 100ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Raspberry, Lychee. Heart Notes: Damask Rose. Base Notes: Akigalawood, Benzoin. Envelop yourself in the captivating notes within MUGLER’s Angel Nova Eau de Parfum natural spray. The fragrance opens with intoxicating scents of raspberry and lychee, conjuring images of crisp, refreshing sorbets. Heart notes of damask rose lead you into a tranquil garden, mingling delicately with benzoin and akigalawood. Crafted by utilising biotechnology and eco-friendly methods, the aroma of rose is as heightened as possible.

listings.rawTitle: MUGLER A*MEN Eau de Toilette Rubber Natural Spray Refillable - 100ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Peppermint, Lavender, Patchouli. Base Notes: Coffee, Tonka Beans, Musk. Adorn yourself with the sumptuous notes within MUGLER's A*MEN Eau de Toilette. Potent and intoxicating, the fragrance opens with top notes of invigorating Peppermint, contrasting pleasantly with soothing Lavender and tantalising Patchouli. Visions of a dense, mysterious forest are conjured, enticing you into its core to explore and experience new beginnings. Notes of Atlas Cedar allow you to envision your hands brushing the bark of the trees, as their branches wind and dance, the sky above you melting into inky evening. Woody and floral, the fragrance effortlessly plays with the ideas of dominance and vulnerability, reminding us that fiercely embodying both is what makes us human. Delve into base notes of creamy Coffee, alluring Tonka Bean and decadent Musk, allowing the perfume to caress your senses and linger on your skin. Packed with many dimensions, the fragrance represents a powerful yet versatile cocktail that is perfect for everyday use. Fiery and unignorable, the amalgamation of scents is ideal for the person that knows exactly who they are. Housed in a lusciously tactile rubber casing, which is totally refillable.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Voce Viva Eau de Parfum for Women - 50ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Italian Bergamot Essence, Mandarin Essence. Heart Notes: Orange Blossom Absolute, Golden Gardenia Accord. Base Notes: Crystal Moss Accord, Vanilla, Tonka Bean. Embrace your sensual side with Valentino’s Voce Vita Eau de Parfum. Alluring and sparkling, the fragrance opens with exotic notes of Italian Bergamot Essence and Mandarin Essence, evoking visions of sun-kissed fruit daring you to take a bite. The colourful top notes hint at adventure and exploration, encouraging you to give into your wanderlust and try new things. Couture, hypnotic notes lead us into the enticing heart of the fragrance, brimming with scents of Orange Blossom Absolute and Golden Gardenia Accord. Fiery and smouldering, the perfume seems to simmer like molten lava, allowing you to make a dramatic entrance wherever you go. Unexpected base notes of intense Crystal Moss Accord, playful Vanilla and creamy Tonka Bean mingle together, allowing the cocktail to reach an addictive and all-consuming crescendo. The sleek, angular bottle, topped with a studded gold-toned lid, seems to radiate passion and uniqueness, encompassing the values of designer Maison Valentino. Splashes of red offer an instantly-recognisable designer flair.

listings.rawTitle: MUGLER Alien Eau de Parfum Refill Bottle 100ml (Worth £141)
listings.description: Top Notes: Sambac Jasmine. Heart Notes: Cashmeran Wood. Base Notes: White Amber. A surge of desire, the Mugler Alien Eau de Parfum Refill Bottle is intensely feminine. This fragrance represents both the peace and power of woman, designed to top-up your existing, refillable Alien EDP. Sambac Jasmine intoxicates the senses, a deep, mystical scent with a lasting impression. Paving the way for warmer tones, its Cashmeran Wood core lends sensual, musky detail. Finally, White Amber is elegant and inviting, tying the fragrance together with touches of passion. The EDP presents a rich, other-worldly fragrance that thrives on complexity. Powered by allure, allow this enigmatic, Alien fantasy to thrill and excite the self.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb Eau de Parfum - 30ml
listings.description: Unshackle a floral explosion with Viktor & Rolf’s iconic Flowerbomb Eau de Parfum, an addictive profusion of floral notes and warm woody undertones for sensory bliss. The seductive fragrance opens with sparkling top notes of tea, bergamot and freesia, interwoven into a vibrant bouquet of sambac jasmine, cattleya orchid and centifolia rose. Warm, resinous hues of amber, cashmeran and patchouli seep in for the dry down, adding substance, depth and richness to the trail for a harmonious blend. Like all editions in Viktor & Rolf’s Flowerbomb family, the EDP is presented in a diamond grenade glass bottle with rose gold accents for a touch of designer luxury.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Eau de Toilette - 150ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Woody Spicy. Top Notes: Bergamot, Grapefruit, Cinnamon Leaf. Heart Notes: Lavender, Pimento Berries, Saffron, Elemi, Pink Pepper. Base Notes: Vetiver, Fir Balsam, Tobacco Accord, White Leather Accord. Discover your latest addiction, Viktor&Rolf’s explosive perfume for men: Spicebomb Eau de Toilette. Powerful, daring and sensual, the cologne detonates a weapon of mass seduction in a bottle. Brace yourself for strong spices, sensory contrasts, and woody trail and pull the trigger to unleash an addictive scent.  Engulfing you in a haze of zesty and refreshing Bergamot and Grapefruit notes, the men's fragrance invigorates the senses with cool spices, icy Elemi and the electric zing of Pepper. Warm spices of fiery Chilli and rich Saffron ooze out, fusing into the masculine dry-down of Leather, Tobacco and Vetiver. Like all of Viktor & Rolf fragrances in the Spicebomb family, the EDT is presented in a sculpted grenade bottle, an object of luxury.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Extreme Eau de Parfum - 90ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Grapefruit, Pimento Berries, Black Pepper. Heart Notes: Warm Spices, Cumin, Cinnamon, Saffron. Base Notes: Tobacco, Vanilla, Bourbon, Amber. Edged with masculine detail, the Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Extreme Eau de Parfum assures a decadent explosion. The scent captures the wearer in their most seductive state – a confident version of the self that exists within. Warm spices set fire to the fragrance; they flicker at the heart, engulfed by blazing notes of Cumin and Cinnamon. Its rich, aromatic core is offset by an initial bite of Grapefruit and Pimento Berries. Defined by puzzling depths, the fragrance is set atop a strip of opulence. Tobacco lends a smoky touch, electrified by a shot of Bourbon and Amber. The Viktor & Rolf EDP is exhilarating by its very nature, powered by threads of charm and allure.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Eau So Intense Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Strawberry, Pear. Heart Notes: Honey, Rosebud. Base Notes: Vanilla, Green Moss. Marc Jacobs’ Daisy Eau So Intense is a captivating fragrance filled with vibrant, sparkling notes. Bringing a deeper, more intense dimension to the beloved Daisy scent, the perfume is brimming with all of perfumer Alberto Morillas’ expertise in this bright yet sophisticated blend. Marrying playfulness with sprightly youth, the perfume opens with fruity Strawberry and fresh Pear, sinking into the sweetness of Honey. A heart of Rosebud adds a softer floral touch while smooth Vanilla creates a creamy, indulgent base. This is offset by Green Moss’ crisp presence for a balanced, fresher feel. Embodying warm springtime charm, the fragrance captures the ephemeral glow of the sunset.

listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Ralph's Club Eau de Parfum - 50ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Woody Fougere Top Notes: Lavandin, Apple, Grapefruit. Heart Notes: Clary Sage, Geranium, Orange Blossom. Base Notes: Virginia Cedarwood, Vetiver. The Ralph Lauren Ralph’s Club Eau de Parfum is an authentically masculine fragrance. Crafted from ingredients distilled to their highest quality, it is designed to provide long-lasting intensity. The scent opens with refreshing notes of lavandin, apple and grapefruit before an aromatic unveiling of clary sage and orange blossom. At the base, the warm richness of Virginia cedarwood adds a woody undertone to balance this uniquely seductive fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Ralph's Club Eau de Parfum - 100ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Woody Fougere Top Notes: Lavandin, Apple, Grapefruit. Heart Notes: Clary Sage, Geranium, Orange Blossom. Base Notes: Virginia Cedarwood, Vetiver. listings.rawTitle: Prada Luna Rossa Ocean Eau de Toilette - 50ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Bergamot Essence, Pink Pepper Essence. Heart Notes: Iris Accord, Sage Essence. Base Notes: Vetiver Essence, Tonka Bean. Discover Prada’s Luna Rossa Ocean Eau de Toilette, a scent for the modern adventurer. The powerful fougere fragrance embraces the calling of discovery, offering a fusion of naturally-inspired fresh and aquatic accords. The energetic eau de toilette for men features an invigorating bergamot opening, contrasted with the masculine elegance of vetiver and iris. Creamy tonka bean offers an additive smoothness, creating a unique everyday scent. The fragrance is housed in a deep blue bottle and signed with the iconic red Prada line, drawing inspiration from the technological excellence, and sleek dynamic beauty of extreme sailing boats. Explore new horizons with Prada.

listings.rawTitle: Tocca Discovery Eau de Parfum Set
listings.description: Ranging from elegant florals and sensuous woods to refreshing compositions, the Tocca Discovery Eau de Parfum Set invites you to find your new favourite scent. The carefully curated set features a selection of fragrances in trial-sized vials, offering a scent for every occasion. Set Contents: Florence Eau de Parfum 1.5ml Stella Eau de Parfum 1.5ml Giulietta Eau de Parfum 1.5ml Cleopatra Eau de Parfum 1.5ml Colette Eau de Parfum 1.5ml Simone Eau de Parfum 1.5ml Maya Eau de Parfum 1.5ml Gia Eau de Parfum 1.5ml

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Hero Eau de Toilette for Men 100ml
listings.description: Captivating with woody fresh notes, Burberry’s Hero Eau de Toilette for Men 100ml portrays a modern man who surpasses himself in all of life's challenges. The EDT features a trio of captivating cedarwood oils, brightened with bergamot for vibrancy and freshness. At the base, juniper and black pepper add an invigorating edge capturing the scent of a forest growing by the English coastline. Featuring an angular glass design, the bottle embodies strength and modernity like the fragrance it holds.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Hero Eau de Toilette for Men 150ml

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Eau de Parfum Naturelle 30ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Woody Floral. Top Notes: Cedrat Essence, Cassis Bourgeon Absolute. Heart Notes: Organic Rose Essence, Neroli Essence. Base Notes: Cedar Essence, Mimosa Absolute. The latest addition to Chloé’s collection of opulent perfumes, Naturelle cloaks you in a veil of woody florals uplifted with zesty citrus notes. Boasting a vegan formulation made with 100% natural-origin ingredients of the highest quality, the eau de parfum arrives in the brand’s distinctive ribbed glass bottle, embellished with a green bow. An iteration of Chloé Signature for rose lovers, Naturelle blends a bouquet of cassis, neroli and mimosa against an enveloping bassline of earthy cedar. Vegan.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Eau de Parfum Naturelle 50ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Woody Floral. Top Notes: Cedrat Essence, Cassis Bourgeon Absolute. Heart Notes: Organic Rose Essence, Neroli Essence. listings.rawTitle: Tocca Simone Eau de Parfum 20ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Fresh-Floral Top Notes: Crisp Apple, Watermelon, Lemon Calypso. Heart Notes: Frangipani, Ylang-Ylang, Rose Petals, Freesia. Base Notes: Blonde Woods, Musk, Amber. Bask in a garden of fresh florals with the Tocca Simone Eau de Parfum. Inspired by the optimism of youth, the fragrance is a radiant infusion of warm, tropical notes. Crisp apple and watermelon create a luminous opening, before tumbling into a bed of vibrant flowers. A sensual dry-down ascends from the base, where blonde woods and amber indulge in a deep, musky moment.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Ombre Leather Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Wrap yourself in the tactile sensuality of Tom Ford’s Ombré Leather Parfum, a deeper, more intoxicating interpretation of the original Eau de Parfum. Opening with the crisp freshness of violet leaf absolute, the scent unfolds with a green vibrancy that gives way to an elegant touch of cedarwood. A luminous heart of jasmine sambac absolute, harvested before the monsoon season, reveals a delicate fruity-floral nuance reminiscent of honeysuckle. Hints of green tobacco weave through the composition, adding depth and character, while a double concentration of orris heart leaves an irresistibly smooth, lingering trail.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Ombre Leather Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Summoning childhood memories of Texan life, Tom Ford's Ombré Leather Eau de Parfum evokes the rugged warmth of the Wild West through a sensual array of rich, velvety accords.  Spicy cardamom opens the scent with an energising warmth reminiscent of the desert landscape. Rustic accords of leather and cool spices reveal an untethered, driven scent, while sweet jasmine and amber heat up the aroma. Topped with white moss, the decadent fragrance ends with an earthy, grounding finish.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Bitter Peach Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Delve into the juicy depths of Tom Ford’s Bitter Peach Eau de Parfum. The fragrance unites fruity frivolity with a sensual edge, made to intoxicate. Peche de vigne and Sicilian blood orange reveal slick sweetness, yielding to the syrupy centre of ripe peaches. Rum-infused davana oil shifts the tone with a strong, seductive core. Set on a patchouli base, the EDP excites with a sweep of reckless desire. This perfume is a rich, alluring scent that climbs to a dizzying crescendo. Sometimes, it’s better to be bitter.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Bitter Peach Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Delve into the juicy depths of Tom Ford’s Bitter Peach Eau de Parfum. The fragrance unites fruity frivolity with a sensual edge, made to intoxicate. listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Silver Birch & Lavender Cologne 100ml
listings.description: Embark on an enchanting scent trail through Lavenderland, a world of violet visions. This limited-edition collection captures English lavender, meandering in purple pathways across the countryside. Morning light illuminates a rambling garden, framed by silver birch trees. The coolness of the crisp air cuts through the unmistakeable scent of English lavender. A squeeze of grapefruit invigorates the senses, grounded by a charismatic, woody base of silver birch and roasted oak.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Legend Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Bergamot, Violet. Heart Notes: Jasmine, Geranium. Base Notes: Moss, Vibrant Wood. Built around tradition, passion and the art of handcrafting, Montblanc introduces Legend Eau de Parfum. This fresh EDP provides an exhilarating take on the brand’s infamous fougère accord, with a concentrated silage, leaving a charismatic scent trail that lasts until evening. The classic urbanity of legend withstands with bergamot and soft and sensual jasmine intertwined with a moss accord. The eau de parfum invigorates the senses with fresh violet leaves and a magnetic floral note of magnolia. The vibrancy of this facet is balanced with sensual woods and leather.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Phantom Eau De Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Born from the clash between luxury craftmanship and tech innovation, Rabanne’s Phantom Eau de Toilette captures the essence of self-confidence. Aromatic organic lavender, exhilarating Italian lemon and Haitian Vetiver combine to create a disruptive signature scent. Fresh, energetic top notes are wrapped in creamy, woody vanilla and sensual patchouli to create an empowering signature scent. Responsibly formulated, Phantom is a a fragrance for today, created for tomorrow. Discover the brand’s first ever connected fragrance for men, showcasing a cutting edge creative design process. Simply tap your phone onto the top of the bottle to unlock a whole world of exclusive content.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Phantom Eau De Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Born from the clash between luxury craftsmanship and tech innovation, Rabanne’s Phantom Eau de Toilette captures the essence of self-confidence. listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Woody. Top Notes: Clary Sage. Heart Notes: Caramel, Tonka Bean. Base Notes: Vetiver. Energising and addictive, the Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Pour Homme Eau de Toilette is a sensual woody fragrance. The fragrance for men is a king of the ring, housed in its champion bottle topped with a golden crown. Provoking scandal with victory, the scent blends notes of clary sage with sweet caramel and tonka bean for a combination of spiced, yet delicately sweet aromas. At the base, extravagant and smoky vetiver is revealed, completing this knockout fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 200ml Refill
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Woody. Top Notes: Clary Sage. Heart Notes: Caramel, Tonka Bean. Base Notes: Vetiver. This eco-friendly refill is designed to top up your existing crown-topped fragrance, without spilling a drop thanks to its unscrewable auto-stop system. Provoking scandal with victory, the scent blends notes of clary sage with sweet caramel and tonka bean for a combination of spiced, yet delicately sweet aromas. At the base, extravagant and smoky vetiver is revealed, completing this knockout fragrance. Note: This product is a refill only.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica By The Fireplace Eau de Toilette - 100ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Woody Top Notes: Clove Oil, Pink Pepper, Orange Flower Petals. Heart Notes: Chestnut Accord, Gaiic Wood Oil. Base Notes: Vanilla Accord, Cashmeran. Enveloping the senses in a comforting warmth, By The Fireplace Eau de Toilette transports the senses to 1971 Chamonix, France, conjuring visions of frosty air and snow-topped mountains. Part of Maison Margiela’s Replica collection, the fragrance captures the memory of an evening spent by the fireplace after a day skiing in the French Alps. A playful contrast between hot and cold, the fragrance opens with exhilarating notes of pink pepper and clove, contrasting with the warmth of cashmeran and orange flower. Gourmand accents of creamy vanilla and rich chestnut give the unisex fragrance a unique, addictive quality. Made in France.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Beach Walk Eau de Toilette - 100ml
listings.description: Family: Fresh/Floral Top Notes: Bergamot, Pink Pepper, Lemon. Heart Notes: Ylang Ylang, Coconut Milk. Base Notes: Musc, Cedarwood. Maison Margiela’s Replica Beach Walk Eau de Toilette captures a moment in Calvi, 1972. Take a stroll along a white sandy beach as summer rays warm the skin. Fresh citrus top notes of lemon and bergamot evoke memories of holidays, while sparkling pink pepper adds a unique spiced warmth. In the heart, sunkissed ylang ylang combines with coconut milk, exuding a luxurious tropical feel. The base of musc and cedarwood holds close to the skin, creating a truly unforgettable Eau de Toilette. Made In France.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Beach Walk Eau de Toilette - 30ml
listings.description: Family: Fresh/Floral Top Notes: Bergamot, Pink Pepper, Lemon. Heart Notes: Ylang Ylang, Coconut Milk. Base Notes: Musc, Cedarwood. listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Under The Lemon Tree's Eau de Toilette - 100ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Citrus Top Notes: Kalamansi Lime Accord, Cardamon Essence. Heart Notes: Coriander Essence, Green Tea Extract. Base Notes: Cedarwood Essence, Cistus Absolute, White Musk. Evoke the memories of summer escapes in the luscious countryside, with Maison Margiela's Replica Under The Lemon Tree Eau de Toilette. Seek shade from the warm sun under the lemon trees, soaking in the aroma of zesty lemons and refreshing green leaves while you relax in the Mediterranean breeze. Invigorating top notes of kalamansi lime and cardamom circulate with fresh heart notes of coriander and green tea. This earthy scent settles on a base of cedarwood and white musk for a light and uplifting everyday fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Bubble Bath Eau de Toilette - 100ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Chypre Floral Top Notes: Soap Bubbles Accord, Pink Pepper, Bergamot. Middle Notes: Lavender Flower, Rose Super Essence, Jasmine. Base Notes: Coconut Milk, White Musks, Patchouli. Sink into the warm, relaxing depths of Maison Margiela’s Replica Bubble Bath Eau de Toilette. Inspiring a moment for the self, this fragrance evokes the memory of a long soak in a blanket of bubbles. Soft floral notes effervesce into a sense of calm, pairing lavender flower with layers of jasmine, patchouli and white musks. Wrap your skin in an exquisite and unique fragrance – this one is the epitome of ‘me time’.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Bubble Bath Eau de Toilette - 30ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Chypre Floral Top Notes: Soap Bubbles Accord, Pink Pepper, Bergamot. Middle Notes: Lavender Flower, Rose Super Essence, Jasmine. listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Springtime in a Park Eau de Toilette - 100ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Fruity. Top Notes: Pear Accord, Bergamot Essence, Blackcurrant Accord. Middle Notes: Lily of the Valley Accord, Rose Damascena Absolue. Base Notes: Musks, Vanilla Accord. Introducing Maison Margiela Replica Springtime In A Park Eau de Toilette, a floral and fruity unisex fragrance. Drawing on the memory of spending springtime in the park, the delicate scent is ideal for everyday wear. Sparkling notes of bergamot essence and sweet pear accentuate the gourmand blackcurrant accord. The fragrance reveals a bouquet of lily of the valley accord and rose damascena absolue at its heart, a fresh and vibrant aroma. Warm, creamy notes of vanilla accord and musk anchor the fragrance, lingering on the skin gently.

listings.rawTitle: Tiffany & Co. Rose Gold Eau de Parfum For Her 75ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Blackcurrant. Heart Notes: Blue Rose. Base Notes: Ambrette Seed. Vibrant and effervescent, the Tiffany & Co. Rose Gold Eau de Parfum For Her embodies the spirit of optimism. Created by master perfumer Jerome Epinette of Robertet, the perfume cloaks skin in a delicate yet sparkling fragrance. The scent trail opens with fresh notes of blackcurrant and lychee, providing a captivating introduction. Born from a fusion of Japanese rose and violet, a heart of blue rose adds subtle citric and floral notes, embodying the inspiration behind the fragrance. A musky ambrette seed base creates a warming finale. Drawing inspiration from Tiffany’s iconic diamond cuts, the perfume is housed in a luxurious rose gold-tinted glass bottle, complete with the iconic blue Tiffany band.

listings.rawTitle: Tiffany & Co. Rose Gold Eau de Parfum For Her 30ml
