listings.rawTitle: Goldfield & Banks Bohemian Lime Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: A moment of bliss awaits with Goldfield & Banks’ Bohemian Lime Perfume. The fragrance draws inspiration from the beauty of Byron Bay, a free-spirited coastal area home to scenic beaches and rainforests. Zesty and refreshing, the scent evokes images of cascading waterfalls, luscious greenery and sun-soaked sands, kissed with the sea’s salty spray. The grounding aroma is a delicate balance of warmth and freshness, characterised by its blend of comforting woods and a juicy finger lime accord. Earthy nuances of vetiver underpin the scent for an idyllic finish. With its gold tint and radiant topper, the flacon’s minimalistic yet eye-catching design showcases the vibrancy of Byron Bay.

listings.rawTitle: Miller Harris Secret Gardenia Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Floral Top Notes: Bergamot Eo, Yuzu Eo, Aqual, Nashi Pear. Heart Notes: Gardenia, Jasmin Abs Egypt, Ylang-Ylang Eo, Violet Petal. Base Notes: Driftwood, Creamy Sandalwood, Cedarwood Eo, Musk. Lose yourself in Miller Harris’ Secret Gardenia Eau de Parfum, a fresh and uplifting floral scent. Capturing the beautiful scents of London’s clandestine white flowers and gardens, Secret Gardenia offers a modern take on floral fragrances. A bouquet of notes such as zesty yuzu and cool, nashi pear open the perfume, before revealing layers of jasmine and violet. Delicate musks and creamy sandalwood ground the scent, celebrating the mystery and intrigue of London’s secret gardens, a tucked away haven from the bustle of the city. Vegan.

listings.rawTitle: Miller Harris Peau Santal Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Woody, Spice Top Notes: Bergamot, Pink Pepper, Saffron. Heart Notes: Olibanum, Violet Leaf, Papyrus. Base Notes: Sandalwood, Cashmere woods, Crisp amber, Vanilla CO2 extract, Moss. Miller Harris’ Peau Santal Eau de Parfum celebrates the comforting warmth of New Caledonian sandalwood in a truly unisex composition. The rich scent conjures images of fireside evenings and library books, combining papyrus and olibanum to create an enveloping resinous quality. The opening of bergamot, pink pepper and saffron offers a kick of spice, enlivening the fragrance, while violet leaf lends a softness that holds close to the skin. A dry down of cashmere woods, moss and crisp amber creates a cosy, earthy feel, wrapped in creamy vanilla CO2 extract. Creating an addictive, lasting trail, the Eau de Parfum evokes sensuality and closeness by balancing sweetness and depth. Vegan.

listings.rawTitle: Miller Harris Lumiere Doree Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Out of the entire collection of London perfumery Miller Harris’ opulent fragrances, Lumière Dorée is by far the brightest scent. It blends crisp, powdery notes of fresh spring flowers with a soapy-clean, fougère undertone that lingers in the backdrop. Hints of musky and woody hues creep in as it dries down, leaving behind a complex but perfectly balanced aroma on your skin with an uplifting feel. Vegan. Free from phthalates, artificial colourants, parabens and formaldehydes.

listings.rawTitle: Miller Harris Coeur de Jardin Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Capturing a precious moment of sunlit warmth following a rainstorm, Miller Harris’ Coeur de Jardin offers a floral chypre composition. Opening with bright, summertime notes of lemon, pear and peach, the radiant scent reveals a heart of Turkish rose, jasmine and tuberose. Enveloped in creamy vanilla, the bouquet is grounded by soft orris and musk. Warm, earthy notes of amber, patchouli, musk and moss linger on the skin, creating an addictive scent trail.

listings.rawTitle: Miller Harris Poirier D'Un Soir Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Woody, Fruity Top Notes: Bergamot Italy, Pear. Heart Notes: Rum, Peony. Base Notes: Birch, Cedarwood. As flowers close and leaves turn to gold, take an evening stroll through a fragrant pear orchard. Capturing the fading light of autumn, Miller Harris’ Poirier D'Un Soir Eau de Parfum bewitches the senses with memories of crackling bonfires, scarves and copper-hued sunsets. Opening with juicy pear and radiant bergamot, fruity accords blend with the soft blooms of dusky Turkish rose and peony, laced with indulgent caramel. The warmth of rum is woven through the heart of the fragrance, alongside a hint of raisin, creating a rich, enveloping dry down. Steam distilled Canadian white cedarwood oil brings a camphor freshness, complemented by birch and musks. Nostalgic and hedonistic, Poirier D'Un Soir is the perfect transitional scent.

listings.rawTitle: Miller Harris Scherzo Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Fruity floral Top Notes: Tangerine, Davana. Heart Notes: Olibanum, Narcissus, Pittosporum, Dark Rose, Peony. Base Notes: Patchouli, Vanilla, Oudh, Sweet Note. Miller Harris’ best-selling Scherzo Eau de Parfum offers a medley of floral and citrus accords to create a radiant and vivacious fragrance. This signature scent captures the sweetness of tangerine before delving into the richness of dark rose. Opulent top notes of davana combine with the heart notes of peony and olibanum creating a luminous bouquet. Heady base notes of oud and vanilla deepen the sugary undertones for a sweet aroma, evoking memories of a traditional sweet shop.

listings.rawTitle: Miller Harris Tea Tonique Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Citrus/Fresh Top Notes: Bergamot Essence Oil, Lemon, Petitgrain. Heart Notes: Green Tea, Earl Grey Tea, Mate Tea, Nutmeg. Base Notes: Birch Tar, Musk. Discover the uplifting fragrance of the Miller Harris Tea Tonique Eau de Parfum. Inspired by a trip to a tea plantation bursting with the refreshing zest of crisp leaves, the EDP captivates the senses with every spritz. The fragrance opens with an infusion of Italian bergamot before revealing a heart of floral earl grey tea. Smokey birch and mate tea evoke an earthy intensity, adding an unpredictable and aromatic edge. Notes of spiced nutmeg and warming musk provide a contrast to this delicate and sparkling scent.

listings.rawTitle: Miller Harris Roll On Lumiere Doree Eau de Parfum 9ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Floral/Fougère. Top Notes: Italian Bergamot, Petit Grain Bigaradier, Orange Bigarade. Heart Notes: Moroccan Neroli, Sambac Jasmine Absolute, Orange Blossom. Base Notes: Cashmere Wood, Vetiver, Crisp Amber, White Musks. Out of the entire collection of London perfumery Miller Harris’ opulent fragrances, Lumière Dorée is by far the brightest scent. It blends crisp, powdery notes of fresh spring flowers with a soapy-clean, fougère undertone that lingers in the backdrop. Hints of musky and woody hues creep in as it dries down, leaving behind a complex but perfectly balanced aroma on your skin with an uplifting feel. Presented in a travel-friendly vial topped with a rollerball. Vegan. Free from phthalates, artificial colourants, parabens and formaldehydes.

listings.rawTitle: Floral Street London Poppy Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Floral. Top Notes: Orange, Lemon, Apricot Blossom. Heart Notes: Jasmine Sambac, Neroli, Sunflower Accord, Marine Accord. Base Notes: Cedarwood, Hinoki Woods, Black Amber. Discover the warm, floral embrace of Floral Street’s London Poppy Eau de Parfum. A fresh citrus opening unfurls to a hypnotic bouquet of jasmine, neroli and sunflower accord, intertwined with deep, resinous woods. Formulated with a 20% concentration of aromatic oils, the fragrance provides a long-lasting perfume. Vegan. Made in the UK.

listings.rawTitle: Floral Street Neon Rose Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Bergamot, Cassis Kir, Apple Blossom, Sichuan Pepper. Heart Notes: Cyclamen, Juniper Berry, Jasmine, Angelica. Base Notes: White Cedarwood, Peach Nectar, Crisp Amber. Lay on a bed of freshly cut roses and botanical cyclamen with this striking floral scent. Expressive hues of sweet apple blossom and fiery sichuan pepper, blend into a glorious bouquet of jasmine and refreshingly clean juniper berry. Settling on a base of white cedarwood, crisp amber, and ripe peach nectar, to express a rich and intense aroma.

listings.rawTitle: Floral Street Ylang Ylang Espresso Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Tangerine, Sichuan pepper. Heart Notes: Fresh Rose, Jasmine, Tiramisu Accord, Patchouli. Base Notes: Ylang Ylang, Espresso Beans, Cocoa Beans, Guaiacwood. A spirited gourmand scent inspired by leaders and thinkers. Harvested from the foothills of the Himalayas, Sichuan pepper electrifies the creamy accords or tiramisu and patchouli. The warm steam from freshly brewed coffee drifts into a soothing aroma of ylang-ylang, creating a rich aromatic experience.

listings.rawTitle: Floral Street Iris Goddess Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Chypre Floral. Top Notes: Lemon Zest, Chilli Pepper. Heart Notes: Midnight Violet, Suede Accord, Tuscan Orris, Carrot Seed. Base Notes: Patchouli Fraction, Black Vanilla, Liquid Musks. Introducing the transcendent FloralStreet Iris Goddess Eau de Parfum. A mystical fragrance, the scent takes you from the forest to the desert on an unforgettable adventure. Invigorating lemon zest and spicy chilli pepper open the fragrance, jolting the senses to life. The scent unfurls to reveal other-worldly notes of suede accord and Tuscan orris, offering a soft and powdery dimension to the scent. Spicy carrot seed infuses the aroma, as earthy patchouli fraction and liquid musks ground the fragrance, evoking a sense of adventure as the scent lingers on the skin. Vegan.

listings.rawTitle: Floral Street Electric Rhubarb Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Rhubarb, Lemon, Bergamot. Heart Notes: Islang Gardenia, Orange Flower Tunisia, Jasmine Sambac. Base Notes: White Cedarwood, Marine Accord, Liquid Musks, Santal Austral. Expect the unexpected with FloralStreet’s Electric Rhubarb Eau de Parfum, a bubbly, white-floral fragrance to charm the senses. Like a bottle of fizz on a balmy summer afternoon, the scent is bright and effervescent. English rhubarb opens with a tangy-sweet tone, blossoming into a heart of flowers. Revealing depths of Australian sandalwood, the EDP settles on a warm, sensuous base. Sunny, radiant skies are paired with an unpredictable blast of salty sea air in this luminous fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Floral Street Neon Rose Eau de Parfum 10ml

listings.rawTitle: Floral Street Arizona Bloom Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Top Notes: Black Pepper, Coconut Extract. Heart Notes: Jasmine Petals, Fig Leaves. Base Notes: Cashmere Woods, Oakmoss, Salted Musks. Wild and euphoric, FloralStreet’s Arizona Bloom Eau de Parfum is a sunny and spirited fragrance for the one who’s unpredictable. Marvel at neon skies and vibrant sunshine, all wrapped up in one dry, floral-amber signature. The scent draws inspiration from flora and fauna in desert landscapes, creating a nomadic sense of being. Black pepper and coconut extract impart a smooth, spicy opening that dips into the freshness of salted musks. Balancing nature and the self, this eau de parfum is powered by liberation. Vegan

listings.rawTitle: Floral Street Wild Vanilla Orchid Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Floral Top Notes: Cassis, Lemon. Heart Notes: Vanilla Blossom, Bamboo, Jasmine. Base Notes: Vanilla Beans, Sandalwood, Patchouli Fraction, Red Orchid. Experience a new and contemporary vanilla scent with FloralStreet’s Wild Vanilla Orchid Eau de Parfum. Centred around creamy vanilla beans, the exotic vegan fragrance envelops the senses like a warm blanket. Delicate Indian jasmine sambac blossoms bloom around sparkling citrus and cassis, enticing the senses. The warmth of bamboo and sandalwood offsets the initial lingering sweetness, creating a lasting scent trail. Vegan.

listings.rawTitle: Floral Street Wonderland Peony Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Fragrance Family: Fruity / Floral. Top Notes: Lemon, Pink Berries, Pink Guava. Heart Notes: Violet, Peony Accord, Raspberry Flower. Base Notes: Vanilla Bean, Pink Cotton Candy, Cedarwood, Vetiver. Light and fruity with sweet undertones, Floral Street’s unforgettable Wonderland Peony Eau de Parfum is a fragrance for the delicate, dreamy and thoughtful. A fresh squeeze of lemon mingles with fruity blackcurrants and guava in the opening, enlivened by piquant pink peppercorn. The perfume evolves seamlessly, introducing colourful visions of rosy peonies in full bloom that transport your senses to a bright and beautiful spring day. Sugary hints of fairy floss seep in, deepened by the woody-balsamic warmth of cedarwood and creamy swirls of vanilla in the dry-down. Crafted with a 20% oil concentration, the fragrance provides a long-lasting perfume, intensified by the warmth of your body. Vegan. Made in the UK.

listings.rawTitle: Goldfield & Banks Sunset Hour Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: The Goldfield & Banks Sunset Hour Perfume imitates the feeling of a gentle breeze brushing against the skin on a delightful summer’s evening. Ignited with an elixir of citrus and spicy accords, the scent transports you to the end of a sun-drenched day. Opening with zesty mandarin and fresh peach, the blend of fruity notes evokes an enlivening beginning to a distinctive fragrance. At the heart, a magnetic fusion of coconut cream and green mango meets with jasmine and ginger to replicate the aroma of a tropical paradise. Australian sandalwood settles at the base with musk and vanilla to create a blazing trail that lingers even once the sun has set.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Autumn Vibes Eau de Toilette 30ml
listings.description: Evoking an olfactive memory of walking through a crisp woodland in the invigorating air of October, Maison Margiela’s Autumn Vibes Eau de Toilette captures the fresh woody aromas and golden depth of the sensorial season. A zesty blend opens the scent trail, spiked with pink pepper and coriander to exhilarate the senses, before an aromatic heart of carrot, nutmeg and frankincense mellows the fragrance. Reminiscent of precious memories, the eau de toilette closes with notes of cedarwood, oak moss and balsam to capture a welcomed nostalgic notion, encouraging a comforting effect with each spritz.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Rose Goldea Blossom Delight Eau De Toilette 75ml
listings.description: The BVLGARI Rose Goldea Blossom Delight Eau De Toilette is a light, luminous scent inspired by the freshness of rosebuds at sunrise. Offering a fresh olfactory experience, the EDT immerses the senses in an elegant floral scent, perfect for daytime wear. The fragrance opens with sweet, crisp nuances of lily of the valley. Grapefruit lends a citrus aroma, wrapped in a freshly-picked bouquet of spring flowers. Lingering on the skin in a moment of absolute serenity, the scent dries down to a warm, comforting base of musk and sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Man Glacial Essence Eau De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: BVLGARI Man Glacial Essence Eau De Parfum embodies the man on his quest for greatness, as he explores the power of the natural elements, surpassing the fierce magnitudes of frozen mountains on the unstoppable journey of masculinity. Juniper berry leads with an icy freshness, layered with Australian sandalwood to warm the heart and reveal intense earthy depths. An infusion of Clearwood® accords contribute light woody nuances, combining the natural elements air and earth in a crisp scent.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Eau Parfumée Au Thé Blanc Eau De Cologne 75ml
listings.description: A delicate yet luxurious unisex Eau de Cologne by BVLGARI, Eau Parfumée Au Thé Blanc is a woody, floral musk that embodies relaxing reverie. The fragrance is designed for both him and her, a soothing addition to your evening wind-down ritual. The captivating fragrance exudes an air of intimacy and serenity, as top notes of herbaceous artemisia balance the soft and ethereal nature of white Himalayan tea. Wrapped in a sultry musk to create a resounding harmony of aromas.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro The Most Wanted Eau De Parfum Intense 50ml
listings.description: The Most Wanted Eau de Parfum Intense is a rich and powerful scent by Azzaro that is unapologetically sensuous. Defined by its thrilling fougere amber composition, the fragrance is for those who refuse to play by the rules. The charismatic scent marries sweet toffee with warm, spicy nuances of cardamom, creating a distinct aroma with a sharp kick. Underpinned by a musky amberwood accord, the perfume entices the senses with every spritz.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Born in Roma Coral Donna Eau de Parfum for Her 30ml
listings.description: Experience a Roman escape with Born in Roma Coral Donna from Valentino. As coral light fills the skyline, the fruity floral fragrance makes this moment yours with a new twist on your Italian fantasy. Opening with a juicy sensation, sparkling strawberry and bergamot energise the scent with a zesty beginning. A floral heart of jasmine grandiflorum reveals a bright expression of modern femininity, with a lightness and charm reminiscent of the audacious Valentino woman. Grounding the base, cedar and vetiver releases earthy undertones for a memorable trail that lingers all day. The fragrance is housed in a glass bottle inspired by Rome at sunset with the quintessential Valentino rock studs.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica When The Rain Stops Eau de Toilette - 100ml
listings.description: When the Rain Stops Eau de Toilette, by Maison Margiela captures the moment of tranquillity that follows a rain shower, as sunrays shyly emerge through the clouds. A vision of springtime, the scent evokes a breath of fresh air, uniting a clean, aquatic accord and woody pine needle oil. A base of patchouli and moss lends an earthy quality, grounding the dewy florals, while luminous Isparta Rose and Pink Pepper essence offer sweetness and vibrancy to capture the promise of new beginnings. The woody aquatic eau de toilette forms part of Maison Margiela’s Replica collection, unique, unisex fragrances inspired by memories.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Her Eau de Toilette 30ml
listings.description: Capturing the essence of the unapologetically free-spirited woman who simply goes with the flow, Burberry Her Eau de Toilette is a fragrance for she who knocks down restraints and embraces spontaneity with open arms. Breezy and light-hearted with unconventional surprises, the fragrance unshackles notes of green pear electrified with daring hints of pepper. Melting to a floral heart, the trail deepens to the warm earthiness of musk and cedarwood as it dries down. The EDT is bottled in luminous green glass to echo its starring note of ripe, freshly-picked garden pears. Made in Spain.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Her Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Capturing the essence of the unapologetically free-spirited woman who simply goes with the flow, Burberry Her Eau de Toilette is a fragrance for she who knocks down restraints and embraces spontaneity with open arms. The EDT is bottled in luminous green glass to echo its starring note of ripe, freshly-picked garden pears. Made in Spain.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez for Her Musc Noir Rose Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Symbolising a new chapter in Narciso Rodriguez’s ‘for her’ story, Musc Noir Rose Eau de Parfum offers a more sensual olfactive experience than its deeper counterpart, Musc Noir. Unveiling the most personal side of femininity, the fragrance blooms with a voluptuous bouquet of tuberose. Sweet, fruity top notes of Italian bergamot oil, and sparking pink peppercorn give way to the signature heart of musk and plum, creating a sense of intimacy. The solar fusion settles into a base of creamy oriental vanilla, lingering on the skin to evoke an addictive sensuality.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez for Her Musc Noir Rose Eau de Parfum 100ml

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau D'Issey Eau and Magnolia Eau de Toilette Intense 50ml
listings.description: Centred around the radiant Magnolia flower, Issey Miyake’s L'Eau D'Issey Eau and Magnolia Eau de Toilette Intense captures a petal-powered scent in a delicate floral bouquet. Paying tribute to nature and its raw elements, the fragrance emits a crystalline freshness with sparkling bergamot and aromatic neroli top notes. The heart revolves around leading Magnolia flower, accompanied by sweet nuances of rose, while sandalwood warms the base bringing the olfactory trail to its close. Housed in a minimalist bottle with a wooden cap to pay homage to the untouched nature that inspires it.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau D'Issey Eau and Cèdre Eau de Toilette Intense 100ml
listings.description: Inspired by nature, the Issey Miyake L'Eau D'Issey Eau and Cèdre Eau de Toilette Intense merge the essence of the elements, combining wooden accords with the freshness of water. Opening with a fiery cardamom scent, the Eau de Toilette reveals an aquatic aroma moulded around the vibrance of cedarwood. Potent notes of vetiver and patchouli unify to unveil a rich, indulgent base. Encased inside the signature minimalist bottle, the fragrance features a wooden lid, apt to the creative direction of the scent.

listings.rawTitle: La Roche-Posay Anthelios UVMune 400 Invisible Fluid Non-Perfumed Suncream SPF50+ 50ml
listings.description: Now enhanced with exclusive filter MEXORYL400, La Roche-Posay’s Anthelios UVMune 400 Invisible Fluid SPF50+ helps to protect skin against damage caused by UVA, UVB and ultra-long UVA rays. Water, sweat and sand-resistant, the high-protection sun cream creates a lightweight veil on the skin with an invisible, non-greasy finish. Specifically designed for all skin types and prototypes, including sensitive skin, the high tolerance formula is ideal for daily use, whether worn alone or under makeup.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Infusion D'Iris Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Capturing the beauty of the iris flower, Prada’s Infusion D’Iris Eau de Parfum is a poetic interpretation of its namesake. The fragrance is a soft and elegant composition, perfect for daytime to evening wear. A refreshing elixir of mandarin and citrus accord opens the fragrance, unfurling into an elegant heart of neroli. Soft, powdery orris uplifts the scent, intertwining with woody nuances. Creating an enchanting scent trail, the perfume diffuses into a creamy base of cedarwood and benzoin, offering a serene finish.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Infusion D'Amande Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: A poetic interpretation of the natural almond, the Prada Infusion D’Amande Eau de Parfum offers a modern and unique scent. Forming a part of the brand’s simplistic Infusion collection, the EDP marries zesty notes with earthy accords for an intoxicating finish. The fragrance is introduced by refreshing Italian Mandarin. Almond lends a nutty, bitter aroma, uplifted by a floral bouquet of star anise and heliotrope. Creating a captivating scent trail, the androgynous scent is anchored in a warm, comforting base of tonka bean and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden Green Tea Lychee Lime Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Opening with sweet and citrusy accords, the Elizabeth Arden Green Tea Lychee Lime Eau de Toilette invites the senses on an aromatic adventure exploring notes of citrus bergamia and lychee, mingling with a zesty cocktail of lemons and limes. Heart notes of geranium, magnolia and water lily offer a light, floral sensation, settling on an earthy base of green tea, adding a refreshing twist to the fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Molton Brown Rose Dunes Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Capturing an eternal desert heat, the Molton Brown Rose Dunes Eau de Parfum embodies the mysterious beauty of silent dusk settling over the sand. Opening with golden, warm notes of saffron and cassis, the fragrance transcends the senses to exotic, unexplored terrains and the shimmering sunset over towering dunes. Luxuriously sweet notes of rose and geranium ebb and flow throughout the fragrance, intertwining with earthy patchouli to bring an unexpected note of luxury to the EDP. Exuding a spellbinding fragrance, the perfume inspires a sense of wanderlust, and a desire to explore the wild beauty of the desert night.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Le Parfum Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: An exploration into male sensuality, Le Beau Le Parfum Eau de Parfum is Jean Paul Gaultier’s answer to surrendering to temptation. The woody amber fragrance exudes a hypnotic allure that even the strongest of men cannot deny. Drawing in the senses with a sweet, creamy aroma is a familiar note of coconut wood. The fresh yet exotic scent envelopes the senses in a warm embrace, shutting out reality and welcoming you to the garden of delight. Blazing at the heart of the scent, a sudden accord of tonka bean delivers a spicy heat that ensnares the senses, begging them to taste the forbidden fruits within. Bursting with a deep note of sandalwood, the fragrance delivers a wild, raw passion that cannot be contained. Housed in the signature torso bottle, a golden vine leaf alludes to the barely-contained desire within.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Le Parfum Eau de Parfum 125ml

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Cobalt Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: An electrifying take on the duality of modern masculinity that defines Carolina Herrera’s Bad Boy fragrance, the Cobalt Eau de Parfum fuses mineral sensuality with an energising freshness. Daring and sophisticated, the scent expresses the bold nature of the modern man, reinvented as his most elegant and confident self. Fresh, aromatic top notes of pink pepper and lavender are amplified by a floral, yet masculine, heart of geranium. At the base, mineral accents of truffle accord are infused with smoky oakwood, vetiver and enticing cedarwood to complete this aromatic woody fragrance. Housed in a striking lightning bolt bottle, the fragrance draws inspiration from cobalt and its pigmented hue.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Cobalt Eau de Parfum 100ml

listings.rawTitle: Moncler Pour Homme Eau de Parfum 60ml
listings.description: A fusion of earthy accords and aromatic woods, Moncler’s Pour Homme Eau de Parfum captures the vivid natural beauty of an alpine forest. The masculine iteration of Moncler's first-ever fragrance opens with an exclusive alpine green accord, elevated with fresh notes of clary sage to embody a leafy vastness of pine trees. Carried by warming cedarwood, an exclusive mountain woods accord creates an earthy dry-down, enhanced by the allure of vetiver. The fragrance is housed in a unique ‘borraccia’ flask-shaped bottle with a ribbed silver design, echoing Moncler’s mountaineering origins and the iconic quilted construction of a Moncler jacket.

The bottle is also adorned with an LED screen, a playful innovation that works via a Bluetooth-powered smartphone app to display a customisable note that appears in scrolling red letters. Includes LED case, refill bottle and charger.

listings.rawTitle: Moncler Pour Femme Eau de Parfum 60ml
listings.description: Breathe in the crisp scent of unexplored mountains and listen close to the crunching of fresh snow, as Moncler’s Pour Femme Eau de Parfum transcends the senses to an unexplored terrain. Cultivated with exclusive fragrance accords, the floral, woody, musky perfume is the female iteration of Moncler’s first scent. Enchanting bergamot, jasmine and heliotrope intertwine with a custom Powdery Snow accord to ignite a passion for adventure, equipping wearers with the desire to embrace the unknown. Achieving the impossible, the perfume obtains a Mountain Wood accord, embodying the magnificence of freedom and celebrating the beauty of nature. A velvety base of vanillin seeks to amplify the fresh and exclusive scents, capturing an impossibly nuanced yet familiar aroma. An ode to nature itself, this sparkling Eau de Parfum is testament to the intrinsic connection between Moncler and the outdoors. Revered globally, the perfume arrives in a flask-shaped bottle, a nod to Moncler’s humble origins.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentleman Eau de Toilette Intense 100ml
listings.description: Encapsulating a confident and caring personality, the Givenchy Gentleman Eau de Toilette Intense pays homage to Hubert de Givenchy. Expressing timeless elegance, the fragrance captivates the senses with aromatic woody accords. The scent opens with crisp notes of basil and cardamom, mingling with the refined and tender infusion of blue orris. Departing with a rich blend of cedarwood and coumarin, the masculine EDT offers a smooth, yet intense aroma.

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Very Good Girl Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Carolina Herrera’s Very Good Girl Eau De Parfum declares an exciting twist to the original Good Girl fragrance. It is a vivid and playful scent, marked by a mischievous redcurrant and exotic lychee opening. Seductive florals unfold from the heart, pursued by a vetiver and vanilla base. The fragrance is reflective of the modern, passionate woman – the one who is equal parts fun and fearless. Housed in the iconic Stiletto bottle, starring a red-lacquered exterior to mirror the daring scent within.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Terre d'Hermès Eau Intense Vétiver Eau de Parfum Natural Spray 100ml
listings.description: Men are beckoned to another Terre. In 2018, Christine Nagel explored her vision of Terre d'Hermès and created Terre d'Hermès Eau Intense Vetiver. A new luminous vibration, an unprecedented expression of the power of Terre. An intense, woody fragrance, Terre d'Hermès Eau Intense Vetiver expresses the depth of vetiver combined with the liveliness of green bergamot and Sichuan pepper. The original cap takes on the warm brown hue of leather tanned in the sun. At its base, the bottle rests on an H in a deeper shade of orange. At the top, the light is intensified and reflected by the bottle's metal shoulders. When held in the hand, the Terre d'Hermès Eau Intense Vetiver bottle unveils its many details: the House's iconic Clou de Selle, the sliding cover used to release the spray, etc. Created by designer Philippe Mouquet, it is inspired by a bottle in a travel vanity case that is conserved at the Emile Hermès museum. Made in France.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Terre d'Hermès Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: The strength of citrus fruits and peppers combined with a note of flint reveal the trace of earth. Terre d’Hermès narrates the relationship between man and earth, his humble and harmonious dialogue with the elements and nature. Terre d’Hermès is the perfume that connects man to his origins, to the source of his creative power.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Twilly d'Hermès Eau de Parfum 85ml
listings.description: The scent of the Hermès girls, a daring fragrance woven with striking ginger and sensual tuberose. A floral, spicy eau de parfum. "It is with young women in mind, by observing their lives, that I created Twilly d’Hermès. Free, bold, connected, mischievous and irreverent, they turn expectation on its head, swim against the tide, impose their own rhythm, invent a brand new tempo." Christine Nagel It is in this spirit that Christine Nagel composed Twilly d'Hermès. Ginger, tuberose and sandalwood are given a new twist. Combined differently, they become searing spice, disconcerting attraction, a revelation of the carnal. In a final flash of wit, a hand-tied silk ribbon playfully graces the bottle. Each silk ribbon is unique.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Twilly d'Hermès Eau Poivrée Eau de Parfum Natural Spray 85ml
listings.description: The peppery spirit of the Hermes girls. A daring fragrance coloured with vibrant pink peppercorn, tender rose and elegant patchouli. Spicy, floral, woody. Made in France.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Twilly d'Hermès Eau Ginger Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Twilly d’Hermès Eau Ginger, the sparkle of the Hermès girls. A dazzling creation woven with three materials: a generous, vibrating peony, a bright candied ginger, a supple and lively cedarwood. A floral, spicy and woody Eau de Parfum. Yesterday they were mischievous, then spicy, and today they are joyful, bright and sparkling. Their faces light up, smiling and free, to express the impertinence and freshness of this new Twilly d’Hermès, one that turns everything on its head.. Inside its box, printed with the Astrologie nouvelle design reworked in fresh colours, sits the Twilly d’Hermès Eau Ginger bottle, tied with a new silk ribbon and topped with a brilliant white cap.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Elixir des Merveilles Eau de Parfum Natural Spray 100ml
listings.description: THE CREATION Created by perfumer Jean-Claude Ellena, Élixir des Merveilles intensifies the magic of the Merveilles collection. A delightful new star, a distillation of enchantment. OLFACTORY NOTES The woody, amber Eau de Parfum blends a gourmet candied orange, enveloping benzoin and deep patchouli. BOTTLE On the emblematic star-spangled magnifying-glass Merveilles bottle, a magical orange glow grows ever more intense. The top of the spray is engraved with the house’s saddle nail seal. THE EAU DES MERVEILLES CONSTELLATION The second opus in the Hermès Merveilles collection, Élixir des Merveilles is deeper and more mysterious. Since 2004, Eau des Merveilles has been a key that opens the door to the wonders of Hermès. From innocence to fantasy, from childhood dreams to femininity, it is a world where the extraordinary is brought into the light. Year after year, we are transported on an air of poetic enchantment. Captured in their round bottles resembling a magnifying glass, the fragrances have the magical power to see the world from new and marvellous angles. It is the key to wonders, the origin of stars in broad day light.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Eau d'orange Verte Eau de Cologne 100ml
listings.description: Hermès' first cologne: the bright and green freshness of orange combined with woody undertones. The founding cologne, created by Françoise Caron in 1979 and inspired by the smell of undergrowth moist with morning dew, Eau d'orange verte has since asserted itself as an emblem of Hermès, standing out by its distinctive freshness. Conceived as an explosion of citrus notes, orange plays the principal role supported by zest and leaves, lemon, mandarin, mint and blackcurrant bud. The fragrance reveals its complexity in a unique sillage composed of oak moss and patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Un Jardin Sur La Lagune Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Un Jardin sur la Lagune, a dream garden, soothing and vibrant. A floral and woody Eau de Toilette. "I dreamed of this garden; I created a perfume woven from its memories, the cycle of trees and flowers, nature still enduring within it" Christine Nagel, Hermès perfumer A half open door, a dream escapes Un jardin sur la Lagune is a secret garden where nature comes into its own again. Woody scents blend with floral notes. The wind carries afar salty notes.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Le Jardin de Monsieur Li Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: A garden of awakening and harmony, poised between reality and the imagination, with wet stones, vegetal jasmine and kumquats. "I remembered the smell of ponds, the smell of jasmine, the smell of wet stones, of plum trees, kumquats and giant bamboos. It was all there, and in the ponds there were even carp steadily working towards their hundredth birthdays." Jean-Claude Ellena Le Jardin de Monsieur Li describes a Chinese garden poised between reality and imagination. A place for meditation, where strolling is allied to thought, and every step sets the imagination free.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Le Jardin de Monsieur Li Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: A garden of awakening and harmony, poised between reality and the imagination, with wet stones, vegetal jasmine and kumquats. listings.rawTitle: Hermès 24 Faubourg Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: A patch of light. A swathe of white flowers opening out in the sunlight, the mystery and sensuality of vanilla and sandalwood. A novel written by Maurice Roucel in 1995, 24 Faubourg is an invitation to travel, with the sun as a destination. A sparkle of white flowers in the top notes, the radiance of a floral heart enveloped in iris, wood and mystery, while vanilla and ambergris set the tone for the sillage.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Kelly Calèche Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: A generous floral harmony, a winning sweetness. “A perfume of leather and flowers, as light as an angel’s wing.” Jean-Claude Ellena A reminder of a visit to the Hermès leather storehouse, Kelly Calèche is a light, feminine, joyous expression of leather. It gives a nod to two emblems of the house, and translates the perfumer’s tactile and olfactory emotions into an evocation of leather worn next to the skin, gently tanned by the touch and embroidered with fresh petals.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Terre d’Hermès Eau Givrée Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Terre d’Hermès Eau Givrée, the heat of ice. A new Eau de Parfum, both fresh and intense. Created by Christine Nagel, Hermès’ perfumer, Terre d’Hermès Eau Givrée combines the vigour of citron and the incisive freshness of juniper berry with the power of Timut pepper. The striking sensation of an icy breeze is juxtaposed with the generosity of the woody, mineral notes characteristic of Terre d’Hermès. Refillable and sustainable, the bottle combines glass with aluminium, two fully recyclable materials. As if cut from ice, the object is sleek and limpid. Frosted glass and brushed aluminium evoke the notion of frost covering the earth. The H on its base is a subtle reference to the ancestry of a now-cult object. Terre d’Hermès Eau Givrée explores a new territory where freshness and strength nourish each other. “An icy cloak fertilises the earth, exalting it with new and vibrant strength.” Christine Nagel, creative director of Hermès fragrances. Terre d’Hermès Eau Givrée encapsulates in a bottle two contradictions, two opposites: an icy tremor and generous power. The Eau de Parfum combines the vigour of citron, the incisive freshness of juniper berry and the power of Timut pepper. The Terre d’Hermès collection tells the story of man’s relationship with the earth, his humble and harmonious dialogue with nature and the elements.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Eau de Basilic Pourpre Natural Spray 100ml
listings.description: The Hermès Colognes are welcoming a new, light and airy botanical creation. Designed by Hermès perfumer Christine Nagel, Eau de Basilic Pourpre is a tribute to this aromatic plant that’s bursting with sunshine, oozes conviviality and brings back memories of summer with family. The iconic lantern bottle adopts a bright, vibrant green colour. On the orange box, a contrasting band echoes the colour of the bottle. An eternal, masterful playground, the Hermès Colognes collection explores the sensory appeal of materials. It promises instant, lavish pleasure, uniting regardless of gender, trend, age or season.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy L'Interdit Eau de Parfum Rouge 35ml
listings.description: Housed inside an enticingly elegant bottle rests a fragrant lacquer that glows red from within. The Givenchy L'Interdit Eau de Parfum Rouge captures the essence of passion, obsession and thrill, symbolised by a scorched flower. Illuminating top notes of blood orange and red spice intertwine with a bouquet of orange blossom and sambac jasmine. The smouldering scent settles on a rich base of sandalwood and patchouli, leaving a provocative trail of spicy accords.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy L'Interdit Eau de Parfum Rouge 50ml
listings.description: Housed inside an enticingly elegant bottle rests a fragrant lacquer that glows red from within. The Givenchy L'Interdit Eau de Parfum Rouge captures the essence of passion, obsession and thrill, symbolised by a scorched flower. Illuminating top notes of blood orange and red spice intertwine with a bouquet of orange blossom and sambac jasmine. The smouldering scent settles on a rich base of sandalwood and patchouli, leaving a provocative trail of spicy accords.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentleman Eau de Toilette 60ml
listings.description: Subverting male stereotypes, Givenchy’s Gentleman EDT is an avant-garde fragrance that explores unexpected floral accords to represent a tender vulnerability within. Crisp and sweet essence of pear envelopes the senses in a refreshing aroma, while an intertwining note of lavender bestows an awakened vibrancy to the fragrance. Taking on an unexpected resilience, iris adds a touch of sensual masculinity, while a grounding, earthy note of patchouli brings the eau de toilette to a climax. Housed in a square form with soft curves, the bottle alludes to the gentleman within.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentleman Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Subverting male stereotypes, Givenchy’s Gentleman EDT is an avant-garde fragrance that explores unexpected floral accords to represent a tender vulnerability within. Crisp and sweet essence of pear envelopes the senses in a refreshing aroma, while an intertwining note of lavender bestows an awakened vibrancy to the fragrance. Taking on an unexpected resilience, iris adds a touch of sensual masculinity, while a grounding, earthy note of patchouli brings the eau de toilette to a climax. Housed in a square form with soft curves, the bottle alludes to the gentleman within.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Irresistible Eau de Parfum 35ml
listings.description: Magnetising fragrance accords work in perfect equilibrium to form the Irresistible Eau de Parfum from Givenchy. Exuding an inspiring aroma, the floral woody musk harmonises to create an addictive perfume for Her. Romantic rose essence captures the senses in an uplifting scent that intertwines delicately with rich and earthy blond wood. Together, the opposing aromas empower each other to create a multi-dimensional, nuanced fragrance that demands attention. Adding a fresh vibrancy to the perfume is a tantalizing note of juicy pear and ambrette to create a delicate charm. Drawing the fragrance to a climax is a rich musk that velvetises the scent for a complete sensorial experience.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Irresistible Eau de Toilette 80ml
listings.description: Playing on opposites, Givenchy’s Irresistible Eau de Toilette explores the hypnotic dynamic between dual fragrance accords that polarise and amplify one another. Exuding a floral woody musky aroma, the renowned perfume ignites a passion for the everyday. Seductive and sweet rose caresses the senses in a warm embrace, inviting the you to bask in the romantic radiance of the fragrance. The perfume is blended with powdery iris to velvetise the scent and emit a harmony of sensual aromas. Undercutting the moment, a note of tangy blackcurrant shines throughout the EDT, working to amplify the subtle floral accords and spotlight their natural allure. Grounding the senses with an unexpected strength are notes of cedarwood and white musk that diffuse the scent with an comforting, earthy scent that brings the fragrance to its pinnacle.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Irresistible Eau de Toilette Fraiche 50ml
listings.description: A fusion of fresh rose and vibrant spices, Givenchy’s Irresistible Eau de Toilette Fraiche exudes sheer spontaneity and liberating energy. The fragrance for women encourages its wearer to express themselves freely, contrasting floral, spicy and musky accords. The fragrance captures the sparkling intensity of fresh rose, harvested at the first light of day in the Isparta Mountains in Turkey. The freshness of each petal shines through and is elevated by bright pink pepper and sweet orange oil, balanced by a musky and woody base.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Irresistible Eau de Toilette Fraiche 80ml
listings.description: A fusion of fresh rose and vibrant spices, Givenchy’s Irresistible Eau de Toilette Fraiche exudes sheer spontaneity and liberating energy. The fragrance for women encourages its wearer to express themselves freely, contrasting floral, spicy and musky accords. The fragrance captures the sparkling intensity of fresh rose, harvested at the first light of day in the Isparta Mountains in Turkey. The freshness of each petal shines through and is elevated by bright pink pepper and sweet orange oil, balanced by a musky and woody base.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Very Irresistible Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Delve into a feminine wonderland of floral elegance with the Givenchy Very Irresistible Eau de Parfum. Evoking glamour and spontaneity, the sweet fragrance opens with sensual notes of star anise intertwined with a floral bouquet of roses. Descending into a rich base of smooth vanilla and patchouli accords, the opulent perfume offers an indulgent and long-lasting scent trail.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Very Irresistible Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Inspired by five variances of rose, Givenchy’s Very Irresistible Eau de Toilette emanates a delicate feminine freshness through a symphony of floral and aromatic accords. Brightening the petal-powered bouquet is star anise, opening the scent with spicy-sweet and warm nuances, heightened by juicy lemon zests. An armful of roses exudes luscious, dreamy notes, captivating the essence of carefree romanticism and free-spirited femininity. Housed in a sleek pink bottle, the eau de toilette offers a contemporary twist on a classical scent.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentleman Eau de Parfum Reserve Privee 60ml
listings.description: The Givenchy Gentleman Eau de Parfum Reserve Privee is a heady, whisky-inspired fragrance for the sophisticated man. Embodying timeless elegance, the scent is an intoxicating duet of sophisticated floral accords and rich amber, offering a refined finish. Refreshing bergamot introduces the fragrance, invigorating the senses with a sweet yet spicy aroma. The EDP unfurls into a heart of iris and chestnut, adding depth and intensity to the scent. Creating an intoxicating scent trail, the fragrance is wrapped in amber and smoky whisky.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Velvet Orchid Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Discover the earthy sweetness of Tom Ford’s Velvet Orchid Eau de Parfum Spray, an enveloping, floral-based fragrance. Bottled in a sleek purple vessel, the scent begins with the shimmering freshness of honey and rum, followed by the signature black orchid and velvet orchid accord. As the heart unfurls, sweet, creamy notes of vanilla are unveiled. Its deep profile makes it perfectly suited to evening events and formal occasions, wrapping you in sensorial warmth.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Forever Wanted Absolu 100ml
listings.description: The ultimate expression of intensity, Azzaro's Forever Wanted Absolu captivates with a blend of addictive amber and woody notes. The fragrance embodies the Azzaro Wanted man who seizes every moment with confidence and charisma, through a smoky allure of incense, a boozy whisky accord and rich vanilla. Offering up to 24 hours of intensity, it commands attention with every spritz.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua Di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Mirto Di Panarea EDT 100ml
listings.description: A tribute to the timeless charm of the Mediterranean, Acqua di Parma's Mirto di Panarea captures the soul of an island suspended between sea and sky. The fragrance opens with a radiant burst of myrtle and basil, lifted by the sparkling freshness of Italian lemon and bergamot. The effect is immediate and enlivening – like the first breath of ocean air carried on a coastal breeze. As the pyramid deepens, a heart of marine notes mingles with jasmine and Damask rose absolutes, evoking the delicate contrast between salt-kissed skin and sun-warmed petals. The floral accord softens the citrus brightness, creating a serene and airy harmony. In the dry down, the fragrance deepens with lentisk and juniper, grounded by Virginian cedarwood and a caress of amber. These notes linger like the golden light of sunset over the Tyrrhenian Sea.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Omnia Minatures Gift Set
listings.description: A collection of timeless and multi-faceted fragrances, Omnia transforms the unique sparkle of coloured Gemstones and the radiance of the most delicate flowers into precious drops of light. Elevating the line to an unprecedented pinnacle of radiance, the redesigned flacon - faithful to iconic infinity shape - treasures the original Omnia scents, which remain unchanged in their uniqueness. Discover the Bvlgari olfactive signatures of our most iconic feminine lines with this travel retail exclusive set containing 3 miniatures of 15ml Omnia Amethyste Eau de Toilette, Omnia Crystalline Eau de Toilette and Omnia Coral Eau de Toilette. Set Contents: Omnia Amethyste Eau de Toilette 15ml Omnia Crystalline Eau de Toilette 15ml Omnia Coral Eau de Toilette 15ml

listings.rawTitle: Balmain Sel d'Ambre Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Introducing Balmain's Sel D'Ambre, a captivating scent that reveals warming nuances of spiced amber and cooling botanicals. Opening with amber essence upon first spritz, the aroma unfolds into a fresh melange of ambergris and olibanum. At its core, rukeri tea leaves soothe the senses with a comforting wind-down, while caramelised amber finalises the scent with a lasting impression of opulence.

listings.rawTitle: Baobab Collection Max 16 Feathers
listings.description: Notes: Black Rose, Oud Wood. The Boabab Collection Max Feathers scented candle is a luxurious addition to any space, captivating the senses with an opulent fragrance. The sensual softness of black rose is infused with the rich depths of oud wood, uplifting your surroundings with a seductive aroma. Crafted with hand-blown glass, the candle features black inlays, enveloping the sides in an elegant feathered effect. Available in various sizes, the candle features an enticing balance of fragrance while the flame will burn in harmony with the indulgently sleek design. Approximate burn times by size: Max 10: 60 hours Max 16: 150 hours Max 24: 400 hours Max 35: 800 hours

listings.rawTitle: Baobab Collection Max 24 Feathers
listings.description: Notes: Black Rose, Oud Wood. The Boabab Collection Max Feathers scented candle is a luxurious addition to any space, captivating the senses with an opulent fragrance. The sensual softness of black rose is infused with the rich depths of oud wood, uplifting your surroundings with a seductive aroma. listings.rawTitle: Baobab Collection Max 16 Stones Marble
listings.description: Notes: Leather, Tuberose, Berries. Embodying the duality of marble stones, this intoxicating scent captures the contrasting interplay of feminine and masculine elements through a fusion of leather notes, softened with powdery hues of tuberose and the sweetness of berries. The scented candle is housed in an ornate, marbled glass jar, expertly hand-blown by the brand’s artisans. The flickering flames from the candle shine through transparent pockets of the marbled vessel, illuminating your interior spaces to create a cosy ambiance and inspire a tranquil atmosphere. Approximate burn times by size: Max 10: 60 hours Max 16: 150 hours Max 24: 400 hours Max 35: 800 hours

listings.rawTitle: Baobab Collection Max 24 Pearls White
listings.description: Notes: Jasmine, White Musk. Baobab’s Pearls collection of scented candles pays tribute to the iridescent beauty of the milky gemstone, which have long been symbols of love and purity, and coined the ‘tears of the gods’. To reflect the collection’s theme, the candles are presented in pearlescent glass jars, expertly hand-blown by the house’s skilled artisans to create an ornate piece. Fusing powdery floral hues of Jasmine with the heady perfume of White Musk, the White Pearls edition unleashes an intoxicating aroma, that fills the air with an intimate ambiance. Featuring a centred wick that ensures a slow and even burn, the scented candle offers a long-lasting olfactory experience. Approximate burn times by size: Max 10: 60 hours Max 16: 150 hours Max 24: 400 hours Max 35: 800 hours

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Wanted By Night Eau de Parfum - 100ml
Baobab Collection Max 24 Gentlemen
listings.description: Notes: Rum, Saffron, Labdanum. Charge the atmosphere with the warm, inviting aromas and flickering flame of Baobab’s Gentlemen candle. Hand-poured into glass jars embellished with a blue print, the scented candle unleashes an intoxicating fragrance of rum, saffron and labdanum, creating a cosy ambiance in your home. Decorate your interiors or gift a loved one with this ornate piece. Approximate burn times by size: Max 10: 60 hours Max 16: 150 hours Max 24: 400 hours Max 35: 800 hours

listings.rawTitle: NEST New York Perfume Oil 5-Piece Discovery Set
listings.description: Capturing the essence of faraway landscapes, the NEST New York Perfume Oil Discovery Set features five transportive fragrances. Each discovery-sized perfume oil is centred around a single note, blended with boabob oil to nourish skin with each application. From the tropical aromas of Balinese Coconut to the sweetness of Madagascar Vanilla, the rollerballs can be worn alone or layered for a moment of wanderlust.  Set Contents: Balinese Coconut Rollerball 3ml Turkish Rose Rollerball 3ml Seville Orange Rollerball 3ml Indian Jasmine Rollerball 3ml Madagascar Vanilla Rollerball 3ml

listings.rawTitle: NEST New York Born to Travel Trio Set 20ml
listings.description: Take your signature scent wherever you venture with NEST New York's Born To Travel Trio Set. Inspired by tropical destinations from around the world, the discovery-sized trio spans notes of Madagascan vanilla, Balinese coconut and vanilla bourbon. Store in your handbag, carry-on or at home for a spritz of summer with each application. Set  Contents: Madagascar Vanilla Perfume Oil 6ml Balinese Coconut Perfume Oil 6ml Vanilla Bourbon Eau de Parfum 8ml

listings.rawTitle: The Nue Co. Mind Energy, Energizing Fragrance Travel Spray 10ml
listings.description: The Nue Co. Mind Energy is a fragrance supplement designed to be used when you need to power through a task. Formulated with upcycled extracts, the fragrance features an invigorating scent that acts as an instant pick-me-up. The fragrance is created around the knowledge that our sense of smell has a direct connection to areas of the brain associated with memory, awareness and mood. Notes of clary sage, juniper, pink peppercorn and clove lend a warm, fresh aroma. In consumer trials after 30 days of use, 86% of people felt they had more focus and 76% felt their productivity levels improved.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity Aromatic Essence for Women 50ml
listings.description: Introducing the Calvin Klein Women's Eternity Aromatic Essence, a floral fragrance that exudes an ultra-feminine freshness with bold, enticing notes. Opening with soft aquatic notes, the fragrance offers an enchanting take on the original fragrance with key lime and ambrette accords. At the heart, silky coconut water meets with peony and blackcurrant for an irresistible vibrant core. Sandalwood and lavender add a touch of richness and depth to the scent for an alluring but sensual finish. Housed in a lacquered teal green glass bottle, the fragrance’s flacon is inspired by the beauty of natural gemstones. The perfume maintains the shape and silver cap of the iconic original Eternity fragrances.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Born in Roma Uomo Coral Eau de Toilette for Him 100ml
listings.description: Valentino invites you to a new Rome at sunset with the Born in Roma Uomo Coral. Inspired by a coral-lit sky over the city, the fragrance celebrates a multi-faceted heritage with its fruity, sweet and sensual aromas. Opening the olfactive expression, the crunch of red apple is paired with its flavourful juice for a sparkling introduction. An aromatic heart of sage adds dimension, before settling on a base of tobacco for warmth and comfort. Instantly iconic, the bottle is adorned with a recognisable stud pattern that takes on a coral theme inspired by sundown in Rome.

listings.rawTitle: Clarins Soothing Gentle Foaming Cleanser 125ml
listings.description: Ideal for sensitive skin, the Clarins Day Care Soothing Gentle Foaming Cleanser is a multi-tasking solution that removes impurities while replenishing moisture. Made with shea butter, this cream-to-foam formula works to remove makeup and debris, alongside soothing and comforting areas of dryness. Supported by Alpine herb extracts from the Domaine Clarins, such as organic chamomile, yellow gentian, moringa and lemon balm to help balance, the cleanser reduces the appearance of uneven tone over time, encouraging a naturally radiant, refreshed result.

listings.rawTitle: Baobab Collection Max 16 Pearls Black
listings.description: Notes: Black Rose, Ginger. Adorn your home with the luxurious scent of Baobab’s Pearls Black candle. Elegant and mysteriously seductive, Black Rose is ignited by fiery Ginger. Adding a divine opulence to any space, the fragrance captures the essence of a precious and elusive natural beauty. The hand-poured scented candle is housed in an artisan glass vessel, speckled with flecks of black to mimic the tones of natural pearls. Designed in collaboration with renowned artistic photographer Peter Lippman, the scented candle offers both visual and sensorial appeal, epitomising luxury home fragrance and premium craftsmanship. Approximate burn times by size: Max 10: 60 hours Max 16: 150 hours Max 24: 400 hours Max 35: 800 hours

listings.rawTitle: The White Company Spa Sleep Mist 125ml
listings.description: Cocoon the senses in an air of calm with The White Company’s Spa Sleep Mist. Developed to support your wind-down rituals at the end of a busy day, this ultra-fine formula refreshes the skin as you get ready for bed, while delivering a light, herbal fragrance for a soothing scent moment. Infused with aloe vera and oatmeal, the mist provides instant cooling hydration, making it ideal as the first step in your evening skincare routine. Meanwhile, notes of lavender, clary sage and chamomile intertwine to relax the senses, inviting you to pause and make more space for holistic self-care.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Soleil Neige Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Soleil Neige is a ray of solar light – a breath of winter air that conjures sun on fresh alpine snow. Radiant and exhilarating, it captivates with bright citrus, white florals and musk. TOM FORD’s winter world conjures the thrill of a day on the slopes that melts into the celebratory warmth of après-ski. A cool burst of bright and green citrus gives way to a bouquet of winter white florals and rose absolute. The fluted flacon is glazed in a warm-white hue paired with the gleam of sliver-toned accents, evoking the luminosity of sun on snow.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Eau D'Ombre Leather Eau de Toilette 100ml
listings.description: Rich, luminous notes meet in the Tom Ford Eau d'Ombré Leather Eau de Toilette. The wildly radiant composition fuses rich amber, vanilla, leather and invigorating spices to capture the essence of a new day rising over the American West. Fresh ginger, coriander and cardamom spark an aromatic introduction that fuels a glowing leather accord. Grounded by a flame of amber and honeyed woods, the Eau de Toilette presents a sensual and enticing scent trail.

listings.rawTitle: Le Monde Gourmand Lait de Coco Eau De Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Capturing the very essence of sun-warmed coconut, Le Monde Gourmand’s Lait de Coco Eau De Parfum is a best-selling scent, capable of whisking the senses away to tropical planes where every day is a beach day. Hanging above stretches of powdery white sands, creamy coconut ripens, while nuances of bergamot dance along crystal-clear waters. Vanilla praline indulges the composition in a slightly toasted, warm trail, underpinning the milky coconut with an inviting allure. Fresh, delicious and reminiscent of summer, spritz this fragrance whenever you need a slice of sunshine.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Eros Energy Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Paying homage to the Greek God of love, the Versace Eros Energy Eau de Parfum is a woody-citrus iteration of the iconic original Eros fragrance. Symbolising the serenity of the Mediterranean coastline as the crisp waves lullaby nearby, the cologne features vibrant bergamot, blood orange and grapefruit notes to capture the beauty of its bountiful nature. Italian lemon imbues a zested, fresh aroma, before warm green nuances of patchouli and oakmoss provide a deep, authentic edge with a long-lasting sillage. Arriving in the signature quadratic bottle, embossed with Eros’ portrait in a new, yellow hue, the eau de parfum sits proudly on any dresser.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Flowers and Flames Eau de Parfum 90ml
listings.description: Building on the success and glamour of Yves Saint Laurent Libre, the Flowers and Flames Eau de Parfum Spray offers a vibrant, fiery twist on the beloved original. The blazing fusion settles with an intensified warmth, emboldening she who wears it. Bold in both scent and elegance, bergamot essence opens the fragrance with a zesty start to awaken the senses. At the heart, Libre’s signature orange blossom inspires sensuality and seduction, set ablaze by spiced desert lily in a flaming twist. Creamy vanilla interrupts for a sweet taste of gourmand accords, met with hints of coconut and ylang-ylang to lure those who cross her path. Tailored with YSL’s craftmanship, the perfume’s flacon is set alight with a golden glow, reflecting the sun-kissed warmth hidden inside.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Elixir de Parfum For Him 60ml
listings.description: Extending a loving invitation to explore, create and connect with our truest selves, Gucci Guilty Pour Femme and Pour Homme fragrances launches with a campaign starring A$AP Rocky, Julia Garner and Elliot Page. An ode to self-acceptance, friendship and love in all its forms. An intense fragrance for an intense connection, Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Elixir de Parfum is a woody, ambery leather fragrance for men. Guilty Elixirs are a daring assertion, a colourful extraversion: captivating and sophisticated scents that extend a loving invitation to accept who we are and let our authentic selves be seen while celebrating the countless iterations of love. Perfumers Quentin Bisch and Nathalie Cetto embued this Gucci fragrance with a bold and sensual base of vanillin, Ambrofix, and benzoin, which is intensified by an overdose of patchouli, complemented by a flamboyant and noble heart of orris butter, orange flower, and sensuous osmanthus. The fragrance for men is rounded off by tempting accents of peppery pimento and smoky nutmeg. This Gucci scent is contained within a refreshing green glass bottle, a sophisticated shade that symbolises refined masculinity and is a reflection of the intense fragrance that lies within. The bottle of this gorgeous scent unexpectedly plays with transparencies and features a debossed interlocking GG logo: precious ingredients concentrated in a flask.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent MYSLF Le Parfum 60ml
listings.description: A radicalisation of the original scent, Yves Saint Laurent's MYSLF Le Parfum offers a more intense, more powerful and more sensual olfactive experience. The refillable fragrance layers lavish orange blossom with textured woods, embodying an expression of modern masculinity and the statement of embracing all your facets and emotions. The floral-wood fusion opens with a fresh burst of bergamot, warmed by a medley of spices including black pepper, cardamom and cinnamon. Beating at the heart, orange blossom absolute creates a rich, honeyed facet that drys down to reveal woods and a silky vanilla bourbon infusion. Sleek, timeless and expertly crafted, the perfume bottle is adorned with matte black lacquering and the iconic YSL Cassandre logo sculpted into the glass.

listings.rawTitle: Ghost Orb of Night Eau de Parfum Spray 30ml
listings.description: Inspired by a rendezvous beneath a rose moon, Ghost’s Orb of Night Eau de Parfum Spray mesmerises with gourmand nuances and ethereal florals. Romance is revealed with alluring cherry-almond, flirting with a bouquet of orange blossom, freesia and jasmine. Caramel melts upon a base of warm sandalwood and white musk, capturing the transformative moments of sundown and sunrise. Elevate your scent ritual from dusk until dawn, with the crescent-shaped bottle offering a seamless refill experience.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Goddess Intense Eau de Parfum Intense for Women 100ml
listings.description: Embark on a journey of self-discovery found through renewed confidence and strength with Burberry fragrance. An intensified interpretation of the original, Burberry Goddess Intense Eau de Parfum unveils a long-lasting gourmand aromatic woody scent for any occasion. The signature trio of vanillas from Goddess is amplified with a fourth vanilla wood to add smoky character. When combined with a luminous lavender essence, the scent is intensified with a vibrant woody edge. Inspired by the colours at sunset, the perfume bottle features a sleek square silhouette which allows the luminous ambery fragrance to shine through. The vegan perfume is designed to be refilled for an endless scent trail. Refill sold separately.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Man Rain Essence Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: An homage to the thrilling trail of a natural element, BVLGARI Man’s Rain Essence Eau de Parfum exudes power. The fragrance is an invitation to explore the force of water, merging fresh and woody notes for an intoxicating olfactory experience. An elixir of green tea and orange essence introduces the scent, invigorating the senses with a juxtaposition of earthy and citrus nuances. At the heart lies a white lotus accord, lending the fragrance a floral twist, before diffusing into a warm base of amber and guaiac wood.
